lemmas.def_en: the periodic rise and fall of the sea level under the gravitational pull of the moon
lemmas.def_zh: 潮, 潮汐, 趋势, 潮流, 涨潮, 高潮

examples.en: The evening tide was coming in rapidly along the rocky shore.
examples.zh: 傍晚的潮水正沿着岩石海岸迅速上涨。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指自然潮汐，也常引申为时代思潮或局势发展，常见搭配如 turn the tide、high tide。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by tides
lemmas.def_zh: 潮汐的, 受潮汐影响的

examples.en: The coastal village relies heavily on tidal energy for its electricity.
examples.zh: 这个沿海村庄很大程度上依赖潮汐能发电。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语，用于描述与潮水规律相关的自然现象，常见搭配如 tidal wave、tidal power。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. (tide someone over) to help someone get through a difficult period, especially with money or food 2. to drift or float with the tide
lemmas.def_zh: 帮助（某人）渡过难关（常与 over 连用）；随潮漂流，顺潮行驶

examples.en: The disabled boat managed to tide into the harbor with the morning current.
examples.zh: 这艘失去动力的船借着早潮成功漂进了海港。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要用于航海语境表示顺潮航行，或与 over 连用构成短语动词 tide over，意为帮助渡过难关。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指“时间、季节”，后引申指受时间支配的海洋“潮汐”，动词引申为“随潮漂流”或“渡过难关”。

lemmas.def_en: the bottom of a shoe or boot; the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation
lemmas.def_zh: 脚后跟, 踵, 后部, 倾侧

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her left heel after walking in new boots all day.
examples.zh: 穿着新靴子走了一整天后，她感到左脚后跟剧痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指脚后跟、鞋袜后跟或船只的倾斜度，常用于 high heels 或 at someone's heels 等习语。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (especially of a boat or ship) To lean over or tilt to one side; to cause to lean over.
lemmas.def_zh: （船只等）倾斜，倾侧；使倾斜；紧随，尾随

examples.en: The strong gust of wind caused the sailboat to heel sharply to starboard.
examples.zh: 一阵强风使帆船向右舷剧烈倾斜。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于航海指船体倾侧，训犬时用作祈使句命狗紧随，也可指给鞋钉跟或用脚跟传球。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义指“脚后跟”或鞋袜的“后跟”，动词可表示给鞋装跟，或（受外力使船身）“倾斜”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To hit a person or animal with a whip or strap. 2. To beat cream, eggs, etc. until light and firm. 3. To move or take something quickly and suddenly.
lemmas.def_zh: 鞭打，抽打；搅打（奶油等）；迅速拿取；猛冲

examples.en: The pastry chef began to whip the cold cream until stiff peaks formed.
examples.zh: 糕点师开始搅打冷藏奶油，直到形成硬性发泡。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示鞭笞、快速搅打食材、迅速抽动或风强力吹拂，常用于 whip up 或 whip out。

lemmas.def_en: an instrument with a handle and a flexible lash that is used for whipping
lemmas.def_zh: 鞭子, 抽打, 车夫, 搅拌器

examples.en: The rider held the whip firmly in his hand as he guided the horse.
examples.zh: 骑手引导马匹时，手里紧握着皮鞭。

lemmas.usage_note: 指实体皮鞭，在政治语境中专指政党纪律主管（党鞭），常见搭配如 a leather whip。

lemmas.def_en: a person who administers punishment by wielding a switch or whip
lemmas.def_zh: 鞭打者；抽打者；似用鞭子抽打者

examples.en: The kitchen staff replaced the broken cream whipper before the dinner rush began.
examples.zh: 厨房员工在晚餐高峰开始前更换了损坏的奶油发泡器。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词源，模仿快速挥动的破空声，引申为“鞭子、抽打”及迅速的动作或快速搅拌食物。

lemmas.def_en: the word class that serves as the predicate of a sentence
lemmas.def_zh: 动词

examples.en: Every complete English sentence must contain at least one finite verb.
examples.zh: 每个完整的英语句子都必须包含至少一个限定动词。

lemmas.usage_note: 语法学术语，表示动作或状态的动词，常见搭配如 modal verb、phrasal verb 等。

lemmas.def_en: communicated in the form of words
lemmas.def_zh: 用言辞的, 言语的, 口头的, 逐字的, 动词的

examples.en: The two parties reached a verbal agreement before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 双方在签署合同之前达成了口头协议。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指口头的（非书面的）或文字上的，在语法中指动词的，常见搭配如 verbal agreement、verbal abuse。

lemmas.def_en: being other than verbal communication
lemmas.def_zh: 不用语言的；不用动词的

examples.en: Her subtle nonverbal cues revealed that she was uncomfortable with the sudden question.
examples.zh: 她微妙的非言语线索表明她对这个突如其来的问题感到不适。

lemmas.def_en: as a verb
lemmas.def_zh: 口头地, 非书面地

examples.en: He was warned verbally by his supervisor before receiving a formal written reprimand.
examples.zh: 在收到正式书面申诫之前，主管对他进行了口头警告。

lemmas.def_en: without words
lemmas.def_zh: 非动词（形式）地

examples.en: The teacher communicated nonverbally by tapping the desk to regain the students' attention.
examples.zh: 老师通过敲桌子这种非语言方式来重新吸引学生的注意力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 verbum（词语），在语法中专指表达动作或状态的核心成分“动词”，派生词 verbal 兼指动词的或口头的。

lemmas.def_en: the hard durable wood of any oak; used especially for furniture and flooring
lemmas.def_zh: 橡树, 橡木

examples.en: A massive ancient oak tree provides abundant shade in the town square.
examples.zh: 一棵巨大的古老橡树在城镇广场上投下大片绿荫。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示橡树为可数，作橡木/家具材质时多用作不可数名词或前置定语，如 an oak table、solid oak。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，特指“橡树”及其木材，在西方文化中象征坚韧和持久。

lemmas.def_en: an outbuilding (or part of a building) for housing automobiles
lemmas.def_zh: 车库, 汽车修理厂, 机库

examples.en: He parked his new car in the underground garage to protect it from the rain.
examples.zh: 他把新车停在地下车库以防淋雨。

lemmas.usage_note: 指停放车辆的车库或提供保养检修的汽车修理厂，常见搭配如 parking garage、car garage。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To put, keep, or store a motor vehicle in a garage.
lemmas.def_zh: 把（车）存放在车库中，停入车库

examples.en: She always garages her classic convertible during the snowy winter months.
examples.zh: 在多雪的冬季，她总是把经典款敞篷车存入车库。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将车辆存放在车库中或送去车厂检修，常用于日常驾车及保养语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 garer（停放、庇护），指停放或维修车辆的“车库/修车厂”，动词表示“把车停进车库”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To push a knife or other sharp, pointed object into someone or something.
lemmas.def_zh: 刺，戳，刺伤

examples.en: The attacker tried to stab the security guard with a pocket knife.
examples.zh: 袭击者试图用一把折叠小刀刺伤保安。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用利器刺、戳，也可引申指突发的情感剧痛或尖锐刺痛，常与 at、in 连用。

lemmas.def_en: in a stable solid fixed manner
lemmas.def_zh: 坚固地, 安定地

examples.en: The economic indicators have been rising stably over the past three fiscal quarters.
examples.zh: 在过去的三个财政季度中，经济指标一直在稳定上升。

lemmas.def_en: someone who stabs another person
lemmas.def_zh: 刺的东西, 锥子, 刺客, 穿索针

examples.en: Police are still searching the dark alleys for the knife-wielding stabber tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚警方仍在黑暗的小巷中搜寻那名持刀行凶者。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼动作词源，指用尖锐武器“刺、戳”，引申为刺痛感或一次尝试。

lemmas.def_en: a murderer (especially one who kills a prominent political figure) who kills by a surprise attack and often is hired to do the deed
lemmas.def_zh: 暗杀者, 刺客

examples.en: The hired assassin waited silently in the shadows for his target to arrive.
examples.zh: 雇来的刺客在阴影中静静等待目标的到来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指出于政治、宗教或受雇金钱目的行刺名人的暗杀者，常见搭配如 paid assassin、hired assassin。

lemmas.def_en: an attack intended to ruin someone's reputation
lemmas.def_zh: 暗杀

examples.en: The sudden assassination of the prime minister plunged the nation into chaos.
examples.zh: 首相的突然遇刺使整个国家陷入了混乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 指针对重要公众人物的暗杀行径或事件，常用于政治历史语境，常见搭配如 assassination attempt。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To murder an important political or public figure deliberately, usually for political reasons. 2. [T] To deliberately destroy someone's reputation.
lemmas.def_zh: 暗杀，行刺；诋毁，破坏（名誉等）

examples.en: Conspirators hatched a secret plan to assassinate the king during the parade.
examples.zh: 阴谋分子密谋在游行期间刺杀国王。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语（原指中世纪极端教派成员），专指受雇或出于政治宗教目的行凶的“暗杀者、刺客”。
family_guide.core_distinction: assassin 指实施暗杀的人；assassination 指暗杀行动这一事件。

lemmas.def_en: someone who pursues a study or sport as a pastime
lemmas.def_zh: 业余爱好者, 外行, 爱好者

examples.en: Although he is an amateur, his oil paintings rival those of professional artists.
examples.zh: 虽然他是个业余爱好者，但他的油画作品却能媲美职业艺术家。

lemmas.usage_note: 指非职业的业余爱好者，有时带有贬义指技术不纯熟的门外汉，常见搭配如 rank amateur。

lemmas.def_en: engaged in as a pastime
lemmas.def_zh: [电] 业余家

examples.en: He earned his first title by winning the national amateur golf championship.
examples.zh: 他通过赢得全国业余高尔夫锦标赛获得了自己的首个头衔。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰活动、运动或团体，指业余性质的而非职业化的，常见搭配如 amateur athletics、amateur radio。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 amare（爱），本义为“出于爱好而做某事的人”，即“业余爱好者”，引申含“不专业”之意。

lemmas.def_en: obscene terms for female genitals
lemmas.def_zh: 〈非正式〉猫咪；〈侮辱〉女阴；〈侮辱〉娘娘腔

examples.en: The frightened little pussy curled up under the warm sofa during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫咪蜷缩在温暖的沙发下面。

lemmas.usage_note: 童语中可指 pussycat（小猫）；但在现代成人俚语中极度粗俗，兼指女性生殖器或胆小懦弱者，正式场合务必严格避免。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声或儿语起源，最早是小猫的爱称（puss），后在俚语中泛化为多种非正式或贬义含义。

lemmas.def_en: the likelihood of a thing occurring rather than not occurring
lemmas.def_zh: 可能性, 几率, 机会, 胜算, 不平等

examples.en: Against all incredible odds, the underdog team won the final championship match yesterday.
examples.zh: 出乎所有人的意料，这支不被看好的队伍昨天赢得了决赛冠军。

lemmas.usage_note: 恒用复数，高频搭配 The odds are that...（很可能…）、against all odds（克服一切阻碍）及 be at odds with（与…不和/冲突）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 odd（奇数的、不平等的），从“不平等、差异”引申出博彩中的“赔率”以及事情发生的“几率、可能性”。

lemmas.def_en: an arm of a sea or ocean partly enclosed by land; larger than a bay
lemmas.def_zh: 海湾, 深渊, 漩涡, 隔阂

examples.en: A wide generational gulf still exists between the teenage students and their parents.
examples.zh: 青少年学生与他们的父母之间仍然存在着巨大的代沟。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理上专指“海湾”（如 the Persian Gulf）；比喻义极高频，指人或群体间巨大的鸿沟，常搭配 a gulf between A and B。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kolpos（海湾、怀抱），指三面环陆的大片海洋（海湾），引申为两者之间巨大的“隔阂、鸿沟”。

lemmas.def_en: bringing death
lemmas.def_zh: 致命的, 重大的, 命运注定的, 粗心的, 不幸的

examples.en: The speeding driver was involved in a fatal car accident on the highway.
examples.zh: 超速驾驶的司机在公路上遭遇了一场致命的车祸。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调导致死亡的、灾难性的或产生毁灭性后果的，修饰事故、疾病、错误等，常见搭配如 fatal mistake。

lemmas.def_en: not bringing death
lemmas.def_zh: 非致命的

examples.en: The driver miraculously survived the highway crash with only several minor, nonfatal injuries.
examples.zh: 司机在高速公路车祸中奇迹生还，仅受了几处非致命的轻伤。

lemmas.def_en: a death resulting from an accident or a disaster
lemmas.def_zh: 不幸, 厄运, 致命性, 死亡者, 厄运, 天命

examples.en: Authorities confirmed there was not a single fatality in the dramatic train derailment.
examples.zh: 当局证实，在这起严重的火车脱轨事故中没有人员死亡。

lemmas.def_en: with fatal consequences or implications
lemmas.def_zh: 致命地, 不幸地, 宿命地

examples.en: The reckless decision fatally compromised the entire security network within a few hours.
examples.zh: 这一鲁莽的决定在数小时内对整个安全网络造成了毁灭性的破坏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fatum（命运、劫数），原指“命中注定的”，后演变为带来不可逆转毁灭的“致命的”。

lemmas.def_en: a ductile malleable reddish-brown corrosion-resistant diamagnetic metallic element; occurs in various minerals but is the only metal that occurs abundantly in large masses; used as an electrical and thermal conductor
lemmas.def_zh: 铜, 警察

examples.en: Water pipes made of copper are widely favored for their durability and corrosion resistance.
examples.zh: 铜制水管因其耐用性和抗腐蚀性而受到广泛青睐。

lemmas.usage_note: 指化学元素金属铜或铜币，在英美口语中也可俗指警察，常见搭配如 copper pipe、copper wire。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To cover or coat something with a layer of copper.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……包铜；给……镀铜

examples.en: Shipbuilders used to copper the hulls of wooden vessels to prevent marine rot.
examples.zh: 造船工人过去常用铜包覆木船的船体，以防止海洋生物侵蚀腐烂。

lemmas.usage_note: 工艺技术用语，指在物体表面镀铜或用铜皮包覆，常用于造船与工业加工领域。

lemmas.def_en: of something having the color of copper
lemmas.def_zh: 含铜的, 铜一样的, 铜制的

examples.en: Her long coppery hair glowed brilliantly beneath the bright rays of afternoon sunlight.
examples.zh: 在午后明亮的阳光下，她那一头红铜色的长发闪闪发光。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cyprium（塞浦路斯岛的金属，古时盛产铜），指金属“铜”，在口语中因英国铜质警察徽章引申为“警察”。

lemmas.def_en: a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
lemmas.def_zh: （评判的）标准，准则

examples.en: Academic ability is not the sole criterion for college admission.
examples.zh: 学业能力并不是大学录取的唯一标准。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术书面语，单数为 criterion，复数是 criteria；常与 meet/satisfy 搭配，切忌将复数当单数使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 krinein（判断、决定），核心义为用作判断或评估的尺度、标准。

lemmas.def_en: a businessperson engaged in retail trade
lemmas.def_zh: 商人，批发商；商业的

examples.en: The tea merchant travels across Asia to source the finest leaves.
examples.zh: 这位茶商穿梭于亚洲各地以采购最优质的茶叶。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面多指批发商或外贸商（如 merchant bank），英式口语中常作后缀构成复合词（如 speed merchant 飙车狂）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mercari（交易、经商），指从事大宗商品买卖的商人或与商业相关的。

lemmas.def_en: a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
lemmas.def_zh: 危险，危害；隐患

examples.en: Accumulated clutter in the hallway poses a serious fire hazard.
examples.zh: 走廊里堆积的杂物构成了严重的火灾隐患。

lemmas.usage_note: 危险，危害；隐患

lemmas.def_en: involving risk or danger
lemmas.def_zh: 危险的，有害的

examples.en: Workers must wear protective gear when handling hazardous chemicals.
examples.zh: 工人在处理危险化学品时必须穿戴防护装备。

lemmas.usage_note: 指对人身安全或健康具有危险性，常修饰 waste, materials, conditions 等名词。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To risk putting forward a guess, suggestion, or opinion that might be wrong. 2. [T] To put something at risk of danger or loss.
lemmas.def_zh: 大胆猜测，冒昧提出；使冒危险，冒……的险

examples.en: I would not hazard a guess as to what the final outcome might be.
examples.zh: 我不敢妄加猜测最终的结果会是什么。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于书面语，表示冒着风险提出猜想或建议，常见搭配 hazard a guess/opinion。

lemmas.def_en: in a dangerous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 冒险地, 有危险地

examples.en: The old wooden bridge swayed hazardously in the ferocious winds of the hurricane.
examples.zh: 那座老木桥在飓风的狂风中危险地摇晃着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语骰子游戏，后引申为可能带来伤害的偶然危险或隐患。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make pain, anxiety, or a difficult situation less severe. 2. [T] To replace someone who is on duty.
lemmas.def_zh: 缓解，减轻（痛苦、压力等）；使宽慰；接替，换班

examples.en: Taking a warm bath can significantly relieve muscle tension after a workout.
examples.zh: 锻炼后泡个温水澡可以显著缓解肌肉紧张。

lemmas.usage_note: 意为减轻痛苦、焦虑或负担，常与 pain, stress, tension 或 oneself 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes the place of another (as when things get dangerous or difficult)
lemmas.def_zh: 解除痛苦的人, 接替者, 救济者

examples.en: She took a fast-acting pain reliever to ease her intense pounding headache.
examples.zh: 她服用了速效止痛药来缓解剧烈的偏头痛。

lemmas.def_en: not lessened or diminished
lemmas.def_zh: 未减轻的, 未受救济的

examples.en: Days of unrelieved heat made everyone in the office irritable and thoroughly exhausted.
examples.zh: 连日不减的酷热让办公室里的每个人都焦躁不安、疲惫不堪。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再、向后）+ lieve（源自拉丁语 levare 减轻、举起），核心义为减轻负担或痛苦。

lemmas.def_en: a person employed to keep watch for some anticipated event
lemmas.def_zh: 侦察；物色，搜寻

examples.en: A talent scout from a major record label attended her performance last night.
examples.zh: 一家大唱片公司的星探昨晚观看了她的演出。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指童子军、侦察员或物色人才的星探，常用搭配 talent scout 或 on the scout。

lemmas.def_en: an adult member of the Boy Scouts movement
lemmas.def_zh: 侦察者, 男童子军

examples.en: An experienced talent scouter attended the youth tournament to discover promising young players.
examples.zh: 一位经验丰富的星探参加了青年锦标赛，以发掘有潜力的年轻球员。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To explore an area in order to gather information about enemy positions or terrain. 2. To look searchingly for someone or something having specific qualities.
lemmas.def_zh: 侦察，勘查；物色，搜寻

examples.en: The director spent weeks scouting for suitable filming locations in the mountains.
examples.zh: 导演花了数周时间在山区物色合适的拍摄场地。

lemmas.usage_note: 指四处搜寻、物色或提前侦察，常与介词 for 或 around 连用，如 scout for locations。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 escouter（倾听、侦察），核心义为暗中观察、搜集信息。

lemmas.def_en: of marriages and offspring; recognized as lawful
lemmas.def_zh: 合法的，正当的，合情合理的

examples.en: The residents raised legitimate concerns about the safety of the new power plant.
examples.zh: 居民们对新发电厂的安全性提出了合情合理的担忧。

lemmas.usage_note: 指符合法律、规则或逻辑常理的，常搭配 legitimate concern/reason/business。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner acceptable to common custom
lemmas.def_zh: 正当地；合理地

examples.en: You can legitimately claim these travel expenses back from your employer next week.
examples.zh: 下周你可以合情合理地向雇主报销这些差旅费。

lemmas.def_zh: 合法, 正统, 正当
lemmas.def_en: lawfulness by virtue of being authorized or in accordance with law

examples.en: The controversial election led many citizens to question the legitimacy of the government.
examples.zh: 这场充满争议的选举导致许多民众质疑该政府的合法性。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指合法性、正统性或合理性，常与 grant, question, lose 连用。

lemmas.def_en: the act of rendering a person legitimate
lemmas.def_zh: 合法化, 认为嫡出

examples.en: The passage of the new law provided the needed legitimation for the merger.
examples.zh: 新法律的通过为此次合并提供了必要的合法化支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 lex/legis（法律），核心义为符合法律、规则或逻辑常理的。

lemmas.def_en: any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
lemmas.def_zh: 现象；杰出的人（或事）

examples.en: Glacial retreat has become a widespread phenomenon driven by global climate change.
examples.zh: 冰川消退已成为全球气候变化引发的一种普遍现象。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指客观存在的现象或非凡之人事；复数形式为phenomena，常与natural、cultural等连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 phainein（展现、显现），指观察到的非凡事物或自然发生的可感知事实。

lemmas.def_en: a failure to perform some promised act or obligation
lemmas.def_zh: 突破，攻破；违背

examples.en: The company faced severe penalties following a massive breach of user data privacy.
examples.zh: 该公司在发生大规模用户数据隐私泄露后，面临着严厉的处罚。

lemmas.usage_note: 指对契约、规则的违反或物理防御的破口，常见搭配如breach of contract、security breach。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To violate or break a law, agreement, rule, or contract. 2. [T] To make a gap or opening in a wall, barrier, or defense.
lemmas.def_zh: 违犯，撕毁（协议、规则）；突破，攻破

examples.en: Hackers managed to breach the internal network and steal sensitive corporate documents.
examples.zh: 黑客成功攻破内部网络，窃取了敏感的公司文件。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指攻破防线、突破屏障或违反协议法规，多用于正式法律及安全语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 与 break（打破）同源，指通过破裂或违反而造成的缺口或破坏。

lemmas.def_en: an organization formed by merging several groups or parties
lemmas.def_zh: 联邦，同盟，联合会

examples.en: Several independent trade unions united to form a powerful national federation.
examples.zh: 几个独立的工会联合起来，组成了一个强大的全国性联合会。

lemmas.usage_note: 指多个州、国或组织结成的联邦或联合会，政治及行业组织中广泛使用该词。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）结成联邦，（使）联合
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To join together to form a federation, or to cause states or organizations to unite in a federation.

examples.en: Several independent labor unions decided to federate to increase their collective bargaining power.
examples.zh: 几个独立的工会决定联合起来，以增强他们的集体谈判权。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 foedus（条约、盟约），指各独立组织或邦联依据盟约联合而成的团体。

lemmas.def_en: an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:
lemmas.def_zh: （活动、影响等的）范围；施展机会

examples.en: This controversial topic clearly falls outside the scope of our current research project.
examples.zh: 这一具有争议的话题显然超出了我们目前研究项目的范围。

lemmas.usage_note: 常表示调查、研究的范围或施展才能的机会，常与beyond、within或动词limit搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 skopein（注视、看），原指瞄准的目标，引申为视界所及或行动开展的范围。

lemmas.def_en: a visual representation of the relations between certain quantities plotted with reference to a set of axes
lemmas.def_zh: 用图表表示，绘制坐标图

examples.en: The graph clearly illustrates the sharp decline in retail sales over the last quarter.
examples.zh: 该图表清晰地展示了上个季度零售额的急剧下降。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用曲线或直条表现数值关系的图表，常见搭配有bar graph、line graph等。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To plot or represent mathematical data, functions, or relationships on a graph or chart.
lemmas.def_zh: 用图表（或坐标图）表示，绘制图表

examples.en: The researchers graphed the experimental results to identify long-term temperature trends.
examples.zh: 研究人员将实验结果绘制成图表，以找出长期的温度变化趋势。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，意为在坐标图上绘制数据或函数图像，常用于数学、统计学等学术领域。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or presented by a graph
lemmas.def_zh: 图的, 记录的, 图示的, 图解的, 书法的, 绘画的, 印刷的, 雕刻的, 详尽的

examples.en: Modern computers rely on a graphical user interface to make navigation intuitive.
examples.zh: 现代计算机依靠图形用户界面使操作更加直观。

lemmas.def_en: in a diagrammatic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 生动地, 活灵活现地, (正式)用图表表示, 以图显示

examples.en: The documentary graphically illustrated the harsh realities of living in extreme poverty.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片生动形象地展现了生活在极端贫困中的残酷现实。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 graphein（书写、描绘），用线条或图形展示数据关系。

lemmas.def_en: how much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
lemmas.def_zh: 数量，分量

examples.en: The factory produces high-tech components in vast quantities to meet foreign demand.
examples.zh: 该工厂大批量生产高科技零部件，以满足国外需求。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示事物的数量、分量，常用于in large quantities或quality vs quantity对比中。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 量化, 定量
lemmas.def_en: a limitation imposed on the variables of a proposition (as by the quantifiers `some' or `all' or `no')

examples.en: Accurate quantification of greenhouse gas emissions is essential for effective environmental policy.
examples.zh: 对温室气体排放量的准确量化对有效的环境政策至关重要。

lemmas.def_zh: 数量词, 精于计算的人
lemmas.def_en: (logic) a word (such as `some' or `all' or `no') that binds the variables in a logical proposition

lemmas.def_zh: 量化，以数量表示，测定……的数量
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To measure or express the amount, size, or degree of something in numbers.

examples.en: It remains extremely difficult to quantify the precise economic cost of the natural disaster.
examples.zh: 要量化这场自然灾害造成的确切经济损失仍然极其困难。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指以数字或具体量值测定评估，常见搭配如quantify the risk/impact。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quantus（多少），表示事物的数量、分量或体量。

lemmas.def_en: any of various long-tailed primates (excluding the prosimians)
lemmas.def_zh: 胡闹；乱动，捣弄

examples.en: The mischievous little monkey hid his sister's favorite toy behind the sofa.
examples.zh: 那个淘气的小猴子把他妹妹最喜欢的玩具藏在了沙发后面。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为猴子，口语中也常指淘气调皮的小孩，属于非正式、具口语色彩的日常词汇。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ with/around) To play or tamper with something carelessly, foolishly, or without permission.
lemmas.def_zh: 胡乱摆弄，瞎捣弄；胡闹，瞎搞

examples.en: Don't monkey with the engine settings unless you know exactly what you are doing.
examples.zh: 除非你非常清楚自己在做什么，否则别瞎摆弄发动机的设置。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与with或around连用（monkey with/around），表示瞎摆弄、胡乱干预。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指灵巧好动的小猴子，后用作动词借代像猴子般调皮摆弄或胡乱改动。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To consider something theoretically or separately from concrete realities; to extract or remove; to summarize.
lemmas.def_zh: 抽象地考虑，把……抽象出来；提炼，提取；作摘要

examples.en: The automated software can rapidly abstract key data points from complex clinical records.
examples.zh: 该自动化软件能够迅速从复杂的临床记录中提取关键数据点。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示提取、抽象化或为论文写摘要，搭配如abstract...from...，偏正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: a concept or idea not associated with any specific instance
lemmas.def_zh: 抽象的；理论上的

examples.en: Please submit a two-hundred-word abstract before submitting the full academic paper.
examples.zh: 在提交完整的学术论文之前，请先提交一份200字的摘要。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，通常指学术论文的摘要、梗概或抽象艺术作品，常见于学术规范及艺术讨论中。

lemmas.def_en: a concept or idea not associated with any specific instance
lemmas.def_zh: 抽象化, 心不在焉, 空想, 提炼, 抽象派作品

examples.en: Philosophers often deal with concepts that exist only in high levels of abstraction.
examples.zh: 哲学家经常探讨那些仅存在于高度抽象层面的概念。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being considered apart from a specific instance or object
lemmas.def_zh: 抽象性

examples.en: The extreme abstractness of his lecture made it very difficult for students to follow.
examples.zh: 他演讲极高的抽象性使学生们很难跟上思路。

lemmas.def_en: existing only in the mind; separated from embodiment
lemmas.def_zh: 抽象的；理论上的

examples.en: Truth and justice are abstract concepts that can be interpreted in numerous ways.
examples.zh: 真理与正义是抽象的概念，可以有多种不同的解读方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指抽象的、概念性的而非具体的，常见搭配如abstract concept、abstract art。

lemmas.def_en: in abstract terms
lemmas.def_zh: 抽象地；理论上地

examples.en: It is much easier to discuss justice abstractly than to apply it in practice.
examples.zh: 抽象地讨论正义比将其付诸实践要容易得多。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 abs-（离开）+ tract（拉、抽取），核心义为从具体物象中抽取概念、概要。

lemmas.def_en: likely but not certain to be or become true or real
lemmas.def_zh: 很可能的，大概的

examples.en: Equipment failure is considered the most probable explanation for the sudden power outage.
examples.zh: 设备故障被认为是造成突发停电的最可能原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示极有可能发生的，概率高于possible，常见搭配如probable cause、probable outcome。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the Roman Catholic philosophy of probabilism
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 概率性的

examples.en: Scientists use probabilistic models to predict the likely paths of approaching storms.
examples.zh: 科学家使用概率模型来预测逼近风暴的可能路径。

lemmas.def_en: a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur; a number expressing the ratio of favorable cases to the whole number of cases possible
lemmas.def_zh: 可能性，几率

examples.en: Statisticians estimated a high probability of rain during the upcoming outdoor festival.
examples.zh: 统计人员估计在即将举行的户外节日期间降雨的几率很高。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指概率、可能性，常用于in all probability（十分可能）或high/low probability中。

lemmas.def_en: by the use of probability theory
lemmas.def_zh: 有概率性地

examples.en: The risk of system failure can be evaluated probabilistically based on historical data.
examples.zh: 系统发生故障的风险可以根据历史数据进行概率评估。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 probare（证明、检验），指经检验极可能发生或成立的事物。

lemmas.def_en: involving financial matters
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 财政的，国库的；会计的

examples.en: The government introduced aggressive fiscal measures to curb rising inflation rates.
examples.zh: 政府推出了强有力的财政措施以抑制不断上升的通胀率。

lemmas.usage_note: 专门修饰国家财政、政府税收或企业会计事务，高频搭配如fiscal policy、fiscal year。

lemmas.def_en: in financial matters
lemmas.def_zh: 在国库方面, 财政上, 在国库岁入方面

examples.en: The government must remain fiscally responsible to keep the national deficit under control.
examples.zh: 政府必须在财政上保持负责，以控制国家赤字。

lemmas.def_zh: 国库
lemmas.def_en: a state treasury or exchequer or a royal treasury; originally the public treasury of Rome or the emperor's private purse

examples.en: The prolonged military campaign drained the imperial fisc and caused severe financial distress.
examples.zh: 长期的军事行动耗尽了国库，造成了严重的财政危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fiscus（原指编织的钱篮，后指国库），专指与国家或公共财政相关的事务。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To annoy, worry, or trouble someone repeatedly through unpleasant or threatening behavior.
lemmas.def_zh: 骚扰，侵扰；不断困扰，烦扰

examples.en: He was accused of harassing his former colleagues with threatening phone calls.
examples.zh: 他被指控用恐吓电话骚扰前同事。

lemmas.usage_note: 指反复骚扰、滋扰或使人备受折磨，常用于被动语态或作及物动词带人作宾语。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of intense annoyance caused by being tormented
lemmas.def_zh: n. 骚扰，折磨

examples.en: The company has strict zero-tolerance policies regarding any form of workplace harassment.
examples.zh: 该公司对任何形式的职场骚扰都实行严格的零容忍政策。

lemmas.usage_note: 多为不可数名词，指骚扰行为，常见复合搭配如 sexual/workplace harassment。

lemmas.def_en: a persistent tormentor
lemmas.def_zh: 骚扰者；袭扰者导弹车

examples.en: The company quickly fired the persistent harasser after reviewing the security footage.
examples.zh: 在调取监控录像后，公司迅速开除了那名屡教不改的骚扰者。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 疲惫不堪的，焦虑的；受骚扰折磨的
lemmas.def_en: feeling tired and anxious because of being subjected to persistent demands or petty annoyances
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰人的面容或状态，如 a harassed expression / look / mother。

examples.en: The harried waiter gave the harassed manager a desperate look during peak hours.
examples.zh: 在高峰时段，忙乱的服务员向疲惫焦虑的经理投去绝望的目光。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 harer（驱狗攻击），引申为反复骚扰、折磨或烦扰。

lemmas.def_en: a room in a school where lessons take place
lemmas.def_zh: n. 教室，课堂

examples.en: Interactive whiteboards are increasingly common in the modern classroom.
examples.zh: 交互式电子白板在现代教室中越来越常见。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 in 搭配表示“在课堂上”（in the classroom）；作定语常见 classroom management/teaching。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 class（班级、课程）+ room（房间）构成，指授课场所。

lemmas.def_en: the season when the leaves fall from the trees
lemmas.def_zh: n. 秋季，秋天

examples.en: The leaves turn vibrant shades of red and gold in early autumn.
examples.zh: 初秋时节，树叶变成了鲜艳的红色和金黄色。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指秋季（美式多用 fall），常与 in, during 连用或作名词定语修饰 leaf, breeze。

lemmas.def_en: of or characteristic of or occurring in autumn
lemmas.def_zh: 秋的, 秋天的

examples.en: A crisp autumnal breeze swept through the quiet park, scattering golden leaves everywhere.
examples.zh: 一阵清爽的秋风吹过安静的公园，金黄的树叶散落一地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 autumnus，专指夏末冬初的丰收与落叶之季。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ at/into) To push a finger, stick, or sharp object quickly into or against someone or something. 2. [I, T] To emerge or cause to project out from an enclosure or opening.
lemmas.def_zh: 戳，捅，刺；伸出，探出

examples.en: The curious kitten poked its head out of the cardboard box.
examples.zh: 那只好奇的小猫把头从纸箱里探了出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用手指或锐物戳、捅，或伸出某物，常与介词 at, into 或副词 out 连用。

lemmas.def_en: fire iron consisting of a metal rod with a handle; used to stir a fire
lemmas.def_zh: n. 拨火棍；扑克牌戏

examples.en: He maintained a poker face throughout the tense negotiation, revealing nothing.
examples.zh: 在紧张的谈判过程中，他始终不动声色，没有泄露任何情绪。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指拨火棍，亦可指扑克牌游戏，常用搭配 a game of poker 或 a poker face。

lemmas.def_en: a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)
lemmas.def_zh: 监狱

examples.en: The reckless thief ended up spending several months locked inside the local pokey.
examples.zh: 那个鲁莽的小偷最终在当地的牢房里被关了几个月。

lemmas.def_en: a correctional institution used to detain persons who are in the lawful custody of the government (either accused persons awaiting trial or convicted persons serving a sentence)

examples.en: They spent the night in a poky, poorly lit motel room near town.
examples.zh: 他们在镇子附近一间狭小且昏暗的汽车旅馆房间里过了一夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 迟钝的, 狭小的, 破旧的, 单调的
lemmas.def_en: wasting time

examples.en: They spent the night in a poky, poorly lit motel room near town.
examples.zh: 他们在镇子附近一间狭小且昏暗的汽车旅馆房间里过了一夜。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声或日耳曼语源，指用尖锐之物或手指“戳”、“刺”的动作。

lemmas.def_en: an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades
lemmas.def_zh: n. 直升机

examples.en: The rescue team used a helicopter to evacuate the stranded hikers.
examples.zh: 救援队用直升机疏散了被困的登山者。

lemmas.usage_note: 交通工具，乘机用 by helicopter；延伸出社会学热词 helicopter parent（直升机父母，指过度保护者）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由希腊语 helico-（螺旋）+ pteron（翅膀）组合而成，字面即“螺旋飞行的翼”。

lemmas.def_en: transmitting light; able to be seen through with clarity
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 透明的；易识破的；坦率明晰的

examples.en: We need a transparent selection process to ensure that all candidates are treated fairly.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个透明的选拔流程，以确保所有候选人得到公平对待。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指物理上的透明，也指制度或意图的公开透明、浅显易懂，常修饰 glass, system, motive。

lemmas.def_en: permitting the free passage of electromagnetic radiation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 透明（度）；公开性

examples.en: The public is demanding greater transparency in how tax revenues are spent.
examples.zh: 公众要求在税收资金的使用上提高透明度。

lemmas.usage_note: 指信息、政策或过程的公开透明度，常与 demand, improve, ensure 等动词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: so as to be easily understood or seen through
lemmas.def_zh: 显然地, 易觉察地；明亮地

examples.en: His intentions were so transparently selfish that nobody agreed to support his proposal.
examples.zh: 他的企图显而易见地自私，以至于没人同意支持他的提案。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 trans-（穿过）+ parent（显现），指光线能穿透并清晰显现，引申为透明与公开。

lemmas.def_en: United States industrialist who built the first American locomotive; founded Cooper Union in New York City to offer free courses in the arts and sciences (1791-1883)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 制桶工人，箍桶匠

examples.en: The skilled cooper carefully assembled the wooden staves to form a wine barrel.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的箍桶匠仔细地将木条拼装成一个酒桶。

lemmas.usage_note: 指传统行业中制作或修补木桶的桶匠，常与酒庄、传统手工艺语境连用。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make or repair wooden barrels and casks.
lemmas.def_zh: 制作（或修配）木桶

examples.en: Craftsmen still cooper oak casks by hand in this historic Scottish distillery.
examples.zh: 在这家历史悠久的苏格兰酿酒厂里，工匠们仍手工制作橡木桶。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见专业动词，指制作或修配木桶，多用于传统酿酒业或手工艺描述中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪荷兰语或低地德语，原指桶匠，现兼作动词表示制桶修桶。

lemmas.def_en: tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times
lemmas.def_zh: n. 玉米；谷物；鸡眼

examples.en: Farmers in the Midwest harvest large fields of sweet corn every August.
examples.zh: 中西部的农民每年八月都会收割大片甜玉米田。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式指玉米，英式泛指谷物；医学上指足部鸡眼。常见搭配 corn on the cob。

lemmas.def_en: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
lemmas.def_zh: 谷类的, 乡巴佬似的, 粗野的

examples.en: He told a series of corny jokes that made everyone in the room groan.
examples.zh: 他讲了一连串老套陈腐的笑话，引得全屋人哀声连连。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To feed cattle or other livestock with corn or grain. 2. [T] To preserve meat or other food with coarse salt or brine.
lemmas.def_zh: 用谷物（或玉米）喂养（牲畜）；用盐腌（肉等）

examples.en: The butcher corned the brisket with coarse salt and spices for a week.
examples.zh: 肉贩用粗盐和香料将牛胸肉腌制了一周。

lemmas.usage_note: 烹饪术语，指用盐腌制肉类，最常见的用法是被动及分词形式 corned beef（腌牛肉）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，原指泛称的小颗粒或谷物，在美语中特指玉米，动词引申为用盐粒腌制。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by enmity or ill will
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 怀有敌意的，不友善的；恶劣的

examples.en: The local residents were openly hostile to the proposed construction of a chemical plant.
examples.zh: 当地居民对拟建化工厂的提议表现出公开的敌意。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 to 或 toward 连用，用于描述态度冷淡敌对，也可修饰生存环境或商业收购行为。

lemmas.def_en: troops belonging to the enemy's military forces
lemmas.def_zh: n. 敌军人员；敌方部队

examples.en: Radar systems identified two unknown hostiles entering the restricted airspace.
examples.zh: 雷达系统识别出两架不明敌机正在进入受限空域。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事与安全领域的专业用语，常作可数名词，指战场上的敌方人员、敌军战机或敌对势力。

lemmas.def_en: a hostile (very unfriendly) disposition
lemmas.def_zh: n. 敌意，对抗；（pl.）战事

examples.en: The United Nations called for an immediate cessation of hostilities between the two bordering nations.
examples.zh: 联合国呼吁这两个接壤国家立即停止一切敌对军事行动。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示敌对情绪或态度，复数形式 hostilities 特指国家或集团之间的战争行为与武装冲突。

lemmas.def_en: with hostility; in a belligerent hostile manner
lemmas.def_zh: 敌对地

examples.en: The two rival factions glared hostilely at each other across the negotiation table.
examples.zh: 两个敌对派系在谈判桌两侧恶狠狠地瞪着对方。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 hostis（敌人），指带有敌意、不友善或不利于生存的状态。

lemmas.def_en: showing self-interest and shrewdness in dealing with others
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 聪明的，机灵的；巧妙的

examples.en: The marketing team came up with a clever campaign that quickly captured public attention.
examples.zh: 营销团队想出了一个巧妙的企划，迅速吸引了公众的注意。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于口语与非正式书面语，常接介词 at 表擅长，修饰方案时强调构思巧妙精巧。

lemmas.def_en: in a clever manner
lemmas.def_zh: 聪明地, 全然, 完全, 巧妙地

examples.en: She cleverly disguised the entrance to the secret storage room behind a large bookshelf.
examples.zh: 她巧妙地将秘密储藏室的入口伪装在一面大书架后面。

lemmas.def_en: the power of creative imagination
lemmas.def_zh: 机灵；聪明

examples.en: His remarkable cleverness allowed him to solve the complex mathematical puzzle quickly.
examples.zh: 他非凡的聪慧使他能够迅速解开那个复杂的数学难题。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自古英语或斯堪的纳维亚语，核心意象为机敏、反应迅捷且善于用巧思。

lemmas.def_en: a barrier constructed to contain the flow of water or to keep out the sea
lemmas.def_zh: n. 水坝，水闸

examples.en: The newly built dam successfully protected the downstream villages from the seasonal flood.
examples.zh: 新建成的大坝成功保护了下游村庄免受季节性洪水的侵袭。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指拦截河流的水利工程设施，常用搭配包括 build a dam 或 burst a dam。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To build a dam across a river or stream to stop or control the flow of water; to hold back or suppress something.
lemmas.def_zh: 筑坝拦住，阻拦；控制，抑制

examples.en: Beavers had dammed up the shallow stream with fallen branches and mud.
examples.zh: 海狸用落枝和泥土筑起水坝截断了这条浅溪。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 up 连用（dam up），既可指物理上筑坝拦水，也常用于比喻压抑情感或阻断流动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古荷兰语，原指阻挡水流的堤坝，引申为动词筑坝拦截。

lemmas.def_en: moving very fast
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 飞快的，敏捷的，迅速的

examples.en: The emergency services received praise for their swift response to the natural disaster.
examples.zh: 应急救援部门因对此次自然灾害的迅速响应而受到赞誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩浓厚，强调行动迅速或反应敏捷，常修饰 action、response 或 recovery。

lemmas.def_en: in a swift manner
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 迅速地，敏捷地

examples.en: The security guards acted swiftly to contain the disruption before it escalated.
examples.zh: 安保人员迅速采取行动控制了混乱，避免事态进一步升级。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰动词，强调动作以极快的速度完成，常见搭配如 act swiftly、move swiftly 等。

lemmas.def_en: United States meat-packer who began the use of refrigerated railroad cars (1839-1903)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 斯威夫特（美国肉类加工商）

examples.en: A flock of swifts darted across the evening sky to catch airborne insects.
examples.zh: 一群雨燕掠过傍晚的天空捕捉空中的昆虫。

lemmas.usage_note: 动物学专有名词，指雨燕科鸟类，因飞行速度极快而得名，作可数名词使用。

lemmas.def_en: a rate (usually rapid) at which something happens
lemmas.def_zh: 迅速, 快

examples.en: The mountain rescue team responded with incredible swiftness to save the stranded hikers.
examples.zh: 山地救援队以惊人的迅速做出反应，救出了受困的徒步旅行者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 swifan（转动、迅速移动），强调速度极快且敏捷，也用作雨燕名。

lemmas.def_en: where in the world
lemmas.def_zh: 无论在哪里，在任何……的地方

examples.en: You can sit wherever you like.
examples.zh: 你想坐哪里都可以。

lemmas.usage_note: 引导让步或地点状语从句，意为“无论何处”；口语中可单独用于问句加强语气表示惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 where（在哪里）与 -ever（无论）复合而成，表示空间的无限制性。

lemmas.def_en: a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases
lemmas.def_zh: 麻布袋, 洗劫

examples.en: He hauled a heavy sack of potatoes from the cellar up to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他从地窖里把一大麻袋沉重的土豆拖到了厨房。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常指粗布麻袋；英式口语中 the sack 指被解雇；历史语境下指对城市的洗劫洗劫行为。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity contained in a sack
lemmas.def_zh: 满袋, 多量

examples.en: The children returned from the garden carrying a sackful of freshly picked apples.
examples.zh: 孩子们带着满满一袋刚采摘的新鲜苹果从花园回来。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. to plunder, destroy, and strip a captured city or place of valuables. 2. (informal) to dismiss someone from a job.
lemmas.def_zh: 劫掠，洗劫（被攻占的城镇）；解雇，开除

examples.en: The company decided to sack the rogue trader after he caused catastrophic losses.
examples.zh: 在那名违规交易员造成灾难性损失后，公司决定将其解雇。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常多用作英式非正式动词表示解雇辞退；在战争历史语境中表示掠夺摧毁被攻陷的城镇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sacc（大布袋），引申出“装入袋中”，在口语中借“收拾铺盖卷走人”引申为解雇。

lemmas.def_en: electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field
lemmas.def_zh: 弧, 弧形, 弓形, 弧光

examples.en: The setting sun followed a graceful arc across the horizon before sinking below the hills.
examples.zh: 落日在地平线上划出一道优美的弧线，随后沉入群山之下。

lemmas.usage_note: 几何上指弧线，文学中指故事发展弧（character arc），物理上指放电产生的弧光。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to move, curve, or form into the shape of an arch or a curved line; to produce an electric arc
lemmas.def_zh: 呈弧形移动；形成弧形，拱起；（电）产生电弧

examples.en: High-voltage electricity arced across the damaged transformer with a loud crack.
examples.zh: 高压电伴随着一声巨响在受损的变压器之间跳火放电。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，既可表示轨迹呈弧形移动，也可在物理与电工语境中表示电弧跳火放电。

lemmas.def_en: forming or resembling an arch
lemmas.def_zh: 弓形的

examples.en: The river carved a distinctly arcuate path through the rocky mountain valley.
examples.zh: 这条河流在多石的山谷中切出了一条明显的弓形路径。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 arcus（弓、拱门），指呈弓形弯曲的几何图形、运动轨迹或故事情节展开的过程。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To stop fighting and admit defeat, giving up resistance to an enemy. 2. [T] To give up something or hand someone over into the control or possession of another.
lemmas.def_zh: 投降，屈服；交出，放弃

examples.en: The surrounded troops had no choice but to surrender their weapons to the enemy.
examples.zh: 被包围的部队别无选择，只能向敌人缴械投降。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词表投降常接 to（surrender to sb）；及物动词表交出权利或物品，搭配 surrender sth to sb。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 投降；放弃，交出
lemmas.def_en: the act of surrendering, yielding, or submitting to the power or control of another
lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，偶尔用作可数；常用搭配包括 unconditional surrender（无条件投降）。

examples.en: The general signed the terms of surrender.
examples.zh: 将军签署了投降条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，由 sur-（向上、移交）和 rendre（给予、交出）构成，核心逻辑为放弃抵抗向对方“交出控制权”。

lemmas.def_en: Mexican revolutionary leader (1877-1923)
lemmas.def_zh: 别墅

examples.en: They rented a luxury villa with a private pool for the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 他们租了一栋带私人泳池的豪华别墅度暑假。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指度假胜地或乡村的“豪华度假别墅”，中式英语切勿将普通郊区民房（house）误称为 villa。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 villa（乡村庄园），原指罗马贵族的乡村休养地，现多指独立别墅或度假洋房。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To officially or formally announce or declare a decision or judgment. 2. To make the sound of a word or letter.
lemmas.def_zh: 宣告，宣判；正式声明；发音，读（音）

examples.en: After hours of deliberation, the judge pronounced the defendant guilty on all counts.
examples.zh: 经过数小时的审议，法官正式宣判被告所涉所有罪名成立。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物，指单词的发音方式；正式语境中常用于法庭或权威人士正式宣告裁决、死亡等。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To pronounce a word or name incorrectly.
lemmas.def_zh: 读错（词）的音，发音不准

examples.en: Many tourists frequently mispronounce the traditional names of local Scottish towns.
examples.zh: 许多游客经常把苏格兰当地城镇的传统名称念错。

lemmas.def_zh: 发音, 读法
lemmas.def_en: the manner in which someone utters a word

examples.en: Her clear pronunciation made it remarkably easy for international students to understand her lecture.
examples.zh: 她清晰的发音让国际学生非常容易听懂她的讲座。

lemmas.usage_note: 语言学核心名词，指语音的读法或特定口音的发音表现，常与 improve、standard 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: an authoritative declaration
lemmas.def_zh: 声明, 公告, 宣言, 宣告, 发表, 意见, 决定

examples.en: The government made an official pronouncement regarding the new tax policy yesterday.
examples.zh: 政府昨天就新税收政策发布了官方声明。

lemmas.def_zh: 发音错误, 读错音的词
lemmas.def_en: incorrect pronunciation

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 显著的，明显的；断然的
lemmas.def_en: very noticeable; strongly marked or distinct
lemmas.usage_note: 常用来修饰差异、特征、趋势或改变，如 a pronounced difference / effect / limp。

examples.en: There has been a pronounced shift in public opinion regarding renewable energy.
examples.zh: 公众对可再生能源的看法发生了显著的转变。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pro-（向前、公开）+ nounce（说，源自拉丁语 nuntiare），核心逻辑是“公开宣告”，引申为把字音读出或正式判决。

lemmas.def_en: a nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas; constitutes 21 percent of the atmosphere by volume; the most abundant element in the earth's crust
lemmas.def_zh: 氧

examples.en: Deep-sea divers rely on a constant oxygen supply delivered through their breathing apparatus.
examples.zh: 深海潜水员依靠呼吸设备输送的持续氧气供应。

lemmas.usage_note: 化学与生物学不可数名词，指氧气元素，常与 supply、deprivation、mask 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: the process of providing or combining or treating with oxygen
lemmas.def_zh: 以氧气处理, 氧化

examples.en: Regular deep breathing exercises improve blood oxygenation and boost your overall energy.
examples.zh: 经常做深呼吸练习能改善血液供氧并提升全身活力。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To supply, treat, or enrich blood, water, or another substance with oxygen.
lemmas.def_zh: 向……充氧，给……供氧，使氧合

examples.en: Aquarium pumps help to oxygenate the water so fish can breathe easily.
examples.zh: 鱼缸水泵有助于给水充氧，使鱼儿能顺畅呼吸。

family_guide.root_logic: 希腊语 oxy-（酸）+ -gen（产生），18世纪科学家曾误认为该元素是所有酸类的必要成分，故名“产酸之物”。

lemmas.def_en: a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
lemmas.def_zh: 概念, 观念, 想法, 打算, 别致的小东西

examples.en: She firmly rejected the absurd notion that women were inherently less capable in mathematics.
examples.zh: 她坚决驳斥了那种认为女性天生不擅长数学的荒谬观念。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示笼统的观念或模糊的想法，常接 that 从句或 of，多带有学术或思辨色彩。

lemmas.def_en: not based on fact; unreal; - F.D.Roosevelt
lemmas.def_zh: 概念的, 想像的

examples.en: The budget figures presented at this early stage are purely notional estimates.
examples.zh: 现阶段提出的预算数字纯粹是概念性的预估。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 notio（认识、观念），源自动词 noscere（了解），指大脑中形成的抽象想法或模糊认知。

lemmas.def_en: the act of departing
lemmas.def_zh: 离开；出发

examples.en: Passengers should arrive at the gate at least thirty minutes prior to departure.
examples.zh: 乘客应在起飞前至少三十分钟到达登机口。

lemmas.usage_note: 离开；出发

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ from/for) (formal) To leave a place, especially to start a journey. 2. [I] (+ from) To deviate or stray from an established rule, practice, or standard.
lemmas.def_zh: 离开，启程；偏离，背离（常规等）

examples.en: The high-speed train is scheduled to depart from platform four at noon.
examples.zh: 高速列车预定于正午从四号站台发车。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，表示启程离开某地或违背常规，常用结构为 depart for（前往）或 depart from（离开/违背）。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词 depart（离开）加名词后缀 -ure，表示离开既定地点、状态或既定轨道的状态或行为。

lemmas.def_en: an enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial
lemmas.def_zh: 码头, 船坞, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分

examples.en: The cargo ship was safely tied up at the commercial dock.
examples.zh: 货船已被安全系泊在商业码头上。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指停靠船舶的水运码头，亦可在法律语境中指法庭上的被告席，常用于 on/in the dock 表达。

lemmas.def_en: a laborer who loads and unloads vessels in a port
lemmas.def_zh: 码头工人

examples.en: Every experienced docker wore a hard hat while unloading the cargo ship.
examples.zh: 每位经验丰富的码头工人在卸货时都戴着安全帽。

lemmas.def_en: a fee charged for a vessel to use a dock
lemmas.def_zh: 入坞费, 码头费, 削减, 扣除

examples.en: The harbour master charged a reasonable dockage fee for overnight boat mooring.
examples.zh: 港口负责人对船只过夜停泊收取了合理的码头费。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (of a ship or spacecraft) To sail into or tie up at a dock; to join together in space. 2. [T] To reduce or deduct an amount of money from someone's pay or benefits.
lemmas.def_zh: （使船只）停靠码头，进港；对接（航天器）；扣减（工资等）

examples.en: The ferry will dock at the harbor in about twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 渡轮将在大约二十分钟后停靠海港。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为动词可表示舰船或航天器“靠泊/对接”，还可用于金融或雇佣语境表示“扣除（工资等）”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] When a ship or spacecraft undocks, it separates from a dock or another vessel to depart.
lemmas.def_zh: 使出坞；出坞, 驶离码头

examples.en: The spacecraft will undock from the space station early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 航天器将于明天清晨脱离空间站。

family_guide.root_logic: 中世纪低地德语借词，原指船只停靠的港池，引申出船只靠岸停靠动作；法律上另有“被告席”之意。

lemmas.def_en: tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion
lemmas.def_zh: 观点，态度；情绪

examples.en: Investor sentiment remained cautious ahead of the interest rate decision.
examples.zh: 在利率决议公布前，投资者情绪依然保持谨慎。

lemmas.usage_note: 观点，态度；情绪

lemmas.def_en: falsely emotional in a maudlin way
lemmas.def_zh: 多愁善感

examples.en: The novel avoids cheap sentimentality and focuses on gritty realistic details instead.
examples.zh: 这部小说避免了廉价的感伤，而是专注于真实的细节。

lemmas.def_en: given to or marked by sentiment or sentimentality
lemmas.def_zh: 感伤的, 感情用事的

examples.en: She kept the worn-out watch purely for sentimental reasons.
examples.zh: 她保留那块破旧的手表纯粹是出于情感原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容过于感情用事或因怀旧而产生的情感，极高频搭配为 sentimental value（纪念价值）。

lemmas.def_en: facing facts or difficulties realistically and with determination
lemmas.def_zh: 不动感情的

examples.en: His unsentimental approach to business management helped the struggling company survive.
examples.zh: 他经营企业时不带个人感情，帮助陷入困境的公司活了下来。

lemmas.def_en: in a sentimental manner
lemmas.def_zh: 富情感地

examples.en: Although worthless to collectors, the battered watch was sentimentally priceless to him.
examples.zh: 尽管对收藏家毫无价值，但这块旧手表对他而言情感上无比珍贵。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 sent/sens（感知、感觉）派生，指基于感知而产生的主观态度、情绪或过度敏感的情感。
family_guide.core_distinction: sentiment 为名词，表示所持的情绪、观点；sentimental 为形容词，指伤感的或感情用事的。

lemmas.def_en: negotiation between nations
lemmas.def_zh: 外交, 外交手腕, 交际手段

examples.en: International disputes are best resolved through patient diplomacy rather than confrontation.
examples.zh: 国际争端最好通过耐心的外交途径而非对抗来解决。

lemmas.usage_note: 指国与国之间的外交事务，也可指日常人际交往中的圆滑手段，常搭配 dollar diplomacy 或 quiet diplomacy。

lemmas.def_en: an official engaged in international negotiations
lemmas.def_zh: 外交官, 有外交手腕的人

examples.en: The experienced diplomat was dispatched to negotiate the ceasefire terms.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官被派去谈判停火条款。

lemmas.usage_note: 指职业外交官，亦可喻指处事圆融老练的人，常用于 senior diplomat 或 career diplomat 等职业表述。

lemmas.def_en: an official engaged in international negotiations
lemmas.def_zh: 外交家, 有外交手腕的人, 外交官

examples.en: The veteran diplomatist negotiated a lasting ceasefire between the two warring nations.
examples.zh: 这位资深外交家促成了两个交战国之间的持久停火。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of diplomacy
lemmas.def_zh: 外交的, 老练的

examples.en: The ambassador handled the sensitive inquiry in a very diplomatic manner.
examples.zh: 大使以非常得体委婉的方式处理了这一敏感问询。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词可修饰外交职能（如 diplomatic immunity/relations），亦可形容为人处事委婉得体。

lemmas.def_en: not skilled in dealing with others
lemmas.def_zh: 无外交策略的

examples.en: His undiplomatic remarks during the official press conference caused widespread international outrage.
examples.zh: 他在官方新闻发布会上的失礼言论引发了广泛的国际愤怒。

lemmas.def_en: with diplomacy; in a diplomatic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 在外交上, 靠外交途径, 凭外交手腕

examples.en: The manager diplomatically handled the delicate dispute between the two rival departments.
examples.zh: 经理巧妙老练地处理了两个竞争部门之间的微妙纠纷。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 diploma（折叠的文件、官方文书），引申为处理国家间公文、事务的策略与手段，再引申指人际交往手腕。
family_guide.core_distinction: diplomacy 为抽象行为名词（外交、交际手腕）；diplomatic 为形容词（外交的、圆滑周到的）。

lemmas.def_en: sports equipment that is worn on the feet to enable the wearer to glide along and to be propelled by the alternate actions of the legs
lemmas.def_zh: 冰鞋；旱冰鞋

examples.en: He laced up his hockey skates tightly before stepping onto the ice rink.
examples.zh: 他走上冰场前紧紧地系好了冰球鞋的鞋带。

lemmas.usage_note: 冰鞋；旱冰鞋

lemmas.def_en: someone who skates
lemmas.def_zh: 溜冰者

examples.en: The talented figure skater performed a flawless triple axel on the ice.
examples.zh: 那位才华横溢的花样滑冰选手在冰面上完成了完美的阿克塞尔三周跳。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To glide smoothly over ice on ice skates, or over a hard surface on roller skates or a skateboard.
lemmas.def_zh: 滑冰，溜冰；滑过，掠过

examples.en: The politician tried to skate over the controversial tax policy.
examples.zh: 这位政治家试图对具有争议的税收政策轻描淡写地一笔带过。

lemmas.usage_note: 指进行滑冰运动，比喻用法常见于 skate around/over an issue，表示回避或轻描淡写地略过问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 eschace（高跷），荷兰人将其改良用于冰上滑行的器具，演化为滑冰鞋及滑行动作。

lemmas.def_en: (physiology) the organic process of nourishing or being nourished; the processes by which an organism assimilates food and uses it for growth and maintenance
lemmas.def_zh: 营养, 营养学

examples.en: Adequate nutrition is essential for the healthy growth of young children.
examples.zh: 充足的营养对幼儿的健康成长至关重要。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，统指摄取养分的过程或营养学学科，常见搭配如 poor nutrition 或 clinical nutrition。

lemmas.def_en: any substance that can be metabolized by an animal to give energy and build tissue
lemmas.def_zh: 养分，营养物

examples.en: Dark leafy vegetables are packed with essential nutrients and vitamins.
examples.zh: 深绿叶蔬菜富含必需的营养成分和维生素。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，具体指食物中的某种营养物质（如维生素、矿物质），常以复数形式 essential nutrients 出现。

lemmas.def_zh: 滋养品, 养料, 营养
lemmas.def_en: a source of materials to nourish the body
a specialist in the study of nutrition
lemmas.def_zh: 营养学家

examples.en: The certified nutritionist designed a balanced meal plan to help him lose weight.
examples.zh: 持证营养师为他制定了均衡的饮食计划以助其减重。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or providing nutrition
lemmas.def_zh: 营养的, 滋养的

examples.en: Consumers often examine the nutritional value on packaged food labels.
examples.zh: 消费者通常会仔细查看包装食品标签上的营养价值。

lemmas.usage_note: 中性客观的客观修饰词，指“关于营养方面的”，极高频搭配为 nutritional value 或 nutritional label。

lemmas.def_zh: 滋养的, 营养的
lemmas.def_en: of or providing nourishment

examples.en: A warm and nutritious soup helps the body recover from illness.
examples.zh: 温热且营养丰富的汤有助于身体从疾病中恢复。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容词，表示食物“富含营养的、滋养的”，常见搭配如 nutritious meal 或 nutritious breakfast。

lemmas.def_en: with regard to nutrition
lemmas.def_zh: 滋养地

examples.en: This homemade vegetable soup is nutritionally rich and very easy to prepare.
examples.zh: 这款自制蔬菜汤营养丰富，且制作非常简单。

lemmas.def_zh: 滋养，养育；助长，怀有（希望、情感等）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To provide people, animals, or plants with food and nutrients necessary for life and growth. 2. [T] To foster, encourage, or keep alive a feeling, idea, or belief.

examples.en: A healthy diet and plenty of rest will nourish your body after a long illness.
examples.zh: 健康的饮食和充足的休息会在久病后滋养你的身体。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 nutr-（滋养、哺育），加名词后缀 -ition，指通过摄取食物获取滋养的过程及营养科学。
family_guide.core_distinction: nutrition 为名词，指营养物质或营养摄取；nutritional 为形容词，指与营养成分或价值相关的。

lemmas.def_en: five-toed pachyderm
lemmas.def_zh: 大象

examples.en: Nobody wanted to mention the budget deficit, which was the elephant in the room.
examples.zh: 谁都不想提及预算赤字，而这正是大家心知肚明却避而不谈的难题。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指哺乳动物象，在习语中常用 the elephant in the room（显而易见却被刻意回避的棘手问题）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 elephas（象、象牙），指陆生巨型哺乳动物。

lemmas.def_en: a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
lemmas.def_zh: 出租车

examples.en: We decided to take a taxi home since it was raining heavily.
examples.zh: 因为雨下得很大，我们决定乘出租车回家。

lemmas.usage_note: 指出租车，可与 take, hail, call 等动词搭配，常见用法有 hail a taxi（招手拦车）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (of an aircraft) To move slowly along the ground before taking off or after landing. 2. [I] (informal) To travel in a taxi.
lemmas.def_zh: （飞机）滑行；乘出租车

examples.en: The aircraft began to taxi slowly along the runway before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞前开始沿跑道缓慢滑行。

lemmas.usage_note: 航空专用动词，指飞机在地面滑行，常接介词 along 或 to，如 taxi down the runway。

family_guide.root_logic: 缩写自 taxicab（taximeter 计程器 + cab 出租马车），后引申指飞机滑行。

lemmas.def_en: a hard copal derived from an African tree
lemmas.def_zh: 日本动漫

examples.en: Japanese anime has gained immense popularity among global audiences.
examples.zh: 日本动漫在全球受众中获得了极高的人气。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指源自日本的动画艺术形式，可作不可数或可数名词，常与 watch anime 或 anime series 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日语借用英语 animation（动画）的缩略词，特指日本风格的动画。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To come to an end, or to bring something to an end. 2. [T] (formal) To end someone's employment.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）终止，（使）结束；解雇

examples.en: The employer reserved the right to terminate the contract without notice.
examples.zh: 雇主保留无须提前通知即可终止合同的权利。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式及法律用语，表示使合同、协议等结束，或列车终到，搭配如 terminate a contract。

lemmas.def_en: a coming to an end of a contract period
lemmas.def_zh: 终止，结束；免职

examples.en: The company announced the wrongful termination of several senior employees.
examples.zh: 公司宣布非法解雇了几名高级雇员。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式文书指“终止、免职或解约”，常见搭配有 termination of employment 或 early termination fee。

lemmas.def_zh: 终点, 界标, 终点站
lemmas.def_en: a place where something ends or is complete

examples.en: The northern terminus of the subway line is situated near the airport.
examples.zh: 该地铁线的北端终点站位于机场附近。

lemmas.usage_note: 指公共交通路线（如铁路线或公交线）的终点站，复数形式多为 termini 或 terminuses。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 terminus（边界、极限），核心表“终结、结束”。
family_guide.core_distinction: terminate 为动词；termination 为其名词形式，指终止的状态或行为。

lemmas.def_en: distinctive manner of oral expression
lemmas.def_zh: 口音，腔调；重音

examples.en: She speaks fluent English, but her slight French accent still gives her away.
examples.zh: 她英语说得很流利，但略带的法国口音还是暴露了她的身份。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指地区或外国口音，搭配have/speak with a broad/heavy/strong accent；亦指语言学中的重音。

lemmas.def_zh: 重读, 加重音符号, 强调
lemmas.def_en: the use or application of an accent; the relative prominence of syllables in a phrase or utterance
1. [T] To emphasize or make something more noticeable. 2. [T] To pronounce a syllable, word, or note with special stress.
lemmas.def_zh: 强调，着重，突出；重读

examples.en: The designer used dark cushions to accent the light gray sofa.
examples.zh: 设计师用深色靠垫来衬托浅灰色的沙发。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词表示强调、突出或重读，常接颜色、风格或特征作宾语，多用于设计或描写语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 强调，突出，使更明显
lemmas.def_en: [T] To emphasize something or make a feature, detail, or contrast much more noticeable.

examples.en: Her tailored black dress was designed to accentuate her tall and slender figure.
examples.zh: 她修身的黑裙子旨在凸显她高挑纤细的身材。

lemmas.def_en: used of syllables
lemmas.def_zh: 非重音的, 非重读的

examples.en: In natural speech, unaccented vowels often reduce to a neutral schwa sound.
examples.zh: 在自然话语中，非重读元音往往会弱化为央元音。

lemmas.def_zh: 重音的, 根据重音定节奏的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to accent or stress

examples.en: Old English poetry relies heavily on an accentual meter rather than syllable counts.
examples.zh: 古英语诗歌主要依赖重音节律，而非音节数量。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（向）+ canere（歌唱），核心为“语调、腔调”，引申为强调。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To cut hair from the face or body very close to the skin using a razor. 2. To cut or scrape thin slices from a surface. 3. To reduce something slightly.
lemmas.def_zh: 剃（须），刮（毛）；刨平，刮掉薄层；略微削减

examples.en: He decided to shave off his beard before attending the formal interview.
examples.zh: 他决定在参加正式面试前把胡子刮掉。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指剃须、刮毛，常用搭配shave off；引申指削减（成本、时间等）。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (archaic) Past participle of shave; to remove hair closely with a razor.
lemmas.def_zh: 剃，刮（shave的过去分词形式）

examples.en: With a freshly shaven face, he looked much younger than his actual age.
examples.zh: 刮干净脸后，他看起来比实际年龄年轻得多。

lemmas.def_en: the act of removing hair with a razor
lemmas.def_zh: 剃须；刨花，薄片

examples.en: The carpenter carefully swept the pine shavings off the workshop floor.
examples.zh: 木匠仔细地将车间地板上的松木刨花清扫干净。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指修面；作复数shavings特指刨削下来的薄片，如wood shavings（刨花）。

lemmas.def_en: an adult male who shaves
lemmas.def_zh: 修面的人, 电动剃刀, 刨刀, 杀价买进期票的人, 善于讨价还价的人

examples.en: He packed his cordless electric shaver into the travel kit this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，他把无线电动剃须刀装进了旅行包。

lemmas.def_en: not shaved
lemmas.def_zh: 不剃须的, 未修面的

examples.en: After a busy weekend, he showed up at the office looking tired and unshaven.
examples.zh: 度过忙碌的周末后，他睡眼惺忪、胡子拉碴地出现在办公室。

lemmas.def_en: not shaved
lemmas.def_zh: 未剃须的,未修面的,未刮脸的

examples.en: His unshaved face gave him a rugged appearance during the mountain camping trip.
examples.zh: 在山间露营期间，他未修边幅的胡茬显得粗犷不羁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 sceafan（刮、刨、刮胡子），核心表“刮去表面一层”。
family_guide.core_distinction: shave 主要作动词或单次剃刮；shaving 为动名词/名词，常作复数指刮下的碎屑薄片。

lemmas.def_en: not only so, but
lemmas.def_zh: 是的，正是（古/庄）

examples.en: He gave his all to the cause, yea, even his life.
examples.zh: 他为这项事业奉献了一切，甚至献出了自己的生命。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或庄重书面语，意为“是的”，亦可用于递进修辞，相当于“不仅如此，甚至”。

lemmas.def_en: an affirmative
lemmas.def_zh: 是的，正是（古/庄）

examples.en: The final count was fifty yeas against twenty nays in the Senate.
examples.zh: 参议院的最终计票结果是五十票赞成对二十票反对。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，专用于表决语境，指赞成票或投赞成票者，固定搭配the yeas and nays（赞成与反对票）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 gēa（是的），古英语肯定副词，现多用于表决投票或古风表达。

lemmas.def_en: floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile)
lemmas.def_zh: 地毯

examples.en: We decided to lay a thick wool carpet in the living room for warmth.
examples.zh: 我们决定在客厅铺上厚羊毛地毯以保持暖和。

lemmas.usage_note: 指地毯，常见搭配wall-to-wall carpet（满铺地毯）或roll out the red carpet（隆重欢迎）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cover something completely with a thick layer, like a carpet. 2. [T] (informal) To severely reprimand or scold someone.
lemmas.def_zh: 厚厚地覆盖；在……上铺地毯；严厉训斥

examples.en: In autumn, the quiet forest path was carpeted with golden leaves.
examples.zh: 秋天，静谧的林间小道上铺满了金黄的落叶。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态be carpeted with，表示厚厚覆盖；英式非正式语境中亦指训斥。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 铺有地毯的；厚厚覆盖着……的
lemmas.def_en: covered with a carpet; covered thickly as if with a carpet
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于形容房间地面（a carpeted room），也常见喻指自然界覆盖，如 carpeted with fallen leaves。

examples.en: The quiet hallway was softly carpeted, dampening the sound of footsteps.
examples.zh: 安静的走廊铺着柔软的地毯，减弱了脚步声。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 carpere（梳理、采摘毛织物），指铺地织物，作动词表铺满或覆盖。

lemmas.def_en: comparatives of `soon' or `early'
lemmas.def_zh: 更早，宁可

examples.en: I would sooner walk home alone than take a ride from that stranger.
examples.zh: 我宁愿独自走回家，也不愿搭乘那个陌生人的车。

lemmas.usage_note: soon的比较级，常用于no sooner... than...（一……就……）或would sooner... than...（宁可）。

lemmas.def_en: a native or resident of Oklahoma
lemmas.def_zh: 更早，宁可

examples.en: Many eager Sooners rushed across the border to claim fertile plots before the official gun sounded.
examples.zh: 许多急切的抢先拓殖者在官方鸣枪之前便越过边界抢占肥沃地块。

lemmas.usage_note: 常首字母大写（Sooner），专指美国俄克拉荷马州抢先占地定居的开拓者，亦为该州居民昵称。

family_guide.root_logic: soon（不久、早）的比较级，引申指美国俄克拉荷马州抢先占地的定居者。

lemmas.def_en: United States writer and poet (1905-1989)
lemmas.def_zh: 野兔繁殖场；拥挤错综的群落/街巷

examples.en: The old quarter of the city is a confusing warren of narrow alleys and hidden courtyards.
examples.zh: 这座老城区是一个由狭窄小巷和隐秘庭院交织而成的迷宫般街区。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，本义为野兔洞穴群，比喻拥挤错综的街巷或建筑群，常接介词of修饰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 warenne（猎物保护区），特指野兔密集筑洞群，引申为拥挤杂乱的街区。

lemmas.def_en: a strong line
lemmas.def_zh: 绳索

examples.en: The climbers secured their tents with heavy nylon rope during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间，登山队员们用结实的尼龙绳将帐篷固定住。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，指粗绳，习语learn/know the ropes表示熟悉业务，on the ropes表示濒临失败。

lemmas.def_en: a decoy who lures customers into a gambling establishment (especially one with a fixed game)
lemmas.def_zh: 制绳者, <美>用索套捕牲口的牧人,诱人进入赌场者

examples.en: The experienced roper caught the running calf with precision at the rodeo.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的套绳手在牛仔竞技比赛中精准套住了奔跑的牛犊。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ in/up/off) To tie, bind, or secure something firmly with ropes. 2. [T] To catch an animal using a lasso.
lemmas.def_zh: 用绳索捆绑，拴紧；用套索抓捕（牲口）

examples.en: Somehow my brother managed to rope me into helping him move furniture all weekend.
examples.zh: 不知怎么的，我哥哥竟然说服我整整一个周末都在帮他搬家具。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用绳捆绑或套住；常见短语rope sb into sth表示拉拢或诱使某人参与某事。

lemmas.def_en: of or resembling rope (or ropes) in being long and strong
lemmas.def_zh: 破旧的, 蹩脚的, 旧式的

examples.en: I felt rather ropey after sleeping poorly on that cold, noisy night.
examples.zh: 在那个又冷又吵的夜晚没睡好后，我感觉身体相当不舒服。

lemmas.def_zh: 绳状的, 可拉成丝的, 粘稠的, 强健的
lemmas.def_en: of or resembling rope (or ropes) in being long and strong

examples.en: The spoiled milk developed a thick, ropy texture that made it completely undrinkable.
examples.zh: 变质的牛奶变得浓稠且能拉成丝，完全无法饮用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 rāp（粗绳），核心指粗绳索，作动词表用绳捆绑或圈入。

lemmas.def_en: the basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union (introduced in 1999); in 2002 twelve European nations (Germany, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Ireland, Greece, Austria, Finland) adopted the euro as their basic unit of money and abandoned their traditional currencies
lemmas.def_zh: 欧元

examples.en: The hotel charges fifty euros per night for a single room.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆单人间每晚收费五十欧元。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作不可数或可数名词（复数多为euros），指欧盟货币单位，常与金额数词连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 缩写自 Europe（欧洲），专指欧洲联盟的统一货币单位“欧元”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to interrupt or cause problems that prevent an event, system, or process from continuing normally.
lemmas.def_zh: 扰乱，破坏；使中断

examples.en: Heavy snowfall completely disrupted the morning rail traffic across the region.
examples.zh: 大雪完全扰乱了整个地区早间的铁路交通。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指使某活动、进程中断或陷入混乱，常搭配disrupt traffic/services/economy。

lemmas.def_en: an act of delaying or interrupting the continuity
lemmas.def_zh: 扰乱，中断，混乱

examples.en: The sudden subway strike caused severe disruption to daily commuter routines.
examples.zh: 突如其来的地铁罢工给通勤者的日常生活带来了严重混乱。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，指中断、混乱或动荡，常接介词to，如cause major disruption to...

lemmas.def_en: characterized by unrest or disorder or insubordination
lemmas.def_zh: 分裂的, 破坏(性)的

examples.en: The noisy student was asked to leave because of his disruptive behavior.
examples.zh: 那名吵闹的学生因具有破坏性的捣乱行为而被请出教室。

lemmas.def_en: in a disruptive manner
lemmas.def_zh: disruptive的变形

examples.en: Cell phones rang disruptively throughout the entire performance, annoying the classical musicians.
examples.zh: 整场演出中手机响个不停，极具干扰性，令古典乐手们十分恼火。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（分开）+ rumpere（打破、破裂），核心为“打破原秩序使其混乱中断”。
family_guide.core_distinction: disrupt 为动词破坏干扰；disruption 为其名词形式，指混乱扰乱的局面。

lemmas.def_en: precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication
lemmas.def_zh: 清楚明白的，直白的

examples.en: The supervisor gave explicit instructions on how to handle the hazardous waste.
examples.zh: 主管就如何处理危险废弃物给出了明确清晰的指示。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示清楚明确、不含糊的，搭配explicit instructions/details；亦可指直白露骨的内容。

lemmas.def_en: in an explicit manner
lemmas.def_zh: 明确地，明白地

examples.en: The lease agreement explicitly prohibits tenants from keeping large pets inside the apartment.
examples.zh: 租赁协议中明确禁止租户在公寓内饲养大型宠物。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，修饰动词如state, mention, forbid, say，强调清晰、毫不含糊地表述。

lemmas.def_en: clarity as a consequence of being explicit
lemmas.def_zh: 直言不讳；明确性

examples.en: The contract was praised for its explicitness and lack of ambiguous phrasing.
examples.zh: 该合同因其条款明确、毫无含糊表述而受到赞赏。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ex-（出）+ plicare（折叠），字面指“展开的、不折叠的”，核心表“明确的、毫无隐瞒的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: explicit 为形容词；explicitly 为副词，意为“明确地、清晰地”。

lemmas.def_en: shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity
lemmas.def_zh: 地震

examples.en: The earthquake measured 6.5 on the Richter scale.
examples.zh: 这次地震里氏震级为6.5级。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 strike, hit, trigger 连用，量级用 measuring... on the Richter scale；可比喻社会政治巨震。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 earth（土地）+ quake（震动），指地壳震动自然现象。

lemmas.def_en: the series of vertebrae forming the axis of the skeleton and protecting the spinal cord
lemmas.def_zh: 脊柱，脊椎

examples.en: The doctor carefully examined the patient's spine to identify the injured vertebra.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了患者的脊柱，以确定受损的椎骨部位。

lemmas.usage_note: 脊柱，脊椎

lemmas.def_en: anesthesia of the lower half of the body; caused by injury to the spinal cord or by injecting an anesthetic beneath the arachnoid membrane that surrounds the spinal cord
lemmas.def_zh: n. 脊髓麻醉

examples.en: The surgeon administered a spinal to ensure the patient remained comfortable throughout the procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生进行了脊髓麻醉，以确保病人在整个手术过程中不感疼痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学临床口语中的可数名词，指蛛网膜下腔阻滞（脊髓麻醉），常省略 anesthesia。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of lacking a strong character; an irresolute disposition
lemmas.def_zh: 无脊椎

examples.en: Voters were disappointed by the politician's utter spinelessness in handling the corruption scandal.
examples.zh: 政客在处理腐败丑闻时表现出的极度软弱让选民大失所望。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To turn around and around quickly, or make something do this. 2. To twist fibers into thread.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）快速旋转；纺（纱，线）；眩晕

examples.en: The earth continues to spin on its axis as it orbits around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球在绕太阳公转的同时，也在持续绕着地轴自转。

lemmas.usage_note: 核心义为自身快速旋转或纺线，引申义可指（政客或媒体）带有偏向性地公关包装新闻事实。

lemmas.def_en: weak in willpower, courage or vitality
lemmas.def_zh: 无脊椎的, 没有骨气的, 懦弱的

examples.en: The spineless manager refused to defend his team against the unfair criticism.
examples.zh: 那个懦弱无能的经理拒绝为自己的团队辩护以抵御不公批评。

lemmas.def_en: having spines
lemmas.def_zh: 多刺的, 刺状的, 尖尖的

examples.en: The desert plant developed sharp spinous leaves to protect itself from hungry animals.
examples.zh: 这种沙漠植物长出了锋利的多刺叶片，以防被饥饿的动物吃掉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 spina（刺、荆棘），引申为动物身体中起支撑作用且形如尖刺串联的脊椎，进而指脊梁或书脊。
family_guide.core_distinction: spine 通常作名词指脊柱或刺；spinal 主要为形容词，作名词时指脊髓麻醉；spin 虽拼写相近但词源不同，意为旋转。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To move an implement through a liquid or other substance in order to mix it thoroughly. 2. To arouse strong feelings or memories. 3. To move slightly.
lemmas.def_zh: 搅动，搅拌；激起，打动；微动

examples.en: She gently stirred the milk into her coffee until it blended completely.
examples.zh: 她轻轻将牛奶搅入咖啡中，直到完全融合。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于物理搅动液体或比喻激发情感，搭配stir up（挑起、激起）或stir in（拌入）。

lemmas.def_en: agitating a liquid with an implement
lemmas.def_zh: n. 萌发；微动；骚动

examples.en: He felt the first stirrings of hope as the morning sun broke through the clouds.
examples.zh: 当晨光穿透云层时，他心中涌起了初现的希望。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用复数形式stirrings，表示内心初次萌动的情感、欲望或微弱的征兆，属书面语。

lemmas.def_en: a person who spreads frightening rumors and stirs up trouble
lemmas.def_zh: 搅拌者, 搅拌器

examples.en: She picked up a small plastic stirrer to blend sugar into her coffee.
examples.zh: 她拿起一根小塑料搅拌棒，把糖搅匀在咖啡里。

lemmas.def_en: in a stirring manner
lemmas.def_zh: 激动地, 刺激地, 令人兴奋地

examples.en: The orchestra performed the national anthem stirringly, moving the entire audience to tears.
examples.zh: 管弦乐团令人动容地演奏了国歌，全场观众为之潸然泪下。

lemmas.def_en: not agitated by stirring
lemmas.def_zh: 没有被搅动(过)的,未受激动的

examples.en: The black coffee sat completely unstirred on the table while she answered calls.
examples.zh: 当她接听电话时，那杯完全未经搅动的黑咖啡静静立在桌上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 styrian，核心义为“移动、搅动”，引申为情感的触动或局势的骚动。
family_guide.core_distinction: stir 作动词指搅动或激发；stirring 作名词指微动或情感的萌动。

lemmas.def_en: the 1st letter of the Greek alphabet
lemmas.def_zh: n. 希腊字母首字；最初；头领

examples.en: The alpha wolf led the pack through the dense forest.
examples.zh: 头狼带领着狼群穿越茂密的森林。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于生物或社会学中指“领头者”（alpha male/female），软件开发中搭配 in alpha testing，金融中指超额收益。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊字母表的第一个字母 alpha，引申为“最初”、“主导者”或科学中的基准参数。

lemmas.def_en: the prevailing current of thought
lemmas.def_zh: n. 主流；主潮

examples.en: His unconventional ideas eventually entered the political mainstream.
examples.zh: 他非传统的观点最终进入了政治主流。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词连用，如 enter/join the mainstream of society（融入社会主流），也极常直接作前置定语修饰 media 或 culture。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 main（主要的）和 stream（溪流）构成的复合词，本义为“主流”，引申为思想、文化或趋势的主体。

lemmas.def_en: a title given to rulers or other important people in Asian countries
lemmas.def_zh: n. 可汗；统治者

examples.en: Genghis Khan united the nomadic tribes of the northeast Asian steppe.
examples.zh: 成吉思汗统一了东北亚草原上的游牧部落。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史政治专有名词，指中世纪蒙古或突厥统治者“汗”，常作专有名词大写，如 Genghis Khan，现代语境偶作中东客栈解。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自突厥语与蒙古语的统治者头衔，指中世纪及近代中亚、内亚的君主或领袖。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or operating at the same time
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 同时发生的；同步的

examples.en: The conference provided simultaneous translation in four different languages.
examples.zh: 该会议提供了四种不同语言的同声传译。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于修饰在同一瞬间发生的动作或事件，常搭配translation（同传）或broadcast（同播）。

lemmas.def_en: at the same instant
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 同时地

examples.en: The software allows multiple users to edit the document simultaneously.
examples.zh: 该软件允许多名用户同时编辑该文档。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰两个或多个同时进行的动作，常置于句末或动词前后，书面与口语均常用。

lemmas.def_zh: 同时发生, 同时
lemmas.def_en: happening or existing or done at the same time

examples.en: Einstein fundamentally challenged traditional views regarding the absolute simultaneity of distant events.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦从根本上挑战了关于遥远事件绝对同时发生的传统观点。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 simul（同时），核心表示多件事情在同一时刻发生。
family_guide.core_distinction: simultaneous 为形容词；simultaneously 为副词修饰动作。

lemmas.def_en: a musical composition of several movements only loosely connected
lemmas.def_zh: n. 套房；成套家具；组曲

examples.en: The company upgraded its office suite to improve team productivity.
examples.zh: 公司升级了办公软件套装以提高团队生产力。

lemmas.usage_note: 指成套的事物，如酒店套房、成套家具或软件套装，常作可数名词，注意发音同sweet。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To be convenient, appropriate, or acceptable for someone. 2. [T] (of clothes, colors, or hairstyles) To make someone look attractive. 3. [I, T] To be right for a particular purpose or situation.
lemmas.def_zh: 适合，适宜；与……相配，衬托；使适应

examples.en: Does the proposed meeting time suit your schedule tomorrow afternoon?
examples.zh: 明天下午拟定的会议时间符合你的日程安排吗？

lemmas.usage_note: 表示合乎要求、方便某人或相配，常见搭配如suit somebody fine/well或suit one's needs。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 suite（跟随、连续的一组），引申为成套的房间、家具或乐章；suit 与之同源，表示适合或套装。
family_guide.core_distinction: suite 专指套房、套件或组曲；suit 动词意为适合，名词意为西装或诉讼。

lemmas.def_en: a partially opened flower
lemmas.def_zh: n. 花蕾；花苞

examples.en: The rose bushes are in bud and will flower in a few weeks.
examples.zh: 玫瑰丛正含苞待放，几周后就会开花。

lemmas.usage_note: 指植物的花蕾或叶芽，常搭配in bud（在含苞/发芽中）或nip in the bud（防患于未然）。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To produce, develop, or begin to open into buds.
lemmas.def_zh: 发芽，萌芽，含苞欲放

examples.en: The cherry trees began to bud as the early spring weather turned mild.
examples.zh: 随着早春天气转暖，樱花树开始发芽了。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指植物发芽萌芽；分词budding常用作形容词修饰新秀或萌芽状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不明的中古英语词汇，本义为植物未绽放的“芽、花苞”，引申为萌芽、发芽。
family_guide.core_distinction: bud 作名词指花芽或幼芽；作动词指发芽或萌发。

lemmas.def_en: the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part
lemmas.def_zh: n. 大部分；主体

examples.en: The bulk of the research budget was allocated to clinical trials.
examples.zh: 大部分研究预算都被分配给了临床试验。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用the bulk of表示“大部分/大半”，或与in搭配构成in bulk表示“大批量（购买）”。

lemmas.def_en: an unwieldy largeness
lemmas.def_zh: 庞大, 笨大

examples.en: The sheer bulkiness of the winter coat made it hard to pack neatly.
examples.zh: 这件冬大衣体积极其笨重，很难整齐地打包进箱子。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] ('bulk up') To become larger, thicker, or heavier, especially by gaining muscle mass. 2. [I] To appear large or take on a bulky shape.
lemmas.def_zh: 膨胀，增大；（健身）增肌；使变大

examples.en: The athlete ate a high-protein diet to bulk up before the competition.
examples.zh: 该运动员在赛前摄入高蛋白饮食以增加肌肉和体重。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配bulk up，表示健身增肌增重，或商业上扩大规模；也可用作及物动词指使膨胀。

lemmas.def_en: of large size for its weight
lemmas.def_zh: 庞大的

examples.en: Couriers charged an extra fee to deliver the bulky wooden furniture upstairs.
examples.zh: 快递员因将这件笨重的大件木制家具搬上楼而加收了费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 bulki（船货、堆积物），引申为物体的体积、庞大身躯或主体部分。
family_guide.core_distinction: bulk 作名词指体积或大部分；作动词（常与 up 连用）指膨胀或增肌。

lemmas.def_en: a solemn statement made under oath
lemmas.def_zh: n. 证词；证据；证明

examples.en: Her successful recovery is a moving testimony to the power of perseverance.
examples.zh: 她的成功康复是对坚韧力量感人至深的证明。

lemmas.usage_note: 指法庭证词或事实证明，常见结构为a testimony to（……的明证/有力证明）。

lemmas.def_en: something that serves as evidence
lemmas.def_zh: 证明书, 介绍信, 奖品, 奖金, 奖状, 感谢信, 表扬信

examples.en: The company website features several glowing testimonials from happy clients.
examples.zh: 公司网站上展示了来自满意客户的几篇好评推荐。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To make a formal statement of what is true, especially in a court of law. 2. [I, T] (+ to) To show, confirm, or give clear evidence that something is true.
lemmas.def_zh: 作证，提供证词；证实，证明，表明

examples.en: Two key witnesses were summoned to testify against the defendant in court.
examples.zh: 两名关键证人被传唤出庭作证指控被告。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与against或for连用表示指证或为某人作证，接to表示证实、证明某事属实。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 testis（证人），核心指法庭上的证词，引申为任何形式的证据或证明。

lemmas.def_en: a smooth lustrous round structure inside the shell of a clam or oyster; much valued as a jewel
lemmas.def_zh: n. 珍珠

examples.en: She received a classic necklace made of freshwater pearls for her birthday.
examples.zh: 她生日时收到了一条淡水珍珠制成的经典项链。

lemmas.usage_note: 指天然或养殖珍珠，比喻用法常搭配pearls of wisdom（至理名言、真知灼见）。

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for a human `tooth'

examples.en: He flashed a wide grin, showing off his set of pearlies.
examples.zh: 他咧嘴一笑，露出一口洁白的牙齿。

lemmas.def_en: a diver who searches for molluscs containing pearls
lemmas.def_zh: 采珠人, 采珠船

examples.en: The old pearler spent decades diving for oysters along the northern coast.
examples.zh: 这位老采珠人在北部沿海潜水捕蚌数十年。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To fish for or gather pearls from oysters in the ocean. 2. [I, T] To form into or adorn with pearl-like drops.
lemmas.def_zh: 采珍珠，捕珠；凝结成珠状

examples.en: Drops of cool morning dew pearled on the delicate petals of the flower.
examples.zh: 清晨凉爽的露珠在娇嫩的花瓣上凝结成珠。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词指采珍珠，或水汽等凝结成露珠状；文学语体中常描写汗珠或水滴聚成珠。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 perla（珍珠，可能源自腿或贝壳的形状），引申为如珍珠般珍贵、圆润的事物。
family_guide.core_distinction: pearl 作名词指天然或人工珍珠；作动词指形成珍珠状或捕捞珍珠。

lemmas.def_en: a structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young
lemmas.def_zh: n. 巢；窝

examples.en: The swallows built a secure nest beneath the roof of the old barn.
examples.zh: 燕子在老谷仓的屋檐下筑了一个安全的巢。

lemmas.usage_note: 指鸟兽的巢穴或不良分子的窝点，引申短语nest egg指储备金或养老金。

lemmas.def_en: someone who settles lawfully on government land with the intent to acquire title to it
lemmas.def_zh: 穴居的兽；筑巢的鸟；放牧地自耕农；试验筛组的单位筛

examples.en: Robins are early nesters that often build their homes in April.
examples.zh: 知更鸟属于筑巢较早的鸟类，通常在四月搭窝。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To build or occupy a nest, or settle down comfortably like a bird in a nest.
lemmas.def_zh: 筑巢，做窠；巢居，落脚；嵌入，嵌套

examples.en: Several rare seabirds nest on these rocky cliffs every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，有几种珍稀海鸟会在这些岩石悬崖上筑巢。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指鸟类筑巢栖息，计算机与设计中指结构相互嵌套（nesting），常用于被动语态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始印欧语 *nizdos（坐下休息之地，即 down + sit），指鸟兽栖息繁衍的巢穴，亦可用作动词表示筑巢或嵌套。
family_guide.core_distinction: nest 作名词指窝或巢；作动词指筑巢或嵌入。

lemmas.def_en: an organization of people (or countries) involved in a pact or treaty
lemmas.def_zh: n. 结合；联合体；联合政府

examples.en: The two minority parties formed a coalition to secure a parliamentary majority.
examples.zh: 这两个少数党派结成联盟，以确保在议会中占据多数席位。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于政治语境指政党或国家结成的执政联盟，常搭配form/build a coalition。

lemmas.def_zh: 联合, 结合, 合并
lemmas.def_en: the union of diverse things into one body or form or group; the growing together of parts

lemmas.def_zh: 合并，联合，结合成一体
lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ into/with) To come together to form one larger group, substance, or mass.

examples.en: The smaller community groups coalesced into a powerful regional movement.
examples.zh: 较小的社区团体合并成了一场强大的区域性运动。

lemmas.def_zh: 联合的, 结合的, 合并的
lemmas.def_en: growing together, fusing

examples.en: The painting featured coalescent streams of vivid color blending across the canvas.
examples.zh: 这幅画的特色是画布上交融结合的鲜艳色彩流。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 coalescere（融合、结合到一起），指不同党派、势力为共同目标组成的临时联合体。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 语法；语法规则；入门书

examples.en: Clear communication relies on a basic understanding of sentence grammar.
examples.zh: 清晰的交流依赖于对句子语法的基本理解。

lemmas.usage_note: 指语言语法体系、规则或语法教材，常见搭配为rules of grammar或grammar check。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to grammar
lemmas.def_zh: 语法的, 合乎语法的

examples.en: Your essay is insightful, but it contains a few minor grammatical errors.
examples.zh: 你的文章很有见地，但包含几处小语法错误。

lemmas.def_en: not grammatical; not conforming to the rules of grammar or accepted usage
lemmas.def_zh: 不合语法的, 不正确的

examples.en: Native speakers quickly noticed that the translated sentence was completely ungrammatical.
examples.zh: 母语者很快注意到这个翻译后的句子完全不合语法。

lemmas.def_en: in a grammatical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 符合语法规则地

examples.en: Although the sentence sounded strange, it was still grammatically correct.
examples.zh: 虽然这句话听起来很怪，但在语法上仍是正确的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 grammatike（书写的艺术），经古法语演变而来，指构建语言句式与结构的规则体系。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To happen at the exact same time. 2. [I] (of ideas, opinions, or interests) To meet or agree fully.
lemmas.def_zh: 同时发生；相符，一致

examples.en: The publication of his new book will coincide with the festival's opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 他的新书出版恰逢电影节开幕式。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词with连用，表示两件事在时间上巧合重合，或在观点、利益上完全一致，多用于正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: an event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental
lemmas.def_zh: n. 巧合，巧事；一致

examples.en: By sheer coincidence, we both booked the same flight to Tokyo without knowing it.
examples.zh: 完全是巧合，我们事先都不知情却订了同一趟飞往东京的航班。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词表示巧合状态，可数名词常与pure, sheer连用表示巧事，常用于by coincidence结构。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or operating at the same time
lemmas.def_zh: 一致的, 符合的, 同时发生的

examples.en: The project's launch was coincident with the company's tenth anniversary.
examples.zh: 该项目的启动恰逢公司成立十周年。

lemmas.def_en: happening at the same time
lemmas.def_zh: 巧合地

examples.en: Coincidently, we both booked the exact same hotel for our summer vacations.
examples.zh: 巧合的是，我们俩暑假预订了同一家酒店。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 co-（共同）+ 拉丁语 incidere（落入，发生），核心意为“恰好落在同一时间或空间”。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characterized by homosexual relations between woman
lemmas.def_zh: 女同性恋的

examples.en: The university established a support group for lesbian and bisexual students on campus.
examples.zh: 大学为校内的女同性恋和双性恋学生设立了一个互助组织。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作定语修饰关系、群体、社团或平权议题，在社科与日常交流中均属客观中性表达。

lemmas.def_en: a female homosexual
lemmas.def_zh: 女同性恋者

examples.en: She has been an outspoken advocate for equal rights ever since she came out as a lesbian.
examples.zh: 自公开自己女同性恋者的身份以来，她一直直言不讳地倡导平权。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为可数名词指代女同性恋者，常与come out等表达连用，日常表述中应注意语境尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊女诗人萨福生活的莱斯博斯岛（Lesbos），后专指女性同性恋。

lemmas.def_en: water soaked soil; soft wet earth
lemmas.def_zh: 泥, 诽谤

examples.en: The heavy downpour quickly turned the unpaved road into a river of thick mud.
examples.zh: 暴雨很快把那条未铺柏油的路变成了一条黏稠的泥河。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指泥浆；比喻义中常用于sling/throw mud at sb，表示恶意诽谤污蔑。

lemmas.def_en: the wetness of ground that is covered or soaked with water
lemmas.def_zh: 沾满污泥, 混乱, 糊涂, 浑浊

examples.en: The sudden muddiness of the river indicated heavy rainfall upstream.
examples.zh: 河水突然变得浑浊，表明上游下了大雨。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To cover, soil, or plaster something with mud.
lemmas.def_zh: 使沾满泥巴，抹泥于

examples.en: The children managed to mud their clothes entirely within ten minutes in the garden.
examples.zh: 孩子们在花园里呆了不到十分钟，就把衣服弄得满是泥巴。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，较少见，通常表示用泥涂抹、弄脏或以泥封固，多见于书面或具象描写语境。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make something dirty with mud, or to make liquid cloudy. 2. [T] ('muddy the waters') To make an issue or situation more complicated and difficult to understand.
lemmas.def_zh: 使沾上泥，弄脏；使（水等）变浑浊；使（局势或问题）复杂化

examples.en: His vague responses only served to muddy the waters instead of clarifying the issue.
examples.zh: 他含糊不清的回答不仅没有澄清问题，反而把水搅得更浑了。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既可指弄脏衣物表面，更常用于muddy the waters等比喻，意为搅混局势或使问题复杂化。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系，本义为“湿软的泥土”，引申出“弄脏、使模糊”之意。
