family_guide.core_distinction: mud 作动词多指用泥糊上或沉入泥中；muddy 作动词常用作比喻，指把水搅浑或使事情变复杂。

lemmas.def_en: the father of your father or mother
lemmas.def_zh: n. 祖父，外祖父

examples.en: Her grandfather taught her how to play chess when she was five.
examples.zh: 她五岁时，祖父教她下国际象棋。

lemmas.usage_note: 除指祖父外，常用于 grandfather clock（落地大摆钟）；法律及商务英语中亦可作动词，指适用不受新规限制的“祖父条款”。

family_guide.root_logic: grand-（高一级的，隔代的）+ father（父亲），字面意为隔一代的父亲。

lemmas.def_en: an elastic material obtained from the latex sap of trees (especially trees of the genera Hevea and Ficus) that can be vulcanized and finished into a variety of products
lemmas.def_zh: 橡胶

examples.en: Tires are typically made of natural or synthetic rubber.
examples.zh: 轮胎通常由天然橡胶或合成橡胶制成。

lemmas.usage_note: 橡胶

lemmas.def_en: [T] To coat or treat something with rubber.
lemmas.def_zh: 涂橡胶于；给……包橡胶

examples.en: Workers rubber the underside of the carpet to prevent it from slipping on tile floors.
examples.zh: 工人们在毯子背面涂上一层橡胶，以防其在瓷砖地面上滑动。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，意为涂橡胶于或用橡胶加工包覆，属于工业及技术制造领域的专业语体词汇。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To rubberize fabric or a surface means to coat or treat it with rubber so that it is waterproof or elastic.
lemmas.def_zh: 涂橡胶, 用橡胶处理

examples.en: Workers will rubberize the roof surface to protect the building from leaks.
examples.zh: 工人们将在屋顶表面涂覆橡胶以防止建筑物漏水。

lemmas.def_en: having an elastic texture resembling rubber in flexibility or toughness
lemmas.def_zh: 橡胶似的, 有弹力的

examples.en: Overcooked squid tends to become tough, rubbery, and difficult to chew.
examples.zh: 煮过头的鱿鱼往往会变硬、有嚼劲且难以下咽。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自动词 rub（摩擦），因该物质最初主要用来擦除铅笔字迹（橡皮），后指橡胶材料。

lemmas.def_en: diurnal bird of prey typically having short rounded wings and a long tail
lemmas.def_zh: 鹰, 掠夺者, 鹰派成员

examples.en: Foreign policy hawks in the administration urged the president to impose immediate trade sanctions.
examples.zh: 政府内的外交鹰派人物敦促总统立即实施贸易制裁。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指鹰隼；政治新闻中常作比喻，指主张强硬、好战政策的鹰派人物，与dove（鸽派）相对。

lemmas.def_en: someone who travels about selling his wares (as on the streets or at carnivals)
lemmas.def_zh: 饲鹰者, 以鹰行猎者, 叫卖小贩

examples.en: The street hawker shouted loudly to attract customers to his fruit cart.
examples.zh: 街头小贩大声叫喊，吸引顾客光顾他的水果车。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To travel around selling goods, usually shouting loudly to attract customers. 2. [T] To clear your throat noisily and bring up phlegm.
lemmas.def_zh: 沿街叫卖，兜售；咳出（痰等），清嗓；放鹰捕猎

examples.en: The old man paused on the porch to hawk and spit before answering my question.
examples.zh: 老人站在门廊上停顿了一下，清了清嗓子吐了口痰，然后才回答我的问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指沿街叫卖兜售货物，也可表示用力清嗓、咳出痰液，后者常搭配介词up使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hafoc（鹰），引申出像鹰一样凶猛扑食或盘旋叫卖的动作。

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for a mother
lemmas.def_zh: n. 妈妈，母亲（儿语或口语）

examples.en: The toddler ran toward the door crying for her mama.
examples.zh: 那个蹒跚学步的孩子哭着喊妈妈，跑向门口。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语及儿语词汇，情感色彩亲昵，正式文体及严肃写作中严禁使用，应替换为 mother。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟婴儿学语时发出的自然双唇音，指代母亲。

lemmas.def_en: tiresomely long; seemingly without end
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 无止境的，没完没了的

examples.en: The committee spent endless hours debating minor details without reaching any conclusion.
examples.zh: 委员会花费了无休止的时间争论细枝末节，却未达成任何结论。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰discussions, meetings, possibilities等，带有强烈的夸张或抱怨语气。

lemmas.def_en: continuing forever without end
lemmas.def_zh: 不断地, 无穷尽地

examples.en: The children giggled and talked endlessly during the long car journey.
examples.zh: 在漫长的车程中，孩子们咯咯地笑个不停，说个没完。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being (or seeming to be) without end
lemmas.def_zh: 无止境

examples.en: Looking across the open ocean, she was overwhelmed by its vast endlessness.
examples.zh: 极目远眺辽阔的海洋，她被其无边无际的广阔所震撼。

family_guide.root_logic: end（尽头）+ 后缀 -less（无……的），核心意为“没有终点的”。

lemmas.def_en: the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole
lemmas.def_zh: 比例, 比率, 均衡, 部分, 面积

examples.en: A significant proportion of the annual budget was allocated to medical research.
examples.zh: 年度预算中的相当大一部分被拨给了医学研究。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指部分占总体的比例，常搭配介词of；也指比例协调，常见搭配为in proportion to。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To adjust the size, amount, or parts of something so that they are in the correct and pleasing relation to each other.
lemmas.def_zh: 使成比例，使相称，使协调

examples.en: The architect carefully proportioned the windows to the overall height of the facade.
examples.zh: 建筑师精心设计了窗户的尺寸，使其与建筑正面的总高度保持均衡。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态或与介词to连用，指使某事物的大小、数量或权重与另一事物相称。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pro-（依照）+ portion（部分），核心语义为“各部分之间相互符合的比例关系”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To hit someone or something quickly with the palm of the hand or a flat object. 2. To place or put something down quickly, forcefully, or noisily.
lemmas.def_zh: 掌掴，拍击；啪地放下（或撞上）；施加（处罚等）

examples.en: He was so furious that he slapped the stack of documents down onto the desk.
examples.zh: 他气愤得把那一叠文件狠狠地摔在了办公桌上。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示用手掌打耳光或用力拍击，也可引申为啪地猛摔物品或迅速实施禁令、罚款等。

lemmas.def_en: a hitter who slaps (usually another person) with an open hand
lemmas.def_zh: 飞片；粘舌

examples.en: The engineer inspected the slapper detonator before proceeding with the high-energy experiment.
examples.zh: 工程师在进行高能实验前检查了飞片起爆器。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模仿巴掌或扁平物体快速拍击发出的清脆响声。

lemmas.def_en: a small replica of a person; used as a toy
lemmas.def_zh: n. 玩偶，洋娃娃

examples.en: The little girl refused to go to sleep without her favorite doll.
examples.zh: 小女孩睡觉前一定要抱着她最喜欢的洋娃娃。

lemmas.usage_note: 指玩具洋娃娃；非正式动词短语常搭配 doll oneself up（打扮得花枝招展），日常口语中称人 doll 略显过时且需慎用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自女子教名 Dorothy 的昵称，演变为指代人偶玩偶，亦可代指打扮精致的人。

lemmas.def_en: the funds of a government or institution or individual
lemmas.def_zh: n. 国库，金库；财政部

examples.en: The government poured millions of dollars from the national treasury into infrastructure.
examples.zh: 政府从国库中调拨了数百万美元投入基础设施建设。

lemmas.usage_note: 常大写指“财政部”（如 HM Treasury），小写指国库或公款；常与 national/state 搭配，属正式政治经济语体。

family_guide.root_logic: treasure（珍宝）+ -y（场所后缀），核心意为“存放珍宝与国家资财的地方”。

lemmas.def_en: a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
lemmas.def_zh: n. 婴儿，幼儿

examples.en: Breast milk provides ideal nutrition for the growing infant.
examples.zh: 母乳为成长中的婴儿提供了理想的营养。

lemmas.usage_note: 指一岁以内的婴儿，比 baby 更正式；常作定语构成 infant mortality（婴儿死亡率）或比喻 infant industry（新兴产业）。

lemmas.def_en: the early stage of growth or development
lemmas.def_zh: 幼年, 初期, 幼儿期

examples.en: Artificial intelligence technology was still in its infancy only a few decades ago.
examples.zh: 人工智能技术在几十年前仍处于初期阶段。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（不）+ 拉丁语 fari（说话），字面意为“还不会说话的小生命”。

lemmas.def_en: the overhead upper surface of a covered space
lemmas.def_zh: n. 天花板；最高限额，上限

examples.en: The government decided to raise the national debt ceiling.
examples.zh: 政府决定提高国家债务上限。

lemmas.usage_note: 除天花板外，高频用于经济及职场隐喻，常与 hit/reach 连用，如 glass ceiling（玻璃天花板）或 debt ceiling（债务上限）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 caeler（覆盖、给……装天花板），核心意为“室内的最高覆盖面”，引申为限度。

lemmas.def_en: a very large person; impressive in size or qualities
lemmas.def_zh: 鲸

examples.en: During their boat tour off the coast, they were lucky enough to spot a humpback whale.
examples.zh: 在沿海乘船游览期间，他们很幸运地看到了一头座头鲸。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指海洋鲸类；口语习语have a whale of a time表示玩得极其痛快高兴。

lemmas.def_en: a seaman who works on a ship that hunts whales
lemmas.def_zh: 捕鲸者, 捕鲸船

examples.en: The old wooden whaler returned to the harbor after months in freezing waters.
examples.zh: 那艘老旧的木制捕鲸船在极寒水域航行数月后返回了港口。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. (informal) To hit or thrash someone or something hard and repeatedly (often followed by 'on' or 'into'). 2. [I] To hunt whales.
lemmas.def_zh: 痛打，猛击（常与 on/into 连用）；捕鲸

examples.en: The boxer began to whale away at his opponent as soon as the bell rang.
examples.zh: 铃声一响，拳击手就立即开始对着对手疯狂猛打。

lemmas.usage_note: 传统用法指捕鲸；现代口语中常构成whale away at/on sb/sth短语，表示猛揍或猛烈抨击。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语系，本指巨大的海洋哺乳动物，动词引申出“猛击”或捕鲸之意。

lemmas.def_en: suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
lemmas.def_zh: 方便的，便利的

examples.en: Would it be convenient for you to meet at my office tomorrow morning?
examples.zh: 明天上午在我的办公室见面，您方便吗？

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语或定语，习惯用 it is convenient for sb to do sth，不可直接用人作主语。

lemmas.def_en: in a convenient manner
lemmas.def_zh: 方便地，便利地

examples.en: The newly opened hotel is conveniently located near the central train station.
examples.zh: 这家新开业的酒店位置十分便利，毗邻中央火车站。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰动词或分词，极常与 located、placed 连用，表示地理位置或配置极其便利。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being suitable or opportune
lemmas.def_zh: 便利，方便；便利设施

examples.en: Please review the attached contract and sign it at your earliest convenience.
examples.zh: 请审阅附件中的合同，并在您方便时尽早签字。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“方便”时为不可数名词，常用 at your convenience；指“便利设施”时为可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 convenire（聚集、适合），核心义为“合乎心意的、便利的”。

lemmas.def_en: offensive or even (of persons) malicious; ; ; ; ; ; - Ezra Pound
lemmas.def_zh: 令人厌恶的；恶毒的；严重的

examples.en: He suffered a nasty cut on his knee during the football match.
examples.zh: 他在足球比赛中膝盖受了很严重的割伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容人脾气恶劣，或指天气、伤口、习惯等令人极度不适或严重，语气较强。

lemmas.def_zh: (nasty 的复数) a. 污秽的, 下流的, 险恶的

examples.en: Wearing a proper mask will keep harmful chemical nasties out of your lungs.
examples.zh: 佩戴合适的口罩可以防止有害的下流污秽物进入肺部。

lemmas.def_en: a state characterized by foul or disgusting dirt and refuse
lemmas.def_zh: 污秽, 不洁, 烦人

examples.en: I was surprised by the sheer nastiness of the comments left on her post.
examples.zh: 她帖子底下那些评论的恶毒程度让我感到震惊。

lemmas.def_en: in a nasty ill-tempered manner
lemmas.def_zh: 污秽地, 不洁地, 讨厌地

examples.en: He nastily dismissed her constructive suggestions in front of the entire project team.
examples.zh: 他在整个项目团队面前恶狠狠地驳回了她的建设性建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不详，原指“肮脏的”，现广泛用于形容令人极度反感、恶劣或棘手的人或事物。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To make a formal, solemn promise to do something or give support. 2. To give something valuable as security against a loan.
lemmas.def_zh: 发誓，庄严承诺；抵押

examples.en: The government has pledged millions of dollars to support clean energy projects.
examples.zh: 政府已承诺拨款数百万美元用于支持清洁能源项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，常用 pledge to do sth 或 pledge sth to sb，表示公开庄重地承诺或捐赠。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes or gives a pledge
lemmas.def_zh: 发誓人, 举杯祝酒的人

examples.en: Each pledger was invited onto the stage to receive a certificate of appreciation.
examples.zh: 每位认捐者都被邀请上台接受感谢证书。

lemmas.def_en: not promised in marriage
lemmas.def_zh: 未经保证的,未许诺的

examples.en: A significant portion of the company assets remained completely unpledged during the negotiations.
examples.zh: 在谈判期间，该公司的很大一部分资产仍完全未作抵押。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 plege（保证、人质），核心义为“庄严承诺或以物抵押担保”。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders
lemmas.def_zh: 精神病学

examples.en: Advances in modern psychiatry have significantly improved the treatment of severe depression.
examples.zh: 现代精神病学的进步显著改善了重度抑郁症的治疗效果。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指医学分支“精神病学”，常用于学术讨论、专业学科设置及医疗背景中。

lemmas.def_en: a physician who specializes in psychiatry
lemmas.def_zh: 精神科医生

examples.en: She decided to consult a psychiatrist after struggling with severe anxiety for months.
examples.zh: 在经受数月的严重焦虑折磨后，她决定向精神科医生求助。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指具有处方权的精神科医生，需注意与心理咨询师（psychologist）区分。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or used in or engaged in the practice of psychiatry
lemmas.def_zh: 精神病学的，精神病的

examples.en: The patient was admitted to a specialized psychiatric clinic for further evaluation.
examples.zh: 该患者被送往一家专业的精神科诊所接受进一步评估。

lemmas.usage_note: 定语形容词，专用于修饰医疗机构、病症或治疗，如 psychiatric hospital、treatment。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 psycho-（灵魂、心理）+ -iatry（医治）构成，指治疗心理疾病的专门学科。
family_guide.core_distinction: psychiatrist 是“精神科医生”（专职人员）；psychiatric 是“精神病学的”（修饰病房、治疗等属性）。

lemmas.def_en: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
lemmas.def_zh: 晒黑的肤色(n.)；黄褐色的(adj.)；晒黑；鞣制(v.)

examples.en: She returned from her Mediterranean vacation with a radiant tan.
examples.zh: 她在地中海度假归来，晒出了一身容光焕发的小麦色皮肤。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指晒成的小麦色皮肤，常用搭配 have a tan 或 get a tan，多含健康美感。

lemmas.def_en: a small coin of the United Kingdom worth six pennies; not minted since 1970
lemmas.def_zh: 制革工人

examples.en: The skilled tanner treated the cowhides with natural oils to make them pliable.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的制革工人用天然油脂处理牛皮，使其变得柔软耐用。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指从事皮革鞣制加工的工人或匠人，多见于工业生产或传统手工业语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 制革厂, 硝皮厂
lemmas.def_en: workplace where skins and hides are tanned

examples.en: Strong chemical odors drifted from the local tannery situated beside the industrial canal.
examples.zh: 强烈的化学气味从位于工业运河旁的地方制革厂飘来。

lemmas.def_en: of a light yellowish-brown color
lemmas.def_zh: 晒黑的肤色(n.)；黄褐色的(adj.)；晒黑；鞣制(v.)

examples.en: He wore a stylish tan leather jacket that matched his boots perfectly.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件时髦的黄褐色皮夹克，与他的靴子完美相配。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语或表语，用来形容皮革、衣物、鞋履等呈现黄褐色或棕褐色。

lemmas.def_en: not converted to leather by a tanning agent
lemmas.def_zh: 未晒黑的

examples.en: She covered her untanned shoulders with a scarf to avoid painful sunburns.
examples.zh: 她用围巾遮住未晒黑的双肩，以免被晒伤。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To become brown, or to make someone's skin brown, from exposure to the sun. 2. [T] To convert animal hide into leather.
lemmas.def_zh: 晒黑；鞣（革）

examples.en: Her fair skin tends to burn easily in the sun rather than tan.
examples.zh: 她的皮肤很白，在阳光下往往容易晒伤而不是晒黑。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作不及物动词表“晒黑”，或及物动词表“把……晒黑”以及工商业中的“鞣（皮）”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语 tannum（制革用的栎树皮），由制革浸润引申为黄褐色及晒黑。
family_guide.core_distinction: tan 作为动词既可指“晒黑”也可指“鞣制皮革”；tanner 专指“制革工人”。

lemmas.def_en: showing extreme cupidity; painfully desirous of another's advantages
lemmas.def_zh: 嫉妒的，吃醋的

examples.en: He felt intensely jealous of his brother's sudden fame and fortune.
examples.zh: 他对哥哥突如其来的名声与财富感到无比嫉妒。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语，固定搭配为 be jealous of sb/sth，表示羡慕妒忌，或对伴侣产生猜忌吃醋。

lemmas.def_en: with jealousy
lemmas.def_zh: 嫉妒, 羡慕, 留心, 戒备

examples.en: The dragon jealously guarded the secret mountain cave full of ancient gold coins.
examples.zh: 那条龙警惕地守卫着堆满古代金币的隐秘山洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 zelos（热心、狂热），后演化出“因别人拥有而眼红、嫉妒”之意。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make secret, new, or private information known publicly; to reveal.
lemmas.def_zh: 透露，揭露，公开

examples.en: The company refused to disclose the exact financial terms of the merger.
examples.zh: 该公司拒绝透露此次并购案的具体财务条款。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 details、information、identity 搭配，多用于法律、财务及新闻报道。

lemmas.def_en: not made known
lemmas.def_zh: 未泄露的, 保持秘密的, 不露真名的, 身分不明的

examples.en: The famous painting was sold to a private collector for an undisclosed amount.
examples.zh: 这幅名画以未公开的金额卖给了一位私人收藏家。

lemmas.def_en: the speech act of making something evident
lemmas.def_zh: 揭发, 泄露, 揭发(或暴露)的事实

examples.en: The sensational disclosure of leaked emails caused a public outcry.
examples.zh: 泄露邮件这一惊人内幕的披露引发了公众的强烈抗议。

lemmas.usage_note: 指泄露行为或被公开的信息，商业与法律中常构成 full disclosure 或 disclosure of info。

family_guide.root_logic: dis-（去除）+ close（关闭），字面逻辑为“打开闭合之物”，即“揭露、披露”。

lemmas.def_en: a state of being confined (usually for a short time)
lemmas.def_zh: 监护权；拘留，羁押

examples.en: The suspect was taken into custody immediately following the armed robbery.
examples.zh: 武装抢劫发生后，犯罪嫌疑人立即被警方拘留。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于家庭法表“监护权”（如 win custody）；用于刑事法表“羁押”（如 in police custody）。

lemmas.def_zh: 管理人, 保管人, 监护人
lemmas.def_en: one having charge of buildings or grounds or animals

examples.en: Museum curators act as custodians of national cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 博物馆馆长担任着国家文化遗产保护人的角色。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，可指历史档案、财产等的“监管人”，在美式英语中亦可指学校、大楼清洁工。

lemmas.def_zh: 保管人的资格, 看守人的责任, 看守人的资格, 保管人的责任
lemmas.def_en: the position of custodian
providing protective supervision; watching over or safeguarding
lemmas.def_zh: 保管的, 保管人的

examples.en: The devoted janitor takes immense pride in his daily custodial duties at school.
examples.zh: 这位敬业的门卫对他每天在学校的保洁工作感到非常自豪。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 custos（守护者、看管人），核心义为“拘管或抚养的照料权”。

lemmas.def_en: willing to give and share unstintingly
lemmas.def_zh: 慷慨的，大方的；丰厚的

examples.en: The charitable foundation made a very generous donation to the local hospital.
examples.zh: 这家慈善基金会向当地医院捐赠了一笔非常丰厚的善款。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰人表大方慷慨，常用 be generous with sth；修饰物表分量充足或待遇丰厚。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in magnanimity; - Times Litt. Sup.
lemmas.def_zh: 胸襟狭窄的, 不大方的, 吝啬的

examples.en: It was ungenerous of him to refuse to share the credit with colleagues.
examples.zh: 他不愿与同事分享这份荣誉，显得十分吝啬。

lemmas.def_en: in a generous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 宽大地；慷慨地；丰盛地

examples.en: The local charity was generously funded by a group of anonymous community donors.
examples.zh: 当地慈善机构得到了社区一群匿名捐赠者的大力资助。

lemmas.def_zh: 慷慨, 宽大
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being willing to give your money or time

examples.en: We were deeply moved by the incredible hospitality and generosity of our hosts.
examples.zh: 东道主无比的热情好客与慷慨大度令我们深受感动。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，表示慷慨的美德或大度的举动，常用 thank sb for their generosity。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 genus（出身高贵），由贵族的品行演变为“慷慨的、大方的”。

lemmas.def_en: United States actor (1914-1998)
lemmas.def_zh: 陆军元帅；最高治安官

examples.en: The field marshall reviewed the troops before the commencement of the parade.
examples.zh: 陆军元帅在阅兵式开始前检阅了部队。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词（亦常拼作 marshal），专指高级军事将领、执法官员或特定仪式统筹人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古高地德语 marah（马）+ scalc（仆人），原指管马的官，后演变引申为元帅、治安官（现通常拼作 marshal）。

lemmas.def_en: large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
lemmas.def_zh: 相当多的，相当大的

examples.en: A considerable amount of research is needed before launching the product.
examples.zh: 在该产品上市之前，还需要进行大量的研究工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，表“数量相当大的”，常修饰 amount/number/progress；切勿与 considerate（体贴的）混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: consider（考虑）+ -able（值得……的），引申为“值得考虑的，数量可观的”。

lemmas.def_en: despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
lemmas.def_zh: 尽管如此，然而

examples.en: The journey was exhausting; nevertheless, they were thrilled to reach the summit.
examples.zh: 旅途极其疲惫；尽管如此，他们成功登顶依然感到无比激动。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式副词，用于转折，常置于句首（后接逗号）或句中；属书面语体，相当于 nonetheless，口语中多用 but/yet。

family_guide.root_logic: 组合自 never + the + less，字面义“绝不因此减少”，即转折连词“尽管如此，然而”。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than fifty
lemmas.def_zh: 里（中国市制长度单位，等于500米）

examples.en: The ancient post station was located just one li away from the city gate.
examples.zh: 那座古驿站距离城门只有一里路。

lemmas.usage_note: 中国长度单位“里”的音译；作修饰语时单复数同形，通常直接作名词或前置定语，仅在涉及中国传统文化语境下使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 汉语拼音借词，指中国传统的长度单位“里”，亦可作为定语使用。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the sixth and just before the eighth in position
lemmas.def_zh: 第七的；第七个的

examples.en: This is the company's seventh consecutive year of profit growth.
examples.zh: 这是该公司利润连续增长的第七年。

lemmas.usage_note: 序数词或名词，前常加 the 表示“第七”，也可作分数表“七分之一”（前面加 a/one）；常用于日期与排位。

family_guide.root_logic: 基数词 seven（七）+ -th 构成序数词，表示序列中的第七。

lemmas.def_en: a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback
lemmas.def_zh: n. 牛仔；莽撞冒险的人

examples.en: The old cowboy spent decades herding cattle across the plains.
examples.zh: 这位老牛仔花了几十年的时间在平原上放牧。

lemmas.usage_note: 除本义“牛仔”外，英式口语中常作定语修饰职业（如 cowboy builder），贬指“做事鲁莽、不可靠的人”。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 cow（牛）+ boy（男孩/牧童）组成的复合词，原指放牧牛群的人，后引申出轻率冒险之意。

lemmas.def_en: unpleasantly stern
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 严厉的；残酷的；刺耳的

examples.en: The arctic explorers had to endure exceptionally harsh weather conditions for weeks.
examples.zh: 北极探险队员们不得不连续数周忍受极其恶劣的天气环境。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰criticism（严厉的）、climate/conditions（恶劣的）或light/sound（刺眼刺耳的）。

lemmas.def_en: in a harsh or unkind manner
lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙地, 粗暴地, 刺耳地

examples.en: The strict manager harshly criticized the junior employee for making a minor mistake.
examples.zh: 严厉的经理因一名初级员工犯了一个小错而对其严加训斥。

lemmas.def_en: the roughness of a substance that causes abrasions
lemmas.def_zh: 粗糙事物, 刺耳, 严肃

examples.en: The harshness of the arctic winter forced the small exploration team indoors.
examples.zh: 北极严冬的残酷环境迫使小型探险队留在室内。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪英语，最初形容触感粗糙，后引申为环境恶劣、言辞严厉或感觉刺耳刺眼。

lemmas.def_en: a ceremonial procession including people marching
lemmas.def_zh: n. 游行；检阅队列

examples.en: Thousands of spectators gathered along the main street to watch the annual Thanksgiving parade.
examples.zh: 成千上万的观众聚集在主干道两旁，观看一年一度的感恩节游行。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指阅兵式、节日游行或招摇的展示，高频搭配有 hold a parade 与 on parade。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To walk or march in a procession or stride around ostentatiously to be seen. 2. [T] To display or flaunt something proudly in order to impress others.
lemmas.def_zh: 游行，招摇过市；炫耀，大肆展示

examples.en: He loved to parade his expensive new sports car through the center of the town.
examples.zh: 他喜欢开着那辆昂贵的新跑车在市中心招摇过市。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作不及物或及物动词，指成队游行，或贬义的炫耀、卖弄，常与 down 或 through 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 parare（准备、陈设），指经过准备、按队列公开展示的游行或炫耀行为。

lemmas.def_en: a complex of concurrent things
lemmas.def_zh: n. 综合征；典型表现

examples.en: Burnout is a common syndrome among medical professionals facing chronic stress.
examples.zh: 倦怠是面临长期压力的医疗专业人员中常见的综合征。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指医学上的“综合征”（如 Down's syndrome），也常用于引申比喻社会/心理的不良现象（如 empty-nest syndrome）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 syn-（共同）+ dromos（奔跑），原指“同时跑向一处”，在医学与社会学中指一组并发的症状或特征。

lemmas.def_en: having no limits or boundaries in time or space or extent or magnitude
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 无限的；极大的

examples.en: Teaching energetic kindergarteners requires an infinite amount of patience and empathy.
examples.zh: 教导精力旺盛的幼儿园小朋友需要无限的耐心与同理心。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容空间、时间、耐心或资源等无限或极大，常搭配 patience, wisdom 或 possibilities。

lemmas.def_en: without bounds
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 无限地；极其

examples.en: Working remotely turned out to be infinitely better for her mental health and productivity.
examples.zh: 事实证明，远程办公对她的心理健康和工作效率要好得多。

lemmas.usage_note: 作副词修饰形容词或副词比较级，相当于 far 或 much，意为“极其、……得多”。

lemmas.def_en: time without end
lemmas.def_zh: n. 无穷，无限

examples.en: Standing under the clear night sky, she gazed into the cold infinity of outer space.
examples.zh: 她站在晴朗的夜空下，凝视着外太空那冰冷深邃的无穷无尽。

lemmas.usage_note: 指无限、无穷尽或无限远的时间与空间，数学与哲学高频词，常见搭配 stretch to infinity。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（无）+ finis（边界/限度），核心义为没有边际或极限的。
family_guide.core_distinction: infinite 为形容词表示无限的；infinitely 为副词修饰形容词或动词，表示极其、无限地。

lemmas.def_en: a long thin implement made of metal or wood
lemmas.def_zh: n. 杆；棒；钓竿；惩戒之杖

examples.en: He packed his fishing rod and headed to the lake early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他收拾好钓竿，大清早就向湖边出发了。

lemmas.usage_note: 指金属或木质硬杆，常见固定搭配如 fishing rod（钓鱼竿）；谚语 spare the rod and spoil the child（省了棍子惯了孩子）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，本义为笔直细长的棍状物，现广泛用于工具、结构件或惩戒用具。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To admit that something is true, valid, or proper, often unwillingly. 2. To acknowledge defeat in a contest or election. 3. To give up or surrender a right, point, or territory.
lemmas.def_zh: （勉强）承认；让步，认输；让与，割让

examples.en: After the recount, the candidate had no choice but to concede defeat.
examples.zh: 重新计票后，该候选人别无选择，只能承认败选。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于正式语境，后接名词、that从句或宾语从句，常见搭配concede defeat（认输）。

lemmas.def_en: a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business
lemmas.def_zh: n. 让步；妥协；特许经营权

examples.en: Both sides were unwilling to make any concession during the trade talks.
examples.zh: 在贸易谈判中，双方均不愿做出任何让步。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于政治谈判或商业语境，常见搭配make concessions to（向……妥协退让）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 con-（完全）+ cedere（让步、离开），核心意象为向对方让步、退回立场。
family_guide.core_distinction: concede 为动词表示承认或让步；concession 为名词表示妥协、让步或特许权。

lemmas.def_en: a person authorized to conduct religious worship
lemmas.def_zh: n. 牧师

examples.en: The pastor delivered an inspiring sermon to the congregation on Sunday.
examples.zh: 牧师在周日向全体会众发表了一场鼓舞人心的讲道。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指新教教会的专职神职人员或牧者，作主语或称谓，常用于宗教生活语境。

lemmas.def_en: a musical composition that evokes rural life
lemmas.def_zh: n. 田园诗；田园画；田园乐

examples.en: Beethoven's Sixth Symphony is often celebrated as a masterpiece of musical pastoral.
examples.zh: 贝多芬的《第六交响曲》常被赞誉为音乐田园乐的杰作。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学与艺术专用名词，指描绘乡村简朴生活或牧人田园风景的诗歌、画作或乐曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pastor（牧羊人），基督教引申为照料信众灵魂的“精神牧人”。
family_guide.core_distinction: pastor 指牧师；pastoral 虽可作形容词（田园的/牧师的），作名词时特指“田园诗/田园乐”，侧重艺术体裁。

lemmas.def_en: pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion; ; ; ; - Thackeray; - Lillian Hellman
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 英俊的；可观的；大方的

examples.en: The startup generated a handsome profit in its very first year of operation.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司在运营的第一年就获得了丰厚的利润。

lemmas.usage_note: 除形容男子英俊外，常修饰利润、回报或数目，意为“可观的；丰厚的”，属正式书面语。

lemmas.def_en: in an attractively handsome manner
lemmas.def_zh: 漂亮地, 整齐地, 当心地, 慢慢地, 优厚地, 慷慨地, 美观地

examples.en: The talented young architect was handsomely rewarded for her innovative building design.
examples.zh: 这位年轻有为的建筑师因其创新的建筑设计而获得了丰厚的回报。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of having regular well-defined features (especially of a man)
lemmas.def_zh: 英俊, 漂亮

examples.en: His natural handsomeness caught the immediate attention of several prominent talent scouts.
examples.zh: 他天生的英俊相貌立刻引起了几位著名星探的注意。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 hand（手）+ -some（易于……的），原指“便手的、便于操作的”，后演变为仪表堂堂、体面的，进一步引申为数量可观的。

lemmas.def_en: concerned with religion or religious purposes
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 神圣的；受尊重的；不可侵犯的

examples.en: They consider it their sacred duty to protect the ancient forest from logging.
examples.zh: 他们认为保护这片原始森林免遭砍伐是自己神圣的职责。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语或表语，修饰宗教圣物或不可侵犯的权利，常见搭配sacred duty（神圣职责）。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being sacred
lemmas.def_zh: 神圣不可侵犯性

examples.en: The tribe fought bravely to preserve the absolute sacredness of their ancestral land.
examples.zh: 该部落勇敢战斗，以维护其祖传土地的绝对神圣性。

lemmas.def_en: by religion
lemmas.def_zh: 神圣地

examples.en: They sacredly promised to honor the ancient traditions passed down by their ancestors.
examples.zh: 他们庄严发誓要恪守祖先流传下来的古老传统。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sacrare（奉献给神），指受到神圣力量保护、不可侵犯的事物。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To make a digital audio recording and make it available on the internet for people to download or stream.
lemmas.def_zh: 制作（或发布）播客节目

examples.en: The science journalists decided to podcast their weekly interviews directly to subscribers.
examples.zh: 科技记者们决定直接向订阅用户播客推送他们的每周访谈。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代数字传媒词汇，可用作及物或不及物动词，指制作、录制或通过网络分发播客节目。

family_guide.root_logic: 现代合成词，由 iPod（苹果便携播放器）+ broadcast（广播）缩合而成，现兼作名词与动词。

lemmas.def_en: the soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat
lemmas.def_zh: n. 肉；肌肉

examples.en: It was thrilling to finally meet the renowned author in the flesh.
examples.zh: 终于亲眼见到这位著名作家，令人激动不已。

lemmas.usage_note: 指人畜肉体或果肉，常见成语搭配in the flesh（本人；亲身），属于通用语体。

lemmas.def_en: more than average fatness
lemmas.def_zh: 肥胖, 多肉

examples.en: Gardeners prefer this heirloom tomato variety for the rich fleshiness of its fruit.
examples.zh: 园丁们更喜欢这种传家宝番茄品种，因为它的果实多肉饱满。

lemmas.def_en: usually describes a large person who is fat but has a large frame to carry it
lemmas.def_zh: 肉的, 肉体的

examples.en: The cactus stores water inside its thick, fleshy leaves during the dry summer.
examples.zh: 仙人掌在干燥的夏季把水分储存在其厚而多肉的叶子里。

lemmas.def_en: marked by the appetites and passions of the body
lemmas.def_zh: 肉体的, 肉欲的, 耽于声色的

examples.en: The ancient monks chose to renounce all fleshly desires to seek spiritual enlightenment.
examples.zh: 古代僧侣选择放弃一切肉体欲望以寻求精神启迪。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To remove adhering meat and fat from the underside of a skin or hide. 2. (flesh something out) To add more details or information to something to make it fuller.
lemmas.def_zh: 刮除（生皮上的）肉；充实，丰富（常与 out 连用）

examples.en: The committee asked the designer to flesh out the preliminary proposal with budget estimates.
examples.zh: 委员会要求设计师为初步提案补充预算预估等详实细节。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与副词out连用（flesh out），指为提纲、论点或计划补充详实细节，使之丰富饱满。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 flæsc，本义为人和动物的肉体、软组织，引申指人类脆弱的本性或将骨架充实起来。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作动词时常与 out 连用（flesh out），表示充实内容、使丰满。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of righteous anger
lemmas.def_zh: 愤怒，愤慨

examples.en: The corrupt official's lenient sentence caused widespread public outrage.
examples.zh: 对这名贪官的轻判引发了公众的普遍愤怒。

lemmas.usage_note: 愤怒，愤慨

lemmas.def_en: excessive excess
lemmas.def_zh: outrageous的变形

examples.en: The sheer outrageousness of his rude demand left everyone in the meeting speechless.
examples.zh: 他那粗鲁要求的荒谬至极让会议上的每个人都目瞪口呆。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to make someone extremely angry and shocked, especially through an unjust, cruel, or offensive action.
lemmas.def_zh: 激怒，使极度愤慨；触犯，违犯

examples.en: The cruelty of the act outraged the entire local community.
examples.zh: 这一行径的残暴彻底激怒了整个当地社区。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指某行为或言论极大地触怒公众或违背道德常理，多用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: grossly offensive to decency or morality; causing horror
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极其荒谬的；令人无法容忍的

examples.en: Charging fifty dollars for a bottle of tap water is utterly outrageous.
examples.zh: 一瓶自来水收取五十美元完全是荒唐透顶。

lemmas.usage_note: 强烈的评判性形容词，修饰行为、价格或言辞，意为“令人无法容忍的”或“离谱的”。

lemmas.def_en: in a very offensive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 凶残地; 肆无忌惮地; 令人不能容忍地; 不寻常地

examples.en: The luxury goods at the airport boutique were priced outrageously high for ordinary travelers.
examples.zh: 机场精品店里的奢侈品对普通旅客来说定价高得离谱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 outre（超出限度，来自拉丁语 ultra）+ -age（状态），指越过行为底线的暴行或由此引发的极度愤慨。
family_guide.core_distinction: outrage 兼具动词与名词，指激怒或义愤；outrageous 为形容词，指骇人听闻的、无法容忍的。

lemmas.def_en: a precise rule (or set of rules) specifying how to solve some problem
lemmas.def_zh: n. 算法；计算程序

examples.en: The search engine uses a proprietary algorithm to rank web pages relevance.
examples.zh: 该搜索引擎使用专有算法来对网页的相关性进行排序。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技与计算机核心词汇，可数名词，常见搭配genetic/search algorithm，表示计算方法或推荐机制。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or having the characteristics of an algorithm
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 算法的

examples.en: Social media platforms rely heavily on algorithmic recommendations to keep users engaged daily.
examples.zh: 社交媒体平台严重依赖算法推荐来保持用户的日常参与度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自9世纪波斯数学家花拉子米（al-Khwārizmī）的名字，经拉丁化后演变为指解决数学或计算问题的一套固定规则与步骤。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed. 2. [T] To restore or reorganize something such as a life, system, or organization.
lemmas.def_zh: 重建，重修；恢复，重新建立

examples.en: The company had to rebuild customer trust after the severe data breach.
examples.zh: 在遭遇严重的数据泄露事件后，该公司不得不重新建立客户信任。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，可指物理层面的重建建筑物，也可抽象指修复信任或经济，常接抽象名词。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense and past participle of rebuild: to construct something again after damage or destruction.
lemmas.def_zh: 重建，重修（rebuild 的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: The historic church was carefully rebuilt after being destroyed in the fire.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的教堂在被大火摧毁后得到了细致的重建。

lemmas.usage_note: rebuild的过去式或过去分词形态，强调已完成的重建动作或状态，常用于被动句中。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ build（建造），核心义为重建或恢复。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To force or oblige someone to do something. 2. [T] To evoke or bring about a particular reaction or feeling by having strong authority or quality.
lemmas.def_zh: 强迫，迫使；激起，引发

examples.en: A severe economic crisis compelled the government to cut public spending.
examples.zh: 严重的经济危机迫使政府削减公共开支。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，最常见句型为compel sb. to do sth.，指法律、环境或道德迫使某人行动。

lemmas.def_zh: 强制的, 强迫的
lemmas.def_en: caused by or suggestive of psychological compulsion

examples.en: His compulsive gambling eventually drove his family into financial ruin.
examples.zh: 他难以克制的强迫性赌瘾最终导致家庭陷入经济破产。

lemmas.usage_note: 心理学及日常用语，指不受理性控制的成瘾行为或冲动，如compulsive liar/gambling。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 强迫性的
lemmas.def_en: a person with a compulsive disposition; someone who feels compelled to do certain things

examples.en: Cognitive behavioral therapy is often recommended for the compulsive struggling with routine disruption.
examples.zh: 认知行为疗法常被推荐给因生活规律被打乱而痛苦挣扎的强迫症患者。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与心理学名词，指患有强迫症或具有强迫行为倾向的人，多用于专业语境中。

lemmas.def_zh: 强迫, 强制
lemmas.def_en: an urge to do or say something that might be better left undone or unsaid

examples.en: She felt a sudden compulsion to check whether the front door was locked.
examples.zh: 她突然感到一种难以克制的冲动，非要去确认前门是否锁好。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指心理上无法抗拒的冲动，也可指外在强迫力量，常搭配feel a compulsion to do sth.。

lemmas.def_zh: 强迫性
lemmas.def_en: the trait of acting compulsively

lemmas.def_zh: compulsive（强迫的, 有强制性的）的变形
lemmas.def_en: the trait of acting compulsively

lemmas.def_zh: 强制地, 强迫地
lemmas.def_en: in a compulsive manner

examples.en: he cleaned his shoes compulsively after every walk

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 com-（加强语气）+ pel（推、驱使），引申为强迫、迫使。

lemmas.def_en: identifying the nature or cause of some phenomenon
lemmas.def_zh: 诊断；判断

examples.en: The doctor confirmed the diagnosis of pneumonia after examining the patient's chest X-ray.
examples.zh: 医生检查了病人的胸部X光片后，确诊其患有肺炎。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指医学诊断也可引申为对问题的分析判断，常搭配 make a diagnosis 与 early diagnosis。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To identify the nature or cause of an illness, problem, or fault through examination and analysis.
lemmas.def_zh: 诊断（病情）；判断（故障）

examples.en: The experienced doctor was able to diagnose the rare illness after several detailed tests.
examples.zh: 经过几次详细检查后，这位经验丰富的医生确诊了这种罕见疾病。

lemmas.def_en: concerned with diagnosis; used for furthering diagnosis
lemmas.def_zh: 诊断的, 有助于诊断的, 特征的

examples.en: The clinic introduced a rapid diagnostic test to identify respiratory infections within an hour.
examples.zh: 该诊所推出了一种快速诊断测试，能在一小时内识别出呼吸道感染。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰名词，指用于诊断的工具、测试或具有特征性的症状，常接 tool, test 或 procedure。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dia-（穿过、彻底）+ gnosis（知道、认知），意为彻底查明并做出诊断。

lemmas.def_en: an accumulation caused by clogging or a stoppage
lemmas.def_zh: 备份；支持；后备人员

examples.en: Always make a regular backup of your critical data.
examples.zh: 务必定期备份你的关键数据。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词不可连带空格，搭配make a backup（做备份）、act as a backup（作后备支持）；注意动词短语为back up。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自短语 back up（支持、备份），名词化后指后备人员、支援或数据副本。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity much larger than is needed
lemmas.def_zh: 过量；过度的

examples.en: Drinking coffee to excess can lead to insomnia, anxiety, and an elevated heart rate.
examples.zh: 过量饮用咖啡会导致失眠、焦虑和心率加快。

lemmas.usage_note: 指超出必要限度的数量或行为，常用于短语 in excess of（超过）与 to excess（过度）。

lemmas.def_en: more than is needed, desired, or required
lemmas.def_zh: 过量；过度的

examples.en: Passengers will be required to pay an additional fee for any excess baggage at check-in.
examples.zh: 办理登机手续时，乘客需为所有超重行李支付额外费用。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语，表示额外的、多余的或过剩的，常见搭配 excess baggage/weight/heat。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ex-（向外）+ cess（走），原指走得太远，引申为超过限度、过量。
family_guide.core_distinction: excess 作为名词表示过量；作为形容词表示过度的、多余的。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ through) To look casually through books, shops, or websites without searching for anything specific. 2. [I] (zoology) (of animals) To feed on leaves, twigs, or other vegetation.
lemmas.def_zh: 浏览，翻阅；随意翻看（商品等）；（动物）吃草

examples.en: I spent a relaxing Sunday afternoon browsing through old paperbacks in the local bookstore.
examples.zh: 周日下午，我在当地的书店里随手翻阅旧平装书，度过了一段惬意的时光。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示漫无目的地在商店闲逛翻看，或在网络上浏览网页，常与 through 或 among 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a viewer who looks around casually without seeking anything in particular
lemmas.def_zh: 浏览器；浏览者

examples.en: You may need to clear your browser cache if the website does not load correctly.
examples.zh: 如果网站无法正常加载，你可能需要清理一下浏览器缓存。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指计算机网络浏览器软件，也可指随便看看而不买的顾客，常见搭配 web browser。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指动物吃嫩叶，引申指随意浏览书籍、网页或商品。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who has recently been married
lemmas.def_zh: 新娘

examples.en: The bride smiled radiantly as she walked down the aisle.
examples.zh: 新娘走在过道上时绽放出灿烂的笑容。

lemmas.usage_note: 指婚礼上的“新娘”，常与 groom 相对；注意中式英语中结婚前称为 fiancee，婚礼及刚结婚时才称 bride。

lemmas.def_en: archaic terms for a wedding or wedding feast
lemmas.def_zh: 婚礼；新娘的

examples.en: She spent months shopping for the perfect bridal gown.
examples.zh: 她花了好几个月选购完美的婚纱。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作为形容词修饰语，作名词时指婚礼仪式或新娘婚庆用品（常作复数 bridals），偏书面与商业语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 brȳd，专指新娘，派生出婚礼相关的修饰词。
family_guide.core_distinction: bride 为新娘；bridal 虽多作形容词（婚礼的），亦可作名词指婚礼或婚宴。

lemmas.def_en: sound recording consisting of a disk with a continuous groove; used to reproduce music by rotating while a phonograph needle tracks in the groove
lemmas.def_zh: 唱片；光盘

examples.en: The band released their latest album on compact disc and vinyl.
examples.zh: 该乐队以CD和黑胶唱片形式发行了他们的最新专辑。

lemmas.usage_note: 唱片；光盘

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 diskos（圆盘、掷铁饼），专指扁平的圆形物体。

lemmas.def_en: an enclosure made or wire or metal bars in which birds or animals can be kept
lemmas.def_zh: 笼子；关入笼中

examples.en: The frightened parrot fluttered frantically against the bars of its metal cage.
examples.zh: 受惊的鹦鹉在金属鸟笼的栅条上狂乱地扑腾着翅膀。

lemmas.usage_note: 指关动物的鸟笼、兽笼或金属护栏结构，常用作名词主宾语，常搭配 iron cage 或 bird cage。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to put or confine someone or an animal in a cage.
lemmas.def_zh: 关入笼中，监禁

examples.en: Animal welfare activists argue that it is cruel to cage wild beasts for human entertainment.
examples.zh: 动物福利倡导者认为，为了人类娱乐而将野生动物关进笼子是残忍的。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指把人或动物关在笼中或禁锢起来，常与 up 连用或以被动语态形式出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cavea（空穴、围场），指关动物或物体的笼子，动词意为关入笼中。

lemmas.def_en: a public building for gambling and entertainment
lemmas.def_zh: 赌场；俱乐部

examples.en: The city is famous for its luxurious hotels and lively casinos.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其豪华的酒店和热闹的赌场而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 指赌场，常见搭配有 casino resort（赌场度假村）或 online casino（线上赌场），去赌场常说 go to a casino。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 casa（房屋）+ -ino（小词缀），原指乡村小夏宫，后专指赌场。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To come to an end and no longer be valid or effective. 2. [I] (formal) To die or breathe one's last breath.
lemmas.def_zh: 期满，失效，终止；断气，死亡

examples.en: Please ensure you renew your passport before it expires at the end of next month.
examples.zh: 请务必在下个月底护照到期之前办理更换手续。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指执照、合同、食品等有效期限届满，文雅语体中可委婉表示人断气身亡。

lemmas.def_en: a coming to an end of a contract period
lemmas.def_zh: 终止, 满期, 呼出, 呼气

examples.en: Check the expiration date on the milk carton before you pour it into your cereal.
examples.zh: 在你把牛奶倒进麦片前，先看一下牛奶盒上的保质期。

lemmas.def_en: not having come to an end or been terminated by passage of time
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 未期满的, 未到期的

examples.en: You must hold a passport with at least six months of unexpired validity to travel.
examples.zh: 出国旅行前，你必须持有一本有效期在六个月以上且未过期的护照。

lemmas.def_zh: 吐气的, 呼气的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the breathing out phase of respiration

examples.en: The doctor carefully measured the patient's expiratory reserve volume during the breathing test.
examples.zh: 在呼吸测试中，医生仔细测量了患者的补呼气量。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ex-（出）+ spire（呼吸），原意为断气、呼出最后一口气，引申为期满、失效。

lemmas.def_en: a science that deals with the history of the earth as recorded in rocks
lemmas.def_zh: 地质学；地质情况

examples.en: The complex geology of the island indicates that it was formed by active volcanic eruptions.
examples.zh: 该岛屿复杂的地质构造表明，它是由活跃的火山喷发形成的。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指地质学这一学科，或某一区域的地质构造特征与岩石状况。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in geology
lemmas.def_zh: 地质学家, 地质学者

examples.en: The field geologist collected several rock samples from the base of the active volcano.
examples.zh: 这位野外地质学家从活火山脚下采集了几份岩石样本。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or based on geology
lemmas.def_zh: 地质的；地质学的

examples.en: The research team conducted a detailed geological survey to assess earthquake risks in the region.
examples.zh: 研究小组开展了详细的地质调查，以评估该地区的地震风险。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语，修饰与地质学或地质过程相关的时期、构造、调查，常接 survey, era 或 fault。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or based on geology
lemmas.def_zh: 地质的, 地质学的

examples.en: The Grand Canyon preserves a stunning record of Earth's ancient geologic history and changes.
examples.zh: 大峡谷保存着地球古老地质历史和变迁的惊人记录。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to geology
lemmas.def_zh: 从地质上来说

examples.en: This quiet valley is geologically active and prone to frequent minor earthquakes throughout the year.
examples.zh: 这个宁静的山谷在地质上非常活跃，全年都容易发生频繁的轻微地震。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 geo-（地球、土地）+ -logy（学科），指研究地球结构与演化的地质学。
family_guide.core_distinction: geology 为学科名词；geological 为修饰该领域的形容词。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To cover something with a veil; to hide, mask, or disguise feelings, intentions, or facts.
lemmas.def_zh: 掩饰，隐瞒；用面纱遮盖

examples.en: Heavy morning mist veiled the distant hills, making the landscape look mysterious.
examples.zh: 晨间浓重的薄雾笼罩着远处的群山，使整个景色显得神秘莫测。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用面纱遮盖，引申为掩饰、隐瞒情感或真实意图，多用被动语态或分词 veiled。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To show or introduce a new plan, product, or system to the public for the first time; to remove a cover or veil from something.
lemmas.def_zh: 公布，推出；揭幕，揭开面纱

examples.en: The tech giant plans to unveil its next-generation smartphone at the upcoming conference tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头计划在明天即将举行的发布会上揭晓其下一代智能手机。

lemmas.def_en: a garment that covers the head and face
lemmas.def_zh: 面纱；面罩

examples.en: The bride lifted her lace veil to smile at the groom as the ceremony began.
examples.zh: 仪式开始时，新娘掀起蕾丝面纱，对着新郎微笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 面纱；面罩

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 戴面纱的；隐蔽的，含蓄的
lemmas.def_en: covered with or wearing a veil; not openly expressed, disguised
lemmas.usage_note: 比喻义非常常用，特别是 a veiled threat（隐晦的威胁）、veiled criticism（含蓄的批评）。

examples.en: His gentle words concealed a veiled threat that left everyone uneasy.
examples.zh: 他温和的话语中隐藏着含蓄的威胁，令大家感到不安。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 velum（布篷、幕），本指面纱、遮蔽物，动词引申为掩盖或隐瞒。

lemmas.def_en: a rule or especially body of rules or principles generally established as valid and fundamental in a field or art or philosophy
lemmas.def_zh: 准则，标准；经典

examples.en: Shakespeare's dramatic works have long been regarded as central to the Western literary canon.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧作品长期以来一直被视为西方文学经典全集的核心。

lemmas.usage_note: 准则，标准；经典

lemmas.def_en: (Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox Church) the act of admitting a deceased person into the canon of saints
lemmas.def_zh: 追封为圣者, 视...为典范

examples.en: Thousands of faithful pilgrims gathered in the square to celebrate the beloved nun's canonization.
examples.zh: 成千上万虔诚的朝圣者聚集在广场上，庆祝这位敬爱的修女被封为圣人。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in canon law
lemmas.def_zh: 圣典学者, 宗规专家

examples.en: The cardinal consulted a renowned canonist to interpret the complex church laws properly.
examples.zh: 枢机主教咨询了一位著名的教会法学者，以正确解释复杂的教会法。

lemmas.def_en: appearing in a biblical canon
lemmas.def_zh: 依教规的, 被认为圣典的, 权威的, 典型的

examples.en: Her latest novel quickly became a canonical example of modern American gothic fiction.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说很快成为了现代美国哥特式小说的典范之作。

lemmas.def_en: appearing in a biblical canon
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 正规的

examples.en: The research paper describes the transformation of data into its standard canonic form.
examples.zh: 这篇研究论文描述了将数据转化为标准正规形式的过程。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (religion) to officially declare a deceased person to be a saint. 2. to regard or accept someone or their work as authoritative, classic, or sacred.
lemmas.def_zh: 封为圣徒；推崇，尊崇，奉为权威

examples.en: The literary critics seemed eager to canonize the young poet before his second book appeared.
examples.zh: 文学评论家们似乎急于在这位年轻诗人的第二本书出版前就将他捧为大师。

lemmas.def_en: in a canonical manner
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 正则地

examples.en: These sacred texts are canonically accepted as authoritative scriptures by the traditional religious council.
examples.zh: 这些神圣文本被传统宗教委员会依教规公认为具有权威性的经典。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kanon（直尺、标准），引申为教规、准则、公认的经典作品全集。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To teach or coach an individual student or small group.
lemmas.def_zh: 辅导，个别指导；当家庭教师

examples.en: She tutors local high school students in advanced mathematics every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每个周末都给当地的高中生辅导高等数学。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，接人或科目，表示课外辅导、私人授课，常见搭配为 tutor sb in sth。

lemmas.def_en: a session of intensive tuition given by a tutor to an individual or to a small number of students
lemmas.def_zh: 大学辅导课；指南，教程

examples.en: He watched an online video tutorial to learn how to edit digital photos.
examples.zh: 他看了一段在线视频教程来学习如何编辑数码照片。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指高校中的小组辅导课，或网上的操作指南、视频教程，常用搭配 follow a tutorial。

lemmas.def_zh: 守护, 监护, 指导
lemmas.def_en: teaching pupils individually (usually by a tutor hired privately)

examples.en: Under the strict tutelage of her mentor, she blossomed into a skilled pianist.
examples.zh: 在导师的严厉指导下，她成长为一名技艺高超的钢琴家。

lemmas.def_en: teaching pupils individually (usually by a tutor hired privately)
lemmas.def_zh: 教师之职位

examples.en: He gained invaluable academic experience during his three-year tutorship at the prestigious university.
examples.zh: 在这所著名大学任教的三年导师任期内，他获得了极其宝贵的学术经验。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 tueri（守护、照看），引申为学术上的个别指导与监护。
family_guide.core_distinction: tutor侧重提供辅导的人或动作，tutorial指辅导课或教程。

lemmas.def_en: language used in a figurative or nonliteral sense
lemmas.def_zh: 比喻；老套的桥段，常见母题

examples.en: The haunted house has become a familiar trope in modern horror movies.
examples.zh: 鬼屋已经成为现代恐怖电影中一个屡见不鲜的套路桥段。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，文学修辞中指比喻，文化评论中常指影视中老生常谈的套路、陈词滥调或母题。

lemmas.def_zh: 回归线
lemmas.def_en: either of two parallels of latitude about 23.5 degrees to the north and south of the equator representing the points farthest north and south at which the sun can shine directly overhead and constituting the boundaries of the Torrid Zone or tropics

examples.en: The ship slowly crossed the northern tropic into the vast expanse of ocean.
examples.zh: 船只缓缓越过北回归线，驶入辽阔的大洋。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)
lemmas.def_zh: 热带的；湿热的

examples.en: They spent their winter vacation exploring a lush tropical rainforest.
examples.zh: 他们度过寒假，探索了一片郁郁葱葱的热带雨林。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰气候、植物、风暴等自然地理概念，意为热带的或湿热的，常作前置定语。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

examples.en: The ship slowly crossed the northern tropic into the vast expanse of ocean.
examples.zh: 船只缓缓越过北回归线，驶入辽阔的大洋。

lemmas.def_en: in a tropical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 关于热带方面

examples.en: The boutique hotel was tropically styled with bamboo furniture, palm plants, and bright fabrics.
examples.zh: 这家精品酒店采用热带风格装饰，配有竹制家具、棕榈植物和鲜艳的面料。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 tropos（旋转、方向），转义为语言上的“转义修辞”，后引申为文学惯用套路；同时因太阳回归转向而衍生出“热带”一词。

lemmas.def_en: English admiral who defeated the French fleets of Napoleon but was mortally wounded at Trafalgar (1758-1805)
lemmas.def_zh: （摔跤中的）颈锁，内尔森式压制

examples.en: The wrestler trapped his opponent in a full nelson to force a submission.
examples.zh: 摔跤手用双臂颈锁牢牢困住对手，迫使其认输。

lemmas.usage_note: 摔跤术语，常与 full/half 连用构成 full/half nelson（双/单臂锁颈），专用于格斗搏击语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以摔跤名宿命名的一种利用手臂穿过对方腋下施压颈部的摔跤固定锁法。

lemmas.def_en: in or to a place that is lower
lemmas.def_zh: 在……下方；（地位、身份）低于

examples.en: The treasure lay hidden deep beneath the ocean floor.
examples.zh: 宝藏深埋在海床之下。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常接表面/掩饰物；习语 be beneath sb. 意为“某人不屑于做…”，比 under 更具文学感。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语复合词（be-强调 + neothan向下），表示在……正下方或地位低下。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being near to the true value
lemmas.def_zh: 准确度，精确性

examples.en: The scientist verified the accuracy of the experimental data.
examples.zh: 科学家核实了实验数据的准确性。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调“精准无误”，常与介词 with（如 with great accuracy）或动词 improve/check 搭配，侧重符合事实。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 accurare（精心照料），经 accurate（精确的）演变为表示精准无误的名词。

lemmas.def_en: a discharge of lightning accompanied by thunder
lemmas.def_zh: 螺栓；门栓；一道（闪电）

examples.en: A sudden bolt of lightning illuminated the dark and stormy sky.
examples.zh: 一道突如其来的闪电照亮了阴暗暴虐的夜空。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指固定用的金属螺栓、门窗插销，或闪电、弩箭等，常用于 a bolt of lightning 结构中。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To suddenly run away very fast, especially out of fear or excitement. 2. [T] To fasten a door or window with a bolt.
lemmas.def_zh: 飞奔，夺路而逃；拴住，锁上

examples.en: Remember to bolt the front door securely before you go to bed tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚睡觉前记得把前门插销给栓牢。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，可指用插销栓上门窗，或指人/动物突然拔腿逃跑，亦可表狼吞虎咽快速进食。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unbolt a door, gate, or window means to slide back its bolt so it can be opened.
lemmas.def_zh: 拔去门闩, 打开

examples.en: She hurried downstairs to unbolt the heavy front door for her late-night visitor.
examples.zh: 她急忙跑下楼，为深夜来访的客人拔开沉重大门的门闩。

family_guide.root_logic: 原始含义为飞掷的箭或弩箭，引申为如利箭般直插的“插销/螺栓”，以及像箭一样迅速“冲出”或“拴住”。

lemmas.def_en: a structure in a hollow organ (like the heart) with a flap to insure one-way flow of fluid through it
lemmas.def_zh: 阀，活门；（心脏）瓣膜；电子管

examples.en: The technician turned the safety valve to release excess pressure from the tank.
examples.zh: 技术人员拧开安全阀，释放了储罐中多余的压力。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指工业设备中的开关阀门、生理上的心脏瓣膜或电子管，常与 open, shut, check 搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 活门的, 心脏瓣膜的, 瓣形的, 有阀门的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or operating by means of valves

examples.en: The patient underwent delicate surgery to repair a severe valvular heart defect.
examples.zh: 该患者接受了精细的手术，以修复严重的心脏瓣膜缺损。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 valva（折叠门的一扇），引申为控制管道液体或气体单向流动的“阀门”。

lemmas.def_en: the condition of living or the state of being alive
lemmas.def_zh: 生机，活力；动画制作，动画片

examples.en: His face lit up with animation as he talked about his new project.
examples.zh: 谈起他的新项目时，他的脸上神采飞扬。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指动画片制作（computer animation），也可表示人“生气勃勃”（talk with animation），不可数。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 anima（灵魂、生命气息），表示赋予生命、使其充满活力的状态或技术。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To base an argument, theory, or statement on a particular premise or assumption.
lemmas.def_zh: 以……为前提；假定，预先设定

examples.en: The reform was premised on the assumption that the economy would continue to grow.
examples.zh: 该改革是以经济将持续增长这一假设为前提的。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常用被动态 premise sth. on/upon sth.，表示“以…为前提/立论依据”，避免与名词复数混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praemittere（预先放置），动词指以某项预设或前提作为推论基础。

lemmas.def_en: any admirable quality or attribute
lemmas.def_zh: 优点，价值；功绩

examples.en: Each scholarship application will be evaluated strictly on its own merits.
examples.zh: 每份奖学金申请都将严格依据其本身的优劣来进行评估。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词表优点、功绩，作可数时指长处；常用搭配 on its merits（根据自身优缺点）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To deserve or be worthy of something such as attention, reward, or punishment.
lemmas.def_zh: 值得，应受

examples.en: This critical environmental issue merits further investigation by the scientific committee.
examples.zh: 这个关键的环境问题值得科学委员会展开进一步调查。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，正式书面语，意为值得、应得或应受到，后接 attention, consideration 等抽象名词。

lemmas.def_zh: 有功绩的, 有价值的, 可称赞的
lemmas.def_en: deserving reward or praise

examples.en: The brave firefighter received a medal for his meritorious service during the emergency.
examples.zh: 这位勇敢的消防员因在紧急情况下的立功表现而获得了奖章。

lemmas.def_en: not merited or deserved
lemmas.def_zh: (赏、罚等)不应受的, 不配得的

examples.en: The harsh public criticism he received online was completely unmerited and unfair.
examples.zh: 他在网上遭到的严厉公众批评完全是不应受且不公平的。

lemmas.def_en: without merit
lemmas.def_zh: 不道德的

examples.en: The judge dismissed the lawsuit immediately, calling the plaintiff's claims entirely meritless and frivolous.
examples.zh: 法官立即驳回了诉讼，称原告的主张毫无依据且纯属无理取闹。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 无上诉利益；无益
lemmas.def_en: without merit

examples.en: protect...from unmeritorious criticism

lemmas.def_zh: 极好
lemmas.def_en: in a meritorious manner

examples.en: he served his country meritoriously

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mereri（赚得、应得），指值得赞赏的价值、长处，作动词时意为“应得”。

lemmas.def_en: at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line
lemmas.def_zh: 垂直的，竖直的；垂直行业内的

examples.en: The climbers struggled to scale the steep, nearly vertical rock face.
examples.zh: 登山者们艰难地攀登着那面陡峭、近乎垂直的岩壁。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，表示物理方向的垂直、竖直，或商业语境中的纵向/垂直细分行业，常与 horizontal 相对。

lemmas.def_en: in a vertical direction
lemmas.def_zh: 垂直地

examples.en: Stack the storage boxes vertically in the closet to save as much floor space as possible.
examples.zh: 把储物箱垂直叠放在壁橱里，以尽可能节省地面空间。

lemmas.def_en: something that is oriented vertically
lemmas.def_zh: 垂直的，竖直的；垂直行业内的

examples.en: The tech firm decided to expand into the healthcare vertical this quarter.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司决定在本季度进军医疗保健这一垂直行业领域。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业及营销领域中常作可数名词，指特定垂直市场或特定垂直行业领域，多见于商业财经语境。

lemmas.def_en: position at right angles to the horizon
lemmas.def_zh: 垂直性, 垂直状态

examples.en: The extreme verticality of the skyscraper creates a dramatic skyline against the sunset.
examples.zh: 摩天大楼极致的垂直感在夕阳下勾勒出壮丽的天际线。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vertex（头顶、顶点），指自上而下穿过头顶直指天顶的垂直线。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fit together the parts of something to construct it. 2. [I, T] To gather together in a single place.
lemmas.def_zh: 组装，装配；集合，聚集

examples.en: The workers quickly assembled the furniture following the detailed diagrams.
examples.zh: 工人们按照详细的图纸迅速把家具组装了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作不及物动词指人群集合，亦可作及物动词指零件组装、拼装，常见搭配 assemble parts/data。

lemmas.def_en: a group of persons together in one place
lemmas.def_zh: 集合, 装配, 一群人

examples.en: A fascinating assemblage of rare artifacts was displayed at the local history museum.
examples.zh: 当地历史博物馆展出了一批引人入胜的稀有文物。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（朝向）+ simul（在一起），表示聚集人马或拼装零件。

lemmas.def_en: open and genuine; not deceitful
lemmas.def_zh: 真诚的，由衷的

examples.en: Please accept our sincere apologies for any inconvenience this delay caused.
examples.zh: 对于此次延误造成的任何不便，请接受我们最真诚的歉意。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，修饰人品或言行态度，意为真挚诚恳的，常见搭配 sincere apologies/gratitude/effort。

lemmas.def_en: with sincerity; without pretense
lemmas.def_zh: 真诚地，由衷地

examples.en: I sincerely hope that both sides can reach an amicable agreement soon.
examples.zh: 我由衷地希望双方能够尽快达成一项友好的协议。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，常修饰动词表真诚地、由衷地，常用于书信结尾 Sincerely yours 或作句中状语修饰动词。

lemmas.def_en: an earnest and sincere feeling
lemmas.def_zh: 诚实, 真实, 诚心诚意

examples.en: Her voice was filled with sincerity when she offered her deepest apologies.
examples.zh: 她在表达最诚挚的歉意时，声音里充满了真诚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sincerus，本义为纯粹的、未掺杂的，引申为真诚的、发自内心的。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To order someone not to do something, or to officially disallow something.
lemmas.def_zh: 禁止，不准；妨碍，阻止

examples.en: Strict safety regulations forbid employees to enter the warehouse without helmets.
examples.zh: 严格的安全规程禁止员工未戴安全帽进入仓库。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词（原形），意为禁止，常用于 forbid sb from doing sth 或 forbid sb to do sth 结构中。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] Past participle of forbid; to officially disallow or order not to do something.
lemmas.def_zh: 禁止，不准（forbid 的过去分词）

examples.en: The headmaster has forbidden the use of mobile phones during classroom lectures.
examples.zh: 校长已经明令禁止在课堂讲座期间使用手机。

lemmas.usage_note: forbid 的过去分词，在完成时或被动语态中作动词谓语核心，构成 have forbidden 或 be forbidden 结构。

lemmas.def_en: [T] Past tense of forbid; ordered someone not to do something or made something prohibited.
lemmas.def_zh: 禁止，不准（forbid 的过去式）

examples.en: Her parents strictly forbade her to stay out alone after midnight.
examples.zh: 她的父母过去严禁她在半夜之后独自在外逗留。

lemmas.usage_note: forbid 的过去式，作一般过去时谓语动词，表示过去某一确定时间明确下令禁止某事。

lemmas.def_en: excluded from use or mention
lemmas.def_zh: 被禁止的, 严禁的

examples.en: Exploring the forbidden area behind the fence is strictly off-limits to visitors.
examples.zh: 围栏后方的禁区对所有访客严格封闭，禁止进入。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，定语或表语，意为被严令禁止的、禁忌的，常见搭配 forbidden fruit, forbidden zone。

lemmas.def_en: in an unpleasant or menacing manner
lemmas.def_zh: 令人生畏地；严峻地

examples.en: The jagged mountain peaks rose forbiddingly above the misty morning valley.
examples.zh: 险峻的山峰在晨雾弥漫的山谷上方森严耸立，令人生畏。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 for-（表示否定、排除）+ bid（吩咐、命令），核心语义为‘明令禁止’。
family_guide.core_distinction: forbade为一般过去式；forbidden可作过去分词或独立作形容词。

lemmas.def_en: subject to death
lemmas.def_zh: 不免一死的, 人类的, 临终的

examples.en: The soldier received a mortal wound in the fierce final battle.
examples.zh: 士兵在那场惨烈的最终决战中受了致命伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指生命终有一死的、凡人的，也可引申为致命的（mortal wound）或生死仇敌（mortal enemy）。

lemmas.def_en: a human being
lemmas.def_zh: 生物, 人类

examples.en: Such extraordinary feats of strength are simply impossible for ordinary mortals.
examples.zh: 如此惊人的力量壮举，对于普通凡人来说根本是不可能的。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指凡人、终有一死的人类，常带有与神明或超凡能力相对的语感，常用于 mere mortals。

lemmas.def_en: the quality or state of being mortal
lemmas.def_zh: 死亡率；必死性

examples.en: Advances in modern medicine have greatly reduced infant mortality across the globe.
examples.zh: 现代医学的进步已经大幅降低了全球范围内的婴儿死亡率。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，可指生命必死的属性，人口统计与医疗领域常指死亡率，常见搭配 infant mortality rate。

lemmas.def_en: in such a manner that death ensues (also in reference to hatred, jealousy, fear, etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 致命地, (非正式)极, 非常

examples.en: The brave knight was mortally wounded during the final battle for the castle.
examples.zh: 英勇的骑士在城堡的最后一战中受了致命伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mort-（死亡），指凡人难逃一死的本质，引申为致命的或终有一死的生命。
family_guide.core_distinction: mortal强调‘必死的’或‘致命的’；mortality指‘死亡率’或‘终有一死的人性本质’。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or advocating equal rights for women

examples.en: The novel is widely analyzed from a feminist perspective in modern literature classes.
examples.zh: 这部小说在现代文学课上常被从女性主义视角进行剖析。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 movement, theory, perspective 等名词，指符合女权主义主张的，多见于社科论述与文化批评。

lemmas.def_en: a supporter of feminism
lemmas.def_zh: 男女平等主义者

examples.en: As a lifelong feminist, she fought tirelessly for equal pay in the workplace.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的女权主义者，她不知疲倦地为职场同工同酬而抗争。

lemmas.usage_note: 指倡导男女平权的女性主义者，常与 committed, active 等形容词连用，书面与口语均极常用。

lemmas.def_en: a doctrine that advocates equal rights for women
lemmas.def_zh: 女权主义，女性主义

examples.en: The rise of feminism has significantly reshaped societal attitudes toward gender roles.
examples.zh: 女性主义的兴起深刻重塑了社会对性别角色的认知。

lemmas.usage_note: 指女性主义思潮或运动，不可数名词，常见搭配有 modern feminism, wave of feminism 等。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 femina（女性），加后缀 -ist 表示支持女性权利倡议的人或其主张。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To throw something lightly or carelessly. 2. [I, T] To move or shake gently or violently from side to side or up and down.
lemmas.def_zh: 轻抛，轻掷；甩（头）；（使）摇摆，颠簸

examples.en: He tossed the keys onto the kitchen counter as soon as he got home.
examples.zh: 他一进家门就随手把钥匙扔在了厨房台面上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指随意轻掷、翻转或抛掷硬币，常与 coin, aside 连用，习语 toss and turn 表示辗转反侧。

lemmas.def_en: the act of flipping a coin
lemmas.def_zh: 投掷, 抛, 摇摆, 震荡, 掷钱币决定

examples.en: The captain won the toss and decided to bat first in the championship match.
examples.zh: 队长在掷硬币猜先中获胜，并决定在决赛中首先击球。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示轻抛或掷硬币决定，常见搭配 win/lose the toss，在体育比赛开场前尤为多见。

lemmas.def_en: terms of abuse for a masturbator
lemmas.def_zh: 二传队员

examples.en: The coach praised the skilled tosser for setting up perfect spikes every game.
examples.zh: 教练称赞了这位出色的二传手每场比赛都能送出完美的扣球传球。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词源或斯堪的纳维亚借词，核心语义为‘轻快、随意地抛扔或翻转’。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) one of nine divisions of play during which each team has a turn at bat
lemmas.def_zh: （棒球）局；（板球）回合；任期

examples.en: The home team took the lead in the bottom of the ninth inning.
examples.zh: 主队在第九局下半场取得领先。

lemmas.usage_note: 棒球中用单数 inning（局），板球多用复数 innings；引申短语 have a good innings 指活得长久或事业成功。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 innung（放入、收取），后在棒球和板球等球类运动中引申为一轮比赛局数。

lemmas.def_en: grass mowed and cured for use as fodder
lemmas.def_zh: 干草

examples.en: The farmers stacked the bales of hay in the barn before the heavy rain started.
examples.zh: 农民们在大雨来临前将一捆捆干草整齐地堆放在谷仓里。

lemmas.usage_note: 指割下晒干作饲料的草，不可数，习语 make hay while the sun shines 意为抓紧时机，hit the hay 表示就寝。

lemmas.def_zh: 海尔（中国家电品牌）

examples.en: They bought a reliable Haier refrigerator for their newly renovated family kitchen.
examples.zh: 他们为新装修的家庭厨房买了一台可靠的海尔冰箱。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To cut grass and cure it to make hay; to feed or supply with hay.
lemmas.def_zh: 割晒牧草，制干草；供给干草

examples.en: They had to hay the lower meadow quickly while the dry weather held.
examples.zh: 他们必须趁着干燥天气抓紧在下游草场收割晒制干草。

lemmas.usage_note: 农业专业动词，指割晒并制成干草，既可用作及物动词也可用作不及物动词，语体偏向农务叙述。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hēg，本义为割下晒干的草，作动词时指割晒牧草。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To wait for something or someone. 2. [T] To be in store for or about to happen to someone.
lemmas.def_zh: 等待，期待；将降临于，在等待着

examples.en: We eagerly await your feedback on the newly proposed plan.
examples.zh: 我们殷切期待您对新提案的反馈意见。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式及物动词，后直接加宾语（await sth），切忌按 wait for 误用成 await for，主语常为事件或结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（加强语气或及物化）+ wait（等待），核心语义为及物动词‘等待、期待’，常接抽象事物作宾语。

lemmas.def_en: a female sorcerer or magician
lemmas.def_zh: 巫婆, 女巫

examples.en: In local folklore, an evil witch was believed to inhabit the depths of the forest.
examples.zh: 在当地民间传说中，人们相信森林深处住着一个邪恶的女巫。

lemmas.usage_note: 指女巫或巫婆，常与 hunt 连用构成 witch-hunt（政治迫害），多用于民间故事或政治讽喻语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 巫术, 魅力
lemmas.def_en: the art of sorcery

examples.en: The quiet village possessed a strange witchery that enchanted every passing traveler.
examples.zh: 这个宁静的村庄拥有一种奇异的魅力，吸引着每位过路的旅客。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to cast a spell over someone; to enchant or bewitch someone through magic or charm
lemmas.def_zh: 施巫术于，蛊惑；迷住

examples.en: Her enchanting voice seemed to witch the entire audience into utter silence.
examples.zh: 她那迷人的嗓音似乎施了魔法一般，让全场观众陷入一片寂静。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见文学动词，意为施巫术迷住或施魔法，常带有神秘或蛊惑的修辞色彩，多见于古典或诗歌语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 wicce（女巫、施法者），动词指施巫术诱惑或用寻水棒探测。

lemmas.def_en: a cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats
lemmas.def_zh: 肥皂, 阿谀

examples.en: Be sure to wash your hands thoroughly with soap and warm water.
examples.zh: 务必用肥皂和温水彻底把手洗干净。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，量词用 bar of soap，口语中可指肥皂剧（soap opera 的简称），日常高频词汇。

lemmas.def_zh: 皂化
lemmas.def_en: a chemical reaction in which an ester is heated with an alkali (especially the alkaline hydrolysis of a fat or oil to make soap)

examples.en: Traditional soapmakers monitor the saponification process carefully to ensure the oils react fully.
examples.zh: 传统肥皂匠人会仔细监测皂化过程，以确保油脂充分反应。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To wash or rub someone or something all over with soap.
lemmas.def_zh: 用肥皂擦洗，在……上涂肥皂

examples.en: He quickly soaped his face and started to shave with a fresh razor.
examples.zh: 他飞快地往脸上抹好肥皂，接着用一把新剃须刀开始刮胡子。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词指涂上肥皂清洗，常与 down 或 up 连用（如 soap oneself down），口语及日常护理场景常用。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or having the qualities of soap
lemmas.def_zh: 涂着肥皂的, 谄媚的, 圆滑的

examples.en: The slippery dish slipped right out of his soapy hands and shattered.
examples.zh: 油滑的盘子从他涂满肥皂沫的手中滑落摔碎了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语 *saipǭ（树脂、油脂涂料），引申为洗涤用的肥皂，动词指涂抹肥皂。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal new mass of tissue that serves no purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 肿瘤，肿块

examples.en: The biopsy revealed that the tumor was entirely benign.
examples.zh: 活检结果显示该肿瘤完全是良性的。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与日常名词，常搭配 benign tumor（良性肿瘤）与 malignant tumor（恶性肿瘤），英式拼作 tumour。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal new mass of tissue that serves no purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 瘤, 肿块

examples.en: Recent medical scans confirmed that the benign tumour had not grown any larger.
examples.zh: 最新的医学扫描证实那个良性肿瘤并没有进一步增大。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 tumere（肿胀），专指病理学上的异常组织肿块。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To flow, run, or fall over the edge of a container accidentally, or to cause a liquid to do this. 2. [I] To pour or move out in large numbers.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）溢出，（使）泼洒；涌出

examples.en: She accidentally knocked the cup over and spilled coffee all over her notes.
examples.zh: 她不小心碰倒了杯子，咖啡洒得整本笔记到处都是。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指液体溢出或秘密泄露，搭配如 spill the beans（泄密），生活与书面通用。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (chiefly British) Past tense and past participle of spill: to flow or cause to flow over the edge of a container.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）溢出，（使）泼洒（spill的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: He accidentally knocked the glass and spilt fresh milk all over the table.
examples.zh: 他不小心碰倒了玻璃杯，把新鲜牛奶洒了一桌子。

lemmas.def_en: an attacker who sheds or spills blood
lemmas.def_zh: 使溢出者, 使溅出者, 堕落网

examples.en: The clumsy coffee spiller quickly grabbed paper towels to clean the sticky floor.
examples.zh: 那个打翻咖啡的冒失鬼赶紧拿来纸巾清理黏糊糊的地板。

lemmas.def_en: the amount that has spilled
lemmas.def_zh: 漏, 溢出, 溢出物

examples.en: Workers rushed to clean up the chemical spillage before it reached the river.
examples.zh: 工人们赶在化学品泄漏物流入河流之前紧急清理。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 spillan（杀死、摧毁、浪费），语义逐渐弱化为液体或颗粒意外溢出、泼洒。

lemmas.def_en: a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection
lemmas.def_zh: 发烧，发热；狂热

examples.en: The child developed a high fever and was rushed to the clinic.
examples.zh: 孩子发高烧被紧急送往诊所。

lemmas.usage_note: 发烧可数，常搭配 have/run a fever；引申为狂热，如 election fever（选举热潮），常与介词 for 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 febris（发烧），核心语义为身体体温异常升高，引申为极度的狂热或兴奋。

lemmas.def_en: long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising
lemmas.def_zh: 横幅，旗帜；标语

examples.en: Protesters marched down the street carrying a large banner for peace.
examples.zh: 抗议者手举写着和平的大横幅沿着街道行进。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指横幅或标语，比喻搭配 under the banner of（在……旗帜/名义下）；作定语修饰如 a banner year（丰收年）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 bandum（旗帜），核心指用以宣传、象征或引导的大幅标语或旗帜。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To end something, such as a protest or rebellion, by using force or authority. 2. [T] To prevent an emotion, reaction, or information from being expressed or revealed.
lemmas.def_zh: 镇压，平定；抑制，忍住；查禁，隐瞒

examples.en: The authoritarian regime deployed armed forces to suppress the peaceful protest.
examples.zh: 当局出动了武装部队来镇压这场和平抗议。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，宾语常为 rebellion, evidence, emotion，表示武力镇压、隐瞒真相或压抑情绪，语体庄重正式。

lemmas.def_en: the failure to develop some part or organ
lemmas.def_zh: 镇压，压制；抑制

examples.en: Human rights groups strongly condemned the severe suppression of independent media.
examples.zh: 人权组织强烈谴责了对独立媒体的严酷打压。

lemmas.usage_note: 抽象名词，多与 of 连用（the suppression of free speech），指镇压、封锁或心理抑制，属正式政经法学术语。

lemmas.def_en: someone who suppresses
lemmas.def_zh: 抑制器, 消除器, 抑制栅极

examples.en: The engineer installed a noise suppressor to improve the audio quality of the device.
examples.zh: 工程师安装了噪声抑制器以提高设备的音频质量。

lemmas.def_en: tending to suppress
lemmas.def_zh: 镇压的, 抑制的

examples.en: The regime introduced suppressive measures to silence critics and control public speech.
examples.zh: 该政权出台了镇压性措施，以压制批评者并控制公众言论。

lemmas.def_en: given vent to
lemmas.def_zh: 未镇压的, 未压制的

examples.en: She laughed with unsuppressed joy upon hearing the wonderful news about her promotion.
examples.zh: 听到升职的好消息，她忍不住开怀大笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 sup-（在…之下）+ press（按压），核心语义为‘强行压制下去’。
family_guide.core_distinction: suppress侧重外力强制压制、封锁；suppression为其对应的名词行为或状态。

lemmas.def_en: a steep high face of rock
lemmas.def_zh: 悬崖，峭壁

examples.en: The castle sits perched on the edge of a sheer cliff.
examples.zh: 城堡坐落在一处险峻悬崖的边缘。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 off/over the cliff 连用；经济或政治中常用 cliff edge 比喻极其险恶的边缘危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，指陡峭的高地或岩壁。

lemmas.def_en: (law) the right and power to interpret and apply the law
lemmas.def_zh: 司法权，审判权，管辖范围

examples.en: The federal court ruled that this civil case falls outside its territorial jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 联邦法院裁定该起民事案件超出了其地域管辖范围。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律政务专词，常与 under, within, fall outside 搭配，表示司法审判权、职权或管辖区域，正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: restricted to the geographic area under a particular jurisdiction
lemmas.def_zh: 司法权的, 裁决权的, 管辖权的

examples.en: The two agencies resolved their jurisdictional dispute before beginning the joint investigation.
examples.zh: 两个机构在展开联合调查之前解决了管辖权争议。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 jus（法律）+ dicere（言说），指依法宣告与管辖的权力。

lemmas.def_en: a natural stream of water smaller than a river (and often a tributary of a river)
lemmas.def_zh: 小溪

examples.en: A shallow brook wound its way quietly through the peaceful mountain valley.
examples.zh: 一条浅浅的小溪在宁静的山谷间悄然穿流。

lemmas.usage_note: 指自然形成的小溪或细流，常出现在文学描写和乡村风景叙事中，属于偏雅致的书面语汇。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal, usually in negative) To tolerate or allow something, especially dissent, interference, or delay.
lemmas.def_zh: 容忍，忍受，容许（通常用于否定句）

examples.en: The strict commander made it clear that he would brook no dissent from his subordinates.
examples.zh: 严厉的指挥官明确表示，他绝不容许下属有任何异议。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，几乎只用于否定句，固定搭配 brook no delay/interference，表示绝不容忍，属高度正式语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 作为名词源于古英语，意为小溪；作为动词表示忍受，多用于否定语境。

lemmas.def_en: being ten more than thirty

examples.en: More than forty employees attended the annual training workshop this morning.
examples.zh: 四十多名员工今天上午参加了年度培训研讨会。

lemmas.usage_note: 基数词作限定修饰语，后接复数可数名词，注意拼写无 u（易误拼为 fourty），用于各语体描述数量。

lemmas.def_zh: [人名] 福捷

examples.en: The Fortier family has lived in this historic neighborhood for over three generations.
examples.zh: 福捷一家在这个历史悠久的街区生活了三代以上。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of ten and four

examples.en: He switched careers when he was well into his forties and found great success.
examples.zh: 他在四十多岁时转行，并取得了巨大的成功。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指数字四十，复数 in one's forties 特指四十多岁，或与 the forties 连用指四十年代。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 four（四）+ -ty（十倍数后缀），表示四十。

lemmas.def_en: an alloy of copper and tin and sometimes other elements; also any copper-base alloy containing other elements in place of tin
lemmas.def_zh: 青铜, 铜像

examples.en: The museum displays a magnificent statue cast in solid bronze.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆展出了一座用纯青铜铸造的宏伟雕像。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指青铜合金材料或铜像、铜牌，常搭配 cast in bronze、bronze medal。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to give the color or appearance of bronze to something; to become or make sun-tanned or bronze in color.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……镀青铜；使晒成古铜色；变成青铜色

examples.en: Weeks of working under the Mediterranean sun had bronzed his shoulders.
examples.zh: 在地中海烈日下工作数周后，他的双肩被晒成了古铜色。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示使晒成古铜色或镀青铜，多用于描述皮肤被阳光晒黑，常用被动或及物形式。

lemmas.def_en: of the color of bronze
lemmas.def_zh: 青铜色的

examples.en: She wore a stunning bronze dress that shimmered under the evening lights.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件在晚间灯光下闪闪发光的古铜色连衣裙。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于形容青铜制成的或呈深褐红色的事物，多作定语修饰名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 bronzo，特指青铜合金，后引申为青铜色及镀铜操作。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To be the first to develop, introduce, or use a new method, area of study, or technology.
lemmas.def_zh: 开创，倡导；作先驱，开辟

examples.en: She helped pioneer modern research techniques that revolutionized the entire field of genetics.
examples.zh: 她协助开创了现代研究技术，彻底改变了整个遗传学领域。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常搭配 pioneer a new method/technique，表示开创先河，后直接接宾语，不加介词。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 先驱，拓荒者，倡导者
lemmas.def_en: a person who is among the first to explore or settle a new country or area, or to develop a new field of activity
lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 of 搭配，如 a pioneer of modern surgery（现代外科手术的先驱）。

examples.en: She was a pioneer in the field of computer science.
examples.zh: 她是计算机科学领域的先驱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 pionier（开路先锋），指开辟新领域的开拓者行为。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make cloth, a basket, or a pattern by crossing threads or strips over and under each other. 2. [I, T] To move along by turning and dodging around obstacles.
lemmas.def_zh: 织，编织；编造，虚构；穿梭，迂回行进

examples.en: The cyclist had to weave through heavy traffic to deliver the package on time.
examples.zh: 骑手不得不穿梭在拥挤的车流中，以便按时送达包裹。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指织布编物，也引申为编造故事或穿行穿梭，常搭配 weave into、weave through。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past participle of weave; made by interlacing threads or strips.
lemmas.def_zh: 编织，织造（weave的过去分词）

examples.en: Local artisans have woven these intricate rugs entirely by hand for centuries.
examples.zh: 数百年来，当地工匠完全用手工编织了这些精致的地毯。

lemmas.usage_note: 为 weave 的过去分词，用作完成时或被动语态中的动词核心，表已被编织或交融。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense of weave; interlaced threads to make fabric, or moved in a winding path.
lemmas.def_zh: 编织，织造（weave的过去式）

examples.en: The skilled artisan wove bright silk threads into an intricate traditional pattern.
examples.zh: 熟练的工匠将鲜艳的丝线编织成复杂的传统图案。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unweave fabric or threads means to undo or separate strands that have been woven together.
lemmas.def_zh: 拆, 解开

examples.en: It took several hours to carefully unweave the tangled threads of the tapestry.
examples.zh: 花了几个小时才小心地解开挂毯上缠结在一起的线。

lemmas.def_en: pattern of weaving or structure of a fabric
lemmas.def_zh: 编法, 织法, 编织式样

examples.en: The loose weave of this linen shirt makes it remarkably breathable in summer.
examples.zh: 这件亚麻衬衫的疏松织法让它在夏天格外透气。

lemmas.usage_note: 指织物的纹理、编法或织式，常与 tight、loose、coarse 等形容词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a craftsman who weaves cloth
lemmas.def_zh: 织布者, 织工

examples.en: The traditional weaver skillfully operated the wooden loom in her workshop.
examples.zh: 那位传统织工在作坊里熟练地操作着木制织布机。

lemmas.usage_note: 指从事纺织工作的工匠或织工，可作职业名词或特定鸟类名，通常作主语或宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为交织、穿行编织。
family_guide.core_distinction: woven 为 weave 的过去分词，常用作形容词；weaver 指从事纺织的人。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ with) To crash violently into someone or something, or to crash into each other while moving. 2. [I] (+ with) (of opinions, interests, or principles) To clash or come into direct opposition.
lemmas.def_zh: 碰撞，互撞；（观点、利益等）冲突，抵触

examples.en: Two passenger trains collided with each other near the junction yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天上午两列客运列车在枢纽站附近相撞。

lemmas.usage_note: 指车辆物体碰撞或意见观念激烈冲突，不及物动词，常与介词 with 连用。

lemmas.def_en: (physics) a brief event in which two or more bodies come together
lemmas.def_zh: 碰撞, 冲突, 抵触

examples.en: The driver swerved sharply to avoid a head-on collision with the oncoming truck.
examples.zh: 司机猛打方向盘以避免与迎面驶来的卡车发生正面碰撞。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示物理撞击事故或抽象的冲突对抗，常搭配 in collision with、avoid a collision。

lemmas.def_en: an accelerator in which two beams of particles are forced to collide head on
lemmas.def_zh: 碰撞机

examples.en: Physicists at the laboratory built a new particle collider to study fundamental matter.
examples.zh: 实验室的物理学家建造了一台新的粒子碰撞机来研究基础物质。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 col-（共同）+ laedere（击打），指猛烈碰撞。
family_guide.core_distinction: collide 为动词强调动作过程；collision 为名词表示碰撞事件或冲突。

lemmas.def_en: the basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music
lemmas.def_zh: 节奏，韵律，规律变化

examples.en: The steady rhythm of the raindrops against the window eventually lulled him to sleep.
examples.zh: 雨点敲打窗户的平稳节奏最终催他入睡。

lemmas.usage_note: 指音乐节奏、生活规律或生理周期，常搭配 biological rhythm、keep rhythm。

lemmas.def_en: the rhythmic property imparted by the accents and relative durations of notes in a piece of music
lemmas.def_zh: 节律性

examples.en: The natural rhythmicity of the heartbeat is controlled by specialized electrical cells.
examples.zh: 心脏跳动的自然节律性是由特殊的起搏细胞控制的。

lemmas.def_en: recurring with measured regularity; - John Galsworthy
lemmas.def_zh: 有韵律的, 有节奏的

examples.en: The rhythmic sound of waves crashing on the shore helped him fall asleep.
examples.zh: 海浪拍打海岸的有节奏的声音帮助他安然入睡。

lemmas.def_en: recurring with measured regularity; - John Galsworthy
lemmas.def_zh: 有韵律的, 有节奏的

examples.en: The rhythmical sound of ocean waves helped the tired travelers fall asleep quickly.
examples.zh: 海浪有节奏的声音帮助疲惫的旅客很快入睡。

lemmas.def_en: in a rhythmic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 有节奏地

examples.en: She tapped her fingers rhythmically on the desk while listening to the music.
examples.zh: 她一边听音乐，一边有节奏地用手指轻敲桌面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 rhythmos（流动、节律），指有规律的运动或拍子。

lemmas.def_en: being long-lasting and recurrent or characterized by long suffering
lemmas.def_zh: 慢性的，长期的，积习难改的

examples.en: She has been receiving specialized treatment for chronic back pain for over a decade.
examples.zh: 十多年来，她一直在接受针对慢性背痛的专业治疗。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰疾病指慢性的，亦形容社会问题积重难返，常搭配 chronic illness、chronic shortage。

lemmas.def_en: in a habitual and longstanding manner
lemmas.def_zh: 慢性地, 长期地, 习惯性地

examples.en: The hospital is chronically short of staff during the cold winter months.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬季，这家医院长期面临人员短缺的问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 chronos（时间），指长期的、积习难改的。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make someone laugh or smile. 2. [T] To keep someone pleasantly entertained so that they do not get bored.
lemmas.def_zh: 逗乐，使发笑；给……提供娱乐，消遣

examples.en: His witty remarks and clever impersonations never failed to amuse his dinner guests.
examples.zh: 他机智的话语和惟妙惟肖的模仿总是能把共进晚餐的客人逗乐。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指逗乐某人或提供消遣，常用搭配 amuse oneself with、be amused by。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of delight at being entertained
lemmas.def_zh: 兴味, 娱乐, 消遣

examples.en: Much to our amusement, the dog tried desperately to catch its own tail.
examples.zh: 令我们大感好笑的是，那只狗拼命地想咬住自己的尾巴。

lemmas.usage_note: 表可笑好玩的感受（不可数）或娱乐设施（可数），常搭配 to one's amusement、amusement park。

lemmas.def_en: in an entertaining and amusing manner
lemmas.def_zh: 有趣地, 好笑地

examples.en: The comedian amusingly described the daily struggles of dealing with modern technology.
examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员风趣幽默地描述了应对现代技术的日常苦恼。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 有趣的，逗乐的
lemmas.def_en: causing laughter and providing entertainment
lemmas.usage_note: 常用来修饰故事、笑话、表演或情景，如 an amusing story / incident。

examples.en: She told an amusing story about her first day at work.
examples.zh: 她讲了一个关于她第一天上班的有趣故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（使）+ muse（凝思/发呆），本指引人注目，后引申为逗乐娱乐。
family_guide.core_distinction: amuse 是动词表示取悦；amusement 为名词指娱乐活动或好笑的心态。

lemmas.def_en: having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully
lemmas.def_zh: 无用的，无效的，没有价值的

examples.en: It is useless to complain about the weather when we cannot change it.
examples.zh: 既然无法改变天气，抱怨它便是毫无意义的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语或前置定语，常见搭配为 be useless to do sth 或 be useless at sth，口语中常指某人能力差。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of having no practical use
lemmas.def_zh: 无用

examples.en: He finally realized the uselessness of arguing with someone who refused to listen.
examples.zh: 他终于意识到，和一个不愿倾听的人争论是毫无意义的。

lemmas.def_en: in a useless manner
lemmas.def_zh: 无益地, 无用地

examples.en: The broken clock ticked uselessly in the corner of the abandoned room.
examples.zh: 那台坏了的时钟在废弃房间的角落里徒劳地滴答作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 use（使用）+ 后缀 -less（无……的）构成，指毫无用处的。

lemmas.def_en: located, suited for, or taking place in the open air
lemmas.def_zh: 室外的，户外的，露天的

examples.en: Our city offers plenty of outdoor activities during the summer months.
examples.zh: 我们城市在夏季月份提供丰富的户外活动。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常只用作前置定语，修饰活动、设施或环境，如 outdoor activities 或 outdoor market，不可作表语。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 out（外）+ door（门）复合而成，指室外的、露天的。

lemmas.def_en: (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
lemmas.def_zh: 极端的；过激的

examples.en: The politician was criticized for promoting ultra nationalist policies.
examples.zh: 那位政治家因推行极端民族主义政策而受到批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于政治或观念语境，形容人或思想极其偏激或极端，常作定语修饰 views、conservatives 等名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语前缀 ultra-，表示“超越、极端”。

lemmas.def_en: an agency of the United States Army responsible for providing timely and relevant and accurate and synchronized intelligence to tactical and operational and strategic level commanders
lemmas.def_zh: 人工智能；（南美）三趾树懒

examples.en: Recent advances in generative AI have transformed natural language processing.
examples.zh: 生成式人工智能的最新进展彻底改变了自然语言处理。

lemmas.usage_note: 大写常指“人工智能”（不可数）；小写亦可作动物名指“三趾树懒”（可数），属较生僻的生物学词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自人工智能（Artificial Intelligence）的缩写或借词，通常指模仿人类智能的技术系统（亦可指南美树懒，但现代多指AI）。

lemmas.def_en: in addition
lemmas.def_zh: 此外；而且

examples.en: The rent is too high; furthermore, the apartment is far from the subway.
examples.zh: 租金太高了；而且，这套公寓离地铁站也很远。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语中的连接副词，常置于句首引出递进论据，后紧跟逗号，语气较 moreover 或 in addition 更庄重。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 further（更进一步）+ more（更多），用于逻辑上的递进。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To cut wood, stone, or another hard material into a specific shape or pattern. 2. [I, T] To slice cooked meat into pieces.
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻，雕琢；把（熟肉等）切成薄片

examples.en: He used a sharp knife to carve a bird out of the soft pine block.
examples.zh: 他用一把锋利的小刀从松木块上雕刻出一只鸟。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指用刀刻削硬物或切割熟肉，常搭配 carve A out of B 或 carve sth up，语体通用。

lemmas.def_en: a sculpture created by removing material (as wood or ivory or stone) in order to create a desired shape
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻品；雕刻术

examples.en: The museum exhibits an intricate wooden carving from the twelfth century.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一件制作于十二世纪的精致木雕品。

lemmas.usage_note: 指雕刻出的具体实物时为可数名词（如 a stone carving）；指雕刻技艺或活动时为不可数名词。

lemmas.def_en: United States botanist and agricultural chemist who developed many uses for peanuts and soy beans and sweet potatoes (1864-1943)
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻匠, 雕工, 切肉刀

examples.en: The skilled carver spent several months shaping the intricate wooden dragon sculpture.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的雕工花了好几个月才雕刻出这座精细的木龙雕塑。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 雕刻的
lemmas.def_en: shaped or decorated by cutting or slicing a hard material
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰木制品、石头或雕塑，如 a carved wooden mask。

examples.en: The temple was decorated with beautifully carved stone pillars.
examples.zh: 这座寺庙装饰着雕刻精美的石柱。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ceorfan，核心义为“用刀切、削或雕刻”。
family_guide.core_distinction: carve 为动词动作；carving 为其名物化，指雕刻品或雕刻工艺。
