family_guide.root_logic: 来自 sad（悲哀的）加副词后缀 -ly，表达悲伤或令人遗憾地。

lemmas.def_en: a small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space
lemmas.def_zh: 壁橱, 小室

examples.en: She organized her winter coats and boots neatly in the bedroom closet.
examples.zh: 她把冬衣和靴子整齐地收纳在卧室的壁橱里。

lemmas.usage_note: 北美常指储藏衣物的壁橱，习语 skeleton in the closet 比喻不可告人的丑闻，属生活用语。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly passive) to shut someone away in a private room for a confidential discussion or intense work.
lemmas.def_zh: 把……关入密室（商谈）；把……藏在小房间中

examples.en: The negotiators closeted themselves in the conference room until an agreement was reached.
examples.zh: 谈判代表们将自己关在会议室里，直到达成协议才出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以 be closeted with 或 closet oneself away 结构出现，表示关在密室里私密商谈或深居简出。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 close（关闭），加指小后缀 -et，原指隐秘的小私室，后特指壁橱。

lemmas.def_en: person who makes a gift of property
lemmas.def_zh: 捐赠人

examples.en: An anonymous donor contributed millions of dollars to the new children's hospital.
examples.zh: 一位匿名捐赠人向新建的儿童医院捐款数百万美元。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于blood/organ donor（献血/器官捐献者）或donor country（援助国），不可用于指代普通小额打赏者。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 donare（给予、赠送），指自愿奉献物资、器官或资金的人。

lemmas.def_en: a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
lemmas.def_zh: 摩托车

examples.en: He prefers riding a motorcycle to work because it helps him weave through heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 他更喜欢骑摩托车上班，因为这能帮他在拥堵的车流中穿行。

lemmas.usage_note: 指两轮机动车辆，常与动词 ride、own 或 hit 搭配，在交通运输与日常口语中高频使用。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to ride or travel on a motorcycle.
lemmas.def_zh: 骑摩托车出行

examples.en: They decided to motorcycle across South America during their summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他们决定在暑假期间骑摩托车横穿南美洲。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指骑摩托车前往某处，常后接 across 或 through 等介词短语表示长途骑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 motor（发动机）+ cycle（脚踏车、轮）构成，即摩托车。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To destroy or ruin something completely or cause severe damage to it. 2. [T] To make someone feel extremely shocked, upset, or devastated.
lemmas.def_zh: 严重破坏，彻底摧毁；使极为震惊悲痛

examples.en: The coastal town was completely devastated by the powerful tsunami.
examples.zh: 这座沿海小镇被强烈的海啸彻底摧毁了。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常指自然灾害或战争彻底摧毁某地，或在情感上使人极度震惊悲痛；常用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being decayed or destroyed
lemmas.def_zh: 毁坏

examples.en: The flood left behind a scene of widespread destruction and utter devastation.
examples.zh: 洪水过后，留下了一片广泛破坏和彻底毁灭的景象。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 毁灭性的；极具破坏力的；令人震惊的
lemmas.def_en: causing severe shock, distress, or grief; causing great damage or harm
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰影响、损失、灾难或批判，如 devastating effect / news / critique。

examples.en: The flood had a devastating impact on the local agricultural economy.
examples.zh: 洪水对当地农业经济造成了毁灭性的打击。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 de-（彻底）+ vastare（荒废），表示彻底化为废墟或击溃。

lemmas.def_en: salty fluid secreted by sweat glands
lemmas.def_zh: 汗，汗水

examples.en: Beads of sweat ran down his forehead during the intense workout.
examples.zh: 高强度锻炼期间，汗珠顺着他的额头滚落下来。

lemmas.usage_note: 汗，汗水

lemmas.def_en: a crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body
lemmas.def_zh: n. 毛衣，针织衫

examples.en: She wore a thick knitted sweater to keep out the winter chill.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件厚针织毛衣来抵御冬日的严寒。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指毛衣或针织衫，常见搭配有 wool sweater（羊毛衫）、pull on a sweater（套上毛衣）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To produce liquid through your skin because you are hot, ill, or nervous. 2. [I] (informal) To worry or feel anxious about something. 3. [I] To work very hard.
lemmas.def_zh: 出汗，流汗；渗出水汽；焦虑，担忧；努力工作

examples.en: He sweated profusely as he waited nervously for the interview results.
examples.zh: 他在紧张地等待面试结果时大汗淋漓。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，表示出汗、渗出水汽；口语中常表示为某事焦虑忧虑（sweat over/about sth）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 swat，描摹人体排汗的生理现象，引申为辛苦劳作。

lemmas.def_en: a riblike part of a plant or animal (such as a middle rib of a leaf or a thickened vein of an insect wing)
lemmas.def_zh: 肋骨, 肋脉, 叶的中脉

examples.en: The entomologist carefully examined the prominent costa along the butterfly's wing.
examples.zh: 昆虫学家仔细检查了蝴蝶翅膀前缘显著的肋脉。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物学与解剖学专门名词，可数（复数 costae），指动物肋骨、昆虫翅脉的前缘脉或植物叶的中脉。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or near a rib
lemmas.def_zh: 肋骨的, 具中脉的

examples.en: He experienced sharp costal cartilage pain after receiving a blow to the chest.
examples.zh: 胸部受到撞击后，他感到肋软骨剧烈疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁语借词，原义为“肋骨”，生物学中指肋骨或叶脉、翅脉的边缘。

lemmas.def_en: mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable
lemmas.def_zh: 番茄, 西红柿

examples.en: She picked a ripe red tomato from her garden to make fresh sauce.
examples.zh: 她从自家花园摘了一个熟透的红番茄来做新鲜酱料。

lemmas.usage_note: 指番茄，复数须加-es写作tomatoes；英音发/təˈmɑːtəʊ/，美音发/təˈmeɪtoʊ/，发音差异显著。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克语）tomatl，指番茄这种果实膨大的作物。

lemmas.def_en: a successful ending of a struggle or contest
lemmas.def_zh: 凯旋, 胜利, 欢欣

examples.en: Winning the gold medal was the ultimate triumph of her athletic career.
examples.zh: 赢得这枚金牌是她运动生涯中最终的辉煌胜利。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作可数或不可数名词，指取得重大成功、辉煌胜利或其带来的巨大喜悦；常用搭配 a triumph of/for。

lemmas.def_en: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
lemmas.def_zh: 得胜的, 得意洋洋的

examples.en: The triumphant team held the gold trophy high above their heads in joy.
examples.zh: 得胜的队伍高兴地将金奖杯高高举过头顶。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or celebrating a triumph
lemmas.def_zh: 胜利的, 凯旋的

examples.en: The victorious general marched his troops proudly beneath the ancient triumphal arch.
examples.zh: 凯旋的将军带领军队骄傲地走过古老的凯旋门。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ over) To gain a great victory or achieve success after a struggle or contest.
lemmas.def_zh: 获胜，成功，战胜

examples.en: Justice will eventually triumph over corruption and deceit.
examples.zh: 正义终将战胜腐败与欺骗。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，书面语色彩浓厚，表示战胜对手或战胜逆境，常与介词 over 连用（triumph over adversity）。

lemmas.def_en: in a triumphant manner
lemmas.def_zh: 耀武扬威地, 得意扬扬地; 胜利

examples.en: She smiled triumphantly after solving the complex mathematical problem ahead of everyone.
examples.zh: 在领先所有人解出这道复杂的数学难题后，她得意地笑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊/罗马的凯旋赞歌与仪式，核心表“重大胜利、成功”及由此产生的“狂喜”。

lemmas.def_en: any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits
lemmas.def_zh: 香蕉

examples.en: He quickly peeled a fresh banana and ate it before his morning workout.
examples.zh: 他在晨练前迅速剥了一根新鲜香蕉吃掉。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词；常用口语习语go bananas表示“发疯/情绪失控”，top banana则指“主要领导或头目”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西非语言，经由西葡语系传播，指代热带水果“香蕉”及相关俚语隐喻。

lemmas.def_en: denoting an action or event preceding or in preparation for something more important; designed to orient or acquaint with a situation before proceeding
lemmas.def_zh: 初步的, 开始的, 预备的

examples.en: The preliminary investigation suggested that the fire was caused by an electrical fault.
examples.zh: 初步调查显示，火灾是由电气故障引起的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常置于名词前作定语，表示初始的、预备性的；常见搭配 preliminary results（初步结果）、preliminary enquiry。

lemmas.def_en: a minor match preceding the main event
lemmas.def_zh: 初步做法, 初步措施, 预试, 预选赛

examples.en: After dispensing with the usual polite preliminaries, they got straight down to business.
examples.zh: 免去通常的客套寒暄后，他们直接进入了正题。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用复数形式 preliminaries，指正式活动前的准备工作、开场白；单数亦可指体育预选赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 pre- (前) + limen (门槛) 构成，字面即“在门槛前的”，引申为“预备的、初步的”。

lemmas.def_en: an unbroken series of events
lemmas.def_zh: （性格中的）特征；连续，一阵子

examples.en: The team extended its winning streak to eight games yesterday.
examples.zh: 该队昨天将连胜纪录扩大到了八场。

lemmas.usage_note: （性格中的）特征；连续，一阵子

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes off all their clothes and runs naked through a public place
lemmas.def_zh: (1970年代出现的)裸跑者

examples.en: A naked streaker disrupted the championship football match by dashing across the pitch.
examples.zh: 一名赤身裸体的裸跑者冲过球场，扰乱了这场足球冠军赛。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To move very fast in a specified direction. 2. [T] To mark with stripes or streaks.
lemmas.def_zh: 飞奔，疾驰；在……上留条纹，布满条纹；裸奔

examples.en: A shooting star streaked across the dark midnight sky.
examples.zh: 一颗流星在漆黑的夜空中飞驰而过。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作不及物动词表示飞速疾驰，或及物动词（常用于被动）表示布满条纹；口语中亦指在公众场合裸奔。

lemmas.def_en: marked with or as if with stripes or linear discolorations
lemmas.def_zh: 有条纹的, 有斑点的, 容易变的

examples.en: The freshly washed window looked disappointing because it was still very streaky.
examples.zh: 刚洗过的窗户看起来令人失望，因为上面仍然布满了条痕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族，核心表“细长条纹”，引申为接连发生且未中断的“连胜/连败”或“飞奔”。

lemmas.def_en: a local church community
lemmas.def_zh: 教区, 堂区

examples.en: The local priest has served this rural parish for more than three decades.
examples.zh: 当地神父已经在这个乡村教区服务了三十多年。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指教会管辖的教区、堂区，在英国等国也指基层行政教区；常见搭配 parish church, parish council。

lemmas.def_zh: 教区的, 地方性的, 目光偏狭的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or supported by or located in a parish

examples.en: His parochial worldview made it difficult for him to accept new cultural ideas.
examples.zh: 他狭隘的世界观使他很难接受新的文化观念。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，既可指教区的（parochial school），也常带贬义指思想狭隘、地方观念重的（parochial attitude）。

lemmas.def_zh: parochial的变形
lemmas.def_en: in a parochial manner

examples.en: parochially narrow in his outlook

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 para- (旁) + oikos (家/住所)，最初指“教区邻里”，现特指地方教会辖区或行政乡。

lemmas.def_en: a man of refinement
lemmas.def_zh: 绅士, 先生

examples.en: He showed what a true gentleman he was by holding the heavy door open for everyone.
examples.zh: 他为所有人扶着沉重的门，展现了一个真正绅士的风度。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指彬彬有礼的绅士，或在正式场合对男士的礼貌称呼；复数用于开场致辞 Ladies and gentlemen。

lemmas.def_en: befitting a man of good breeding
lemmas.def_zh: 绅士的, 绅士派头的

examples.en: His calm and gentlemanly conduct during the heated debate impressed all the observers.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辩论中，他从容且极具绅士风度的表现给所有观察员留下了深刻印象。

lemmas.def_en: not befitting a gentleman
lemmas.def_zh: 无绅士风度的, 不像绅士的, 非绅士的, 无教养的

examples.en: His rude interruption was widely criticized as entirely ungentlemanly behavior during the dinner.
examples.zh: 他在晚宴上的粗鲁打断被广泛批评为毫无绅士风度的行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 gentle (出身优渥/文雅的) + man 构成，指“绅士；有教养的男子”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move people away from a dangerous place to safety, or to leave a building or area because of danger. 2. [T] To empty the bowels or bladder.
lemmas.def_zh: 疏散，撤离；排泄

examples.en: Emergency services moved quickly to evacuate residents from the flooded neighborhood.
examples.zh: 紧急救援部门迅速行动，将居民从被洪水淹没的街区疏散撤离。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指从危险区域疏散人员，或居民撤离某地；常见搭配 evacuate residents from an area。

lemmas.def_en: the act of removing the contents of something
lemmas.def_zh: 撤退, 疏散

examples.en: The government ordered a mass evacuation ahead of the approaching category-five hurricane.
examples.zh: 在五级飓风来临之前，政府下达了大规模疏散命令。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，既可指撤离、疏散行动（order an evacuation），也可用作医学术语指排泄排空；常与 order/plan 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 e- (出) + vacare (空)，字面为“使其变空”，特指将人或物从险境中撤出以腾空该地。

lemmas.def_en: a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter
lemmas.def_zh: 机智, 智力, 头脑, 理智, 妙语, 机智的人

examples.en: Her razor-sharp wit and charming humor kept the audience entertained throughout the evening.
examples.zh: 她敏捷的机智和迷人的幽默整晚都让观众开怀大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数时指机智、幽默风趣；可数时指机智幽默的人；复数 wits 常指智力、理智（keep one's wits about one）。

lemmas.def_en: a message whose ingenuity or verbal skill or incongruity has the power to evoke laughter
lemmas.def_zh: 机智, 临机应变

examples.en: Her natural wittiness always allowed her to deliver clever comebacks during tense debates.
examples.zh: 她天生的机智使她总能在紧张的辩论中巧妙反击。

lemmas.def_en: combining clever conception and facetious expression
lemmas.def_zh: 富于机智的, 诙谐的

examples.en: He made a witty remark that instantly dissolved the awkward tension in the room.
examples.zh: 他的一句俏皮话立刻化解了房间里的尴尬气氛。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指说话或写作机智幽默、巧妙风趣的；常见修饰 witty remark（妙语）、witty response。

lemmas.def_en: in a witty manner
lemmas.def_zh: 机智地, 机敏地, 俏皮地

examples.en: The speaker wittily addressed the awkward mistake, making the entire audience laugh aloud.
examples.zh: 演讲者机智地化解了尴尬的失误，逗得全场观众哄堂大笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语核心词，本义为“知晓、洞悉”，引申为敏锐的“机智、风趣”及复数表“心智”。
family_guide.core_distinction: wit指机智与幽默感；witty为形容词形式，指言语风趣幽默的。

lemmas.def_en: hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee
lemmas.def_zh: 短袜, 鞋垫, 一击

examples.en: He pulled off his woolen socks and warmed his cold feet by the fire.
examples.zh: 他脱下羊毛短袜，在炉火旁暖了暖冰冷的双脚。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指短袜，成双出现时用复数；口语中也可指重击，常与 have/give 连用。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) To hit someone or something very hard, especially with a closed fist.
lemmas.def_zh: 重击，痛打，用拳猛击

examples.en: The boxer managed to sock his opponent right in the jaw.
examples.zh: 拳击手一记重拳狠狠击中了对手的下巴。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语中指用拳猛击某人，常与介词 in, on 连用表示击打部位。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 soccus (轻便低帮鞋)，后指“短袜”；在俚语中因其包裹拳头的隐喻引申为“重击”。

lemmas.def_en: a roughly cylindrical vessel that is open at the top
lemmas.def_zh: 桶

examples.en: She filled a plastic bucket with soapy water to wash the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 她往塑料桶里装满肥皂水，准备清洗厨房地板。

lemmas.usage_note: 指盛液体或散装物的圆桶；口语中常用于 buckets of 表示大量。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity contained in a bucket
lemmas.def_zh: (一)桶, 满桶

examples.en: The excited children gathered a bucketful of colorful seashells on the sandy beach.
examples.zh: 兴奋的孩子们在沙滩上捡了满满一桶五颜六色的贝壳。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (informal, especially 'bucket down') To rain very heavily and in large amounts. 2. [T] To carry, pour, or scoop something in a bucket.
lemmas.def_zh: 大雨倾盆（尤与 down 连用）；用桶提（舀）水

examples.en: The rain began to bucket down just as we stepped out of the museum.
examples.zh: 我们刚踏出博物馆，大雨就倾盆而下。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式口语中常构成 bucket down 表示倾盆大雨；亦可指飞速颠簸行驶。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自古法语 buquet (桶)，指圆柱形提水容器；动词指“倾盆而下”或“飞奔”。

lemmas.def_en: a deliberately false or improbable account
lemmas.def_zh: 寓言, 神话, 谎言

examples.en: The teacher shared a classic fable to explain the importance of honesty.
examples.zh: 老师讲了一个经典寓言，用以阐释诚实的重要性。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指带有道德寓意的传统寓言故事，常与 Aesop's 等专有名词连用。

lemmas.def_en: a person who tells or invents fables
lemmas.def_zh: 寓言家, 说谎者

examples.en: Aesop is arguably the most famous fabulist in Western literary history.
examples.zh: 伊索可以说是西方文学史上最著名的寓言家。

lemmas.def_en: extremely pleasing
lemmas.def_zh: 传说的, 寓言般的, 难以置信的

examples.en: The fireworks display over the harbor was absolutely fabulous.
examples.zh: 海港上空的焰火表演真是精彩绝伦。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中极常用于赞叹某事极好、绝妙；书面语中也可保留寓言般的、神话般的古义。

lemmas.def_en: exceedingly; extremely
lemmas.def_zh: 非常(富有的/伟大的)

examples.en: The successful tech entrepreneur became fabulously rich after the company went public.
examples.zh: 公司上市后，这位成功的科技创业家变得极其富有。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fari (讲述/言说)，特指蕴含道德说教的“寓言”，派生词向“如神话般极佳”演变。
family_guide.core_distinction: fable指具体寓言故事；fabulous意为极好的、难以置信的（源于神话/寓言般的超现实感）。

lemmas.def_en: very opposed in nature or character or purpose
lemmas.def_zh: 相反的, 矛盾的, 对立的

examples.en: His actions were completely contrary to the advice given by his lawyer.
examples.zh: 他的所作所为完全背离了律师提出的建议。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时常接介词 to，表示与某事相反、违背；修饰人时指任性执拗的。

lemmas.def_en: a relation of direct opposition
lemmas.def_zh: 相反, 对立面

examples.en: Unless there is clear evidence to the contrary, we must assume he is innocent.
examples.zh: 除非有确凿的相反证据，否则我们必须假定他是无辜的。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词常用于固定短语 on the contrary（恰恰相反）或 to the contrary（相反的）。

lemmas.def_en: deliberate and stubborn unruliness and resistance to guidance or discipline
lemmas.def_zh: 反对, 矛盾, 乖张

examples.en: His sheer contrariness made it virtually impossible for the committee to reach a consensus.
examples.zh: 他纯粹的逆反心理让委员会几乎不可能达成任何共识。

lemmas.def_en: in a contrary disobedient manner
lemmas.def_zh: 反之, 相反地, 反对地

examples.en: Most stocks plummeted today, but contrarily, renewable energy shares rose significantly.
examples.zh: 今天大多数股票暴跌，但相反的是，新能源板块大幅上涨。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 contra (相对/对抗)，核心表“相反的、对立的”。

lemmas.def_en: an orderly arrangement
lemmas.def_zh: 排列, 衣服, 大批, 军队

examples.en: The bakery displayed an impressive array of freshly baked pastries.
examples.zh: 面包店陈列着琳琅满目的现烤糕点。

lemmas.usage_note: 常构成 an array of 搭配，意为令人赞叹的一大批、一系列陈列的物品。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) to arrange things or people in an attractive, orderly, or impressive display or formation.
lemmas.def_zh: 部署，排列，整齐排布；打扮，盛装装扮

examples.en: The guests were arrayed in elegant evening gowns for the royal gala.
examples.zh: 宾客们身着华丽的晚礼服盛装出席皇家庆典。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态 be arrayed in，指身着盛装打扮；也可指布署军队或阵型。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，由 ad- (向) + 构词词根组成，核心表“整齐布置、排列成行”，用于军队、展示或数据。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To build or construct a structure, building, or monument. 2. [T] To raise something to a vertical position; to establish a system or idea.
lemmas.def_zh: 建造，架设；使竖立，建立

examples.en: The workers managed to erect a temporary shelter before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 工人们在暴风雨来临前成功搭建起一座临时避难所。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指正式地竖立纪念碑、搭建帐篷或建立体系结构，语体较为正式。

lemmas.def_en: upright in position or posture
lemmas.def_zh: 直立的, 竖立的, 笔直的

examples.en: The guards stood erect and motionless outside the palace gates.
examples.zh: 卫兵们笔直地伫立在宫门外，纹丝不动。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词常作表语或后置定语，形容身体、姿态或物体笔直竖立的状态。

lemmas.def_en: an erect penis
lemmas.def_zh: 直立, 竖起, 建筑物

examples.en: The erection of the new bridge took nearly three years to complete.
examples.zh: 这座新桥梁的架设工程耗时近三年才得以完成。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指建筑物、脚手架等的竖立过程或构建物，也可用于医学语境指生理勃起。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 e- (完全) + regere (引直/伸正) 构成，核心表“垂直竖立”。
family_guide.core_distinction: erect侧重动作或形容词状态；erection为建造或挺立的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: a diplomatic building where ambassadors live or work
lemmas.def_zh: 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员

examples.en: She went directly to the foreign embassy to renew her expired tourist visa.
examples.zh: 她直接前往外国大使馆办理了过期的旅游签证续签。

lemmas.usage_note: 指大使馆或使馆全体官员；常搭配 the US/Chinese Embassy，常与介词 in 连用指馆舍，与 to 连用指驻某国使团。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系（通过古法语进入），核心表“使命/使者”，现专指主权国家派驻他国的外交机构及馆舍。

lemmas.def_en: blatant or sensational promotion
lemmas.def_zh: 大肆宣传；皮下注射

examples.en: The new sci-fi movie failed to live up to all the media hype.
examples.zh: 那部新科幻电影并未达到媒体大肆炒作所宣称的水准。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词，指媒体或公关的大肆炒作、天花乱坠的宣传；常与 live up to 连用。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) To advertise or promote a product, person, or event extravagantly to create intense public excitement.
lemmas.def_zh: 大肆宣传，炒作

examples.en: Marketers heavily hyped up the product long before its official release.
examples.zh: 营销人员在该产品正式发布前很久就进行了铺天盖地的炒作。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与副词 up 连用构成 hype up，意为大肆宣传、炒作某人或某物以引起关注。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美式俚语，可能与 hyperbole（夸张）有关，核心语义为“过度的炒作或天花乱坠的宣传”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To build something again that has been damaged or destroyed. 2. [T] To piece together how a past event happened from available evidence.
lemmas.def_zh: 重建，重修；重现，再现（事件经过）

examples.en: Detectives used surveillance footage to reconstruct the sequence of events.
examples.zh: 侦探们利用监控录像重构了事件发生的前后经过。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既指重建受损建筑，也指根据线索重组案情、还原历史原貌。

lemmas.def_en: the period after the American Civil War when the southern states were reorganized and reintegrated into the Union; 1865-1877
lemmas.def_zh: 改造, 再建

examples.en: The economic reconstruction of the war-torn region required immense international aid.
examples.zh: 这个饱受战争蹂躏地区的经济重建需要大量国际援助。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指战后或灾后的重建工作，亦可指对历史、犯罪现场的还原重组。

lemmas.def_en: helping to restore to good condition
lemmas.def_zh: 再建的, 改造的

examples.en: The patient underwent reconstructive surgery to repair severe facial damage from the car accident.
examples.zh: 患者接受了整复手术，以修复车祸造成的严重面部创伤。

lemmas.def_en: adhering to an attitude or position widely held to be outmoded
lemmas.def_zh: 未重建的, 反对变革的, 脑筋转不过来的, 旧思想的

examples.en: He remained an unreconstructed rebel, firmly refusing to adapt to the changing modern world.
examples.zh: 他依旧是个不肯悔改的叛逆者，坚决拒绝适应日新月异的现代世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ construct（建造），核心语义为“重构、复原”。
family_guide.core_distinction: reconstruct 为动词，指重建或还原；reconstruction 为名词，指重建的过程或结果。

lemmas.def_en: a fraudulent business scheme
lemmas.def_zh: 骗局, 诡计；故事

examples.en: She nearly fell for an online scam that promised quick investment returns.
examples.zh: 她差点轻信了一个承诺高额投资回报的网络骗局。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式名词，指欺诈手段或骗局，常与 fall for, run a scam 等动词搭配。

examples.en: The victims of the scammed were devastated after losing their entire life savings.
examples.zh: 受骗者在失去一生的全部积蓄后感到绝望无比。

lemmas.def_en: a person who swindles you by means of deception or fraud
lemmas.def_zh: [美俚] 骗子, 诈骗犯

examples.en: The clever scammer convinced elderly people to send him money for fake investments.
examples.zh: 那个狡猾的骗子说服老年人把钱汇给他用于虚假投资。

examples.en: Online scamming has become a major concern for law enforcement agencies across the world.
examples.zh: 网络诈骗已成为全球执法机构密切关注的主要问题。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) To cheat or trick someone out of money or property through a dishonest scheme.
lemmas.def_zh: 欺诈，诈骗（钱财）

examples.en: A fake travel agent scammed dozens of tourists out of their savings.
examples.zh: 一个假旅行社代理骗走了数十名游客的积蓄。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，非正式口语中指通过欺诈骗取某人钱财，常用 scam sb out of sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自20世纪美式俚语，核心语义指“欺诈伎俩或骗局”。

lemmas.def_en: a loud resonant repeating noise
lemmas.def_zh: 冲突, 撞击声, 抵触

examples.en: The meeting ended abruptly after a fierce clash of opinions among board members.
examples.zh: 董事会成员之间爆发了激烈的意见冲突后，会议戛然而止。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指人与人之间的激烈冲突、观点抵触或颜色/日程上的不协调。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ with) To fight or argue violently with an opposing group or person. 2. [I] (+ with) To disagree strongly, or to look bad together or occur at the same time.
lemmas.def_zh: 发生打斗，发生冲突；争执，发生分歧；（颜色、时间等）不协调，抵触

examples.en: Her bright orange skirt clashed horribly with her purple jacket.
examples.zh: 她那条亮橙色的裙子和紫色外套搭配起来显得极不协调。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常接介词 with，指观点抵触、日程撞期或颜色搭配极不协调。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟金属相击的刺耳声音，引申为“强烈的碰撞、冲突或不合”。

lemmas.def_en: someone who censures or condemns
lemmas.def_zh: 检查员

examples.en: The government appointed a strict military censor to review all outgoing dispatches.
examples.zh: 政府指派了一名严厉的军事审查员来审查所有发出的新闻简报。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指负责审查书刊、电影或信件的官方审查员，常用于政治、军事及出版语境中。

lemmas.def_en: counterintelligence achieved by banning or deleting any information of value to the enemy
lemmas.def_zh: 检查制度

examples.en: The author strongly condemned the strict censorship imposed on modern literature.
examples.zh: 这位作者强烈谴责了对当代文学施加的严厉审查制度。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指审查制度或审查行为，常见搭配有 impose/tighten censorship（实施/收紧审查）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To examine books, films, or other materials officially and remove parts considered offensive, politically sensitive, or dangerous.
lemmas.def_zh: 审查并删剪（书刊、电影、信件等）；查禁

examples.en: Broadcasters had to censor any controversial scenes before airing the documentary.
examples.zh: 广播公司在播出这部纪录片之前，不得不删剪掉所有具有争议的画面。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指删减、审查（出版物或言论），常用于被动语态，如 be heavily censored（受到严格审查）。

lemmas.def_en: not subject to censorship
lemmas.def_zh: 未经审查的, 无保留的

examples.en: The documentary showed an uncensored look at the harsh realities of front-line combat.
examples.zh: 该纪录片未经审查地展现了前线战斗的残酷现实。

lemmas.def_en: harshly critical or expressing censure
lemmas.def_zh: 爱批判的, 挑剔的

examples.en: Her censorious remarks about her colleagues' work created unnecessary tension in the whole office.
examples.zh: 她对同事工作的挑剔言论在整个办公室制造了不必要的紧张气氛。

lemmas.def_en: belonging or relating to a censor or a censor's functions
lemmas.def_zh: 检查官的, 苛评的

examples.en: The board exercised its censorial authority to block the distribution of the controversial magazine.
examples.zh: 董事会行使其审查职权，阻止了那份备受争议的杂志的发行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 censere（评定、审查），罗马时期的监察官，核心语义为“审查与监督”。
family_guide.core_distinction: censor 既指审查官员也指审查行为；censorship 专指审查制度或审查过程本身。

lemmas.def_en: yellow oval fruit with juicy acidic flesh
lemmas.def_zh: 柠檬, 柠檬树, 柠檬色

examples.en: She squeezed fresh lemon juice over the grilled fish.
examples.zh: 她把新鲜的柠檬汁挤在烤鱼上。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数/不可数名词指柠檬；口语中常作可数名词，指存在严重缺陷的劣质品（如二手车）或让人失望的人。

lemmas.def_en: tasting sour like a lemon
lemmas.def_zh: 柠檬的

examples.en: The cleaning spray left a pleasant, lemony aroma throughout the newly polished kitchen.
examples.zh: 这款清洁喷雾在刚刚打磨一新的厨房里留下了宜人的柠檬清香。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 limon（柠檬），因味酸涩而在美式俚语中引申指“有缺陷的、令人失望的事物（尤指次品车）”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To laugh at someone or copy them unkindly to make them look foolish. 2. [T] To make something seem completely useless or ineffective.
lemmas.def_zh: 嘲弄，嘲笑；（通过模仿）戏弄；使落空，使显得可笑

examples.en: The bully would constantly mock him for his thick regional accent.
examples.zh: 那个霸凌者总是嘲笑他浓重的乡音。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，意为嘲弄、模仿取笑或挫败，语气偏消极，常搭配宾语直接跟人或观点。

lemmas.def_en: constituting a copy or imitation of something
lemmas.def_zh: 假的, 伪造的, 模拟的

examples.en: Students took a mock examination to prepare for the real test next month.
examples.zh: 学生们参加了一次模拟考试，为下个月的正式考试做准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语，意为模拟的、虚假的，常修饰 exam、battle、trial 等，表示演练或假装性质。

lemmas.def_en: in a disrespectful jeering manner
lemmas.def_zh: 愚弄地, 取笑地

examples.en: He bowed mockingly to his opponents as he slowly walked away from the debate.
examples.zh: 他在缓缓离开辩论场地时，嘲讽地向对手鞠了一躬。

lemmas.def_zh: 嘲弄, 笑柄, 歪曲
lemmas.def_en: showing your contempt by derision

examples.en: His unfair trial made a complete mockery of the judicial system.
examples.zh: 对他的不公正审判完全让司法系统沦为了笑柄。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词表嘲讽，作单数名词表荒谬的模仿或笑柄，常见搭配 make a mockery of（使……沦为笑柄）。

lemmas.def_en: someone who jeers or mocks or treats something with contempt or calls out in derision
lemmas.def_zh: 嘲弄者, 模仿者

examples.en: The arrogant mocker was finally silenced when his rival outperformed him in the contest.
examples.zh: 当对手在比赛中表现超越他时，那个傲慢的嘲讽者终于闭了嘴。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 mocquer（嘲弄、戏弄），引申出“模拟的、虚假的”语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: mock 作动词时强调嘲讽行为；作定语形容词时强调模仿、假模假样的性质。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ into) To examine or investigate a complex, hidden, or suspicious situation thoroughly. 2. [I, T] To physically examine an area, wound, or object by poking with a tool or hand.
lemmas.def_zh: 探究，调查；用探针探查，探寻

examples.en: Independent journalists began to probe into the suspicious political scandal surrounding the mayor.
examples.zh: 独立记者们开始调查围绕着市长的这起可疑政治丑闻。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于媒体与学术，指深入调查或物理探查，常见搭配 probe into a scandal/matter、probe the wound。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 proba（检验），原指外科探针，引申为“深入探查、彻底调查”。

lemmas.def_en: (golf) the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire course
lemmas.def_zh: 标准, 票面价值, 平均数量, 同等水平

examples.en: The quality of local wine here is certainly on a par with imported brands.
examples.zh: 这里出产的当地葡萄酒品质完全可以与进口品牌相媲美。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于固定搭配，如 on a par with（与……平起平坐/不相上下）、below/above par（低于/高于正常标准）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (in golf) To score the standard number of strokes on a hole.
lemmas.def_zh: 以标准杆数完成（球洞）

examples.en: He managed to par the difficult eighteenth hole to win the championship.
examples.zh: 他在高难度的第十八洞成功打出标准杆，赢得了冠军。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，在专业或特定场景（如高尔夫球达到标准杆，或计算机传输控制）中作及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 par（平等、相等），用于高尔夫中指“标准杆”，通用语境中指“常态、同等水平”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To gather or collect something gradually over a period of time, or to increase in amount over time.
lemmas.def_zh: 积累，积聚；堆积

examples.en: Dust and debris began to accumulate rapidly on the abandoned bookshelf.
examples.zh: 灰尘和杂物开始在废弃的书架上迅速积聚起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作及物动词（积累财富/经验），也可作不及物动词（污垢/雪等堆积），强调随时间逐渐增多。

lemmas.def_en: an increase by natural growth or addition
lemmas.def_zh: 积聚, 累积, 积聚物

examples.en: The sudden accumulation of snow on the roof caused it to collapse.
examples.zh: 屋顶上积雪的骤然增多导致其坍塌。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，指累积过程或堆积物，常与 of 连用，多见于正式文体与科学报告。

lemmas.def_en: increasing by successive addition
lemmas.def_zh: 积聚而成的, 累积的

examples.en: The accumulative fatigue of constant travel began to weaken the athlete's performance.
examples.zh: 频繁奔波带来的累积疲劳开始影响该运动员的表现。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（去、朝向）+ cumulus（堆积），字面义为“堆成一堆”，引申为“逐渐积累”。
family_guide.core_distinction: accumulate 为动词，指积累的动作；accumulation 为名词，指积累的过程或积聚物。

lemmas.def_en: informal abbreviation of `gentleman'
lemmas.def_zh: 绅士

examples.en: An elderly gent tipped his hat politely as he walked past the shop.
examples.zh: 一位上了年纪的绅士走过商店时礼貌地脱帽致意。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式名词，gentleman 的缩写，复数 the gents 在英式英语中常特指“男洗手间”。

lemmas.def_en: in a gradual manner
lemmas.def_zh: 温和地, 温柔地, 轻轻地, 逐渐地

examples.en: She gently closed the nursery door so as not to wake the sleeping baby.
examples.zh: 她轻轻关上育儿室的门，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，修饰动作，表示温柔地、轻轻地或坡度逐渐地，常与 push、stir、slope 等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gentilis（出身名门的），gent 为 gentleman 的口语缩写；gently 保留了“高贵而文雅、温和”的语义。
family_guide.core_distinction: gent 为名词俗语指男士；gently 为副词，意为温和地、轻轻地。

lemmas.def_en: a transient variation in voltage or current
lemmas.def_zh: 长钉, 鞋钉, 钉状物, 尖峰状物, 穗

examples.en: There was a dramatic spike in fuel prices following the cold weather alert.
examples.zh: 在发布寒潮预警后，燃油价格出现了一次急剧暴涨。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指尖状物、长钉，新闻经济语境中常指“（价格、数据等的）突然急剧上升”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To rise sharply and suddenly to a high peak. 2. [T] To pierce or fasten with a sharp spike. 3. [T] To secretly add alcohol or a drug to a drink.
lemmas.def_zh: 猛增，急升；刺穿，扎破；在（饮料）中掺烈酒（或毒药）

examples.en: The editor decided to spike the article because the source was unreliable.
examples.zh: 主编决定扣下并不予发表这篇文章，因为消息来源不可靠。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指刺穿、暗中掺入烈酒/药物，或在新闻中指废弃新闻稿、阻止计划推进。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族词根，指尖锐的大钉或尖峰，引申为“短时间内猛增或扎刺”。

lemmas.def_en: a fee levied for the use of roads or bridges (used for maintenance)
lemmas.def_zh: 通行费, 代价, 钟声

examples.en: Drivers must pay a five-dollar toll before crossing the suspension bridge.
examples.zh: 司机在通过这座悬索桥前必须支付五美元的通行费。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指路桥通行费；引申表示伤亡人数或代价，常见搭配 take a heavy toll on（造成严重破坏）。

lemmas.def_en: a person who rings church bells (as for summoning the congregation)
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 收费人, 征税官

examples.en: The tired toller collected coins from long lines of drivers all through the night.
examples.zh: 疲惫的收费员整夜向排成长队的司机收取硬币。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] When a large bell tolls, or someone tolls it, it rings slowly with deep, solemn strokes. 2. [T] To collect a toll or fee from.
lemmas.def_zh: （缓迎慢送地）敲（钟），鸣（钟）；（钟）沉重缓慢地鸣响；征收（通行税等）

examples.en: The church bell began to toll solemnly for the fallen soldiers.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟声开始庄严肃穆地鸣响，为阵亡士兵致哀。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，特指（大钟）缓慢庄严地敲响或鸣钟哀悼，既可作及物动词也可作不及物动词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语或日耳曼语系借词，原指税费或代价；作为拟声动词指“缓慢敲钟”，常暗指丧钟与伤亡代价。

lemmas.def_en: the leaf of a conifer
lemmas.def_zh: 针, 尖

examples.en: Thread the cotton through the eye of the needle before tying a knot.
examples.zh: 在打结之前，先把棉线穿过针眼。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指缝纫针、注射针、指针或松针，搭配如 find a needle in a haystack（大海捞针）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) to deliberately annoy, tease, or provoke someone, especially with repeated remarks.
lemmas.def_zh: （故意）招惹，激怒，挑衅；用针缝

examples.en: His older brother loved to needle him about his messy bedroom.
examples.zh: 他的哥哥总喜欢就他乱糟糟的卧室不停地找茬逗他。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，日常生活及口语中常用于表示“不断用言语挑衅、招惹某人”，引起对方烦躁。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，核心语义为“针、针状物”，引申出“用言语刺痛挑衅、刺激”。

lemmas.def_en: a tetravalent nonmetallic element; next to oxygen it is the most abundant element in the earth's crust; occurs in clay and feldspar and granite and quartz and sand; used as a semiconductor in transistors
lemmas.def_zh: n. 唱名第七音（ti）；国际单位制（缩写）

examples.en: The soprano hit the high si with remarkable clarity.
examples.zh: 这位女高音极其清晰地唱出了高音si。

lemmas.usage_note: 作首字母缩写多指国际单位制（SI units）；也可作唱名指简谱中的“xi”（亦拼作ti），属专业术语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语唱名，代表全音阶中的第七音，亦常用作国际单位制（SI）的缩写。

lemmas.def_en: a transparent optical device used to converge or diverge transmitted light and to form images
lemmas.def_zh: n. 透镜，镜片；镜头；晶状体

examples.en: The photographer wiped the lens before taking the portrait.
examples.zh: 摄影师在拍摄肖像前擦拭了镜头。

lemmas.usage_note: 单数以 s 结尾，复数为 lenses；常用于 contact lenses（隐形眼镜）或比喻 through the lens of。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语lentil（小扁豆），因双凸透镜形状酷似扁豆而得名，核心指聚焦光线的透镜或镜头。

lemmas.def_en: a polygenic disease characterized by abnormally high glucose levels in the blood; any of several metabolic disorders marked by excessive urination and persistent thirst
lemmas.def_zh: n. 糖尿病

examples.en: Regular exercise can significantly reduce the risk of type 2 diabetes.
examples.zh: 经常运动可以显著降低患2型糖尿病的风险。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学不可数名词，动词用单数；常见搭配 have/suffer from diabetes、Type 1/2 diabetes。

lemmas.def_zh: 糖尿病患者
lemmas.def_en: someone who has diabetes

examples.en: As a careful diabetic, she routinely tracks her carbohydrate intake after every meal.
examples.zh: 作为一名谨慎的糖尿病患者，她每顿饭后都会常规监测自己的碳水摄入量。

lemmas.usage_note: 指糖尿病患者，常可数；为避免冒犯，现代正式语体多推荐用 a person with diabetes 替代。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语，字面义为“虹吸管、穿过”，借指体内水分迅速排出（多尿），现代指糖尿病。

lemmas.def_en: dearly loved
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 深爱的，心爱的

examples.en: The author dedicated the novel to his beloved wife.
examples.zh: 作者将这部小说献给了他心爱的妻子。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面且具抒情色彩，作定语修饰人或物；常用搭配 be beloved by/of sb.，读音常为三音节 /bɪˈlʌv.ɪd/。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀be-（加强）+ love + -ed（形容词后缀），表示“被深深爱戴的”。

lemmas.def_en: the aggregation of a country's military aircraft
lemmas.def_zh: n. 航空，飞行；航空工业

examples.en: Advances in aviation have made global travel faster and safer.
examples.zh: 航空业的进步让全球旅行变得更加快捷和安全。

lemmas.usage_note: 指航空航天工业或飞行术，不可数；常作定语，如 aviation industry/safety/authority。

lemmas.def_zh: 飞行员
lemmas.def_en: someone who operates an aircraft

examples.en: The brave aviator completed the first solo nonstop flight across the stormy ocean.
examples.zh: 这位勇敢的飞行员完成了首次独自穿越暴风雨大洋的不间断飞行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语avis（鸟），经由法语构词，引申为人工飞行的科学、工业或活动。

lemmas.def_en: close observation of a person or group (usually by the police)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 监视，监控

examples.en: The suspects were kept under constant electronic surveillance.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人一直处于持续的电子监控之下。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，固定搭配 under surveillance（处于监视下）及 keep surveillance on，常用语体较严肃正式。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语，sur-（在...之上）+ veiller（看守/警惕），核心指居高临下的监视、监控。

lemmas.def_en: cutlery used for serving and eating food
lemmas.def_zh: n. 餐叉；分叉口；耙

examples.en: Take the left branch when you reach the fork in the woodland path.
examples.zh: 当你走到林间小路的分岔口时，走左边那条支路。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指餐叉、农用叉，或道路、河流的“分岔口/分支处”。

lemmas.def_zh: 双叉, 分叉, 分歧, 分歧点
lemmas.def_en: a bifurcating branch (one or both of them)
1. [I] To divide into two separate parts or branches, as a road or river. 2. [T] To lift, dig, or move something using a fork.
lemmas.def_zh: 分叉，分流；走岔路；用叉子叉起（或翻起）

examples.en: The highway will fork into two directions just beyond the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 过了交通信号灯，这条公路就会分岔为两个方向。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词指道路分岔；及物动词指用叉子挑起，口语搭配 fork out/over 表示“不情愿地掏钱”。

lemmas.def_zh: （使）分叉，（使）分成两支
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (formal) To divide or split into two separate branches or forks.

examples.en: The narrow forest trail begins to bifurcate into two separate paths just past the river.
examples.zh: 穿过小河后，这条狭窄的林间小道便分叉为两条小路。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语furca（叉状工具），引申出分叉、支线及岔开的动作。

lemmas.def_en: a river in east central England that flows past Cambridge to join the Ouse River
lemmas.def_zh: n. 凸轮

examples.en: The engine's cam regulates the opening and closing of the valves.
examples.zh: 发动机的凸轮控制着气门的开合。

lemmas.usage_note: 机械工程专业词汇指凸轮；口语网络中也是 camera/webcam 的常见缩写，如 on cam。

family_guide.root_logic: 可能源自凯尔特语或荷兰语，本义为弯曲，机械学中专指将回转运动变为往复运动的凸轮。

lemmas.def_en: gum resin used especially in treating skin irritation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 百元美钞（俚语）；最宠爱的幼子；安息香

examples.en: He flashed a thick roll of benjamins at the counter.
examples.zh: 他在柜台前亮出了一叠厚厚的百元美钞。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式街头俚语中常指百元美钞（印有富兰克林头像），常用复数 all about the Benjamins。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希伯来语人名本雅明（意为“右手之子/幼子”），俗语中常引申指百元美钞（因印有本杰明·富兰克林头像）或安息香。

lemmas.def_en: the mother of your father or mother
lemmas.def_zh: n. （外）祖母，奶奶，姥姥

examples.en: Her grandmother taught her how to bake traditional apple pie.
examples.zh: 她的祖母教会了她如何烘烤传统苹果派。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式称谓，日常口语常用 grandma 或 granny；用于母系或父系祖母均可，区分时用 maternal/paternal。

family_guide.root_logic: grand-（高一代的，长辈）+ mother（母亲），指祖母或外祖母。

lemmas.def_en: a chordophone that has a triangular frame consisting of a sounding board and a pillar and a curved neck; the strings stretched between the neck and the soundbox are plucked with the fingers
lemmas.def_zh: n. 竖琴

examples.en: She sat beside the grand harp, gently plucking its strings to produce a soothing melody.
examples.zh: 她坐在那架大型竖琴旁，轻拨琴弦，奏出一段舒缓的旋律。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词表示大型弹拨乐器“竖琴”，常与 play、pluck 等动词搭配，用于音乐及艺术语境。

lemmas.def_en: someone who plays the harp
lemmas.def_zh: n. 竖琴演奏者

examples.en: The wandering harper entertained the tavern guests with ancient Celtic ballads.
examples.zh: 那位流浪的竖琴手用古老的凯尔特歌谣款待酒馆里的客人们。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指演奏竖琴的人（常含传统或民谣色彩），多用于文学描述或传统民俗音乐语境。

lemmas.def_en: someone who plays the harp
lemmas.def_zh: 竖琴师

examples.en: The talented harpist played soothing classical melodies throughout the quiet wedding reception.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的竖琴师在宁静的婚礼招待会上弹奏着舒缓的古典旋律。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (harp on/upon) To talk or complain repeatedly and tediously about the same subject. 2. [I] To play the harp.
lemmas.def_zh: 喋喋不休，反复唠叨（与on/upon连用）；弹竖琴

examples.en: Please stop harping on my past mistakes; I have already apologized multiple times.
examples.zh: 请不要再对我过去的错误喋喋不休了；我已经道过好几次歉了。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与介词 on 连用构成 harp on，表示“反复唠叨、喋喋不休”，含厌烦贬义色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，本义为古老的弦乐器竖琴，引申出单调反复地弹奏或唠叨。
family_guide.core_distinction: harp作动词时常与on连用表示喋喋不休；harper为演奏该乐器的人。

lemmas.def_en: the bony skeleton of the head of vertebrates
lemmas.def_zh: n. 颅骨，头骨，脑袋

examples.en: The archaeologist carefully unearthed a human skull dating back thousands of years.
examples.zh: 考古学家小心翼翼地挖掘出一具数千年前的人类头骨。

lemmas.usage_note: 指颅骨或头骨，常用于医学或解剖语境；习语 skull and crossbones 指骷髅旗/剧毒标志。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自北欧语，本义为壳、碗状物，引申为保护脑部的坚硬骨骼即头骨。

lemmas.def_en: continuing forever or indefinitely
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 永恒的，不朽的；无休止的

examples.en: They pledged their eternal love to each other under the starlit sky.
examples.zh: 他们在星空下向彼此许下了永恒的爱意。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词表示“永恒的、不朽的”，常修饰 life、truth 等抽象概念，也可在口语中表示令人厌烦的“无休止的”。

lemmas.def_en: for a limitless time; ; - P.P.Bliss
lemmas.def_zh: 永恒地, 常常

examples.en: I will remain eternally grateful to the surgeon who saved my brother's life.
examples.zh: 我将永远感激那位挽救了我兄弟生命的挽救者。

lemmas.def_en: time without end
lemmas.def_zh: n. 永恒；漫长的时间（口语夸张）

examples.en: Waiting for the exam results felt like an eternity to the anxious students.
examples.zh: 等待考试结果的过程对焦急的学生们来说仿佛过了整整一个世纪。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指永恒或来世；口语中常作单数 an eternity，夸张表示漫长难熬的极长时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语aevum（时代、永久），核心表示无始无终、永不消逝的状态。

lemmas.def_en: highly offensive; arousing aversion or disgust
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 恶臭的；下流的；犯规的

examples.en: A foul odor drifted from the neglected basement, forcing everyone to cover their noses.
examples.zh: 一股恶臭从无人打理的地下室飘出来，迫使大家都捂住了鼻子。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词常修饰 smell、air 表示“恶臭的”，修饰 language 表示“下流粗俗的”，也可指体育比赛中的犯规动作。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (sports) To commit an unfair or illegal act against an opposing player. 2. [T] To make dirty or polluted.
lemmas.def_zh: （体育运动中）犯规，对……犯规；弄脏，污染；缠住

examples.en: The defender fouled the striker just outside the penalty box to prevent a certain goal.
examples.zh: 为了阻止一次势在必进的射门，后卫在禁区外直接对前锋犯规。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词表示“弄脏、污染（环境/管道）”，在体育中及物或不及物皆可，表示对对手“犯规”。

lemmas.def_en: disgusting wickedness and immorality
lemmas.def_zh: 纠缠, 卑鄙

examples.en: The foulness of the stagnant river water drove residents far away from the bank.
examples.zh: 死水河散发的恶臭让居民们纷纷远离河岸。

lemmas.def_en: in an unfair and insulting manner
lemmas.def_zh: 肮脏地, 下流地, 卑鄙地, 邪恶地

examples.en: The corrupt official had acted foully to betray the complete trust of his community.
examples.zh: 这位腐败的官员行为极其卑鄙，彻底背叛了社区对他的信任。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，本义为腐臭、肮脏的，引申指恶劣天气、卑鄙行径或体育中的违规犯规。

lemmas.def_en: a mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue
lemmas.def_zh: 伤疤；创伤 (n.) / 结疤；留下创伤 (v.)

examples.en: The surgical operation left a faint scar across her left shoulder.
examples.zh: 外科手术在她的左肩上留下一道淡淡的伤疤。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词既可指皮肤上愈合后留下的“物理伤疤”，也常引申为战争、创伤留下的“心灵创伤”，与 leave 连用居多。

lemmas.def_zh: 松土用农具, 划痕器

examples.en: The farmer hitched the heavy scarifier to his tractor to break up hard soil.
examples.zh: 农夫把沉重的松土机挂在拖拉机上，用来粉碎坚硬的泥土。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To leave a permanent physical mark on the skin or land. 2. [T] To leave a lasting feeling of grief or emotional trauma in someone. 3. [I] To form a scar.
lemmas.def_zh: 使留下伤痕；使心灵受创伤；结疤

examples.en: The tragic childhood memories permanently scarred his emotional development.
examples.zh: 那段悲惨的童年记忆给他的心理发育留下了永久的心灵创伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词常用于被动语态 be scarred by，指身体留疤或精神遭受深重创伤，具强烈文学或情感色彩。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (agriculture / medical) To make shallow cuts or scratches in soil, seeds, or skin.
lemmas.def_zh: 在...上划痕, 吓唬, 松(土), 擦破硬皮, 割破硬皮

examples.en: Gardeners often scarify hard seeds before planting to encourage faster and healthier germination.
examples.zh: 园丁通常在播种前划破硬壳种子，以促进其更快、更健康地发芽。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 带有伤疤的；受过心灵创伤的
lemmas.def_en: marked with scars; having deep emotional wounds from a painful experience
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指身体留有疤痕（scarred face/hands），也可指心理受创（emotionally scarred）。

examples.en: Many veterans returned from the war deeply scarred by what they had witnessed.
examples.zh: 许多退伍军人从战争归来，目睹的一切让他们心灵深受创伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 eskhara（火炉、焦痂），后演变指伤口愈合后留下的痕迹，包括肉体与心灵。

lemmas.def_en: the rational and systematic study of religion and its influences and of the nature of religious truth
lemmas.def_zh: 神学；宗教教义

examples.en: He earned a master's degree in Christian theology before becoming a university lecturer.
examples.zh: 他在成为大学讲师之前，获得了基督教神学的硕士学位。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性学科词汇，指“神学”或特定宗教派别的“教义体系”，多用于学术与宗教文化语境。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is learned in theology or who speculates about theology
lemmas.def_zh: 神学家

examples.en: The renowned theologist spent decades studying the ancient religious manuscripts in the library.
examples.zh: 这位著名的神学家花了数十年时间研究图书馆里的古代宗教手稿。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or concerning theology
lemmas.def_zh: 神学的；神学上的

examples.en: The scholars held an intense theological debate regarding the concept of divine grace.
examples.zh: 学者们就神的恩典这一概念展开了一场激烈的神学辩论。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词修饰 seminary、debate、doctrine 等，表示“神学的、神学角度的”，多见于正式学术讨论。

lemmas.def_en: as regards theology
lemmas.def_zh: 神学地, 神学上地

examples.en: The two scholars debated whether the ancient ritual was theologically sound and justified.
examples.zh: 两位学者就该古老仪式在神学上是否合理且站得住脚展开了辩论。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 theos（神）+ -logy（学科），即对神及宗教教义的研究。

lemmas.def_en: an authoritative person who divines the future
lemmas.def_zh: 先知；预言家；提倡者

examples.en: The environmentalist was hailed as a prophet for warning about global warming decades ago.
examples.zh: 那位环保主义者早在数十年前就警示全球变暖，因而被誉为先知。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指宗教中的“先知”或预言未来趋势的“预言家、倡导者”，常搭配 prophet of doom（悲观预言者）。

lemmas.def_en: knowledge of the future (usually said to be obtained from a divine source)
lemmas.def_zh: 预言；预言能力

examples.en: The ancient prophecy claimed that a brave warrior would eventually unite the kingdom.
examples.zh: 古老的预言宣称，一位勇敢的战士终将统一这个王国。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指预言的内容或预言能力，常搭配 fulfill a prophecy（应验预言），注意与动词 prophesy 拼写区分。

lemmas.def_en: foretelling events as if by supernatural intervention
lemmas.def_zh: 预言的, 先知的, 预示的

examples.en: His warnings about the impending economic crisis turned out to be remarkably prophetic.
examples.zh: 他对即将到来的经济危机的警告最终被证明极具预见性。

lemmas.def_en: foretelling events as if by supernatural intervention
lemmas.def_zh: 预言的, 预示的, 预言家的

examples.en: The old monk was revered by villagers for his strange and prophetical dreams.
examples.zh: 老僧人因其奇异且具预示性的梦境而受到村民的尊崇。

lemmas.def_en: in a prophetic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 预言地

examples.en: She had prophetically predicted the collapse of the tech giant years before it happened.
examples.zh: 她早在这家科技巨头倒闭前数年就极具预言性地预测了这一结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 pro-（在……之前、公开）+ phanai（说），原指“代言神谕者”，引申为先知、预言家。

lemmas.def_en: a young dog
lemmas.def_zh: 小狗，幼犬

examples.en: The energetic puppy chewed up several pairs of shoes.
examples.zh: 那只精力充沛的小狗咬坏了好几双鞋。

lemmas.usage_note: 指幼犬，常见搭配 puppy love（早恋/少男少女短暂的迷恋）；口语中 puppy fat 指婴儿肥。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 poupée（洋娃娃），原指爱犬或玩偶，后专指幼犬。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To make an engine run quickly, or to run quickly. 2. (rev up) To become or cause something to become more active, lively, or faster.
lemmas.def_zh: （使发动机）加速运转；（使）加速，活跃起来（常与 up 连用）

examples.en: He sat in his sports car, revving the engine loudly before the race began.
examples.zh: 他坐在跑车里，在比赛开始前猛轰油门让引擎轰鸣。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用，主要搭配 rev up（发动引擎使其高速运转），引申指使经济或活动加速/活跃起来。

family_guide.root_logic: revolution（转数）的口语缩略形式，特指引擎加速运转。

lemmas.def_en: a straight line through a body or figure that satisfies certain conditions
lemmas.def_zh: 轴；轴线；坐标轴；枢纽

examples.en: The Earth continuously rotates on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 地球每二十四小时绕着自身的地轴自转一周。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指旋转的“轴心”、图表的“坐标轴（X/Y axis）”或政治上的“轴心国联盟”，复数形式为 axes。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To suddenly cancel a project, cut funding, or dismiss employees.
lemmas.def_zh: 停办，削减，解雇；用斧砍

examples.en: The board decided to ax the controversial project due to mounting budget deficits.
examples.zh: 由于预算赤字不断增加，董事会决定砍掉这个备受争议的项目。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling an axis of rotation
lemmas.def_zh: 轴的, 成轴的, 轴向的

examples.en: Engineers carefully measured the axial load before completing the construction of the bridge.
examples.zh: 工程师们在完成桥梁施工前仔细测量了轴向荷载。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to an axis
lemmas.def_zh: 轴向地

examples.en: The mechanical components must be aligned axially to prevent unnecessary friction and wear.
examples.zh: 机械部件必须沿轴向对齐，以防止不必要的摩擦和磨损。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 axis（车轴），指物体旋转所围绕的中心线，或图表中的坐标轴。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
lemmas.def_zh: 赤字；逆差；不足

examples.en: The government pledged to cut the budget deficit over the next three years.
examples.zh: 政府承诺在未来三年内削减财政赤字。

lemmas.usage_note: 经济正式用语，固定搭配 trade/budget deficit（贸易/预算赤字），常与 run/reduce a deficit 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 deficere（不足、缺乏），专指财务收支中的亏损、逆差或数量不足。

lemmas.def_en: an agenda of things to do
lemmas.def_zh: 票价，车费；伙食 (n.) / 进展，过活 (v.)

examples.en: The city council decided to raise the standard subway fare by twenty cents this winter.
examples.zh: 市议会决定在今年冬天将标准地铁票价上调二十美分。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词主要表示公共交通的“车费、船票费（bus/air fare）”，也可在书面语中指餐馆供应的“伙食、食物”。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ well/badly) To succeed, progress, or get along in a particular situation.
lemmas.def_zh: 进展，遭遇，过活

examples.en: The local tourism industry fared well despite the unusually cold weather this season.
examples.zh: 尽管本季气候异常寒冷，当地的旅游业发展势头依然良好。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与 well、badly、better 连用，表示某人在特定处境下“进展、过活、表现”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 faran（出行、旅程），后分化为指代出行的交通费用以及在旅程/生活中的进展情况。

lemmas.def_en: the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
lemmas.def_zh: 地平线；视野；眼界

examples.en: Traveling alone in foreign countries helped him broaden his horizons.
examples.zh: 在异国独自旅行帮助他拓宽了视野。

lemmas.usage_note: 单数指地平线（on the horizon）；复数固定搭配 broaden/expand one's horizons（开阔眼界）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 horizein（划分、限制），天地相交的视线界限，引申为眼界、视野。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing or requiring special skill
lemmas.def_zh: 有技能的；熟练的；需要专门技术的

examples.en: The factory is facing a severe shortage of skilled workers.
examples.zh: 该工厂正面临熟练技术工人严重短缺的局面。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配 be skilled in/at doing sth（熟练于），多修饰劳动力或工艺；修饰工人时常用 skilled worker/labor。

lemmas.def_en: not having or showing or requiring special skill or proficiency
lemmas.def_zh: 无(特殊)技能的, 不熟练的, 拙劣的

examples.en: Automation has replaced many unskilled factory workers with efficient, programmable robotic arms.
examples.zh: 自动化技术已经用高效的可编程机械臂取代了许多无技能的工厂工人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 skill（技能），加形容词后缀 -ed，表示“具有熟练技能的”。

lemmas.def_en: a dead body that has been brought back to life by a supernatural force
lemmas.def_zh: 僵尸；行尸走肉；麻木迟钝的人

examples.en: After pulling an all-nighter, I felt like a complete zombie at work.
examples.zh: 通宵熬夜之后，我上班时感觉自己简直像个活死人。

lemmas.usage_note: 指僵尸或丧尸，口语中常比喻极度疲惫、反应迟钝的人；金融中常构成 zombie company（僵尸企业）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西非和中非刚果语词汇，原指伏都教巫术中复活的行尸走肉，引申为麻木无知觉的人或僵尸状态。

lemmas.def_en: (folklore) a corpse that rises at night to drink the blood of the living
lemmas.def_zh: n. 吸血鬼；残酷剥削者；吸血蝙蝠

examples.en: The folklore depicts the vampire as a creature that shuns sunlight.
examples.zh: 民间传说将吸血鬼描绘成一种避开阳光的生物。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为吸血鬼，常喻指残酷压榨他人的人；日常可搭配 energy vampire（消耗他人精力的人）等形象表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自斯拉夫语系民间传说，本义指夜间吸食人血的恶灵，后引申为残酷剥削他人的人或吸血蝙蝠。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of heat equal to the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of one kilogram of water by one degree at one atmosphere pressure; used by nutritionists to characterize the energy-producing potential in food
lemmas.def_zh: n. 卡路里，卡（热量单位）

examples.en: A brisk thirty-minute walk can help you burn around one hundred and fifty calories.
examples.zh: 轻快步行三十分钟可以帮助你消耗大约一百五十卡路里的热量。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词指能量或热量单位“卡路里”，日常健康语境中常与 count、burn、cut 等动词搭配。

lemmas.def_zh: 热的, 热量的, (热)卡的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or associated with heat

examples.en: Athletes closely monitor their daily caloric intake to sustain peak energy during rigorous training.
examples.zh: 运动员密切监控每日卡路里摄入量，以在严苛训练中保持最佳体能。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 calor（热量），后被引入物理学与营养学作为能量测量单位。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing keen interest or intense desire or impatient expectancy
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 热切的，渴望的；热心的

examples.en: The fresh graduates were eager to demonstrate their professional capabilities in the new company.
examples.zh: 应届毕业生们急于在新公司里展示自己的专业能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词表示“渴望的、急切的”，高频句式为 be eager to do sth 或 be eager for sth，强调积极迫切的心态。

lemmas.def_en: with eagerness; in an eager manner
lemmas.def_zh: 渴望, 热衷于, 热切

examples.en: The young students eagerly waited for the science competition results to be announced.
examples.zh: 年轻的学生们急切地等待着科学竞赛结果的公布。

lemmas.def_en: a positive feeling of wanting to push ahead with something
lemmas.def_zh: 热心

examples.en: His eagerness to impress his new colleagues was evident in every meeting.
examples.zh: 在每次会议中，他渴望给新同事留下好印象的表现都很明显。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 acer（敏锐、尖锐），古法语演变后语义由“尖锐、剧烈”转为形容精神状态上的“急切、渴望”。

lemmas.def_en: originating where it is found
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 本地的，本土的；土著的

examples.en: The kangaroo is indigenous to the Australian continent.
examples.zh: 袋鼠是澳大利亚大陆的本土物种。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 to 连用，多修饰动植物、文化或居民，常见搭配如 indigenous peoples、indigenous culture。

lemmas.def_en: in an indigenous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 本土

examples.en: The company takes pride in products designed and manufactured indigenously within the country.
examples.zh: 该公司为其在国内本土设计和制造的产品感到自豪。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 indi-（内）+ gen-（产生、出生）构成，核心逻辑为“在本土出生的”，即土生土长的。

lemmas.def_en: concerned primarily with theories or hypotheses rather than practical considerations
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 理论（上）的；假设的

examples.en: Her research provides a solid theoretical foundation for future studies.
examples.zh: 她的研究为后续研究提供了坚实的理论基础。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于学术或正式语境，常搭配 theoretical framework、theoretical basis，与 practical 相对。

lemmas.def_en: in theory; according to the assumed facts
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 理论上，按理论来说

examples.en: Theoretically speaking, this new engine can achieve zero emissions.
examples.zh: 理论上讲，这种新型发动机可以实现零排放。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作句首评注性状语或修饰形容词，用于表达“理论上可行但现实未必”，相当于 in theory。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 theor-（观察、深思），经由 theory（理论）派生出的形容词及副词体系。
family_guide.core_distinction: theoretical为形容词，修饰名词或作表语；theoretically为副词，常作状语修饰动词或全句。

lemmas.def_en: an employee who performs clerical work (e.g., keeps records or accounts)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 文书，办事员；店员

examples.en: The court clerk recorded every statement made during the trial.
examples.zh: 法庭书记员记录了审判期间的每一项陈述。

lemmas.usage_note: 美语中常指零售店员，英美通用指政府、律所或公司的办事员，常见搭配 bank clerk、court clerk。

lemmas.def_en: in Christianity, clergymen collectively (as distinguished from the laity)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 神职人员，牧师总称

examples.en: The local clergy were actively involved in organizing community relief efforts.
examples.zh: 当地神职人员积极参与组织社区救济工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合名词，通常与定冠词 the 连用，谓语动词常用复数，正式用于宗教及社会管理语境。

lemmas.def_en: the job of clerk
lemmas.def_zh: 文书的职位

examples.en: Securing a federal clerkship is a prestigious milestone for any aspiring young lawyer.
examples.zh: 获得联邦法院书记员职位是任何有抱负的年轻律师的崇高里程碑。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to clerks
lemmas.def_zh: 文书的, 事务上的, 抄写员的, 牧师的

examples.en: She spent the entire morning correcting several clerical errors found in the contract.
examples.zh: 她花了一整个上午纠正合同中发现的几处文书错误。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (chiefly US) To work as an office clerk, court clerk, or store assistant.
lemmas.def_zh: 当文书，当办事员；当店员，做售货员

examples.en: After graduating from law school, she clerked for a federal judge.
examples.zh: 法学院毕业后，她担任了一名联邦法官的实习书记员。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与介词 for 或 in 连用，多用于法律界指为法官担任实习书记员或秘书。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古希腊语 klerikos（神职人员），因中世纪仅神职人员识字并负责文书工作，后词义世俗化为文员、店员。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move or cause people or animals to suddenly move in different directions; disperse. 2. [T] To throw or drop things in different directions over a wide area.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）分散，四散；撒，播撒；驱散

examples.en: The wind scattered the dry leaves across the lawn.
examples.zh: 风把枯叶吹散在草坪各处。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词常搭配 scatter A over/on B（将A撒在B上）；作不及物动词表示人群等“四散奔逃”，不可加宾语。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 零散的，散布的；（气象）分散的
lemmas.def_en: spread over a wide area or occurring at irregular intervals
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰村落、居民点，或天气中的零星阵雨，如 scattered showers / villages。

examples.en: There will be sunny intervals with scattered showers throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午天气晴暗相间，伴有零星阵雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼表意词，可能与 shatter（粉碎）同源，核心意象为“向四面八方散落、驱散”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to ask for something in an earnest and emotional way; to beg 2. [I, T] to state formally in court whether you are guilty or not guilty of a crime
lemmas.def_zh: 恳求，乞求；（在法庭上）认罪或抗辩；为……辩护

examples.en: The defendant chose to plead guilty to all charges to avoid a longer sentence.
examples.zh: 被告选择对所有指控认罪，以换取较轻的刑期。

lemmas.usage_note: 法庭抗辩常搭配 plead guilty/not guilty；表示恳求时常接 plead with sb for sth，语体庄重或情感强烈。

lemmas.def_en: (law) a statement in legal and logical form stating something on behalf of a party to a legal proceeding
lemmas.def_zh: n. 恳求；诉状，抗辩

examples.en: Her desperate pleading failed to convince the committee to change its mind.
examples.zh: 她苦苦的恳求未能说服委员会改变心意。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常指恳求的言语（不可数）；法律上常用复数 pleadings，指双方提交的诉状或辩护状。

lemmas.def_en: a lawyer who pleads cases in court
lemmas.def_zh: 辩论者, 辩解者, 申诉人, 答辩人

examples.en: The skilled legal pleader presented a compelling argument to the attentive jury.
examples.zh: 这位老练的法庭辩护人向专心致志的陪审团提出了令人信服的论点。

lemmas.def_en: in a beseeching manner
lemmas.def_zh: 祈求地, 诉愿地

examples.en: The stray dog looked up pleadingly, hoping someone would drop a piece of food.
examples.zh: 流浪狗乞求地抬头望着，希望有人能扔下一块食物。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 恳求的，乞求的
lemmas.def_en: expressing or indicating an urgent, emotional entreaty
lemmas.usage_note: 常用来修饰目光、声音或语气，如 a pleading look / voice / tone。

examples.en: The little boy looked at his mother with pleading eyes, hoping for a piece of cake.
examples.zh: 小男孩用恳求的眼神看着妈妈，希望能得到一块蛋糕。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 placitum（意见、决定），经法庭语境演化为“辩护、恳求”。
family_guide.core_distinction: plead为动词表示恳求或抗辩；pleading多作名词指法庭答辩状，或用作形容词指恳求的。

lemmas.def_en: an integrated course of academic studies
lemmas.def_zh: n. 全部课程，课程体系

examples.en: The university is updating its academic curriculum to include artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 这所大学正在更新其学术课程体系，以纳入人工智能内容。

lemmas.usage_note: 教育学术核心词，复数形式为 curricula 或 curriculums，常搭配 core curriculum、school curriculum。

lemmas.def_zh: 课程的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an academic course of study

examples.en: The school made significant curricular changes to enhance students' critical thinking.
examples.zh: 该校进行了重大的课程设置改革，以提升学生的批判性思维能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语修饰教学规划，常搭配 curricular reform、curricular activities，与 extra-curricular 相对。

family_guide.root_logic: 拉丁语原义为“奔跑、跑道”（源自 currere 奔跑），引申为学生在校期间需要“跑完”的学习进程，即课程体系。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it
lemmas.def_zh: n. 历史学家，史学工作者

examples.en: The historian uncovered forgotten letters that shed light on the war.
examples.zh: 这位历史学家发现了一些被遗忘的书信，揭示了那场战争的真相。

lemmas.usage_note: 指历史学家，常见搭配 art/military historian；前面冠词在现代英语中通用 a historian（极少用 an）。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 histor-（了解、历史）+ -ian（专家、从事者），指系统研究过去事件的人。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to give something to someone in exchange for something else, or exchange places.
lemmas.def_zh: 交换，调换，以物易物；替换

examples.en: We swapped phone numbers before parting ways at the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站分别前交换了电话号码。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用，常搭配 swap A for B（以A换B）或 swap with sb.，意为交换或调换。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，最初指击手成交的声响，后引申为物与物之间的直接调换或交换。

lemmas.def_en: a container that is usually woven and has handles
lemmas.def_zh: n. 篮子，篓；（篮球）篮框，投篮得分

examples.en: She carried a wicker basket filled with fresh apples.
examples.zh: 她提着一个装满新鲜苹果的柳条篮。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见短语 a basket of currencies（一篮子货币），比喻义中常指统合的一组事物或投资组合。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity contained in a basket
lemmas.def_zh: 满篮

examples.en: Grandmother returned from the orchard carrying a heavy basketful of freshly picked apples.
examples.zh: 祖母提着满满一篮刚采摘的苹果从果园回来了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指用柳条或编织材料制成的敞口容器，后扩展到球类运动等特定设备。

lemmas.def_en: small ovoid fruit of the European olive tree; important food and source of oil
lemmas.def_zh: n. 橄榄（树/果）；橄榄色

examples.en: She added a handful of fresh olives to the Mediterranean salad.
examples.zh: 她往地中海沙拉里加了一把新鲜的橄榄果。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 olive oil（橄榄油）或 olive branch（橄榄枝/和解信号），也可指橄榄绿这种颜色。

lemmas.def_en: of a yellow-green color similar to that of an unripe olive
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 橄榄色的，黄褐色的

examples.en: He had distinctive olive skin and dark hair inherited from his southern heritage.
examples.zh: 他有着从南方血统遗传而来的典型橄榄色皮肤和黑发。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰肤色或物体外观，常见搭配 olive skin（黄褐色皮肤）、olive green（橄榄绿）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 oliva（油橄榄），后既指代橄榄树与其果实，也因其果叶色泽引申为橄榄色。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To run or move somewhere very quickly. 2. [T] To strike or throw something violently against a surface. 3. [T] To destroy someone's hopes, dreams, or expectations.
lemmas.def_zh: 猛冲，急奔；猛击，猛掷；使（希望、梦想等）破灭

examples.en: The sudden downpour dashed our hopes of having an outdoor picnic.
examples.zh: 突如其来的倾盆大雨让我们举行户外野餐的希望破灭了。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示人急奔（常接 into/out），也可作及物动词指猛撞或抽象引申为“使（希望）破灭”。

lemmas.def_en: in a highly fashionable manner
lemmas.def_zh: 时髦地；华丽地；精力充沛地

examples.en: He walked into the ballroom dashingly attired in a tailored midnight blue tuxedo.
examples.zh: 他身着一身量身定制的午夜蓝燕尾服，风度翩翩地走进了宴会厅。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 风度翩翩的，英俊潇洒的；时髦有活力的
lemmas.def_en: attractive, confident, and elegant (especially of a man)
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰男性或外貌、装扮，如 a dashing young officer / actor。

examples.en: He looked very dashing in his tailored black tuxedo.
examples.zh: 他穿着合身的黑色燕尾服，显得非常英俊潇洒。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声兼动作词，生动模拟快速冲击、猛冲或猛撞的声音与动态。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to give someone the official authority or freedom to do something; to give someone more control over their life or situation.
lemmas.def_zh: 授权，准许；使能够，提升……的自主权

examples.en: The new law empowers local authorities to regulate rental housing markets.
examples.zh: 这项新法律授权地方当局监管租赁住房市场。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 empower sb to do sth，兼具法律行政的“正式授权”与社会学领域的“赋能”之意。

lemmas.def_en: the act of conferring legality or sanction or formal warrant
lemmas.def_zh: n. 授权；赋能；自主

examples.en: Economic empowerment of women has been proven to benefit the entire community.
examples.zh: 事实证明，赋予女性经济自主权能让整个社区受益。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，多用于管理学与公共政策领域，常见搭配 female empowerment、employee empowerment。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 em-（使成为、赋予）+ power（权力、力量），核心义为赋予权力或能力。

lemmas.def_en: a table (in a restaurant or bar) surrounded by two high-backed benches
lemmas.def_zh: n. 货摊；隔间；电话亭；投票间

examples.en: We visited every booth at the international food fair.
examples.zh: 我们逛遍了国际美食展上的每一个摊位。

lemmas.usage_note: 指封闭或半封闭小隔间，常见固定搭配有 voting booth（投票间）和 phone booth（电话亭）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，本义为临时搭建的小屋或棚屋，后引申为封闭或半封闭的隔间、摊位。

lemmas.def_en: the central part of a car wheel (or fan or propeller etc) through which the shaft or axle passes
lemmas.def_zh: n. 中心；枢纽；轮毂

examples.en: The city has become a major transportation and logistics hub.
examples.zh: 这座城市已成为一个重要的交通和物流枢纽。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于比喻，搭配 a hub of activity/transport/finance，指活动中心或交通、商业枢纽。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自方言词，原指车轮的中心轴，引申为活动的中心或交通网络的枢纽。

lemmas.def_en: any authorization to pass or go somewhere
lemmas.def_zh: n. 护照；（达成某事的）途径，手段

examples.en: Hard work is often the best passport to success.
examples.zh: 努力工作往往是通往成功的最佳途径。

lemmas.usage_note: 除本义护照外，引申义常搭配 passport to sth.（如 to success），指通往某结果的通行证/手段。

family_guide.root_logic: pass（通过）+ port（港口、关卡），字面即“准许通过港口的文书”。

lemmas.def_en: (of persons) freed from or not subject to an obligation or liability (as e.g. taxes) to which others or other things are subject
lemmas.def_zh: 免除的

examples.en: Charitable donations are usually exempt from national income tax.
examples.zh: 慈善捐赠通常免征国家个人所得税。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语与 from 搭配（exempt from），正式用于法定义务、赋税或规章制度的免除。

lemmas.def_en: (of goods or funds) subject to taxation
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 基本薪酬的人；非豁免；非豁免权员工

examples.en: Under federal labor laws, nonexempt employees are entitled to receive overtime pay.
examples.zh: 根据联邦劳动法，非豁免员工有权获得加班费。

lemmas.def_en: immunity from an obligation or duty
lemmas.def_zh: n. 豁免；免除；免税项目

examples.en: The company was granted a temporary exemption from environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 该公司获得了暂时豁免遵守环保法规的许可。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，法律及税务常用，常搭配 tax exemption、claim an exemption from...

lemmas.def_en: [T] To officially excuse someone or something from a duty, payment, or rule that others have to obey.
lemmas.def_zh: 免除，豁免

examples.en: His chronic medical condition exempted him from serving in the military.
examples.zh: 他的慢性疾病使他免服兵役。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于句式 exempt sb/sth from sth，被动语态非常高频，语体庄重正式。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ex-（向外）+ emere（拿取），即“从中拿出来排除在外”，表示免除。
family_guide.core_distinction: exempt 作动词指主动免除义务，作形容词指已被免除的状态；exemption 是其名词形式（免除/免税额）。

lemmas.def_en: any place of complete bliss and delight and peace
lemmas.def_zh: n. 天堂；乐园；极乐

examples.en: With its white sands and crystal waters, the island is a paradise for divers.
examples.zh: 白色的沙滩配上清澈的海水，这座岛屿成了潜水爱好者的天堂。

lemmas.usage_note: 指宗教乐园时首字母大写且不加冠词；比喻宜人胜地时常与介词 for 搭配，如 a paradise for walkers。

lemmas.def_zh: 天堂的, 极乐的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or befitting Paradise

examples.en: The remote island offered a paradisiacal retreat far from noisy city streets.
examples.zh: 这座偏远的岛屿提供了一个远离喧嚣城市街道的天堂般休养所。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古波斯语，原指“带围墙的皇家花园”，后引申为伊甸园、天堂或极乐世界。

lemmas.def_en: the first public performance of a play or movie
lemmas.def_zh: n. 首映；首次公演；首发

examples.en: The director and actors attended the world premiere of the movie.
examples.zh: 导演和演员们出席了这部电影的全球首映礼。

lemmas.usage_note: 文娱语境常用，指影视、戏剧等的首映或首演，常搭配 world/movie premiere 或 have its premiere。

family_guide.root_logic: 借用自法语，源自拉丁语 primus（第一），指戏剧、电影或音乐的首次公演。

lemmas.def_en: at some indefinite or unstated time
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 在某个时候；日后

examples.en: Let's get together for a cup of coffee sometime next week.
examples.zh: 我们下周找个时间一起喝杯咖啡吧。

lemmas.usage_note: 指过去或将来某个不确定的时间点，常搭配 sometime next week；注意勿与 sometimes（有时）混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: some（某）+ time（时间），指过去或将来的某个不确定的时间点。

lemmas.def_en: a shelter serving as a place of safety or sanctuary
lemmas.def_zh: n. 避难所；安息所；港口

examples.en: The secluded garden proved to be a peaceful haven from the noisy streets.
examples.zh: 事实证明，那个僻静的花园是远离嘈杂街道的宁静避难所。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词for搭配表示“……的避风港/安全处”，如a safe haven for；书面语中多指庇护所或平静居所。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，本指避风港、港口，引申为安全场所、避难所。

lemmas.def_en: the rays of the sun
lemmas.def_zh: n. 阳光；晴天；快活的人

examples.en: We spent the whole afternoon relaxing and soaking up the sunshine.
examples.zh: 我们整个下午都在悠闲地沐浴阳光。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常用in the sunshine（在阳光下）；口语常引申为“快乐之源”，也可用作亲昵的称呼。

family_guide.root_logic: sun（太阳）+ shine（照耀），指日光直射，也比喻带来欢乐的人或物。

lemmas.def_en: one of the five boroughs of New York City
lemmas.def_zh: n. 曼哈顿（鸡尾酒）；曼哈顿区

examples.en: He ordered a dry Manhattan at the hotel lounge.
examples.zh: 他在酒店休息室点了一杯干曼哈顿鸡尾酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指纽约曼哈顿区或由威士忌等调制的“曼哈顿鸡尾酒”；作为专有名词首字母通常大写，泛指酒水时常小写。

family_guide.root_logic: 地名，源自美洲原住民阿尔冈昆语词汇，后转借指产自该地的著名黑麦威士忌经典鸡尾酒。

lemmas.def_zh: pron. 我们的（所有物）

examples.en: Their car broke down, so they traveled in ours.
examples.zh: 他们的车坏了，所以坐我们的车旅行。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词性物主代词，后不可再加名词；常见搭配a friend of ours（我们的一位朋友），易错写成带撇号的our's。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 our（我们的）加所有格后缀 -s 构成的名词性物主代词。

lemmas.def_en: the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100
lemmas.def_zh: n. 一千

examples.en: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
examples.zh: 你要爱邻如己。

lemmas.usage_note: 古英语或诗歌/宗教语体中的第二人称单数主格（相当于you）；非正式英式口语中偶可作俚语表示“一千”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语第二人称单数主格代词，在现代英语中已被 you 取代，主要见于古诗文或宗教语境。

lemmas.def_en: in addition
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 此外；而且；并且

examples.en: The rent is reasonable; moreover, the location is absolutely ideal.
examples.zh: 租金很合理；此外，地段也绝对理想。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语副词，常置于句首且后接逗号，用于补充更有力的新论据；避免在口语对话中过度生硬使用。

family_guide.root_logic: more（更多）+ over（此外），表示在已有基础上进一步追加论据，承上启下。

lemmas.def_en: the secretion of an endocrine gland that is transmitted by the blood to the tissue on which it has a specific effect
lemmas.def_zh: n. 激素；荷尔蒙

examples.en: Stress triggers the release of cortisol, a hormone that regulates metabolism and immune response.
examples.zh: 压力会引发皮质醇的释放，这是一种调节新陈代谢和免疫反应的激素。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指人体或植物分泌的生物化学激素，常见搭配如 growth hormone（生长激素）、hormone levels（激素水平）。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by hormones
lemmas.def_zh: 荷尔蒙的

examples.en: Sudden mood swings during adolescence are often triggered by complex hormonal fluctuations.
examples.zh: 青春期突发的情绪波动往往是由复杂的荷尔蒙波动引起的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 horman（驱策、刺激、激起），指体内驱动和调节生理机能的化学分泌物。

lemmas.def_en: a liquid used for printing or writing or drawing
lemmas.def_zh: 墨水, 墨汁

examples.en: Please fill out this official application form in black ink rather than pencil.
examples.zh: 请用黑色墨水而不是铅笔填写这份正式申请表。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数名词，表示书写或打印用的墨水，常见搭配如 in ink（用钢笔/墨水写）、ink cartridge（墨盒）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To sign a formal contract or agreement. 2. [T] To apply ink to a surface or printing block.
lemmas.def_zh: 正式签署（合同或协议）；给……涂墨水

examples.en: The tech giant is expected to ink a lucrative multi-year partnership with the startup next week.
examples.zh: 预计该科技巨头将于下周与这家初创公司签署一份利润丰厚的多年度合作协议。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，商业和法律语境中常引申为“签署（协议/合同）”，常搭配 ink a deal/contract。

lemmas.def_zh: 墨水的, 给墨水弄污的, 漆黑的
lemmas.def_en: of the color of black ink

examples.en: We gazed up into the inky night sky, admiring the brilliant scattered stars.
examples.zh: 我们仰望漆黑的夜空，欣赏着璀璨散落的繁星。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指书写、印刷用的墨水或墨汁，后引申为用墨水签署或纹身。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To prevent something from growing or developing freely, or to slow down a process. 2. [T] To make someone feel too self-conscious or nervous to act naturally.
lemmas.def_zh: 阻碍，抑制，阻止；使拘束，使难为情

examples.en: Strict regulatory measures may inadvertently inhibit technological innovation across the sector.
examples.zh: 严格的监管措施可能会无意中抑制整个行业的技术创新。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面动词，指阻碍发展或抑制生理/心理过程，核心句型为 inhibit sb/sth from doing sth。

lemmas.def_en: (psychology) the conscious exclusion of unacceptable thoughts or desires
lemmas.def_zh: 禁止, 抑制, 压抑

examples.en: She felt all her inhibitions disappear after dancing freely to the energetic music.
examples.zh: 伴着欢快的音乐自由起舞后，她感到了前所未有的放松自在。

lemmas.def_en: a substance that retards or stops an activity
lemmas.def_zh: 禁止者, 抑制人, 抑制物, 抑制因素, 抑制剂, 阻化剂

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a new enzyme inhibitor to lower his high blood pressure.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种新型酶抑制剂来降低他的高血压。

lemmas.def_zh: 禁止的, 抑制的
lemmas.def_en: restrictive of action

examples.en: The medication produces an inhibitory effect on certain pain receptors in the brain.
examples.zh: 该药物对大脑中的某些疼痛受体产生抑制作用。

lemmas.def_en: not inhibited or restrained
lemmas.def_zh: 不受禁令约束的, 不受拘束的, 自由自在的, 随心所欲的, 大吵大闹的

examples.en: Her uninhibited laughter echoed across the room, bringing a smile to everyone present.
examples.zh: 她无拘无束的笑声在房间里回荡，让在场的每个人都露出了微笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语前缀 in-（进入、在内）+ habere（持有），字面为“内持、扣住”，引申为阻止、抑制。

lemmas.def_en: one who loves and defends his or her country
lemmas.def_zh: 爱国者, 爱国主义者

examples.en: He was regarded as a true patriot who devoted his entire life to serving.
examples.zh: 他被视为真正的爱国者，一生都奉献给了自己的国家。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，意为“爱国者”，常与true或staunch连用；多出现在政治演说、历史评论或重大集会报道等严肃语体中。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 patriotes（同胞），派生自 pater（父亲），指深爱祖国的人。

lemmas.def_en: meat cut from the thigh of a hog (usually smoked)
lemmas.def_zh: 火腿, 后腿, 笨拙演员

examples.en: She ordered a sandwich layered with smoked ham, melted cheese, and fresh lettuce.
examples.zh: 她点了一份夹着烟熏火腿、融化奶酪和新鲜生菜的三明治。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指食品火腿（可数或不可数），也可在戏剧语境中口语化指代“表演夸张蹩脚的演员”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (informal, often ham it up) to overact or exaggerate emotions in an artificial, theatrical way
lemmas.def_zh: 过火地表演，夸张作态

examples.en: The lead actor chose to ham it up for the comedic scenes, drawing loud laughter from the audience.
examples.zh: 主角在喜剧场景中选择夸张表演，引得观众哄堂大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常与 up 连用构成 ham it up，指演员演戏过火、夸张表演以博取关注。

lemmas.def_en: affectedly dramatic; overacted
lemmas.def_zh: 有火腿香味的, (非正式)表演过火的

examples.en: The actor gave a hammy performance that failed to convince the critical audience.
examples.zh: 这位演员过火浮夸的表演未能说服挑剔的观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为大腿弯曲处，引申指猪后腿肉（火腿）；演艺俚语中指表演过火的二流演员（源自 hamateur）。

lemmas.def_en: armor plate that protects the head
lemmas.def_zh: 钢盔, 盔, 防护帽

examples.en: Always make sure to wear a helmet when riding a bicycle on busy streets.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的街道上骑自行车时，务必记得戴上头盔。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，核心搭配为wear/put on a helmet（戴头盔）；安全防护语境高频词，如crash/safety helmet。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古日耳曼语，是 helm（头盔、覆盖物）的指小词，专指保护头部的坚硬护具。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To jump high or a long distance into the air, or move suddenly and eagerly. 2. [I] To increase suddenly by a large amount.
lemmas.def_zh: 跳跃，腾跃，跃过；暴涨，猛增

examples.en: Sales leaped dramatically after the company launched its nationwide marketing campaign.
examples.zh: 在公司发起全国营销活动后，销售额急剧猛增。

lemmas.usage_note: 动作动词，强调大幅度跳跃或骤然跃进，常见短语有 leap at the chance（欣然抓住机会）、leap over。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense and past participle of leap; jumped high or far, or moved suddenly.
lemmas.def_zh: 跳跃，跃过（leap的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: The terrified cat leapt onto the high fence to escape the barking dog.
examples.zh: 受惊的猫猛然跳上高栅栏，以躲避吠叫的狗。

lemmas.usage_note: leap 的过去式及过去分词形式（英式多用 leapt，美式多用 leaped），表示动作已发生。

lemmas.def_en: a light, self-propelled movement upwards or forwards
lemmas.def_zh: 跳跃, 剧增, 急变, 被越过之物

examples.en: The discovery of the new vaccine represents a giant leap forward in public health.
examples.zh: 新疫苗的发现代表了公共卫生领域的巨大飞跃。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指跳跃的动作，或比喻突破性进展，常用搭配 a leap of faith（盲目冒险）、a quantum leap。

lemmas.def_en: someone who bounds or leaps (as in competition)
lemmas.def_zh: 跳跃者

examples.en: As a remarkable leaper, the young athlete easily cleared the challenging high bar.
examples.zh: 作为一名出色的跳跃选手，这位年轻运动员轻松越过了极具挑战性的横杆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hlēapan，本义为跳跃、蹦跳，强调幅度大、距离远或突发性。

lemmas.def_en: a restaurant where food is cooked on a grill
lemmas.def_zh: 烤架，烤炉

examples.en: He cleaned the charcoal grill thoroughly before laying the fresh steaks on the metal rack.
examples.zh: 在将新鲜牛排放在金属架上之前，他彻底清洁了木炭烤架。

lemmas.usage_note: 烤架，烤炉

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. (informal) To question someone intensely and relentlessly for a long period. 2. [I, T] To cook food directly under or over intense heat on a metal frame.
lemmas.def_zh: 严加盘问，诘问；烧烤

examples.en: Reporters gathered outside to grill the minister about the leaked financial documents.
examples.zh: 记者们聚集在门外，就泄露的财务文件严加盘问这位部长。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指烧烤食物，引申为“严加盘问、审讯”，常搭配 grill sb about/on sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 craticula（铁栅栏），指烤架，引申为烧烤及像放在烤架上一样严苛盘问。

lemmas.def_en: psychological suffering
lemmas.def_zh: 苦恼, 贫困, 痛苦

examples.en: The sinking cargo vessel sent out an immediate distress signal to the coast guard.
examples.zh: 正在下沉的货轮立即向海岸警卫队发出了遇险求救信号。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指精神上的极度痛苦或经济贫困，亦指船只呼救，搭配 in distress、emotional distress。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone feel very upset, sorrowful, or anxious; to cause emotional suffering to.
lemmas.def_zh: 使焦虑不安，使悲伤痛苦；使苦恼

examples.en: It distressed her deeply to see her hometown severely devastated by the unexpected flood.
examples.zh: 看到家乡被突如其来的洪水严重破坏，她感到极度悲伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示使某人极度忧虑、悲痛，多用于被动语态 be distressed by/at/about。

lemmas.def_en: unpleasantly
lemmas.def_zh: 使人痛苦, 令人苦恼

examples.en: The number of endangered animals in this region has fallen distressingly fast recently.
examples.zh: 该地区濒危动物的数量最近下降得令人十分揪心。

lemmas.def_en: causing distress or worry or anxiety
lemmas.def_zh: 使苦恼的, 苦难重重的, 痛苦的

examples.en: Hearing the distressful news about the earthquake left everyone deeply shaken and sorrowful.
examples.zh: 听到关于地震的令人痛苦的消息，大家都深感震惊和悲痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 dis-（分开）+ stringere（拉紧），本义为“拉扯得支离破碎”，引申为极度的痛苦、困境。

lemmas.def_en: having or expressing strong emotions
lemmas.def_zh: 热情的, 热烈的, 易怒的, 热恋的

examples.en: She is deeply passionate about environmental conservation and devotes her weekends to wildlife protection.
examples.zh: 她对环境保护充满热情，并将周末时间奉献给野生动物保护事业。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，表示对某事极具热情或情感强烈的，常与介词 about 搭配，如 be passionate about sth。

lemmas.def_en: with passion
lemmas.def_zh: 热情地, 激昂地

examples.en: He argued passionately in favor of educational reform during the heated panel discussion.
examples.zh: 在激烈的专题讨论中，他激情澎湃地为教育改革进行辩护。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 passio（受难、强烈情感），形容情感极其充沛、热烈。

lemmas.def_en: a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
lemmas.def_zh: 咖啡馆, 酒店

examples.en: They met at a cozy corner cafe to chat over hot cups of coffee.
examples.zh: 他们在街角一家舒适的咖啡馆碰面，一边喝热咖啡一边聊天。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指提供咖啡和小吃的休闲餐饮店，注意与指代饮品本身的 coffee 区分，常搭配 at a cafe。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自法语 café（咖啡、咖啡馆），最终源于阿拉伯语 qahwah，指提供咖啡和小食的休闲场所。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make something neat or tidy by cutting away unwanted or irregular parts. 2. [T] To reduce the amount, number, or size of something.
lemmas.def_zh: 修剪，剪去；削减，缩减

examples.en: The gardener uses sharp shears every spring to trim the overgrown hedges around the yard.
examples.zh: 园丁每年春天都会用锋利的剪刀修剪院子周围疯长的树篱。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指修剪枝叶毛发或削减开支，常与 down/back 连用，如 trim the budget/costs。

lemmas.def_en: thin and fit
lemmas.def_zh: 整齐的

examples.en: Decades of regular swimming helped the retired athlete maintain a lean and trim figure.
examples.zh: 数十年来规律的游泳习惯帮助这位退役运动员保持着精干苗条的身材。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，多用来形容人身材匀称苗条，或物体整洁利落，常作定语或表语，如 keep trim。

lemmas.def_en: not trimmed
lemmas.def_zh: 未装饰的, 未修饰的

examples.en: The untrimmed grass in the abandoned yard had grown nearly knee-high over summer.
examples.zh: 废弃院子里未修剪的杂草在夏天几乎长到了膝盖高。

lemmas.def_en: the act of adding decoration
lemmas.def_zh: 整理, 修剪, 装饰, 点缀物, 装饰物, 修剪下来的东西, 诈骗, 击败, 殴打

examples.en: The family gathered on Christmas Day to enjoy a roasted turkey with all the traditional trimmings.
examples.zh: 全家人在圣诞节齐聚一堂，享用烤火鸡和所有传统配菜辅料。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常用复数 trimmings，指衣服装饰物、配菜边料或削减下来的碎屑，搭配 all the trimmings。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who thins out and trims trees and shrubs
lemmas.def_zh: 整理者, 装饰者, 修剪者

examples.en: The hedge trimmer spent the whole afternoon shaping the garden bushes neatly.
examples.zh: 绿篱修剪工花了一整个下午将花园的灌木修剪整齐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 trymian（使坚固、整理好），核心语义为“修整至整齐、合适的状态”。
family_guide.core_distinction: trim 兼作动词（修剪）、形容词（苗条整洁的）；trimming 为名词（剪屑、配料装饰）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To fail to give proper care, attention, or maintenance to someone or something. 2. [T] (+ to do) To fail to do something because of carelessness or forgetfulness.
lemmas.def_zh: 疏忽，忽视，不顾；疏于照管；未能（做某事）

examples.en: Preoccupied with his busy career, he began to neglect his personal health and family life.
examples.zh: 由于专注于忙碌的职业生涯，他开始忽视自己的个人健康和家庭生活。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指因疏忽而未予照顾或未履行责任，后接名词或动词不定式 neglect to do sth。

lemmas.def_en: lack of attention and due care
lemmas.def_zh: 疏忽, 忽略, 漏做

examples.en: The historic mansion gradually fell into decay after suffering from decades of neglect.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的豪宅在经历数十年的荒废失修后逐渐破败。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指因忽视导致的不良状态，常用于短语 suffer from neglect 或 years of neglect。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏忽, 粗心大意, 忽视
lemmas.def_en: failure to act with the prudence that a reasonable person would exercise under the same circumstances

examples.en: The hospital faced a serious lawsuit due to gross medical negligence by the surgical team.
examples.zh: 该医院因手术团队严重的医疗过失而面临重大诉讼。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律及正式语境名词，指应负责任而未尽责的“过失、玩忽职守”，常见搭配 professional negligence。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏忽的, 粗心的, 不在意的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by neglect and undue lack of concern

examples.en: The safety inspector was found negligent in failing to report the faulty electrical wiring.
examples.zh: 安全检查员因未能上报故障电线而被认定犯有失职疏忽。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式形容词，指疏忽大意的、玩忽职守的，常用搭配 be negligent in (doing) sth 或 negligent of。

lemmas.def_en: not showing due care or attention
lemmas.def_zh: 不小心的, 疏忽的

examples.en: The neglectful pet owner left the dog alone in the yard overnight.
examples.zh: 那位粗心的宠物主人把狗独自在院子里留了一整夜。

lemmas.def_zh: 疏忽地；粗心大意地
lemmas.def_en: in a negligent manner

examples.en: he did his work negligently

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 neg-（不）+ legere（挑选、拾取），字面为“不去拾取”，引申为疏忽、忽视。

lemmas.def_en: one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas; the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line
lemmas.def_zh: 段落, 短评

examples.en: Please summarize the main idea of the second paragraph in one sentence.
examples.zh: 请用一句话概括第二段的中心思想。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指文章的段落，常见搭配有 in the opening paragraph、paragraph structure 等。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To divide a piece of writing into separate paragraphs. 2. [T] To write about something in a paragraph.
lemmas.def_zh: 将（文章等）分段；写短文报道

examples.en: The editor carefully paragraphed the manuscript to make it easier to read.
examples.zh: 编辑仔细地将稿件分段，使其更易于阅读。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指将文章分段或为报道撰写短评，常用于书面语或编辑校对语境中。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自希腊语 para-（在旁）+ graphein（写），原指写在正文旁用于分段的标记符号，后代指段落。

lemmas.def_en: hypersensitivity reaction to a particular allergen; symptoms can vary greatly in intensity
lemmas.def_zh: 变应性, 反感, 厌恶

examples.en: He developed a severe food allergy after eating shellfish at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 他在餐馆吃完贝类海鲜后出现了严重的食物过敏。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示生理过敏或比喻对某事的极度厌恶，常用搭配 have an allergy to sth。

lemmas.def_en: a physician skilled in the diagnosis and treatment of allergies
lemmas.def_zh: 过敏症专科医生

examples.en: My doctor referred me to an experienced allergist for detailed skin tests.
examples.zh: 我的医生建议我去一位经验丰富的过敏症专科医生那里做详细皮试。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by or caused by allergy
lemmas.def_zh: 对...过敏的, 极反感的

examples.en: She is allergic to cat hair and begins to sneeze whenever one is around.
examples.zh: 她对猫毛过敏，只要周围有猫就会开始打喷嚏。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作表语形容生理过敏或反感，标准搭配为 be allergic to sth/doing sth。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 allos（其他的、异常的）+ ergon（反应、活动），指机体对某些物质产生的变态/过敏反应。
family_guide.core_distinction: allergy 为名词（过敏症）；allergic 为其形容词形式（过敏的、反感的）。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To do what you are told to do by a person, rule, or law.
lemmas.def_zh: 服从，听从，顺从

examples.en: All drivers must obey the traffic regulations to ensure road safety.
examples.zh: 所有驾驶员都必须遵守交通法规以确保道路安全。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，表示顺从命令或遵照规则，常搭配 obey rules、obey orders。

lemmas.def_en: the act of obeying; dutiful or submissive behavior with respect to another person
lemmas.def_zh: 服从, 顺从, 忠实
