examples.en: The training course teaches young dogs basic obedience and good behavior.
examples.zh: 该训练课程教导幼犬基本的服从性和良好的行为规范。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，表示服从状态或顺从行为，常见搭配有 blind obedience、in obedience to。

lemmas.def_en: bending the head or body or knee as a sign of reverence or submission or shame or greeting
lemmas.def_zh: 敬礼, 鞠躬, 敬重

examples.en: The subjects bowed low in silent obeisance as the king entered.
examples.zh: 国王步入时，臣民们躬身肃立以示敬意。

lemmas.def_en: dutifully complying with the commands or instructions of those in authority; ; ; ; - Edmund Burke
lemmas.def_zh: 服从的, 顺从的, 孝顺的

examples.en: The obedient puppy sat down immediately when its owner gave the command.
examples.zh: 听到主人的指令后，那只顺从的小狗立刻坐了下来。

lemmas.def_en: in an obedient manner
lemmas.def_zh: 顺从地；服从地；忠顺地

examples.en: The young children waited obediently in line for their turn at lunch.
examples.zh: 孩子们顺从地排着队，等待轮到自己吃午餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 ob-（朝向）+ audire（听），字面为“倾听”，引申为认真听从并顺从指令。
family_guide.core_distinction: obey 为动词（服从）；obedience 为名词（服从、顺从）。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of things wrapped or boxed together
lemmas.def_zh: 捆, 束

examples.en: The delivery man left a large bundle of newspapers outside the shop entrance.
examples.zh: 快递员把一大捆报纸留在了商店门口。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指扎成一捆的物品或口语中巨款，常构成 a bundle of nerves/sticks。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ up/together) To tie or wrap multiple items tightly together into a bundle. 2. [T] (+ into/off) To push or hurry someone quickly somewhere.
lemmas.def_zh: 捆扎，扎成包；把……匆忙打发走

examples.en: She bundled her clothes into a suitcase and rushed out the door.
examples.zh: 她胡乱把衣服塞进手提箱，然后冲出了门。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示乱塞、匆忙塞入或裹暖和，常与介词搭配使用，如 bundle up、bundle sth into。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语系，本义为“捆、扎”，引申为包裹或聚集在一起的事物。

lemmas.def_en: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
lemmas.def_zh: 未开化的, 野蛮的, 无礼的, 残酷的, 原始的, 粗鲁的, 未开发的

examples.en: The politician faced savage criticism from the press over his controversial remarks.
examples.zh: 这位政客因其争议性言论遭到了媒体的严厉批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容野蛮、残暴的攻击或严厉批评，常修饰 attack、criticism、beast 等词。

lemmas.def_en: a member of an uncivilized people
lemmas.def_zh: 原始人, 粗鲁人

examples.en: He behaved like a savage when he lost his temper at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在会议上发脾气时，表现得像个毫无教养的粗人。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指野蛮人或缺乏教养者，多用于文学作品或带贬义的批评语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 兽性, 原始状态, 野蛮人
lemmas.def_en: the property of being untamed and ferocious

examples.en: The brutal savagery of the sudden border attack shocked the entire peaceful nation.
examples.zh: 突如其来的边境袭击极其野蛮残暴，震惊了整个爱好和平的国家。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being untamed and ferocious
lemmas.def_zh: 天然, 野蛮

examples.en: The utter savageness of the winter storm surprised even the local residents.
examples.zh: 这场冬季风暴的无比凶猛甚至让当地居民都感到惊讶。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (especially of an animal) To attack someone violently and cause severe injuries. 2. [T] To criticize something or someone very harshly.
lemmas.def_zh: （动物等）凶猛攻击，撕咬；猛烈抨击

examples.en: The stray dog savaged the sheep before the farmer could intervene.
examples.zh: 农夫还来不及干预，那只流浪狗就凶残地咬伤了绵羊。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指野兽凶猛撕咬或媒体严重抨击，常作 savage sb/sth。

lemmas.def_en: in a vicious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 野蛮地；残忍地

examples.en: The harsh critics savagely attacked the director's newest experimental movie in reviews.
examples.zh: 苛刻的影评人在评论中对这位导演最新的实验电影进行了猛烈抨击。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 silva（森林），原指“森林中的、野生的”，引申为凶猛、残酷或未经开化的。

lemmas.def_en: the act of taking something from someone unlawfully
lemmas.def_zh: 盗窃, 失窃, 盗窃罪, 赃物

examples.en: Police are actively investigating the theft of expensive jewelry from the store.
examples.zh: 警方正在全力调查该商店昂贵珠宝失窃一案。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与正式语体中指“偷窃行为”，常搭配 identity theft（身份盗用）或 commit a theft。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，与 thief 同源，专指偷窃的行为或罪行。
family_guide.core_distinction: theft 指“偷窃行为”；thief 指“实施盗窃的人”。

lemmas.def_en: large shaggy-haired brown bison of North American plains
lemmas.def_zh: 水牛

examples.en: A vast herd of buffalo grazed peacefully across the open plain.
examples.zh: 一大群水牛在开阔的平原上安静地吃草。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，单复数多同形，指水牛或美洲野牛，常用搭配 a herd of buffalo。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal, chiefly North American) To intimidate, overpower, or bewilder someone into submission or confusion.
lemmas.def_zh: 威吓，恐吓；愚弄，蒙骗

examples.en: Don't let them buffalo you into agreeing to an unfair contract.
examples.zh: 别让他们吓唬住你，从而签下一份不平等的合同。

lemmas.usage_note: 北美非正式动词，意为威吓、迷惑或愚弄，常用于被动语态或及物用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语，指“野牛”，动词引申义来自美式俚语中野牛的强横冲击感，意为威吓、迷惑。

lemmas.def_en: a criminal who takes property belonging to someone else with the intention of keeping it or selling it
lemmas.def_zh: 小偷, 贼

examples.en: The thief managed to steal her purse without anyone noticing in the crowd.
examples.zh: 小偷趁人群拥挤，神不知鬼不觉地偷走了她的钱包。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词（复数 thieves），指暗中窃取财物的小偷，常与 catch、identity 连用。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (dated / literary) To steal things; to take another person's property secretly and dishonestly.
lemmas.def_zh: 偷窃，做贼，行窃

examples.en: The dishonest employee was caught attempting to thieve company supplies from the warehouse.
examples.zh: 这名不诚实的员工在企图从仓库盗窃公司用品时被抓获。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，指实施不法秘密窃取行为的人。
family_guide.core_distinction: thief 指“盗贼”；theft 指“盗窃罪行”。

lemmas.def_en: agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
lemmas.def_zh: 合意, 一致, 同感

examples.en: The committee finally reached a broad consensus on the proposed environmental policy.
examples.zh: 委员会最终就拟议的环境政策达成了广泛共识。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数或单数名词，表示群体共识，常见搭配 reach/build a consensus on。

lemmas.def_en: existing by consent
lemmas.def_zh: 在两方愿意下成立的, 交感的

examples.en: The contract was terminated through a consensual agreement between both business partners.
examples.zh: 这份合同是通过双方合伙人自愿达成的协议终止的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 con-（共同）+ sentire（感觉、思考），指大家的想法一致，即共识。

lemmas.def_en: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
lemmas.def_zh: 残酷的, 令人极痛苦的

examples.en: It is extremely cruel to keep wild animals in cramped cages.
examples.zh: 把野生动物关在狭窄的笼子里是极其残忍的。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容人或行为残忍冷酷，固定搭配为 be cruel to sb/animals、cruel fate。

lemmas.def_en: excessively
lemmas.def_zh: 残忍地, 残酷地, 极

examples.en: The innocent villagers were cruelly mistreated by the occupying military forces.
examples.zh: 无辜的村民受到了占领军的残酷虐待。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being cruel and causing tension or annoyance
lemmas.def_zh: 残忍, 残暴, 残酷, 残酷的行为, 刻毒伤人的语言

examples.en: She was deeply shocked by the cruelness shown toward the abandoned animals.
examples.zh: 她对那些被遗弃动物所遭受的残酷对待深感震惊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 crudelis（冷酷残忍的），与生肉、未经加工的粗暴状态有关，核心为给他人施加痛苦。

lemmas.def_en: slices of bread that have been toasted
lemmas.def_zh: 吐司, 烤面包, 干杯

examples.en: The host stood up to propose a toast to the bride and groom.
examples.zh: 主持人站起身来，向新娘新郎敬酒祝贺。

lemmas.usage_note: 吐司为不可数名词；祝酒辞为可数，常用 propose/make a toast to sb。

lemmas.def_en: someone who proposes a toast; someone who drinks to the health of success of someone or some venture
lemmas.def_zh: 烤面包器, 烤面包炉, 祝酒人

examples.en: He bought a compact toaster that browns bread evenly within two minutes.
examples.zh: 他买了一台小巧的烤面包机，两分钟内就能把面包烤得均匀金黄。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To raise a glass and drink in honor of someone's health, happiness, or success. 2. [I, T] To brown bread or other food by exposing it to heat.
lemmas.def_zh: 为……举杯敬酒；烤，烘（面包等）

examples.en: We raised our glasses to toast his remarkable achievement in science.
examples.zh: 我们举起酒杯，为他在科学领域的卓越成就祝酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指烘烤面包或为某人举杯祝贺，常搭配 toast sb/sth。

lemmas.def_en: not having been browned by exposure to heat
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 没有了

examples.en: She prefers eating untoasted bread with fresh butter every morning for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她每天早上喜欢吃抹了新鲜黄油的未烤面包作为早餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 torrere（烘烤）；碰杯习俗源于旧时向酒中加烤面包碎提味的传统。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To shape metal by heating it in a fire and beating it with a hammer. 2. [T] To build or form something strong, such as an alliance, relationship, or agreement. 3. [T] To make an illegal copy of something to deceive people.
lemmas.def_zh: 打制，锻造；缔造，开创；伪造，假冒

examples.en: He was arrested for attempting to forge his manager's signature on the contract.
examples.zh: 他因企图在合同上伪造经理的签名而被逮捕。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指锻造金属，引申为伪造证件或建立密切关系，常见搭配为 forge a signature/relationship。

lemmas.def_zh: 伪造, 伪造罪, 伪造物
lemmas.def_en: a copy that is represented as the original

examples.en: The painting looked authentic, but experts quickly proved it was a clever forgery.
examples.zh: 这幅画看起来像是真迹，但专家很快证明它是一件巧妙的伪造品。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指伪造罪这一行为，也可指伪造的假画、假钞等物件，多用于法律或艺术领域。

lemmas.def_en: someone who operates a forge
lemmas.def_zh: 铁匠, 伪造者, 赝造者

examples.en: The skilled forger produced fake paintings that fooled even experienced art dealers.
examples.zh: 那个熟练的伪造者制作了假画，连经验丰富的艺术品商人都被骗了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fabrica（作坊），本指打铁锻造，引申为伪造及艰难缔造某种关系。

lemmas.def_en: a domain in which something is dominant
lemmas.def_zh: 王国, 领土, 领域

examples.en: Artificial intelligence has opened up entirely new possibilities in the realm of medicine.
examples.zh: 人工智能在医学领域开辟了全新的可能性。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语，常比喻“领域、范围”，高频搭配 in/within the realm of（如 the realm of possibility）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 reaume（王国），引申为特定思想、学科或活动的领域。

lemmas.def_en: someone who pays taxes
lemmas.def_zh: 纳税人

examples.en: The construction of the new public library was funded entirely by local taxpayers.
examples.zh: 新公共图书馆的建设资金完全由当地纳税人提供。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以复数或所有格形式用于公帑议题，高频搭配 at the taxpayers' expense（由纳税人买单）。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词：tax（税）+ payer（支付者），即纳税人。

lemmas.def_en: immunity from arbitrary exercise of authority: political independence
lemmas.def_zh: 自治, 自治权

examples.en: The university was granted greater autonomy in managing its financial budget.
examples.zh: 该大学在财务预算管理方面获得了更大的自主权。

lemmas.usage_note: 指个人、机构或地区的自主权与独立性，常与 grant、enjoy 或 regional 连用。

lemmas.def_en: (of political bodies) not controlled by outside forces
lemmas.def_zh: 自治的

examples.en: Tibet is an autonomous region located in the southwest of China.
examples.zh: 西藏是位于中国西南部的一个自治区。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰具有自我管理能力的地区、机构或独立运行的系统，常见搭配为 autonomous region/vehicle。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 auto-（自我）+ nomos（法律、规则），核心指不受外界干预、自我治理。
family_guide.core_distinction: autonomy 为名词（自治、自主权）；autonomous 为形容词（自治的、自主的）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make a substance pure by removing unwanted materials from it. 2. [T] To improve a method, system, idea, etc. by making small changes.
lemmas.def_zh: 提炼，精炼；改进，完善

examples.en: She spent months refining her presentation technique before the global summit.
examples.zh: 在全球峰会召开前，她花了数月时间完善自己的演讲技巧。

lemmas.usage_note: 指提纯原材料（如石油、糖），或引申为改进方法、完善技能，常接 skills 或 technique。

lemmas.def_zh: 精炼厂
lemmas.def_en: an industrial plant for purifying a crude substance

examples.en: A sudden fire broke out at the coastal oil refinery late last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚深夜，沿海的一家炼油厂突然发生火灾。

lemmas.usage_note: 指加工提炼石油、金属或糖等的精炼厂，高频搭配如 oil/sugar refinery。

lemmas.def_en: a highly developed state of perfection; having a flawless or impeccable quality; ; ; --Joseph Conrad
lemmas.def_zh: 精致, 高尚, 精巧

examples.en: The latest smartphone update shows considerable refinement in its overall interface design.
examples.zh: 最新的智能手机更新在整体界面设计上展现出相当大的改进与精致度。

lemmas.def_en: one whose work is to refine a specific thing
lemmas.def_zh: 炼制业者, 精炼机

examples.en: The local sugar refiner invested heavily in modern equipment to boost daily production.
examples.zh: 当地的糖精炼厂大举投资现代设备，以提高日产量。

lemmas.def_en: not refined or processed
lemmas.def_zh: 未精制的, 未提炼的, 不高尚的, 粗俗的, 不优雅的

examples.en: Unrefined coconut oil often retains a stronger natural flavor and distinct aroma.
examples.zh: 未精制的椰子油通常保留了更浓郁的天然风味和独特香气。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（再）+ fine（纯净的、优良的），本义为“使再次纯净”，即精炼、完善。

lemmas.def_en: the period of time during which something continues
lemmas.def_zh: 持续时间, 持续

examples.en: Passengers must keep their seatbelts fastened for the entire duration of the flight.
examples.zh: 在整个飞行期间，乘客必须系好安全带。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，表示持续时间，极高频固定搭配为 for the duration of（在……的整个期间内）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 durare（持续、坚硬），指某事物从开始到结束所经历的时间长度。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To pull or drag something heavy with continuous effort. 2. [T] To transport goods or materials by truck, cart, or ship.
lemmas.def_zh: 用力拖拽，拉；运送，搬运

examples.en: Fishermen worked together to haul the heavy net full of fish onto the deck.
examples.zh: 渔民们齐心协力把装满鱼的沉重渔网拉到了甲板上。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调费力拉拽重物或用车辆长途运输，常与 away、up、into 等介词搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: the act of drawing or hauling something
lemmas.def_zh: 拖曳, 运费, 牵引量

examples.en: The logistics company specializes in the road haulage of temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical goods.
examples.zh: 这家物流公司专门从事对温度敏感的药品的公路货物运输。

lemmas.def_en: a haulage contractor
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 绞盘

examples.en: The crew secured the heavy cable to the mechanical hauler on deck.
examples.zh: 船员将重型缆绳固定在甲板上的机械绞盘上。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语，意为用力拖拉或长途运输。

lemmas.def_en: the part of a garment that is attached at the armhole and that provides a cloth covering for the arm
lemmas.def_zh: 袖子, 套管

examples.en: He rolled up his shirt sleeves and began repairing the damaged water pipe.
examples.zh: 他挽起衬衫袖子，开始修理受损的水管。

lemmas.usage_note: 指衣物的袖子或唱片、机械套管，常见习语有 roll up one's sleeves（挽起袖子准备苦干）。

lemmas.def_en: having no sleeves
lemmas.def_zh: 无袖的

examples.en: She wore a lightweight sleeveless dress because of the sweltering summer heat.
examples.zh: 由于夏日酷暑，她穿了一条轻便的无袖连衣裙。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指手臂的遮盖物，后引申为套筒或唱片封套。

lemmas.def_en: extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; ; ; ; - Walter Lippman
lemmas.def_zh: 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的

examples.en: The medical team made a tremendous effort to save the critically injured patient.
examples.zh: 医疗团队付出了巨大的努力来挽救这名重伤患者。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容体量、力量、程度极大或极好，常修饰 effort、amount、success 或 progress。

lemmas.def_en: extremely
lemmas.def_zh: 极大地; 极端地; 极其; 非常

examples.en: Her overall confidence grew tremendously after she delivered the successful keynote speech.
examples.zh: 在发表了成功的基调演讲后，她的自信心大增。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 tremere（颤抖），本义为可怕得令人发抖，引申为巨大、极好的。

lemmas.def_en: farm consisting of a large tract of land along with facilities needed to raise livestock (especially cattle)
lemmas.def_zh: 大牧场

examples.en: They bought a cattle ranch in Texas to raise livestock for a living.
examples.zh: 他们在得克萨斯州买下了一处养牛场，以饲养牲畜为生。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指美洲饲养牛、马或羊的大型牧场，常与 cattle、horse 或 dude 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a person who owns or operates a ranch
lemmas.def_zh: 大农场经营者, 牧场工人

examples.en: The local rancher checked all the fences before the winter storm arrived.
examples.zh: 当地牧场主在冬季暴风雪来临前检查了所有围栏。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To manage, operate, or work on a ranch (a large farm for raising livestock such as cattle or horses).
lemmas.def_zh: 经营牧场；在牧场工作

examples.en: His family has ranched in the western valley for more than three generations.
examples.zh: 他的家族在西部山谷经营牧场已有三代之久。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为动词使用频率较低，指经营牧场或在牧场上放牧，通常作为不及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西班牙语 rancho（临时住处/餐肉），在美洲特指放牧牛羊的大农场。

lemmas.def_en: a standard or model or pattern regarded as typical
lemmas.def_zh: 基准, 模范, 标准, 准则, 平均数

examples.en: Working from home has quickly become the accepted norm for many tech employees.
examples.zh: 在家办公已迅速成为许多科技行业员工公认的常态。

lemmas.usage_note: 常构成 the norm（常态），表示社会规范时常用复数 social norms，常与 establish, conform to 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 norma（木工的矩尺、规矩），引申为社会准则或正常状态。

lemmas.def_en: stick of wax with a wick in the middle
lemmas.def_zh: 蜡烛

examples.en: We had to light a candle when the sudden storm caused a power outage.
examples.zh: 突如其来的暴风雨导致停电时，我们不得不点燃了一支蜡烛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指照明用蜡烛，常见搭配有 light a candle（点蜡烛）或 blow out the candles（吹灭蜡烛）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To examine eggs for freshness or fertility by holding them up to a bright light.
lemmas.def_zh: 透光检查（蛋的受精或新鲜程度）

examples.en: Farmers usually candle the chicken eggs to check whether the embryos are developing properly.
examples.zh: 农户通常会照验鸡蛋，以检查胚胎是否发育正常。

lemmas.usage_note: 专门动词，指将禽蛋置于强光前透视照验以检查受精或新鲜情况，多用于家禽养殖业。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 candere（发光、发亮），指用蜡制成的发光照明体。

lemmas.def_en: a painting of a naked human figure
lemmas.def_zh: 裸体画, 裸体

examples.en: The museum displayed an exquisite marble nude sculpted by a famous Renaissance artist.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一尊由著名文艺复兴艺术家雕刻的精美大理石裸体雕像。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指艺术领域中的裸体人像画、雕塑或摆姿势的裸体模特，多用于艺术评论语境。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being without clothing or covering of any kind
lemmas.def_zh: 裸露, 裸露物, 裸体像

examples.en: The film received a mature rating due to frequent scenes of violence and nudity.
examples.zh: 这部电影因频繁出现的暴力和裸露镜头而被评为限制级。

lemmas.def_en: completely unclothed
lemmas.def_zh: 裸的, 肉色的, 无装饰的

examples.en: She chose a pair of nude high heels to complement her elegant evening gown.
examples.zh: 她选了一双肉色高跟鞋来搭配她优雅的晚礼服。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容一丝不挂的人体，或指接近肤色的肉色款式，常见搭配 nude beach/shoes。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nudus（光秃的、赤裸的），指未穿衣服的身体或艺术裸体。

lemmas.def_en: a location marked by an intense competition and struggle for survival
lemmas.def_zh: 丛林, 杂乱的一堆, 弱肉强食的地方

examples.en: Navigating the legal paperwork felt like hacking through an impenetrable bureaucratic jungle.
examples.zh: 处理这些法律文件感觉就像在难以逾越的官僚丛林中披荆斩棘。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作比喻，如 concrete jungle（水泥森林）、law of the jungle（丛林法则），形容竞争残酷混乱的环境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自印地语/梵语，原指荒地，后专指热带地区密不透风的热带雨林，引申为弱肉强食的环境。

lemmas.def_en: a piece broken off or cut off of something else
lemmas.def_zh: 碎片, 破片, 片段

examples.en: Archaeologists uncovered a tiny fragment of ancient pottery at the excavation site.
examples.zh: 考古学家在发掘现场发现了一块古代陶器的微小碎片。

lemmas.usage_note: 指破裂的残片、碎屑，或文章/记忆中不完整的片段，常搭配 a fragment of glass/memory。

lemmas.def_en: separating something into fine particles
lemmas.def_zh: 分裂, 破碎

examples.en: Political fragmentation within the coalition made it difficult to pass any major laws.
examples.zh: 联盟内部的政治分裂使得通过任何重大法律都变得困难。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To break or split into many small, separate pieces or disconnected parts.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）碎裂，（使）分裂成碎片

examples.en: The political party began to fragment into smaller factions following the leadership dispute.
examples.zh: 在领导层争议之后，该政党开始分裂成若干小派系。

lemmas.usage_note: 指分裂成碎片，引申为组织解体或系统数据分段碎片化，兼具及物与不及物用法。

lemmas.def_zh: 碎片的, 碎屑的, 片断的, 断片的, 碎块的, 不完全的, 不连续的, 不完整的
lemmas.def_en: consisting of small disconnected parts

examples.en: Detectives could only piece together a fragmentary account from the terrified witness's statements.
examples.zh: 侦探们只能根据惊恐目击者的陈述拼凑出零碎的案情。

lemmas.def_en: consisting of small disconnected parts
lemmas.def_zh: 破片的, 断片的

examples.en: His memory of that chaotic evening remained fragmental and utterly unreliable.
examples.zh: 他对那个混乱夜晚的记忆仍然是支离破碎且完全不可靠的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 frangere（打破），指破裂后产生的碎片或不完整的部分。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [T] To praise or describe someone or something enthusiastically as being very good. 2. [T] To wave or call out to catch the attention of a person or taxi. 3. [I] (impersonal) To produce hailstones during a storm.
lemmas.def_zh: 赞扬，称颂；欢呼；招呼（出租车或人）；下冰雹

examples.en: The young scientist's latest breakthrough was hailed as a milestone in cancer research.
examples.zh: 这位年轻科学家的最新突破被誉为癌症研究的里程碑。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于被动语态表示“誉为”（hail as），也可指招手叫车（hail a cab）或下冰雹，属正式与日常兼具用词。

lemmas.def_en: precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents
lemmas.def_zh: 冰雹, 致敬, 欢呼, 招呼

examples.en: The police officers were forced to retreat under a sudden hail of rocks and bottles.
examples.zh: 警官们在突如其来的一阵飞石和玻璃瓶袭击下被迫后撤。

lemmas.usage_note: 指自然界的冰雹，常用于比喻义“一阵像冰雹般袭来的事物”（a hail of bullets/stones），多见于书面报道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，兼有冰雹（自然现象）与打招呼/致敬（来自 health/hale 表祝愿安好）两个历史渊源。

lemmas.def_en: the act of disrupting an established order so it fails to continue
lemmas.def_zh: 崩溃, 故障

examples.en: A sudden engine breakdown forced the delivery driver to pull over immediately.
examples.zh: 突发的发动机故障迫使送货司机立即靠边停车。

lemmas.usage_note: 指机械故障、谈判破裂（a breakdown in negotiations）或精神崩溃（nervous breakdown）；也指详尽的数据细分列表。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 break + down，直观表达系统、机械或心理的彻底崩溃、瓦解。

lemmas.def_en: marked by close acquaintance, association, or familiarity; ;  - V.L. Parrington
lemmas.def_zh: 亲密的, 私人的, 秘密的

examples.en: They had an intimate conversation over dinner about their childhood dreams and fears.
examples.zh: 他们在晚餐时进行了一次亲密交谈，聊起了童年的梦想与恐惧。

lemmas.usage_note: 读作 /ˈɪntɪmət/，常修饰关系（intimate friend）、环境（intimate atmosphere）或隐私知识，语气亲近而庄重。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To communicate or make something known indirectly; to hint. 2. [T] To state or announce officially.
lemmas.def_zh: 暗示，透露；通告，宣布

examples.en: The spokesperson intimated that the CEO might resign if the quarterly targets were not met.
examples.zh: 发言人暗示，如果未能达成季度目标，首席执行官可能会辞职。

lemmas.usage_note: 读作 /ˈɪntɪmeɪt/，意为委婉示意或间接表明，常接that从句，属极正式的书面与公文语体用词。

lemmas.def_en: in a close manner
lemmas.def_zh: 亲切地, 亲密地, 个人性地

examples.en: As the chief architect, he was intimately familiar with every detail of the design.
examples.zh: 作为首席建筑师，他极其熟悉这项设计的每一个细节。

lemmas.def_en: an indirect suggestion
lemmas.def_zh: 暗示, 提示, 通知

examples.en: Her subtle smile gave an intimation that she already knew the secret.
examples.zh: 她微妙的微笑暗示着她已经知道了这个秘密。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 intimus（最内心的），形容人际关系亲密，作动词时意为透漏私密想法（暗示）。

lemmas.def_en: a visual presentation showing how something works
lemmas.def_zh: 演示, 样本唱片

examples.en: The development team gave a live demo of the new software to prospective investors.
examples.zh: 开发团队向潜在投资者现场演示了这款新软件。

lemmas.usage_note: demonstration的口语截短词，常与give, live或product搭配，指产品演示、试玩版软件或音乐样本小样。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (informal) 1. to demonstrate how a product or software works. 2. to record a demonstration version of a song.
lemmas.def_zh: 演示，示范，展示；录制样本唱片

examples.en: During the conference, the engineer demoed several key features of the autonomous drone.
examples.zh: 在大会期间，工程师现场演示了该自主无人机的几项核心功能。

lemmas.usage_note: 在科技与商业语境中广泛用作动词，直接接被演示的产品或功能作宾语，属于行业常用非正式动词。

family_guide.root_logic: demonstration 的截短缩写形式，指用于展示目的的样品、演示或示威游行。

lemmas.def_en: something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness
lemmas.def_zh: 头痛, 令人头痛之事

examples.en: He took an aspirin to relieve his throbbing headache.
examples.zh: 他服了一片阿司匹林来缓解阵阵作痛的头痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 表生理头痛常搭配 have a headache；引申为“令人头痛的事/麻烦”，如 cause a major headache for sb。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 head + ache（头疼），引申指让人感到头痛、棘手的人或麻烦事。

lemmas.def_en: followers of an exclusive system of religious beliefs and practices
lemmas.def_zh: 邪教；异教；狂热崇拜

examples.en: The police launched an investigation into the secretive religious cult.
examples.zh: 警方对这个神秘的宗教邪教展开了调查。

lemmas.usage_note: 邪教；异教；狂热崇拜

lemmas.def_en: a member of a religious cult
lemmas.def_zh: 热衷搞迷信崇拜的人

examples.en: Investigators discovered that the cultist had lived in absolute secrecy for years.
examples.zh: 调查人员发现，这名邪教信徒多年来一直秘密生活。

lemmas.def_zh: 崇拜, 迷信, 热衷搞迷信崇拜的倾向
lemmas.def_en: devotion to the doctrine or a cult or to the practices of a cult

examples.en: Sociologists warned that the rise of online cultism could alienate young people from reality.
examples.zh: 社会学家警告说，网络迷信崇拜的兴起可能会使年轻人脱离现实。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 colere（崇拜、耕作），常指对某种信仰、人物或狂热崇拜的团体，引申为小众狂热追捧。

lemmas.def_en: [I] ('welsh on') (informal) To fail to pay a debt, fulfill an obligation, or keep a promise.
lemmas.def_zh: 赖账，失信，食言

examples.en: He promised to pay his share of the rent, but he welshed on the deal.
examples.zh: 他答应分摊房租，结果却食言赖账了。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式且带贬义，常与 on 搭配（welsh on a bet/deal），意为“赖账、背信弃义”，使用时需注意语境冒犯性。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英格兰对威尔士人（Welsh）的历史偏见，后来引申出逃避责任或赖账的行为。

lemmas.def_en: back and sides of a hog salted and dried or smoked; usually sliced thin and fried
lemmas.def_zh: n. 培根，熏猪肉

examples.en: She woke up to the smell of crispy bacon frying in the pan.
examples.zh: 她在锅里煎得脆嫩香脆的培根香气中醒来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指熏肉时为不可数名词；极高频俚语搭配为 bring home the bacon（挣钱养家）与 save one's bacon（脱离险境）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族中指代猪背部或熏肉的词根，专指腌制熏烤的猪肉片。

lemmas.def_en: domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age; ; ; - Bible
lemmas.def_zh: n. 牛（总称），牲畜

examples.en: The farmer drives his cattle to the lower pasture before sunset.
examples.zh: 农夫在日落前将牛群赶往地势较低的牧场。

lemmas.usage_note: 集合名词，永远作复数使用且不可加 -s，谓语动词用复数；表数量时用 a herd of cattle 或 ... head of cattle。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 capitale（财产、本钱），古代牲畜被视为核心动产，后特指牛类。

lemmas.def_en: the compass point midway between south and east; at 135 degrees
lemmas.def_zh: n. 东南，东南部

examples.en: A warm front is moving slowly toward the southeast.
examples.zh: 一个暖锋正缓缓向东南方向移动。

lemmas.usage_note: 表特定地区时首字母大写且前加 the（in the Southeast）；指一般方位时用 in the southeast of，作副词时不加介词。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 south（南）和 east（东）复合而成，指介于正南和正东之间的方位。

lemmas.def_en: English writer noted for early detective novels (1824-1889)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 柯林斯鸡尾酒

examples.en: The bartender served a refreshing gin collins garnished with a cherry.
examples.zh: 调酒师端上了一杯点缀着樱桃的清爽金汤柯林斯鸡尾酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 调酒术语，指用烈酒、柠檬汁和苏打水调制的长饮鸡尾酒，最常见搭配为 Tom Collins，首字母通常大写。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自经典鸡尾酒 Tom Collins，通常由烈酒、柠檬汁、糖浆和苏打水调制而成。

lemmas.def_en: a Christian celebration of the Resurrection of Christ; celebrated on the Sunday following the first full moon after the vernal equinox
lemmas.def_zh: n. 复活节

examples.en: Children enjoyed hunting for painted eggs hidden across the lawn on Easter morning.
examples.zh: 孩子们在复活节早晨开心地在草坪各处寻找彩蛋。

lemmas.usage_note: 西方复活节，首字母须大写；常用搭配有 Easter Sunday、Easter egg，表示“在复活节”介词多用 at Easter。

lemmas.def_en: a wind from the east

examples.en: A chilly easterly swept across the coastal bay, chilling the evening air.
examples.zh: 一阵寒冷的东风掠过沿海海湾，使傍晚的空气变得更加刺骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语中的春之女神 Ēostre，基督教借此节日纪念耶稣复活，象征重生与新生。

lemmas.def_en: any of a group of organic substances essential in small quantities to normal metabolism
lemmas.def_zh: n. 维生素

examples.en: Citrus fruits are rich in vitamin C, which helps boost the immune system.
examples.zh: 柑橘类水果富含维生素C，有助于增强免疫力。

lemmas.usage_note: 具体字母维生素常大写且不加冠词（vitamin C）；泛指维生素类药片时可数，搭配 take vitamins 或 vitamin deficiency。

family_guide.root_logic: 由拉丁语 vita（生命）和 amine（胺）合成，原意为“维持生命所必需的胺类物质”，泛指维生素。

lemmas.def_en: someone whose style is out of fashion
lemmas.def_zh: n. 化石；老顽固，守旧者

examples.en: The museum recently acquired a rare dinosaur fossil that was uncovered in the desert.
examples.zh: 该博物馆最近收藏了一具在沙漠中出土的罕见恐龙化石。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指地质化石，也常构成复合名词fossil fuel，在非正式语境中亦可戏谑指思想僵化、顽固不化的老古董。

lemmas.def_en: the process of fossilizing a plant or animal that existed in some earlier age; the process of being turned to stone
lemmas.def_zh: 化石化, 固定化, 使陈腐

examples.en: Rapid burial in wet sediment is essential for the natural fossilization of bones.
examples.zh: 在潮湿沉积物中快速掩埋对骨骼自然化石化至关重要。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. To turn into a fossil, or cause an organism to become preserved as a fossil. 2. To become rigid, outmoded, or unchangeable, or to make something so.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）变成化石；（使）僵化，（使）陈腐

examples.en: Rigid company policies tend to fossilize creative thinking among the younger staff.
examples.zh: 僵化的公司制度往往会使年轻员工的创造性思维变得陈腐。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 fossilis（从地下掘出来的），演变指保存在地层中的古代生物遗骸或遗迹。

lemmas.def_en: the least possible
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 最小的，最低限度的

examples.en: The patient recovered swiftly from the minor surgery with minimal discomfort.
examples.zh: 这名病人在微创手术后恢复迅速，几乎没有感到任何不适。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，强调数量、程度或影响减小到最低限度，常搭配impact、effort、risk或requirement，偏正式。

lemmas.def_en: to a minimal degree
lemmas.def_zh: 最低限度地；最低程度地

examples.en: The patient was minimally affected by the experimental treatment and recovered quickly.
examples.zh: 患者受该实验性疗法的影响极小，且恢复迅速。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 minimus（最小的），表示数量、程度或规模达到最低限度。

lemmas.def_en: an imperfection in a bodily system
lemmas.def_zh: 缺点

examples.en: The automaker recalled thousands of vehicles due to a potentially dangerous brake defect.
examples.zh: 该汽车制造商因一处潜在的危险刹车缺陷召回了数千辆汽车。

lemmas.usage_note: 重音在首音节 /ˈdiːfekt/，指产品瑕疵（manufacturing defect）或性格缺陷，常与correct, detect搭配。

lemmas.def_en: withdrawing support or help despite allegiance or responsibility
lemmas.def_zh: 背叛, 缺乏, 毛病

examples.en: His sudden defection to the rival firm shocked everyone in the department.
examples.zh: 他突然叛逃到竞争对手公司，令部门里的所有人都感到震惊。

lemmas.def_en: a person who abandons their duty (as on a military post)
lemmas.def_zh: 背叛者, 叛离者

examples.en: The secret agent debriefed the political defector at a secure safehouse.
examples.zh: 特工在秘密安全屋中向这名政治叛逃者了解情况。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ from/to) To leave your own country, political party, or organization in order to join an opposing one.
lemmas.def_zh: 背叛，叛逃，变节（投奔敌对阵营）

examples.en: A senior diplomat chose to defect to the neighboring country amid rising political turmoil.
examples.zh: 在日益加剧的政治动荡中，一名高级外交官选择叛逃至邻国。

lemmas.usage_note: 重音在第二音节 /dɪˈfekt/，指背叛国家、党派或阵营叛逃，核心搭配为defect from... to...，属严肃政治语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 deficere（不足、脱离），引申为物品的瑕疵缺损，或政治立场上的背叛与脱离。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为名词重音在前（/ˈdiːfekt/），作为动词重音在后（/dɪˈfekt/）。

lemmas.def_en: a grant paid by a government to an enterprise that benefits the public
lemmas.def_zh: 补贴，津贴，补助金

examples.en: The city offers a generous subsidy to encourage residents to install residential solar panels.
examples.zh: 该市提供优厚的补贴，以鼓励居民安装家用太阳能电池板。

lemmas.usage_note: 补贴，津贴，补助金

lemmas.def_en: money (or other benefits) obtained as a subsidy
lemmas.def_zh: 补助；提供津贴；奖金

examples.en: Heavy government subsidization helped the renewable energy industry expand very rapidly.
examples.zh: 巨额的政府补贴帮助可再生能源行业迅速扩张。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to pay part of the cost of something to keep prices low or encourage it to happen; give a subsidy to
lemmas.def_zh: 资助，给……发补助金

examples.en: The council voted to subsidize public transport to reduce city traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 委员会投票决定补贴公共交通，以缓解城市交通拥堵。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (chiefly BrE) to support financially by paying part of the costs; subsidize
lemmas.def_zh: 资助，给……发补助金

examples.en: The university agreed to subsidise housing costs for international graduate students.
examples.zh: 大学同意为国际研究生资助部分住宿费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 subsidium（支援、后备部队），引申为政府或机构为维持经济活动提供的财政资助。

lemmas.def_en: a small being, human in form, playful and having magical powers
lemmas.def_zh: n. 小仙子，小精灵

examples.en: The bedtime story featured a tiny woodland fairy with shimmering wings.
examples.zh: 睡前故事里有一个长着闪亮翅膀的小树林仙子。

lemmas.usage_note: 指童话小仙子，常见搭配有 fairy tale（童话故事）；注意用于指人时可能带有贬义冒犯色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 faerie（仙境、魔法），后专指神话传说中拥有超自然力量的仙子、精灵。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ on/upon) To think deeply and carefully about something. 2. [I] To focus the mind in silence for spiritual peace or relaxation.
lemmas.def_zh: 沉思，深思；冥想，打坐

examples.en: She sat quietly by the lake every morning to meditate on the deeper meaning of life.
examples.zh: 她每天清晨静静地坐在湖边，沉思生命的更深层意义。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不及物动词时常与on/upon连用表示对问题深思熟虑；亦可表示静坐冥想以放松心神，兼具哲学与身心健康语体。

lemmas.def_en: continuous and profound contemplation or musing on a subject or series of subjects of a deep or abstruse nature
lemmas.def_zh: n. 冥想，深思

examples.en: Daily meditation has been proven to lower stress levels and significantly boost mental focus.
examples.zh: 每日冥想已被证实能够减轻压力水平并显著提高专注力。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词指冥想修习（practice meditation），可数名词常用复数指对某一主题的深度沉思录，偏书面语。

lemmas.def_en: deeply or seriously thoughtful
lemmas.def_zh: 默想的, 耽于默想的, 冥想的

examples.en: She took a long, meditative walk through the quiet forest every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨都会在安静的森林里漫步冥想很久。

lemmas.def_en: in a meditative manner
lemmas.def_zh: 冥想地

examples.en: He stared meditatively at the rain tapping against the cold windowpane.
examples.zh: 他若有所思地凝视着雨水敲打着冰冷的窗玻璃。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 meditari（沉思、考量），表达向内集中注意力、进行深层心灵思考的动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: meditate 为动词行为；meditation 为名词状态或活动。

lemmas.def_en: a distinguishing feature of your personal nature
lemmas.def_zh: n. 特征，特质，特性

examples.en: Patience is often considered an essential trait for effective leadership.
examples.zh: 耐心常被视为高效领导力所必不可少的特质。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于心理学或正式书面语，指个性特征，高频搭配为 personality/character trait 或 genetic trait。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 tractus（拉伸、划出的线条），原指面部轮廓的笔画特征，后引申为人的性格或遗传特质。

lemmas.def_en: the British cabinet minister responsible for finance
lemmas.def_zh: n. 总理；大臣；大学校长

examples.en: The chancellor announced a series of major tax reforms in the annual budget.
examples.zh: 总理在年度预算案中公布了一系列重大的税制改革。

lemmas.usage_note: 指德国总理、大学校长或英国财政大臣（Chancellor of the Exchequer），首字母常大写。

lemmas.def_en: the office of chancellor
lemmas.def_zh: 长官的职位或任期

examples.en: During his lengthy chancellorship, the country experienced remarkable economic stability and growth.
examples.zh: 在他漫长的大臣任期内，国家经历了显著的经济稳定与增长。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自晚期拉丁语 cancellarius（屏风守门官、法庭书记员），后演变指政府最高首脑、大臣或大学校长。

lemmas.def_en: a disorderly crowd of people
lemmas.def_zh: 暴民, 民众, 暴徒

examples.en: The angry mob marched through the city center, vandalizing shops and setting fires.
examples.zh: 愤怒的暴民涌过市中心，砸毁沿街店铺并纵火焚烧。

lemmas.usage_note: 指失去理智的暴民或乌合之众（angry mob），大写The Mob特指黑手党犯罪集团，感情色彩偏负面。

lemmas.def_en: a criminal who is a member of gang
lemmas.def_zh: 犯罪集团成员

examples.en: Police finally arrested the notorious mobster after a long and thorough investigation.
examples.zh: 经过长期彻底的调查，警方终于逮捕了这名臭名昭著的黑帮分子。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To crowd around someone or something in a large, noisy, and disorderly group.
lemmas.def_zh: 蜂拥团团围住，大举包围

examples.en: The pop star was immediately mobbed by enthusiastic fans as soon as he stepped out of the hotel.
examples.zh: 这位流行歌星一走出酒店，便立刻被热情的粉丝们团团围住。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指人群蜂拥围拢某人（多为明星或要人）或聚众袭击，常用被动语态 be mobbed by fans/supporters。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mobile vulgus（易变的大众），核心指“乌合之众”及由此引申的群聚围攻行为。

lemmas.def_en: the region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis
lemmas.def_zh: 腹部, 食欲

examples.en: The puppy rolled onto its back and exposed its soft belly, waiting to be scratched.
examples.zh: 小狗仰面翻过身来，露出柔软的肚皮，等待着主人的抚摸。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于口语指腹部或肚子（belly laugh, beer belly），在航空航海中亦指机腹或船舱腹部，风格亲切接地气。

lemmas.def_en: an undesirable overabundance
lemmas.def_zh: 满腹, 满肚子

examples.en: I have had a bellyful of their endless complaints about the schedule.
examples.zh: 我已经受够了他们对日程安排无休止的抱怨。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ out) To swell out or cause something (such as a sail) to swell outward with air or pressure. 2. [I] (informal) To crawl forward on one's belly.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）鼓起，（使）胀开；匍匐前进

examples.en: The ship's white sails bellied in the strong wind as it glided across the open sea.
examples.zh: 随着船在开阔的海面上滑行，白色的风帆在强风中鼓胀了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与out连用构成短语动词 belly out，形容帆、窗帘等在风力作用下像肚子一样鼓起膨胀，极具视觉画面感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，原指皮囊或腹部，后引申为像肚子一样凸起或贴地移动。

lemmas.def_en: consistent with or based on or using reason
lemmas.def_zh: 理性的, 合理的

examples.en: Try to remain calm and make a rational decision based on the available facts.
examples.zh: 尽量保持冷静，根据现有事实做出理性的决定。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 decision、explanation、approach 等词，表示基于理性思考而非情绪的。

lemmas.def_en: the state of having good sense and sound judgment
lemmas.def_zh: 合理性, 纯理性

examples.en: In moments of crisis, human rationality is often tested by extreme fear.
examples.zh: 在危机时刻，人类的理性往往会经受极端恐惧的考验。

lemmas.def_en: in a rational manner
lemmas.def_zh: 理性地；讲道理地

examples.en: She was too angry to think rationally about the consequences of her actions.
examples.zh: 她太生气了，无法理性地思考自己行为的后果。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ratio（理性、计算），核心语义是“有理性的、符合逻辑的”。

lemmas.def_en: the organic process of bearing flowers
lemmas.def_zh: 花, 开花, 青春, 钢块

examples.en: The cherry trees were in full bloom, attracting thousands of visitors to the park.
examples.zh: 樱花盛开，吸引了成千上万的游客来到公园。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指单朵花，也指开花状态，常见搭配 in full bloom（盛开）及象征性的“青春鼎盛”。

lemmas.def_en: a flower that blooms in a particular way
lemmas.def_zh: 布卢默(姓氏)

examples.en: Professor Bloomer delivered an inspiring lecture on modern European history yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 布卢默教授昨天上午就现代欧洲历史发表了鼓舞人心的演讲。

lemmas.def_en: [I] 1. When a plant blooms, it produces flowers. 2. To develop, flourish, or become healthy and successful.
lemmas.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，兴旺，容光焕发

examples.en: Her confidence began to bloom after she received praise from her mentor.
examples.zh: 在得到导师的称赞后，她的自信心开始萌发建立起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 指植物开花，也常比喻人才华展露、事业或感情蓬勃发展，作不及物动词居多。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心语义为“花朵”以及“盛开、处于巅峰”的状态。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To run or move at maximum speed over a short distance.
lemmas.def_zh: 全速奔跑，冲刺

examples.en: He had to sprint across the platform to catch the departing train.
examples.zh: 他不得不全速穿过站台去赶那趟正要开出的火车。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示以最快速度短距离奔跑或冲刺，常与 for、to、towards 等介词连用。

lemmas.def_en: someone who runs a short distance at top speed
lemmas.def_zh: 短跑选手

examples.en: The Olympic sprinter broke the world record in the hundred-meter final race.
examples.zh: 这位奥运短跑选手在百米决赛中打破了世界纪录。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自斯堪的纳维亚语，核心意为“急速冲刺、短距离全速奔跑”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] ('bail out') To pay money to secure the temporary release of an accused person from custody before trial. 2. [I, T] ('bail out') To empty water from a boat using a bucket or container.
lemmas.def_zh: 保释（某人）；（用容器）舀水（出船舱）

examples.en: The government refused to bail out the failing bank with taxpayers' money.
examples.zh: 政府拒绝用纳税人的钱来救助这家濒临倒闭的银行。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见短语 bail sb. out（保释某人或助其摆脱困境），亦可指用容器将船中的积水舀出。

lemmas.def_en: the agent to whom property involved in a bailment is delivered
lemmas.def_zh: 受托者

examples.en: As the bailee, the repair shop is legally responsible for safeguarding your property.
examples.zh: 作为受托人，修理厂在法律上有责任保护你的财产。

lemmas.def_en: the delivery of personal property in trust by the bailor to the bailee
lemmas.def_zh: 寄托, 保释

examples.en: A contract of bailment was formed when she left her car at the valet.
examples.zh: 当她把车交给代客泊车员时，便形成了一项寄托合同。

lemmas.def_en: the person who delivers personal property (goods or money) in trust to the bailee in a bailment
lemmas.def_zh: 寄托人

examples.en: The bailor handed over the valuable jewelry for secure storage during his vacation.
examples.zh: 寄托人在度假期间移交了贵重珠宝以进行安全存放。

lemmas.def_en: admitting of bail
lemmas.def_zh: 可保释的, 可交保的

examples.en: The judge ruled that the defendant's alleged offense was indeed a bailable crime.
examples.zh: 法官裁定被告被指控的罪行确实属于可保释罪行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指投递或看管，衍生出法律上的“保释”，以及“舀水”、“紧急抽身”之意。

lemmas.def_en: a metallic tapping sound
lemmas.def_zh: 滴答声, 一瞬间, 壁虱, 褥套, 信用, 赊欠

examples.en: The rhythmic tick of the grandfather clock filled the quiet living room.
examples.zh: 落地钟有节奏的滴答声回荡在安静的客厅里。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指钟表的滴答声、核对标记（勾号）或扁虱，口语中常用 in a tick 表示“片刻”。

lemmas.def_en: the hollow muscular organ located behind the sternum and between the lungs; its rhythmic contractions move the blood through the body
lemmas.def_zh: 滴答响的东西, 断续器

examples.en: Investors watched the stock ticker closely as share prices dropped rapidly.
examples.zh: 随着股价快速下跌，投资者们密切关注着股票行情显示器。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] When a clock or watch ticks, it makes a regular, soft clicking sound every second. 2. [T] (chiefly British) To put a checkmark (✓) beside an item.
lemmas.def_zh: （钟表等）发滴答声；给……打勾，打钩标出；起作用，运转

examples.en: Please tick the appropriate box to indicate your preferred method of payment.
examples.zh: 请在相应的方框内打勾，以标明您首选的付款方式。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词常与 off 连用表示勾选清单；不及物动词指钟表发声或运作（what makes sb. tick）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟钟表走动发出的轻微声响，引申为“打勾标记”及钟表“滴答作响”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To show something clearly through signs or actions. 2. [I] (often 'manifest itself') To appear or become evident.
lemmas.def_zh: 显露，表明，表现；显现

examples.en: Chronic stress often manifests itself in the form of severe headaches and fatigue.
examples.zh: 长期的精神压力通常会以严重头痛和疲劳的形式表现出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指情感、病症或特征显现出来，常用搭配 manifest itself（显露，呈现）。

lemmas.def_en: a clear appearance
lemmas.def_zh: 显示, 证明, 示威运动

examples.en: The peaceful protest was a clear manifestation of public anger.
examples.zh: 这场和平抗议是公众愤怒情绪的明显体现。

lemmas.def_en: unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
lemmas.def_zh: 明白地

examples.en: The proposed plan was manifestly unfair to the junior staff members.
examples.zh: 所提议的计划显然对初级员工不公平。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 manifestus（抓个正着、显而易见），核心意为“清晰显现、使明朗”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To laugh at or make jokes about someone in a playful or unkind way. 2. [T] To comb hair or wool backward to give it volume or fluff it up.
lemmas.def_zh: 取笑，戏弄，逗弄；梳理（头发或纤维）

examples.en: The older boys used to tease him about his thick accent, but he never let it bother him.
examples.zh: 那些大一点的男孩过去常取笑他的浓重口音，但他从未放在心上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指善意或恶意的取笑、逗弄，搭配 tease sb. about sth.，亦可指梳刮头发使其蓬松。

lemmas.def_en: a worker who teases wool
lemmas.def_zh: 戏弄者, 起绒机

examples.en: The studio released a short teaser for the upcoming superhero movie.
examples.zh: 制片厂发布了这部即将上映的超级英雄电影的简短预告片。

lemmas.def_en: in a playfully teasing manner
lemmas.def_zh: 烦恼地,受嘲弄地

examples.en: She smiled teasingly before hiding the birthday present behind her back.
examples.zh: 她打趣地笑了笑，然后把生日礼物藏到了身后。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 戏弄的；逗弄的；揶揄的
lemmas.def_en: intended to provoke, laugh at, or make fun of someone in a playful or cruel way
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于修饰语气、声音、微笑或举止，表达善意的打趣或轻微的嘲弄，如 a teasing remark / smile。

examples.en: She gave him a teasing smile and refused to reveal the secret.
examples.zh: 她冲他戏谑地一笑，拒绝透露秘密。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语原指“梳理毛发”，后引申为通过轻微挑弄来“逗弄、取笑”。

lemmas.def_en: an emblem (a small piece of plastic or cloth or metal) that signifies your status (rank or membership or affiliation etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: 徽章, 标记

examples.en: She proudly wore the security badge around her neck during the conference.
examples.zh: 会议期间，她骄傲地把安保胸牌挂在脖子上。

lemmas.usage_note: 指佩戴在身上的徽章、工牌，也常引申为某种品质、经历的“象征”或“标志”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To mark, brand, or furnish someone or something with a badge or distinguishing mark.
lemmas.def_zh: 在……上佩戴徽章，为……打上标牌；标明

examples.en: All conference attendees must be badged before entering the main exhibition hall.
examples.zh: 所有参会人员在进入主展厅前必须佩戴好胸牌登记完毕。

lemmas.usage_note: 技术或管理语境中指给人员佩戴工牌、给设备贴标认证或在软件界面加角标标记。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪英语，原指作为标记的饰物，引申为佩戴的徽章或以佩戴标识认证。

lemmas.def_en: (Roman Catholic Church) one of a group of more than 100 prominent bishops in the Sacred College who advise the Pope and elect new Popes
lemmas.def_zh: 红衣主教, 鲜红色

examples.en: The cardinals gathered in the Sistine Chapel to elect the new pope.
examples.zh: 红衣主教们齐聚西斯廷礼拜堂以选举新教皇。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指天主教的红衣主教，或指北美红雀（北美产的一种鲜红色鸣禽）。

lemmas.def_en: serving as an essential component
lemmas.def_zh: 主要的, 深红色的

examples.en: Respecting confidentiality is a cardinal rule for anyone working in healthcare.
examples.zh: 保护隐私是任何从事医疗保健工作的人都必须遵守的首要原则。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面用语，表示极重要的、根本的，高频搭配 cardinal rule（基本原则）、cardinal sin（大罪）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cardo（门枢），比喻“关键的、起枢纽作用的”，在宗教中演变为红衣主教。
family_guide.core_distinction: 作为形容词强调“根本的、首要的”；作为名词特指天主教“枢机主教（红衣主教）”。

lemmas.def_en: a bowl-shaped vessel; usually used for holding food or liquids
lemmas.def_zh: 盆, 盆地

examples.en: He poured warm water into the basin to wash his face.
examples.zh: 他往盆里倒了温水来洗脸。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式常指洗手池（washbasin）；地理上指‘流域’或‘盆地’，如river basin，不可混同于普通bowl。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指凹形器具，后地理学引申指被高地包围的“盆地、流域”。

lemmas.def_en: cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist
lemmas.def_zh: 裙子, 下摆, 边缘, 郊区

examples.en: She bought a tailored wool skirt to wear for her upcoming job interview.
examples.zh: 她买了一条合身剪裁的羊毛裙，准备在即将到来的求职面试中穿。

lemmas.usage_note: 指下装裙子；复数形式 skirts 常引申为城市、森林等外围边缘或郊区地带。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To go around the outer edge of something rather than through it. 2. [T] To avoid talking about or dealing with a difficult subject directly.
lemmas.def_zh: 绕过……的边缘，沿……边缘走；回避，绕开（难题）

examples.en: The politician tried to skirt around the controversial issue during the press conference.
examples.zh: 那位政客在记者会上试图回避这个充满争议的问题。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指沿……边缘走，也常比喻巧妙地回避、绕开棘手的问题或敏感话题（skirt around）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语，原指下摆或边缘，引申为环绕、避开边缘。

lemmas.def_en: an ardent follower and admirer
lemmas.def_zh: 暗黄色, 暗黄色皮革, 人的皮肤

examples.en: He wiped the silver teapot carefully with a soft piece of buff.
examples.zh: 他用一块柔软的浅黄色软皮仔细擦拭着银制茶壶。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指浅黄色皮革或用于抛光的软布；口语中亦指爱好者或行家，如 film buff。

lemmas.def_en: of the yellowish-beige color of buff leather
lemmas.def_zh: 暗黄色的

examples.en: The documents were filed inside sturdy buff envelopes for long-term storage.
examples.zh: 文件被装入结实的暗黄色信封中以便长期归档保存。

lemmas.usage_note: 用于描述介于米黄与浅棕之间的暗黄色；口语中也可形容体格健壮、肌肉发达。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To polish and make something shiny using a soft cloth or a buffing tool. 2. [T] To give leather a soft, velvety finish.
lemmas.def_zh: 用软布擦亮，打磨；使（皮革等）起绒变软

examples.en: She used a dry microfiber cloth to buff the scratched surface of the coffee table.
examples.zh: 她用一块干燥的超细纤维布将茶几有划痕的表面擦得锃亮。

lemmas.usage_note: 意为用软布或轮具擦亮某物表面，常与 up 搭配，多用于车辆、鞋履或金属保养。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To protect someone or something from the impact of something harmful, shocking, or sudden; cushion.
lemmas.def_zh: 缓冲，减缓……的冲击；保护

examples.en: A substantial emergency fund can buffer families against sudden financial shocks.
examples.zh: 充足的应急基金能帮助家庭缓冲突如其来的经济冲击。

lemmas.usage_note: 指减缓不良影响、充当缓冲物，常与 against 或 from 连用；计算机语境指数据缓冲。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自水牛皮（buffalo），引申出浅黄色、磨光皮革，再引申指爱好者及健硕体格；buffer指用软物缓冲或抛光。
family_guide.core_distinction: buff作动词强调擦亮抛光，buffer强调缓冲保护或用缓冲器抛光。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than fourteen

examples.en: The teacher gave the class fifteen minutes to complete the quiz.
examples.zh: 老师给了全班十五分钟的时间来完成测验。

lemmas.usage_note: 数词作定语修饰复数名词（fifteen minutes）；注意基数词在短语中如fifteen minutes of fame（短暂的成名）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 five（五）和 -teen（十）构成的基数词。

lemmas.def_en: situated in or oriented toward the northwest
lemmas.def_zh: 西北的, 在西北的, 来自西北的

examples.en: A cold northwest wind blew across the lake during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间，一股寒冷的西北风吹拂着湖面。

lemmas.usage_note: 定语修饰名词表方位（the northwest coast）；作形容词前不加介词，与名词词性注意区分。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 north（北）和 west（西）组成的方位复合词。

lemmas.def_en: on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
lemmas.def_zh: 在船上, 在火车上, 在飞机上

examples.en: The flight attendant welcomed all the passengers aboard the aircraft.
examples.zh: 乘务员欢迎所有乘客登上飞机。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与go, get, climb连用，表示‘在/上船、飞机、车’；欢迎语常用welcome aboard，不可误拼为abroad。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（在……上）+ board（甲板/船舷），表示“在交通工具上”。

lemmas.def_en: being of the age 13 through 19
lemmas.def_zh: 十三岁到十九岁的

examples.en: The magazine is designed to appeal directly to a teenage audience.
examples.zh: 这本杂志旨在直接吸引青少年读者。

lemmas.usage_note: 只作定语修饰青少年相关事物（teenage years/teenage angst），切勿作表语（不用The boy is teenage）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 teen（青少年）+ age（年龄）复合而成的形容词。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To be unable to breathe, or prevent someone from breathing, because the windpipe is blocked or constricted. 2. [T] To fill or block a passage or space completely. 3. [T] To suppress, stifle, or restrain an emotion or speech.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）窒息，噎住，呛住；阻塞，堵塞；抑制，掐住

examples.en: Thick black smoke began to choke the residents trapped on the upper floors.
examples.zh: 浓烈的黑烟开始让受困在顶层的居民窒息难耐。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指因异物或浓烟导致物理窒息，也指抑制情感或阻塞通道；常与 on、back 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: someone who kills by strangling
lemmas.def_zh: 噎住的人, 窒息物, 宽领带

examples.en: She wore an elegant black velvet choker with her evening gown.
examples.zh: 她身穿晚礼服，戴着一条优雅的黑色天鹅绒贴颈项链。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 堵塞的；哽咽的；填满的
lemmas.def_en: filled or blocked with something; speaking in a voice full of emotion and constrained
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 choked with 结构，表示物理上的堵塞（如道路、水管），也可修饰声音表达因情绪激动而哽咽（如 in a choked voice）。

examples.en: The city streets were choked with traffic during the evening rush hour.
examples.zh: 傍晚下班高峰期，城市街道堵得水泄不通。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词源，模拟呼吸受阻发出的声音，核心义为窒息、阻塞。

lemmas.def_en: the bulb of an onion plant
lemmas.def_zh: 洋葱

examples.en: He chopped an onion while preparing the sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 他在准备晚饭酱汁时切了一个洋葱。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用可数复数或以 layers of an onion 比喻事物层次复杂；习语 know one's onions 意为精通某领域。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 unio（单一、整体，因洋葱由多层合为一体而得名）。

lemmas.def_en: either of two bean-shaped excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine
lemmas.def_zh: 肾, 个性

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water is essential to maintain healthy kidney function.
examples.zh: 多喝水对保持健康的肾脏功能至关重要。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学搭配 kidney failure（肾衰竭）或 kidney transplant（肾移植）；比喻用法 of that/the same kidney 表同类人。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源不明，可能与腹部或蛋形器官有关，指肾脏。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To force a way into or through something. 2. [I, T] To enter and become established in an organization, group, or market. 3. [T] To succeed in understanding something complicated or mysterious.
lemmas.def_zh: 刺入，穿透；渗入，打入；洞悉，看穿

examples.en: The new sunlight managed to penetrate the dense canopy of the ancient forest.
examples.zh: 初升的阳光成功穿透了古老森林浓密的树冠。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物，指物理上的穿透、刺入，亦引申指打入市场、看透真相或理解复杂问题。

lemmas.def_en: an attack that penetrates into enemy territory
lemmas.def_zh: 穿透, 渗透, 侵入, 识穿, 洞察(力)

examples.en: The company achieved significant market penetration with its affordable smartphone line.
examples.zh: 该公司凭借其亲民的智能手机系列实现了显著的市场渗透。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于商业（市场渗透率 market penetration）及军事或洞察力语境，表穿透深度与广度。

lemmas.def_en: an intruder who passes into or through (often by overcoming resistance)
lemmas.def_zh: 穿入者, 侵入者, 渗透者

examples.en: Security systems identified the digital penetrator who breached the private network.
examples.zh: 安全系统识别出了侵入专用网络的数字入侵者。

lemmas.def_en: having or demonstrating ability to recognize or draw fine distinctions
lemmas.def_zh: 渗透的, 有渗透力的, 彻骨的, 敏锐的, 打动人的

examples.en: Her penetrative questions made the spokesperson uncomfortable during the press conference.
examples.zh: 在新闻发布会上，她敏锐深刻的提问让发言人感到很不自在。

lemmas.def_en: with ability to see into deeply
lemmas.def_zh: 敏锐地, 响亮地

examples.en: He looked penetratingly at the suspect, waiting for an honest response.
examples.zh: 他目光敏锐地注视着嫌疑人，等待着坦白的回应。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 pen-（内部）+ -trate，表示深入内部、穿透。
family_guide.core_distinction: penetrate 为动词动作，penetration 为其抽象名词或市场渗透率。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To repair, redecorate, and improve a building, room, or piece of furniture so that it is in good condition again.
lemmas.def_zh: 翻新，修复，修缮（旧建筑、家具等）

examples.en: The couple spent months working to renovate the dilapidated Victorian cottage.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇花了数月时间修缮那栋破旧的维多利亚风格乡村小屋。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指通过修缮、重装使旧建筑或设备焕然一新，宾语通常为房屋、酒店或设施。

lemmas.def_en: the act of improving by renewing and restoring
lemmas.def_zh: 革新, 刷新, 修理

examples.en: The municipal library is currently closed to the public for extensive interior renovation.
examples.zh: 市政图书馆目前闭馆以进行全面的内部翻修改造。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数，指翻新工程或改造状态；常见短语如 under renovation（正在装修中）。

lemmas.def_en: a skilled worker who is employed to restore or refinish buildings or antique furniture
lemmas.def_zh: 革新者, 刷新者, 修理者

examples.en: A skilled renovator carefully restored the historical wooden staircase to its glory.
examples.zh: 一位熟练的修缮者精心修复了具有历史意义的木制楼梯。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ nov（新）+ -ate（动词后缀），字面即“使其重新变新”。
family_guide.core_distinction: renovate 为动词，renovation 为其名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To stop, catch, or seize someone or something moving from one place to another before they reach their destination
lemmas.def_zh: 拦截，截住，阻截；截听，截获

examples.en: Air defense systems were deployed rapidly to intercept the incoming hostile missiles.
examples.zh: 防空系统迅速展开部署，以拦截来袭的敌方导弹。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指半路截获信件、截听通信或拦截导弹、球类，多用于军事、情报与体育语境。

lemmas.def_en: the act of intercepting; preventing something from proceeding or arriving
lemmas.def_zh: 拦截, 截断, 截住, 截取, 截击, 窃听, 侦听, 雷达侦察

examples.en: The sudden interception of the pass changed the entire momentum of the game.
examples.zh: 这次传球的突然被断彻底改变了整场比赛的走势。

lemmas.def_en: a fast maneuverable fighter plane designed to intercept enemy aircraft
lemmas.def_zh: 阻止的人, 妨碍者, 拦截战斗机

examples.en: The military scrambled an interceptor to investigate the unidentified aircraft quickly.
examples.zh: 军方迅速紧急起飞了一架拦截机去调查不明飞行物。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 inter-（在……之间）+ cept（抓取），意为在半路抓截。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To prepare and use land for growing crops, or to grow plants and crops. 2. [T] To develop or improve an attitude, skill, or relationship deliberately.
lemmas.def_zh: 耕作，耕耘；培育，培植；培养，建立（关系）

examples.en: He made a conscious effort to cultivate positive relationships with his new colleagues.
examples.zh: 他特意付出努力，与新同事建立并培养良好的人际关系。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指农业上的耕作土地、培育作物，也广泛用于培养习惯、结交人脉或陶冶情操。

lemmas.def_en: socialization through training and education to develop one's mind or manners
lemmas.def_zh: 教化, 培养, 耕作

examples.en: The fertile soil of the river valley is particularly suitable for rice cultivation.
examples.zh: 河谷地区的肥沃土壤尤其适合水稻的种植耕作。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常构成 land/crop cultivation（农作物种植）或引申指文化素养、品德修养的养成。

lemmas.def_en: someone concerned with the science or art or business of cultivating the soil
lemmas.def_zh: 耕者, 栽培者, 耕田机

examples.en: The farmer hitched the new cultivator to his tractor to prepare the soil.
examples.zh: 农民把新耕田机挂在拖拉机上准备平整土壤。

lemmas.def_en: (of land or fields) not prepared for raising crops
lemmas.def_zh: 未经耕作的, 不文明的, 无教养的

examples.en: Vast stretches of uncultivated land surrounded the isolated mountain village.
examples.zh: 这处偏僻的山村周围环绕着大片未开垦的荒地。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 colere（耕作、培养），引申为培养能力、培育人际关系。
family_guide.core_distinction: cultivate 为动词，cultivation 为其农耕培育或修养的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Queen Victoria of Great Britain or to the age in which she ruled
lemmas.def_zh: 英国维多利亚女王时代的, 笃信宗教的, 讲究体面的

examples.en: The museum boasts an impressive collection of authentic Victorian furniture.
examples.zh: 该博物馆藏有一批令人赞叹的纯正维多利亚时代家具。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母通常大写；特指19世纪英国维多利亚时代的建筑、文学或该时期拘谨刻板的道德观。

lemmas.def_en: a person who lived during the reign of Victoria
lemmas.def_zh: 维多利亚女王时代的英国人

examples.en: The Victorians placed immense value on strict public decorum and duty.
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代的人极度看重严格的公共礼仪和责任感。

lemmas.usage_note: 首字母通常大写；指维多利亚时代生活的人，常以复数形式用于历史学或社会学论述。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英国维多利亚女王（Queen Victoria），代表19世纪维多利亚时代的风格或特征。

lemmas.def_en: a male religious living in a cloister and devoting himself to contemplation and prayer and work
lemmas.def_zh: 修道士, 僧侣, 和尚

examples.en: A solitary monk walked slowly through the quiet gardens at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨，一位修道士独自在寂静的花园中缓缓踱步。

lemmas.usage_note: 特指男性僧侣或修道士（女性为 nun）；常见固定搭配 become a monk 指出家修行，生活修饰语为 monastic。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 monos（单独的），原指离群索居修道的人。

lemmas.def_en: a cultural unit (an idea or value or pattern of behavior) that is passed from one person to another by non-genetic means (as by imitation)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 模因；网络爆梗，网络迷因

examples.en: The funny cat video quickly turned into a viral meme across social media.
examples.zh: 那个搞笑的猫咪视频迅速在社交媒体上演变成了一个爆火的梗。

lemmas.usage_note: 现多指网络迷因或搞笑表情包，动词搭配常接 create/share a meme，或用 become a meme 表示在网上爆红。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 mimema（模仿的东西），道金斯造词以比喻文化传播单元，现多指网络梗。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (literary or archaic) To kill a person or animal violently or in war. 2. [T] (informal) To impress, delight, or amuse someone overwhelmingly.
lemmas.def_zh: 残杀，杀戮；（俚语）深深打动，惊艳

examples.en: The mythical hero embarked on a dangerous quest to slay the terrifying dragon.
examples.zh: 神话中的英雄踏上了凶险的征程，意图斩杀那条可怖的巨龙。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或新闻中指残杀、斩杀；现代流行语中作及物或不及物动词，形容大获成功、艳惊四座。

lemmas.def_en: people who have been slain (as in battle)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 被杀者，死者（与 the 连用表群体）

examples.en: The solemn national monument was erected to honor the memory of the slain.
examples.zh: 这座庄严肃穆的国家纪念碑是为铭记那些殉难者而建立的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与定冠词 the 连用构成集合名词 the slain，作复数概念，指战场或惨案中的死者群体。

lemmas.def_en: someone who causes the death of a person or animal
lemmas.def_zh: 杀人者, 凶手, 屠宰者

examples.en: Ancient legends describe the fearless knight as a ruthless dragon slayer.
examples.zh: 古老的传说将这位无畏的骑士描述为冷酷的屠龙者。

lemmas.def_en: (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
lemmas.def_zh: n. 大量，许多（常与 of 连用）

examples.en: The press conference generated a slew of difficult questions for the spokesperson.
examples.zh: 新闻发布会向发言人抛出了一连串棘手的提问。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式用语，固定搭配 a slew of，后接复数可数名词，表示大量、许多。

lemmas.def_en: unlawful premeditated killing of a human being by a human being
lemmas.def_zh: n. 谋杀，杀害

examples.en: Federal detectives reopened the cold case after fresh evidence emerged about the slaying.
examples.zh: 在出现关于这起凶杀案的新线索后，联邦侦探重新启动了陈年悬案的调查。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于新闻报道与司法语境，指蓄意凶杀案、杀害事件，为可数或不可数名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 slean（打击、杀死），引申为现代俚语中“惊艳全场/征服观众”。
family_guide.core_distinction: slain 为过去分词作名词指死者；slew 既是 slay 的过去式也可指大量；slaying 为谋杀事件。

lemmas.def_en: the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
lemmas.def_zh: n. 体育锻炼，健身；练习

examples.en: A thirty-minute morning workout can significantly boost your energy levels.
examples.zh: 早晨进行三十分钟的锻炼可以显著提升你的精力。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词为单数名词（勿与动词短语 work out 混淆），常见搭配 have/do a workout，修饰语常为 intense/light。

family_guide.root_logic: 由短语动词 work out（锻炼、解决）复合而成的名词。

lemmas.def_en: a setting with precious stones so closely set that no metal shows
lemmas.def_zh: v. 铺砌，铺路；n. 密镶宝石（法式拼写 pavé）

examples.en: The engagement ring features a magnificent round diamond surrounded by a delicate pave.
examples.zh: 这枚订婚戒指以一颗夺目的圆形钻石为主石，周围环绕着精致的密镶碎钻。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自法语（常写作 pavé），珠宝学专业名词，指多颗宝石紧密排列、不见底托的密镶工艺。

lemmas.def_en: the paved surface of a thoroughfare
lemmas.def_zh: n. 人行道；地面硬化铺层

examples.en: Pedestrians were urged to remain on the pavement during the busy morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的早高峰期间，行人们被提醒走在人行道上。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指人行道（相当于美式 sidewalk）；在工程与地质语境指硬化路面或石质地表。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ with) To cover a road, path, or surface with flat stones, bricks, or concrete to make it firm and level.
lemmas.def_zh: 铺砌，铺（路）

examples.en: Municipal workers arrived early in the morning to pave the cracked asphalt street.
examples.zh: 市政工人清早赶来，对那条开裂的沥青街道进行重新铺设。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用石块、沥青等铺设地面；常用比喻搭配 pave the way for 为……铺平道路。

lemmas.def_en: not having a paved surface
lemmas.def_zh: 没有铺砌的

examples.en: Driving down the bumpy unpaved road kicked up clouds of thick dust.
examples.zh: 在颠簸且未铺设的土路上行驶激起了阵阵厚厚的尘土。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pavire（夯实、敲打），引申为铺设路面，进而出“铺平道路”之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: pave 作名词时通常指密镶宝石饰（法式音 /pɑːˈveɪ/）；pavement 指铺就的硬化路面/人行道。

lemmas.def_en: a constant in the equation of a curve that can be varied to yield a family of similar curves
lemmas.def_zh: n. 参数；界限，规范

examples.en: The research team must operate strictly within the parameters defined by the grant.
examples.zh: 研究小组必须在资助基金所划定的界限范围内严格展开工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 数学或技术语境指参量；日常及商务中常作复数 parameters，指规则、限定范围或框架界限。

lemmas.def_zh: 参数的, 参量的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or in terms of a parameter

examples.en: The engineers performed detailed parametric analysis to optimize the complex aircraft design.
examples.zh: 工程师进行了详尽的参数化分析，以优化复杂的飞机设计。

lemmas.def_zh: [统]非参数的
lemmas.def_en: not involving an estimation of the parameters of a statistic

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 para-（旁边、辅助）+ metron（测量），指界定或衡量事物的尺度与界限。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to force air suddenly out of the lungs with a sharp, noisy sound. 2. [I] (of an engine or machine) to make a sudden harsh, sputtering sound.
lemmas.def_zh: 咳，咳嗽；咳出；（发动机等）发出爆震声

examples.en: The dust from the construction site made everyone cough uncontrollably.
examples.zh: 施工现场的灰尘呛得大家忍不住连连咳嗽。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见搭配 cough up（口语中指勉强掏钱或吐出），咳嗽本身为不及物动词，勿带宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟胸腔气流爆发性冲破声门的声音。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or common to or descriptive of all members of a genus
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 一般的，通用的；无专利商标的；n. 无商标商品；非专利药

examples.en: The doctor recommended a generic drug because it is much cheaper than the brand-name equivalent.
examples.zh: 医生推荐了一种仿制药，因为它比同类的品牌药便宜得多。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指非特指的、通用的或无专利商标的，常见搭配如 generic term（通称）或 generic drug（仿制药）。

lemmas.def_en: a wine that is a blend of several varieties of grapes with no one grape predominating; a wine that does not carry the name of any specific grape
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 一般的，通用的；无专利商标的；n. 无商标商品；非专利药

examples.en: Consumers often opt for generics to save money on their monthly grocery bills.
examples.zh: 消费者通常选择无商标的通用品，以节省每月的杂货开支。

lemmas.usage_note: 主要指非品牌产品或非专利药，多用复数 generics，常见于商业与医药语境。

lemmas.def_en: a general kind of something
lemmas.def_zh: （生物分类）属；类，种

examples.en: Lions and tigers belong to the same genus, Panthera.
examples.zh: 狮子和老虎属于同一个属——豹属。

lemmas.usage_note: 生物分类学专业术语，指“属”，介于科（family）与种（species）之间，复数形式为 genera。

lemmas.def_en: without a trademark or brand name
lemmas.def_zh: 关于属类, 属类地, 属类上

examples.en: The medication is prescribed generically to help patients save money on treatments.
examples.zh: 该药物按通用名开具，以帮助患者节省治疗费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 genus（种类、属），指缺乏特定品牌或独特个性的“通常种属的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: generic 作形容词表示通用的、非特指的；作名词特指非专利药或无品牌商品。

lemmas.def_en: very light colored; highly diluted with white
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 苍白的，灰白的；微弱的

examples.en: She looked unusually pale after hearing the shocking news.
examples.zh: 听到那个令人震惊的消息后，她的脸色显得异常苍白。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述肤色苍白、光线微弱或色彩浅淡，常见搭配有 pale complexion 或 pale blue。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('pal up/around with') (informal) To become close friends with someone and spend time together.
lemmas.def_zh: 结为朋友，友好交往

examples.en: He palled around with a group of musicians during his college years.
examples.zh: 大学期间，他和一群音乐人打成一片。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用动词，表示“结交为友”或“闲逛”，常与 up 或 around/about 连用。

lemmas.def_en: unnatural lack of color in the skin (as from bruising or sickness or emotional distress)
lemmas.def_zh: 苍白, 青白

examples.en: The unusual pallor of his face suggested he was feeling very unwell.
examples.zh: 他脸上异样的苍白表明他感到非常不舒服。

lemmas.def_en: unnatural lack of color in the skin (as from bruising or sickness or emotional distress)
lemmas.def_zh: 变青, 苍白, 淡薄

examples.en: The distinct paleness of her skin contrasted sharply with her dark hair.
examples.zh: 她皮肤明显的白皙与乌黑的头发形成了鲜明的对比。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner lacking interest or vitality
lemmas.def_zh: 苍白地, 青青地, 淡色地

examples.en: The weak winter sun shone palely through the fog this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨，虚弱的冬日阳光透过薄雾苍白地洒下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pallidus（苍白的、褪色的）。
family_guide.core_distinction: pale 为形容词，注意勿与非同根词 pal（好朋友/做朋友）混淆。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To follow a person or animal quietly and secretly in order to catch, attack, or harass them. 2. [I] To walk in a proud, stiff, or angry manner.
lemmas.def_zh: 潜近（猎物）；非法跟踪骚扰；大步昂首走

examples.en: The leopard silently stalked its prey through the dense grass.
examples.zh: 猎豹穿过茂密的草丛，悄悄潜近它的猎物。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示动物潜近猎物、非法跟踪骚扰他人，或昂首阔步地走，常及物使用或后接介词短语。

lemmas.def_en: someone who walks with long stiff strides
lemmas.def_zh: 潜随猎物者

examples.en: The leopard is a skilled stalker, creeping silently toward its target through the grass.
examples.zh: 花豹是出色的潜伏捕猎者，在草丛中悄无声息地逼近猎物。

lemmas.def_en: attached directly by the base; not having an intervening stalk
lemmas.def_zh: 无茎的

examples.en: The botanist carefully examined the stalkless flowers blooming directly on the woody vine.
examples.zh: 植物学家仔细检查了直接开在木质藤蔓上的无茎花朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 stealcian（潜行），借隐秘接近猎物的动作指代跟踪骚扰。

lemmas.def_en: (sports) the chief official (as in boxing or American football) who is expected to ensure fair play
lemmas.def_zh: （口语）裁判员

examples.en: The ref blew the whistle and awarded a penalty kick to the home team.
examples.zh: 裁判吹响哨子，判给主队一个点球。

lemmas.usage_note: （口语）裁判员

family_guide.root_logic: 口语缩写词，截取自 referee（裁判员，源自 refer 参考/仲裁）。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To stop moving or progressing, or to make someone or something stop.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）停止，（使）停下；（使）中断

examples.en: Bad weather halted the construction of the new railway line.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气导致新铁路线的施工停工。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作及物动词表示“使中断/叫停”，也可用作不及物动词表示“停止前进”，语体较正式。

lemmas.def_en: in a halting manner
lemmas.def_zh: 迟疑不决地；犹豫地

examples.en: He spoke haltingly, struggling to find the right words in front of the audience.
examples.zh: 他在观众面前吞吞吐吐地讲着，难以找到合适的词句。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 蹒跚的；踌躇的；断断续续的
lemmas.def_en: stopping and starting often, especially because you are not certain or are lacking confidence; limping
lemmas.usage_note: 现代英语中多指言语、步调犹豫不决或断断续续，如 a halting voice / conversation；古旧用法指肢体瘸拐蹒跚。

examples.en: He made a halting attempt to explain why he was late.
examples.zh: 他吞吞吐吐地试图解释自己迟到的原因。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自德语 Halt（停止），多指行动、进程突然被迫或主动停下。

lemmas.def_en: a politician who is running for public office
lemmas.def_zh: n. 被提名人，候选人

examples.en: The Oscar nominee walked the red carpet under the flash of cameras.
examples.zh: 这位奥斯卡获提名者在闪光灯的聚焦下走过了红毯。

lemmas.usage_note: 指被提名人或候选人，后常接 for 引导职务或奖项，如 nominee for president/an Oscar。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自动词 nominate（提名，词源与 name 名字相关），加受动者后缀 -ee。

lemmas.def_en: gossip spread by spoken communication
lemmas.def_zh: n. 管道；供给线；（在制品/项目）筹划渠道

examples.en: Several promising new drugs are currently in the company's research pipeline.
examples.zh: 该公司目前有数款前景看好的新药正在研发筹备中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用短语 in the pipeline（在筹备/进行中），商务和科技语境常引申为项目储备或人才输送渠道。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 pipe（管道）+ line（线路），现广泛引申为流水线式供给或项目储备进程。

lemmas.def_en: an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
lemmas.def_zh: n. 飞机（英式常用 aeroplane）

examples.en: The airplane glided smoothly through the clouds before beginning its descent.
examples.zh: 飞机平稳地穿过云层，随后开始下降航行。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式标准拼写，英式写作 aeroplane；介词常搭 by airplane 或 on the airplane。

lemmas.def_en: an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
lemmas.def_zh: 飞机

examples.en: We watched the vintage aeroplane glide gracefully across the clear blue summer sky.
examples.zh: 我们看着那架老式飞机在晴朗蔚蓝的夏日天空中优雅地滑翔。

family_guide.root_logic: 美式英语构词 air（空气）+ plane（翼面/平面），直指借助机翼升空飞行的机械。

lemmas.def_en: an edible tuber native to South America; a staple food of Ireland
lemmas.def_zh: 土豆，马铃薯（俚语）

examples.en: We served roast beef with mashed murphies on the side.
examples.zh: 我们供应了烤牛肉，并配有土豆泥。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常见于固定词组 Murphy's law（墨菲定律），作普通名词指土豆时属极其小众的俚语用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自爱尔兰常见姓氏Murphy，因爱尔兰人常以土豆为主食而衍生出俚语指代。

lemmas.def_en: a courteous or respectful or considerate act
lemmas.def_zh: 礼貌；谦恭；免费提供

examples.en: He closed the door quietly out of courtesy to the sleeping baby.
examples.zh: 出于对熟睡婴儿的体谅，他轻轻关上了门。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 (by) courtesy of（蒙…提供/承蒙好意）或 out of courtesy（出于礼貌），属书面及正式语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自court（宫廷），指宫廷中培养的有礼貌、谦恭的举止与待遇。

lemmas.def_en: any of several noncommissioned officer ranks in the Army or Air Force or Marines ranking above a corporal
lemmas.def_zh: 陆军中士；警官

examples.en: The sergeant instructed the new recruits on rifle maintenance.
examples.zh: 中士指导新兵如何保养步枪。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与军警衔称连用，如 police sergeant 或 flight sergeant；作称呼时首字母常大写，注意拼写易漏中部的e。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语serviens（服役的、侍候的），演变为军队或警队的士官、巡官级别。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ to) To follow or obey a rule, belief, or agreement strictly. 2. [I] (+ to) To stick firmly to a surface or object.
lemmas.def_zh: 遵守，坚持（与to连用）；黏附，附着（与to连用）

examples.en: All employees must adhere strictly to the company's safety regulations.
examples.zh: 所有员工都必须严格遵守公司的安全规章制度。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，必须与介词 to 搭配，既可指物理上的“粘附”，也常指遵守规则、坚持原则。

lemmas.def_en: a substance that unites or bonds surfaces together
lemmas.def_zh: 粘合剂, 橡皮膏

examples.en: Apply a waterproof adhesive to fix the broken handle firmly onto the ceramic mug.
examples.zh: 涂抹一层防水粘合剂，把断裂的手柄牢牢固定在陶瓷杯上。

lemmas.def_zh: 依附, 固执, 坚持
lemmas.def_en: faithful support for a cause or political party or religion

examples.en: The firm's strict adherence to quality standards earned it a global reputation.
examples.zh: 该企业对质量标准的严格坚守为其赢得了全球声誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，后接 to，指对规则、信念或计划的“坚守、遵循”，语气正式庄重。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal union of bodily tissues; most common in the abdomen
lemmas.def_zh: 附着, 粘着, 支持, 追随

examples.en: The new tires provide excellent adhesion, ensuring safety even on wet and icy roads.
examples.zh: 这种新轮胎抓地力极佳，即使在湿滑冰冷的道路上也能确保安全。

lemmas.def_en: someone who believes and helps to spread the doctrine of another
lemmas.def_zh: 信徒, 追随者

examples.en: As a dedicated adherent of minimalism, she keeps only essential items in her home.
examples.zh: 作为极简主义的忠实追随者，她家里只保留必需品。

lemmas.def_en: the property of sticking together (as of glue and wood) or the joining of surfaces of different composition
lemmas.def_zh: 粘[附着, 胶粘]性, 粘附[胶粘]度

examples.en: High humidity often reduces the adhesiveness of the tape, causing it to peel off.
examples.zh: 高湿度往往会降低胶带的粘性，导致其脱落。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根ad-（去、朝向）+ here（粘附），本义为紧紧贴住，引申为坚守、遵守。

lemmas.def_en: a connecting point at which several lines come together
lemmas.def_zh: 节点；叉点；结节

examples.en: Each computer on the local network acts as an independent node.
examples.zh: 局域网上的每台计算机都是一个独立的节点。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技、医学及网络领域的专业名词，指网络节点、分支叉点或淋巴结等结构。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move your head down and up, especially to show agreement, greeting, or acknowledgement. 2. [I] To let your head fall forward when sleepy; to fall asleep briefly.
lemmas.def_zh: 点头示意，点头答应；打盹，打瞌睡

examples.en: She nodded politely when she passed her neighbor in the hallway.
examples.zh: 在走廊里经过邻居身旁时，她礼貌地点了点头。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可作及物也可作不及物动词，常指点头示意赞同或打招呼，搭配 nod off 可表示打瞌睡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语nodus（结、关节），表示连接点、膨大部分；nod为其同源变体，指头部快速弯曲点动的动作。
family_guide.core_distinction: node指交叉点或结节（名词）；nod指点头致意或打盹（动词）。

lemmas.def_en: eagerly desirous
lemmas.def_zh: 焦虑的；渴望的

examples.en: Parents are naturally anxious about their children's safety when they travel alone.
examples.zh: 当孩子独自外出时，父母自然会为他们的安全感到焦虑。

lemmas.usage_note: 后接 about/for 表示“焦虑忧虑”；后接 to do 或 for 则表示“急切渴望”。

lemmas.def_en: with anxiety or apprehension
lemmas.def_zh: 忧虑地, 不安地

examples.en: Parents waited anxiously outside the exam hall until the final school bell rang loudly.
examples.zh: 家长们焦急地在考场外等待，直到学校最后的铃声响起。

lemmas.def_en: (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
lemmas.def_zh: 焦急

examples.en: Her deep breathing helped relieve the growing anxiousness she felt before the interview.
examples.zh: 她的深呼吸有助于缓解面试前心中愈发强烈的焦虑。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语angere（掐紧喉咙、引起痛苦），表示因担忧或渴望而内心紧绷。

lemmas.def_en: a craftsman who shapes pottery on a potter's wheel and bakes them it a kiln
lemmas.def_zh: 陶工, 制陶工人

examples.en: The skilled potter shaped the wet clay into an elegant vase.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的陶工将湿润的黏土塑成了一只优雅的花瓶。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指专门制作陶器、瓷器的工匠或手艺人，常见于手工艺与艺术语境。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (chiefly BrE) To walk or move about slowly and aimlessly. 2. [I] To spend time doing small, pleasant, or trivial tasks in a relaxed way.
lemmas.def_zh: 闲逛，信步漫步；从容做琐事，消磨时间

examples.en: On quiet Sundays, he likes to potter around in the garden.
examples.zh: 在宁静的周日，他喜欢在花园里慢悠悠地忙些杂活。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语常用不及物动词（美式多作 putter），常与 about/around 连用，表示闲逛或做零星杂事。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词指制作罐罐（pot）的制陶工人；动词源自方言pote（戳、瞎摸索），引申为闲逛、漫不经心地做事。
family_guide.core_distinction: 名词与动词含义独立，名词关联陶瓷，动词侧重悠闲无目的的小动作。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To examine someone's past background, qualifications, or a document carefully to check suitability and accuracy. 2. [T] To examine or treat an animal medically.
lemmas.def_zh: 审查，审核（资格、背景或材料）；（兽医）诊疗（动物）

examples.en: Security officials thoroughly vetted all candidates before the appointment.
examples.zh: 安保官员在任命前对所有候选人进行了彻底审查。

lemmas.usage_note: 熟词生义，表“严格审查（背景、资格或方案）”，常用于被动语态，如 thoroughly vetted for the post。

family_guide.root_logic: 缩写自veterinarian（兽医），动词化指像兽医检查牲畜健康一样严格审查、核验。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to officially order someone to come or be present, especially in court. 2. [T] to gather or call forth courage, strength, or energy (often with 'up').
lemmas.def_zh: 传唤，召唤；召集（会议）；鼓起，振作

examples.en: She managed to summon enough courage to confront her boss.
examples.zh: 她终于鼓起足够的勇气去质问老板。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，常搭配 summon (up) the courage（鼓起勇气）或 summon sb. to do sth.（传唤某人）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (law) To order someone to appear in a court of law with an official summons.
lemmas.def_zh: 传唤，传讯（出庭）

examples.en: The court summonsed the witness to testify next Monday.
examples.zh: 法院传唤该证人下周一出庭作证。

lemmas.usage_note: summons 自带s但作动词原形，常接 to court，指“依法传唤/传讯”，极具法律语体色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语sub-（暗中、自下而上）+ monere（警告、提醒），引申为正式传唤、召集或振作力量。
family_guide.core_distinction: summon为标准动词；summons常用作名词（传票），也可作动词表示正式下达传票。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth
lemmas.def_zh: 颚, 颌

examples.en: The boxer suffered a severe injury to his lower jaw during the fight.
examples.zh: 拳击手在比赛中下颌严重受伤。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与日常常用名词，指人或动物的下巴、颌骨，常用搭配如 upper/lower jaw。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (informal) To talk or chat at length; to lecture or scold someone tediously.
lemmas.def_zh: 闲聊，闲谈；唠叨，训斥

examples.en: They sat at the bar for hours, jawing about old football games.
examples.zh: 他们在酒吧坐了好几个小时，喋喋不休地聊着过去的足球比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语动词，意为“喋喋不休地闲聊”或“教训、数落他人”，后常接介词 away 或 at。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语ceowe（咀嚼），名词指下巴颌骨，动词引申为口若悬河地闲聊或唠叨。

lemmas.def_en: a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined
lemmas.def_zh: 矿石，矿砂

examples.en: The company extracts high-grade iron ore from the open-pit mine.
examples.zh: 该公司从这座露天矿中开采高品位铁矿石。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指天然“矿石”，高频搭配有 iron ore（铁矿石）及 extract metal from ore。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语āra（未精炼的金属、矿石），专指蕴含经济价值金属的天然矿石。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is a member of the faculty at a college or university
lemmas.def_zh: n. 教授（口语）

examples.en: The prof canceled today's lecture due to illness.
examples.zh: 教授因病取消了今天的讲座。

lemmas.usage_note: professor 的口语缩略形式，常在校园非正式语境中指代教授，正式写作中应使用完整拼写。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 professor 的非正式口语缩写。

lemmas.def_en: long and light rowing boat; especially for racing
lemmas.def_zh: n. 临时工作，零工；演奏会

examples.en: He landed a freelance writing gig for a travel magazine.
examples.zh: 他找到了一份为旅游杂志撰稿的自由职业零工。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代高频词，原指“现场演出”，现多指“临时工作/兼职”，常构成 gig economy（零工经济）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自爵士乐俚语，指临时演出，现引申指任何短期或零工性质的工作。

lemmas.def_en: equally
lemmas.def_zh: 一样, 以同样的方式

examples.en: The festival attracts tourists and locals alike every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，该节日都同样吸引着游客和当地居民。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作副词置于两个名词并列结构（如 A and B alike）之后，意为“同样地”、“两者皆然”。

lemmas.def_en: having the same or similar characteristics
lemmas.def_zh: 相似的, 同样的

examples.en: Although they are twins, their personalities are not at all alike.
examples.zh: 尽管他们是双胞胎，但两人的性格却截然不同。

lemmas.usage_note: 表语形容词，不能作前置定语，常用在 look alike 或 are alike 结构中，表示外观或性质极其相似。

lemmas.def_en: not alike or similar
lemmas.def_zh: 不相似的, 不一样的

examples.en: Although raised in the same house, the sisters have completely unalike tastes.
examples.zh: 尽管在同一个屋檐下长大，这对姐妹的品味却完全不同。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（处于……状态）+ like（相似的），表示状态或方式上的相似。
family_guide.core_distinction: alike 通常只作表语或副词，不置于名词前作定语；like 可作介词或前置定语。

lemmas.def_en: a low triangular area of alluvial deposits where a river divides before entering a larger body of water
lemmas.def_zh: n. 三角洲；希腊字母表的第四个字母

examples.en: The river delta is known for its fertile soil and rich wildlife.
examples.zh: 该河流三角洲以其肥沃的土壤和丰富的野生动植物而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理学指三角洲（常大写如 the Nile Delta）；科技与金融语境中表示“变量增量/差额”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊字母表的第四个字母Δ（三角形），因尼罗河口形状相似而引申指河流三角洲。

lemmas.def_en: highest in quality
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 优秀的，杰出的；英国货币的

examples.en: She has earned a sterling reputation for her honesty.
examples.zh: 她因诚实而赢得了极佳的声誉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于褒义书面语，修饰品质、声誉或工作，如 sterling reputation/qualities/work，意为极其优秀的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，最初指刻有小星或品质标准的银币，引申为纯正、优秀的品质。

lemmas.def_en: preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 家庭作业；准备工作

examples.en: Before attending the interview, make sure you do your homework on the company.
examples.zh: 在参加面试之前，确保你对这家公司做足功课。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词；除作业外常用于商务口语 do one's homework，意为提前做好准备调研工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 home（家）+ work（工作），字面指“在家里做的工作”，引申为课外作业及预备工作。

lemmas.def_en: of less size or importance
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 较小的，次要的

examples.en: Choosing between two bad options is often about picking the lesser evil.
examples.zh: 在两个糟糕的选项中做选择，往往是两害相权取其轻。

lemmas.usage_note: 只作前置定语，常用于成语 the lesser of two evils（两害相权取其轻）或修饰次要地位。

family_guide.root_logic: little 的双重比较级（less + -er），强调在重要性、程度或数量上“更小的、次要的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: lesser 侧重重要性或规模上的“次要”，通常作定语；less 侧重不可数名词的数量“更少”，多作限定词或副词。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong
lemmas.def_zh: n. 美德，高尚品德；优点，长处

examples.en: Patience is considered an essential virtue in long-term financial investment.
examples.zh: 在长期金融投资中，耐心被视为一种不可或缺的美德。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不可数名词表示德行，作可数名词表示优点；高频搭配有 by virtue of（凭借）和 make a virtue of。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong
lemmas.def_zh: 有德;高洁;贞淑

examples.en: Her natural virtuousness earned her the deep respect of the entire community.
examples.zh: 她天生的美德赢得了整个社区的深深敬意。

lemmas.def_en: morally excellent
lemmas.def_zh: 品德高尚的, 公正的, 贞洁的, 有效力的

examples.en: He led a virtuous life dedicated entirely to helping the poor and needy.
examples.zh: 他过着品德高尚的生活，一生致力于帮助穷困之人。

lemmas.def_en: in a moral manner
lemmas.def_zh: 合乎道德地；品性正直地；善良地

examples.en: She always acted virtuously, refusing to compromise her morals for personal gain.
examples.zh: 她行事一向合乎道德，拒绝为了个人利益牺牲道德原则。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 virtus（男子气概、美德），核心指道德上的卓越或事物固有的优点。

lemmas.def_en: a round shape formed by a series of concentric circles (as formed by leaves or flower petals)
lemmas.def_zh: 卷轴, 画卷, 名册, 条幅, 滚动

examples.en: The museum recently restored an ancient silk scroll dating back to the Han dynasty.
examples.zh: 博物馆最近修复了一幅可追溯至汉代的古代丝绸卷轴。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指古旧的纸卷、卷轴，也可在计算机语境指滚动条；常见搭配为 ancient scroll 或 parchment scroll。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ up/down/through) (computing) To move text, images, or webpage content across a screen. 2. [I, T] To curl or cause to curl into the shape of a scroll.
lemmas.def_zh: 滚屏，滚翻（屏幕内容）；（使）卷起

examples.en: He casually scrolled through his social media feed while waiting for the train.
examples.zh: 等火车时，他漫不经心地刷着社交媒体动态。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代多指在屏幕上滚屏浏览，常与 down、up 或 through 连用；亦可表示将纸张等卷成筒状。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，指卷起来的羊皮纸卷，在计算机时代引申指滚屏、滑动页面。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to make more complex, refined, or worldly; to alter or adulterate deceptively.
lemmas.def_zh: 使复杂化；使变得世故，使精明；篡改

examples.en: Rapid technological advances continue to sophisticate modern communication tools.
examples.zh: 技术的飞速进步不断使现代通信工具更加精密复杂。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指使技术、系统复杂精密化，或指使人变得世故成熟，多用于正式或书面语体中。

lemmas.def_en: uplifting enlightenment
lemmas.def_zh: 诡辩, 老于世故, 复杂(性)

examples.en: The new software system brings a high level of technical sophistication to our workflow.
examples.zh: 这款新软件系统为我们的工作流程带来了高度的技术复杂度。

lemmas.def_en: not wise in the ways of the world; ; - Kate O'Brien
lemmas.def_zh: 不懂世故的, 单纯的, 不精细的, 纯洁的

examples.en: His unsophisticated manners made him seem remarkably sincere among the polished politicians.
examples.zh: 在圆滑的政客中，他纯朴质朴的举止显得格外真诚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 sophistes（智者），后演变为指使复杂化、使见多识广或篡改纯度。

lemmas.def_en: a compartment in a stable where a single animal is confined and fed
lemmas.def_zh: 厩, 停车处, 牧师职位, 货摊, 托辞, 拖延

examples.en: She spent her Saturday morning browsing the vegetable stalls in the local market.
examples.zh: 她周六上午都在当地集市的蔬菜摊位前闲逛挑选。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指集市上的货摊、剧院前排座席或牲畜棚隔栏；高频搭配有 market stall 与 street stall。

lemmas.def_en: a tactic used to mislead or delay
lemmas.def_zh: 失速, 停转

examples.en: The committee criticized his deliberate stalling during the contract negotiations.
examples.zh: 委员会批评了他在合同谈判过程中故意拖延的行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词时主要指拖延行为、引擎熄火停转或飞机失速状态，常用于工程技术及商务博弈语境。
