lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. (of an engine or vehicle) To stop suddenly, or cause to stop suddenly. 2. To stop or cause a process to stop making progress. 3. To deliberately delay doing something or answering.
lemmas.def_zh: （使发动机等）熄火，抛锚；（使进程）停顿，拖延；拖延，支吾

examples.en: The defense attorney tried to stall for time by requesting an unexpected recess.
examples.zh: 辩护律师试图通过申请意外休庭来拖延时间。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，指发动机熄火、进程受阻或故意拖延时间；常搭配 stall for time。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，原指牲畜的隔间或固定的货摊，引申指停顿、拖延或熄火。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being believed
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 可信的，可靠的

examples.en: The prosecutor failed to provide credible evidence to support the accusation.
examples.zh: 检察官未能提供可信的证据来支持这项指控。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示证据、信息或人可靠且令人信服；常与 evidence、witness、threat 或 explanation 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being believable or trustworthy
lemmas.def_zh: n. 可信度，信誉

examples.en: The repeated policy shifts have severely undermined the government's economic credibility.
examples.zh: 政策的反复变动严重削弱了政府在经济政策上的公信力。

lemmas.usage_note: 指机构、理论或言论的可信度与声誉；高频动宾搭配有 gain/lose credibility 与 undermine credibility。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 cred-（相信）+ -ible（可……的），核心意义为“值得信任的、可信的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: credible 指“可信赖的、可靠的”；credulous 指人“轻信的、易受骗的”。

lemmas.def_en: a canned meat made largely from pork
lemmas.def_zh: 罐头猪肉, 垃圾邮件

examples.en: My inbox is constantly flooded with useless marketing spam.
examples.zh: 我的收件箱经常被毫无用处的营销垃圾邮件塞满。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，主要指互联网垃圾邮件或午餐肉罐头；常见搭配有 spam filter 与 unsolicited spam。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 滥塞

examples.en: The platform updated its community guidelines to strictly forbid commercial spamming.
examples.zh: 该平台更新了社区守则，严禁任何商业性质的群发垃圾信息行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，专指大量发送垃圾信息或在网络论坛刷屏的滥发行为，常见搭配 anti-spamming。

examples.en: The company spammed thousands of users with promotional messages without their prior consent.
examples.zh: 该公司未经事先同意，就向数千名用户发送了大量推销垃圾邮件。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To send unwanted or repetitive advertising or messages to a large number of people over the internet.
lemmas.def_zh: 群发垃圾邮件，批量发送垃圾信息

examples.en: Fraudulent companies often spam users with deceptive promotional messages.
examples.zh: 欺诈公司经常用虚假的推广短信轰炸用户。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指密集发送垃圾邮件或大量刷屏；常接目标对象或介词 with，如 spam sb with ads。

family_guide.root_logic: 原为午餐肉品牌，因英国喜剧短剧反复呼喊该词演变为指代“泛滥成灾的垃圾邮件”。

lemmas.def_en: a list of names
lemmas.def_zh: n. 花名册，值勤表，球员名单

examples.en: The coach announced the final roster for the championship game.
examples.zh: 教练公布了冠军赛的最终队员名单。

lemmas.usage_note: 指值班表或花名册，常见搭配 on the roster（在名单上）或 duty roster（轮值表）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 rooster（网格、栅栏），引申为一张带网格的花名册或值班表。

lemmas.def_en: aromatic substances of vegetable origin used as a preservative
lemmas.def_zh: 香料, 药料, 香气, 调味品, 情趣, 少许

examples.en: The chef added a blend of rare spices to give the soup a distinct aroma.
examples.zh: 大厨加入了几种罕见的混合香料，使汤散发出独特的香气。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指烹饪用的香料调味品（可数/不可数），也引申指生活的情趣刺激；常见搭配 exotic spices。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] ('spice up') To make a talk, event, or relationship more interesting, lively, or exciting. 2. [T] To add spices to food to give it flavor.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……增添趣味，使更精彩；在……中加香料

examples.en: The speaker used humorous anecdotes to spice up an otherwise dry presentation.
examples.zh: 演讲者穿插了幽默的轶事，让原本枯燥的报告生动起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示在食物中加香料，常用于引申搭配 spice up（增添趣味、使生动活跃）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 species（种类、货物），特指珍贵的小包装香料，后引申为增添趣味的事物。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To move forward on hands and knees or with the body dragging close to the ground. 2. [I] To move forward extremely slowly. 3. [I] (informal) To behave subserviently toward someone.
lemmas.def_zh: 爬行，匍匐前进；缓慢行进；巴结，谄媚

examples.en: Morning rush-hour traffic slowed to a crawl as vehicles crawled along the snowy highway.
examples.zh: 早高峰交通放缓，车辆在积雪的高速公路上极其缓慢地移动。

lemmas.usage_note: 指身体贴地爬行或车流等极其缓慢地前行；高频搭配有 crawl forward、crawl along 及 crawl with（满是）。

lemmas.def_en: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
lemmas.def_zh: 爬行者, 蠕动的东西, 虱, (澳)马屁精, 奴颜婢膝的人, 婴儿的罩衣

examples.en: A search engine crawler browses the internet to index new and updated web pages.
examples.zh: 搜索引擎爬虫通过浏览互联网来为新增和更新的网页建立索引。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为贴地缓慢匍匐前行，引申为极慢的移动或爬行。

lemmas.def_en: an account of the series of events making up a person's life
lemmas.def_zh: n. 传记

examples.en: She spent three years researching historical archives to write an authorized biography of the scientist.
examples.zh: 她花了三年时间查阅历史档案，为这位科学家撰写了一部授权传记。

lemmas.usage_note: 指由他人撰写的人物传记（区别于自传 autobiography）；常见搭配 authorized/unauthorized biography。

lemmas.def_en: someone who writes an account of a person's life
lemmas.def_zh: 传记作者

examples.en: The talented biographer spent ten years researching the controversial politician's private life.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的传记作者花了十年时间研究那位争议政客的私生活。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or being biography
lemmas.def_zh: 传记的

examples.en: The introduction provides brief biographical details about the author before the main text.
examples.zh: 引言在正文之前提供了关于作者的简短生平介绍。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 bio-（生命）+ -graphy（记录、书写）构成，即记录人一生的文字。

lemmas.def_en: having a sharp inclination
lemmas.def_zh: 险峻的, 陡峭的, 急剧升降的, 夸大的

examples.en: The tourists struggled to climb the steep slope leading to the mountain summit.
examples.zh: 游客们艰难地攀登通往山顶的陡峭山坡。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容山坡陡峭、数据急剧升降，或口语中指价格过高；常修饰 slope、rise、fall 或 price。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ in) To soak food, tea, or herbs in liquid to soften them or extract flavor. 2. [T] ('be steeped in') To fill someone or something completely with a quality or tradition.
lemmas.def_zh: 浸泡，沏（茶）；使沉浸于，使深谙（be steeped in）

examples.en: Steep the tea leaves in hot water for three minutes before serving.
examples.zh: 将茶叶在热水中浸泡三分钟后再饮用。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指将物体浸泡提取，多用于被动语态短语 be steeped in（沉浸于、深受熏陶）。

lemmas.def_en: in a steep manner
lemmas.def_zh: 险峻地

examples.en: The path rose steeply up the mountain, making the final hike quite exhausting.
examples.zh: 山路险峻地向上延伸，使得最后的徒步跋涉十分吃力。

lemmas.def_en: the property possessed by a slope that is very steep
lemmas.def_zh: 险峻

examples.en: The extreme steepness of the rocky slope made climbing it without ropes impossible.
examples.zh: 岩石斜坡的极度险峻使得没有绳索根本不可能爬上去。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心义为“高度的倾斜或浸入”，作形容词指陡峭，作动词指浸泡于液体或氛围中。

lemmas.def_en: a close friend who accompanies his buddies in their activities
lemmas.def_zh: 朋友, 伙伴, 同志, 同谋

examples.en: We have been good pals since our elementary school days.
examples.zh: 从小学时代起，我们俩就是非常要好的伙伴。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语常用，指亲密无间的朋友或伙伴，常用于 pen pal（笔友）或 old pal 等非正式搭配。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('pal up/around with') (informal) To become close friends with someone and spend time together.
lemmas.def_zh: 结为朋友，友好交往

examples.en: He used to pal around with the wrong crowd during his teenage years.
examples.zh: 他十几岁时曾经常和一群不三不四的人混在一起。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式动词，常与 around 或 up 连用构成短语 pal around/up with，表示与某人交朋友或混在一起。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗姆语词汇，意为兄弟或伙伴，指亲密无间的朋友或与之结伴。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal) To succeed in reaching or achieving a particular goal, standard, or age.
lemmas.def_zh: （经过努力）达到，获得，实现

examples.en: She worked diligently for years to attain the position of chief executive.
examples.zh: 她勤奋工作多年，终于获得了首席执行官的职位。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，强调通过长期努力、奋斗获得目标、地位或达到某一特定年龄或水平。

lemmas.def_en: the act of achieving an aim
lemmas.def_zh: 达到

examples.en: The attainment of his lifelong dream required years of relentless hard work.
examples.zh: 实现他毕生的梦想需要多年坚持不懈的努力。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being achievable
lemmas.def_zh: 可达到, 所及

examples.en: The manager assessed the attainability of the sales goals before setting them.
examples.zh: 经理在制定销售目标之前评估了其可行性。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being attained or accomplished
lemmas.def_zh: 可到达的, 可得到的

examples.en: Setting realistic and attainable goals helps students stay motivated throughout the semester.
examples.zh: 设定切合实际且可实现的目标有助于学生在整个学期保持动力。

lemmas.def_en: impossible to achieve
lemmas.def_zh: 难到达的, 不可得到的

examples.en: Perfection is an unattainable ideal, so we should focus on continuous progress.
examples.zh: 完美是一个无法达到的理想，因此我们应该专注于持续进步。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 attingere（接触、达到），核心义为通过努力达到目标或状态。

lemmas.def_en: a plan or design of something that is laid out
lemmas.def_zh: n. 布局，版面设计

examples.en: The magazine redesigned its layout to attract younger readers.
examples.zh: 该杂志重新设计了版面，以吸引更年轻的读者。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 page layout（版面设计）或 the layout of a building/room（建筑/房间布局），是单一名词而非动词词组。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自短语动词 lay out（摆放、展开），名词指事物平铺展示出的版面或空间布局。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (cooking) To split a piece of meat, fish, or shrimp almost completely in half and spread it flat before cooking.
lemmas.def_zh: 将（肉、鱼或虾等）从中间切开摊平（成蝶状）

examples.en: Butterfly the chicken breasts so they cook more evenly on the grill.
examples.zh: 把鸡胸肉从中间剖开摊平，这样烤起来受热更均匀。

lemmas.usage_note: 烹饪特有用词，意为“把（肉、虾等）从中切开摊平”，常构成过去分词修饰语 butterflied shrimp/chicken。

family_guide.root_logic: 由名词“蝴蝶”引申为动词，指像蝴蝶般展开或切开，亦指在社交中像蝴蝶般轻浮穿梭。

lemmas.def_en: a sweater or jersey with a high close-fitting collar
lemmas.def_zh: 海龟

examples.en: Every summer, female sea turtles return to this beach to lay their eggs.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，雌性海龟都会回到这片海滩产卵。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指海龟或水龟，常用于海洋生物学及生态保护语境，注意与陆龟（tortoise）区分。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (especially of a boat or vehicle) To turn completely upside down; capsize.
lemmas.def_zh: （船只或车辆）翻覆，底朝天翻转；捕龟

examples.en: The violent gust caused the small sailing dinghy to turtle in the bay.
examples.zh: 一阵狂风导致那艘小型帆船在海湾里彻底翻了底朝天。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见航海或专业动词，指船只彻底倾覆、底朝天翻倒，或指像海龟一样捕捞海龟。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心指海龟或陆龟，引申指像龟一样翻覆或退缩。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To breathe out slowly and audibly, expressing sadness, tiredness, relief, or frustration; to say something with a sigh.
lemmas.def_zh: 叹气，叹息；叹着气说

examples.en: She sighed deeply when she saw the endless pile of paperwork.
examples.zh: 看着堆积如山的文件，她深深地叹了一口气。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，既可表示叹气动作，也可后接引语表示叹息着说，常与 with/in (relief/despair) 连用。

lemmas.def_en: an utterance made by exhaling audibly
lemmas.def_zh: 叹息

examples.en: A heavy sigh escaped his lips as the final results were announced.
examples.zh: 当最终结果公布时，他忍不住发出了一声沉重的叹息。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常与 breathe, heave, give 搭配，如 a sigh of relief（如释重负的叹息）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟长呼气的声音，表示叹息或如叹息般的轻柔声响。

lemmas.def_en: hurting
lemmas.def_zh: 悲伤的, 痛的, 引起痛苦的

examples.en: My muscles were extremely sore the day after the marathon.
examples.zh: 跑完马拉松的第二天，我的肌肉酸痛得厉害。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指身体部位酸痛发炎，或引申为恼怒、伤心，常见搭配 sore throat（咽痛）、sore point（痛处）。

lemmas.def_en: to a great degree
lemmas.def_zh: 疼痛地, 强烈地, 非常

examples.en: Your valuable advice and presence will be sorely missed by the entire team.
examples.zh: 整个团队都会极其想念你宝贵的建议和陪伴。

lemmas.def_en: an open skin infection
lemmas.def_zh: 痛处, 溃疡, 疮

examples.en: Apply this antibacterial ointment to the sore twice a day.
examples.zh: 每天把这种抗菌药膏涂抹在疮口上两次。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指皮肤或粘膜上的疮、溃疡或发炎创口，常用于医学或日常健康语境中。

lemmas.def_en: a pain that is felt (as when the area is touched)
lemmas.def_zh: 痛苦, 悲伤, 愤慨

examples.en: A warm bath can help ease muscle soreness after a long run.
examples.zh: 长跑后泡个温水澡有助于缓解肌肉酸痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为身体的疼痛或创伤，引申指精神上的触痛或恼怒。

lemmas.def_en: the mother of your father or mother
lemmas.def_zh: n. 奶奶，外婆

examples.en: My grandma makes the best apple pie in the world.
examples.zh: 我奶奶做世界上最好吃的苹果派。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常口语、儿语词汇，表达亲昵；正式公文、严谨学术写作中应替换为 grandmother。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 grand-（隔代的）+ ma（母亲口语）构成的亲昵称呼。

lemmas.def_en: the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber
lemmas.def_zh: n. 树干；躯干；汽车后备箱；象鼻

examples.en: Please put your luggage in the trunk of the car.
examples.zh: 请把你的行李放到汽车后备箱里。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指树干、大象鼻子、汽车后备箱（英式用boot）或大皮箱；复数trunks指男士游泳裤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 truncus（截断之躯干），引申指树干、人体躯干、箱子及汽车后备箱。

lemmas.def_en: nearest in space or position; immediately adjoining without intervening space
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 邻近的，毗连的

examples.en: The parking lot adjacent to the train station fills up quickly every morning.
examples.zh: 紧邻火车站的那个停车场每天早晨很快就会停满。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语形容词，表示物理位置上毗连、相邻的，固定与介词 to 连用（adjacent to）。

lemmas.def_en: the attribute of being so near as to be touching
lemmas.def_zh: 邻接, 邻接物

examples.en: The hotel's adjacency to the central train station makes it very convenient.
examples.zh: 这家酒店毗邻中央火车站，交通非常便利。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 ad-（靠近）+ jacere（躺、放）构成，核心义为紧挨着躺在旁边。

lemmas.def_en: clean or organized
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 整洁的；整齐的；纯的（酒）；极好的

examples.en: He keeps all his documents arranged in neat stacks on the desk.
examples.zh: 他把所有文件整整齐齐地叠放在桌子上。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指事物整齐有序、威士忌等酒类纯饮不加水加冰，口语中亦可表示极好的、巧妙的。

lemmas.def_zh: 整齐的, 有条理的
lemmas.def_en: marked by order and cleanliness in appearance or habits

examples.en: She always keeps her bedroom clean and tidy.
examples.zh: 她总是把自己的卧室保持得既干净又整洁。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，强调环境或物品井井有条，也可用作口语修饰金额相当可观（a tidy sum）。

lemmas.def_zh: 不整齐的, 懒散的, 混乱的
lemmas.def_en: not neat and tidy

examples.en: careless and untidy in her personal habits
an untidy living room

lemmas.def_en: with neatness
lemmas.def_zh: 整洁地, 干净地, 匀称地

examples.en: She arranged all her books neatly on the wooden shelf by category.
examples.zh: 她把所有的书按类别整齐地摆放在木架上。

lemmas.def_zh: 整洁地, 整齐地
lemmas.def_en: in a tidy manner

examples.en: the door gave access to a tidily furnished sitting-room where chintz and oak predominated

lemmas.def_zh: 不整洁地; 不修边幅地; 凌乱地; 无条理地
lemmas.def_en: in a messy, untidy manner

examples.en: Rossi spat very deliberately, and very messily, upon Durieux's party card

lemmas.def_en: the state of being neat and smart and trim
lemmas.def_zh: 整洁, 干净

examples.en: His mother always insisted on absolute neatness and order in his bedroom.
examples.zh: 他母亲总是坚持要求他的卧室保持绝对的整洁和有序。

lemmas.def_zh: 整齐, 整洁
lemmas.def_en: the habit of being tidy

lemmas.def_zh: 不整洁, 不修边幅；凌乱, 无条理性
lemmas.def_en: the condition of being untidy

lemmas.def_zh: 整理，收拾，使整齐
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (chiefly British) (often tidy up) to make a room or items neat by putting things in order.

examples.en: I need to tidy up the living room before our guests arrive tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚客人到达之前，我得把客厅好好收拾整理一下。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，通常与 up 连用（tidy up），表示整理收拾房间或某处杂物使其恢复秩序。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nitidus（光亮的），后演变为整齐的、纯净的、巧妙的。

lemmas.def_en: being of delicate or slender build; - Frank Norris
lemmas.def_zh: 瘦的, 苗条的, 微小的, 稀少的, 微薄的

examples.en: There is only a slim chance that the outdoor concert will proceed as planned.
examples.zh: 这场户外音乐会按原计划举行的机会非常渺茫。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容词指人身材苗条匀称；亦常用来形容机会、希望等微小渺茫（a slim chance）。

lemmas.def_zh: 减轻体重的

examples.en: She followed a strict slimming diet to prepare for her upcoming wedding.
examples.zh: 为了准备即将举行的婚礼，她遵循了严格的减肥食谱。

examples.en: The company introduced a slimmed version of its software for mobile users.
examples.zh: 该公司为移动用户推出了一款精简版的软件。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ down) To lose body weight, or reduce the size, staff, or costs of an organization.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）缩减规模，精简；变苗条

examples.en: The company decided to slim down its workforce to cut operational costs.
examples.zh: 公司决定精简员工规模以削减运营成本。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作不及物动词表示节食减肥，也可与 down 连用（slim down）表示机构人员精简或身形变瘦。

lemmas.def_en: a small margin
lemmas.def_zh: 细长；微薄

examples.en: The slimness of the new smartphone makes it very comfortable to hold.
examples.zh: 这款新智能手机的轻薄设计使其握持起来非常舒适。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，原义为倾斜或微小，引申为身材纤细苗条或机会渺茫。

lemmas.def_en: a former British gold coin worth 21 shillings
lemmas.def_zh: 几内亚

examples.en: They spent three weeks traveling across Guinea to study local cultural traditions.
examples.zh: 他们在几内亚各地旅行了三周，以研究当地的文化传统。

lemmas.usage_note: 曾为英国旧金币单位（合21先令）；高频搭配为guinea pig，常用于比喻“实验对象、小白鼠”。

family_guide.root_logic: 地名几内亚（Guinea）的借用，原指用几内亚黄金铸造的英国旧金币。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To force saliva, food, or liquid out of your mouth; to eject liquid or sparks forcefully. 2. [I] (impersonal) To rain very lightly.
lemmas.def_zh: 吐出（唾沫、食物等）；喷出，喷射；下毛毛雨

examples.en: He tasted the spoiled milk and spat it out immediately.
examples.zh: 他尝了一口变质的牛奶，立刻就吐了出来。

lemmas.usage_note: 动词，指吐口水、吐出食物，也可指天空飘零星小雨或壁炉木柴噼啪迸火星，常接 out 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a quarrel about petty points
lemmas.def_zh: 蚝卵, 口角, 拍打

examples.en: The couple had a brief spat over who forgot to lock the front door.
examples.zh: 夫妻俩因为谁忘了锁前门而发生了一场短暂的口角。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，多用于非正式语境，指微不足道的小争吵、小口角（a petty spat），亦可指牡蛎等幼体。

lemmas.def_en: a person who spits (ejects saliva or phlegm from the mouth)
lemmas.def_zh: 用灸叉拷肉的人, 吐唾沫的人

examples.en: The referee immediately ejected the notorious spitter from the soccer field.
examples.zh: 裁判立即将那名臭名昭著的吐口水者罚出了足球场。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟吐痰或吐口水的声音，引申为小口角或小雨。

lemmas.def_en: deserving or inciting pity; ; ; - Galsworthy
lemmas.def_zh: 悲哀的, 可怜的, 感伤的, 差劲的

examples.en: The team gave a pathetic performance and lost by twenty points.
examples.zh: 该队表现得极其差劲，最终输掉了二十分。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，既可表令人同情悲哀的，更常用于非正式口语中带轻蔑口吻，表示极其差劲无能或窝囊的。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner arousing sympathy and compassion
lemmas.def_zh: 悲哀地, 哀伤地, 感伤地

examples.en: The stray puppy whined pathetically at our back door in the rain.
examples.zh: 那只流浪小狗在雨中对着我们的后门哀伤地呜咽。

lemmas.def_zh: 伤感力, 感伤, 悲怅, 同情, 偶然因素, 哀婉动人的词句
lemmas.def_en: a quality that arouses emotions (especially pity or sorrow)

examples.en: The poignant film relies heavily on genuine pathos rather than cheap sentimental tricks.
examples.zh: 这部凄美的电影依靠的是真挚的感伤力量，而非廉价的煽情伎俩。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 pathos（痛苦、感情），引申为令人怜悯的或差劲得可怜的。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To feel great fear, anxiety, or apprehension about something that is going to or might happen.
lemmas.def_zh: 非常害怕，畏惧，极度担心

examples.en: She dreaded going to the dentist, so she kept postponing her appointment.
examples.zh: 她极度害怕去看牙医，因此一再推迟预约。

lemmas.usage_note: 常接名词、动名词或that从句，表示对未来可能发生之事的极度担忧或抗拒，语气强烈。

lemmas.def_en: causing fear or dread or terror
lemmas.def_zh: 可怕的

examples.en: We had to cancel our picnic because of the dreadful weather.
examples.zh: 由于天气太糟糕，我们不得不取消野餐。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作定语或表语，修饰天气、事故、错误等，口语中常用作强调词，表示极糟糕或可怕的。

lemmas.def_en: of a dreadful kind
lemmas.def_zh: (非正式)非常, 可怕地, 令人惊骇地

examples.en: I am dreadfully sorry for arriving so late to the dinner party.
examples.zh: 晚宴迟到了这么久，我感到非常抱歉。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语来源，核心含义是极其恐惧、害怕。
family_guide.core_distinction: dreadful 强调极度糟糕或令人畏惧，侧重评价属性。

lemmas.def_en: distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers
lemmas.def_zh: 鹿

examples.en: A graceful deer suddenly leapt across the quiet country road yesterday morning.
examples.zh: 昨天早晨，一只优雅的鹿突然跳过了安静的乡间小路。

lemmas.usage_note: 单复数同形（one deer / two deer），切勿加-s；其肉通常称为venison而非deer meat。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语原泛指一切野兽，后特指鹿科动物。

lemmas.def_en: the absence of matter
lemmas.def_zh: 真空, 空间, 真空吸尘器

examples.en: The sudden resignation of the CEO left a huge leadership vacuum in the company.
examples.zh: 首席执行官的突然辞职在公司内部留下了巨大的领导权力真空。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指物理真空、吸尘器，或比喻某种空缺，常与fill、create等动词连用，具抽象或日常语境。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To clean something using a vacuum cleaner.
lemmas.def_zh: 用吸尘器清扫，吸尘

examples.en: He vacuums the living room carpet every Sunday morning to remove pet hair.
examples.zh: 他每周日早晨都会用吸尘器清理客厅地毯以去除宠物毛发。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可用作及物动词（接地毯、房间等作宾语），也可作不及物动词，表示用真空吸尘器清扫。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vacuus（空的），核心含义是真空或空虚状态。

lemmas.def_en: a wise and trusted guide and advisor
lemmas.def_zh: 指导者, 良师益友

examples.en: Throughout her medical career, she regarded Dr. Harris as her most influential mentor.
examples.zh: 在她的整个医疗生涯中，她一直将哈里斯医生视为对她影响最大的导师。

lemmas.usage_note: 指在职业、学业或生活中给予指导的有经验者，常与trusted、career等词搭配，书面语常用。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To advise, guide, and train a younger or less experienced person over a period of time.
lemmas.def_zh: 指导，辅导（提供长期建议与培训）

examples.en: Senior engineers are encouraged to mentor junior colleagues within the team.
examples.zh: 公司鼓励资深工程师在团队内部指导年轻同事。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作及物动词，接初学者、学生等作宾语，表示指导、辅导其成长，多用于职场和教育语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自《荷马史诗》中受托辅导奥德修斯之子的智者门托（Mentor），引申为导师。

lemmas.def_en: a large artillery gun that is usually on wheels
lemmas.def_zh: 大炮, 加农炮

examples.en: The old fortress was defended by several massive iron cannons mounted on the walls.
examples.zh: 这座古老的堡垒由架设在城墙上的几门巨型铁炮把守。

lemmas.usage_note: 指重型旧式大炮或飞机机关炮，复数既可为cannon也可为cannons，多用于军事或历史语境。

lemmas.def_en: a serviceman in the artillery
lemmas.def_zh: 炮手

examples.en: The experienced cannoneer carefully adjusted the angle of the heavy artillery piece.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的炮手仔细调整了重炮的角度。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ into/against) (chiefly British) To collide violently with something or someone, especially while moving fast and rebounding. 2. [I] (billiards) To hit two balls in succession.
lemmas.def_zh: （疾行中猛烈地）撞击，相撞；（台球中）击中两球得分

examples.en: The runaway car cannoned into the storefront, shattering the glass completely.
examples.zh: 失控的汽车猛烈撞击了店面，将玻璃彻底撞碎。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与into连用，表示猛烈撞击或疾冲过去；亦可指用重炮轰击，多具动态或文学色彩。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 canna（管子、芦苇），原指大管状火炮，引申为猛撞。

lemmas.def_en: a particular environment or walk of life
lemmas.def_zh: 球, 球面, 球体, 天体, 地球仪, 范围

examples.en: Her achievements in the public sphere made her a role model for young women.
examples.zh: 她在公共领域取得的成就使她成为年轻女性的楷模。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指几何球体，也广泛引申为领域、范围，高频搭配如sphere of influence（势力范围）。

lemmas.def_en: the roundness of a 3-dimensional object
lemmas.def_zh: 球状, 球形

examples.en: The modern instrument measured the precise sphericity of the polished glass lens.
examples.zh: 这台现代仪器测量了抛光玻璃透镜的精确球度。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to spheres or resembling a sphere
lemmas.def_zh: 球的, 球面的, 球状的, 天体的

examples.en: Planets naturally adopt a spherical shape under the pull of their gravity.
examples.zh: 行星在自身重力的吸引下自然呈球状。

lemmas.def_en: having the shape of a sphere or ball; ; ; - Zane Grey
lemmas.def_zh: 球的, 球状的, 球面的, 球形的, 天体的

examples.en: Astronomers calculated the precise spheric coordinates of the distant glowing celestial body.
examples.zh: 天文学家计算出了那个遥远发光天体的精确球面坐标。

lemmas.def_en: in a spherical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 球状地, 球地

examples.en: The optical sensor was shaped spherically to capture light from every direction.
examples.zh: 该光学传感器呈球形，以捕捉来自各个方向的光线。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 sphaira（球体），引申指范围或领域。

lemmas.def_en: the cook on a ranch or at a camp
lemmas.def_zh: 家常小甜饼, 饼干, 普通小饼, 巨型炸弹, (非正式)(女)厨师, 厨师助手

examples.en: Grandma gave each child a sweet chocolate cooky fresh from the oven.
examples.zh: 奶奶给每个孩子分了一块刚出炉的香甜巧克力饼干。

lemmas.usage_note: cookie 的变体拼写，口语中常用搭配如 bake cookies；在美语俚语中也指人，如 smart cooky。

family_guide.root_logic: cookie的变体拼写，源自荷兰语 koekje（小蛋糕），特指甜饼干。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war
lemmas.def_zh: 俘虏, 迷恋者

examples.en: The soldiers were taken as captives and held in a remote prison camp.
examples.zh: 士兵们沦为俘虏，被关押在一个偏远的战俘营中。

lemmas.usage_note: 指战俘、被绑架者或被关押的动物，常与take/hold someone captive（囚禁某人）形成词组关联。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being imprisoned
lemmas.def_zh: 囚禁, 被关

examples.en: Giant pandas born in captivity often struggle to adapt to the wild.
examples.zh: 在人工圈养环境下出生的大熊猫往往很难适应野外生存。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指被囚禁、关押的状态，尤常用于动物保护语境中，如in captivity（圈养下）。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being intensely interested (as by awe or terror)
lemmas.def_zh: 迷惑, 着迷, 魅力

examples.en: Her deep captivation with the mystery novel kept her awake all night.
examples.zh: 她对这部悬疑小说的着迷让她整夜未眠。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To attract and hold the attention and affection of someone completely by being charming, beautiful, or delightful.
lemmas.def_zh: 迷住，深深吸引

examples.en: The magician managed to captivate the young audience with his incredible illusions.
examples.zh: 魔术师用他不可思议的幻术成功迷住了年轻的观众。

lemmas.def_en: in a bewitching manner
lemmas.def_zh: captivating的变形

examples.en: The actress smiled captivatingly as she walked onto the brightly lit stage.
examples.zh: 这位女演员走上灯火通明的舞台时，迷人地微笑着。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 capere（抓住、捕获），核心含义为被俘获的。
family_guide.core_distinction: captive 指被俘虏的人，captivity 指被关押或囚禁的状态。

lemmas.def_en: of or being or relating to or involving cognition
lemmas.def_zh: 认知的, 认识的

examples.en: Regular physical exercise can significantly reduce the risk of cognitive decline.
examples.zh: 规律的体育锻炼可以显著降低认知能力下降的风险。

lemmas.usage_note: 学术和心理学核心词，修饰与大脑思维、感知、学习相关的过程，常搭配ability、decline等。

lemmas.def_zh: 察知的, 认识到的, 有认识能力的
lemmas.def_en: (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception

examples.en: was aware of his opponent's hostility
became aware of her surroundings

lemmas.def_en: with regard to cognition
lemmas.def_zh: 认知地

examples.en: The therapist evaluated how cognitively capable the patient was after the stroke.
examples.zh: 治疗师评估了该患者在中风后的认知能力水平。

lemmas.def_zh: 认知, 认识
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (philosophy / psychology) To perceive, recognize, or become consciously aware of an object or truth.

examples.en: Philosophers often debate how human beings actually cognize reality and truth.
examples.zh: 哲学家经常争论人类究竟是如何认知现实与真理的。

lemmas.def_zh: 认识, 察知, 审理
lemmas.def_en: having knowledge of

examples.en: he had no awareness of his mistakes
his sudden consciousness of the problem he faced

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cognoscere（认识、了解），专指认知相关的心理过程。

lemmas.def_en: large tough nonrigid bag filled with gas or heated air
lemmas.def_zh: 气球

examples.en: The children released dozens of colorful balloons into the clear blue sky.
examples.zh: 孩子们将几十只五颜六色的气球放飞到湛蓝的天空中。

lemmas.usage_note: 指充气玩具气球或热气球，常与hot-air搭配，也见于漫画中的对话框（speech balloon）。

lemmas.def_en: someone who flies a balloon
lemmas.def_zh: 驾驶/操纵气球的人

examples.en: An experienced balloonist checked the wind conditions carefully before the morning flight.
examples.zh: 经验丰富热气球驾驶员在晨飞前仔细检查了风况。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To increase very rapidly in amount, degree, or size. 2. [I] To swell out like a balloon.
lemmas.def_zh: 急剧增加，激增；膨胀如气球

examples.en: The company's debt ballooned to over ten million dollars within just two years.
examples.zh: 在短短两年内，该公司的债务急剧膨胀至超过一千万美元。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，比喻债务、开支、人口等在短时间内急剧激增或膨胀，常用于经济及新闻报道。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自意大利语 palla（球），加放大后缀变为大球体，引申指像气球一样膨胀激增。

lemmas.def_en: a rectangular piece of absorbent cloth (or paper) for drying or wiping
lemmas.def_zh: 手巾, 毛巾

examples.en: Please hang the wet towel on the rack so it can dry properly.
examples.zh: 请把湿毛巾挂在架子上，以便晾干。

lemmas.usage_note: 指吸水用的毛巾或浴巾，搭配如bath towel（浴巾）、paper towel（厨房纸巾），日常口语高频。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (often towel down/off) To dry or wipe yourself, someone else, or an object using a towel.
lemmas.def_zh: 用毛巾擦干，用毛巾擦拭

examples.en: After taking a quick shower, he toweled himself dry and dressed in clean clothes.
examples.zh: 快速冲了个澡后，他用毛巾擦干身体，换上了干净的衣服。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与down/off或反身代词连用（如towel oneself dry），表示用毛巾擦干身体或某物表面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心语义为吸水的抹布或毛巾。

lemmas.def_en: a fissure in the earth's crust (or in the surface of some other planet) through which molten lava and gases erupt
lemmas.def_zh: n. 火山

examples.en: The active volcano erupted suddenly, spewing lava and dense ash into the air.
examples.zh: 那座活火山突然喷发，将熔岩和浓厚的火山灰喷射到空中。

lemmas.usage_note: 指地质学上的火山，常与active（活）、dormant（休眠）、erupt（喷发）等词搭配，可用作隐喻。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or produced by or consisting of volcanoes
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 火山的；由火山引起的

examples.en: The fertile soil in this valley is formed mainly from weathered volcanic rock.
examples.zh: 该山谷肥沃的土壤主要由风化的火山岩形成。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指火山产生的或具有火山性质的，常修饰ash（灰）、eruption（爆发）、rock（岩石）等名词。

lemmas.def_en: by or like volcanoes
lemmas.def_zh: 火山似地, 激烈地, 猛烈地

examples.en: The island is volcanically active and features several bubbling natural hot springs.
examples.zh: 该岛屿火山活动频繁，拥有好几处冒泡的天然温泉。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗马火神Vulcan，核心指喷发熔岩与气体的火山及相关现象。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make a high sound by forcing air through your lips or teeth, or by blowing a whistle. 2. [I] To move quickly making a sharp sound like a whistle.
lemmas.def_zh: 吹口哨，鸣笛；呼啸，发尖锐声

examples.en: The cold wind began to whistle through the narrow cracks in the window frame.
examples.zh: 寒风开始顺着窗框的狭窄缝隙呼啸而过。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词，表示人吹口哨、风呼啸或器具鸣叫；及物动词时常搭配曲调名称。

lemmas.def_en: United States painter (1834-1903)
lemmas.def_zh: 吹口哨的人, 发啸声的东西

examples.en: The cheerful whistler walked down the street, entertaining passersby with his catchy tunes.
examples.zh: 那个快乐的吹口哨者走在街上，用悦耳的曲调吸引着路人。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟空气穿过窄缝时发出的高亢锐鸣。

lemmas.def_en: an arc of colored light in the sky caused by refraction of the sun's rays by rain
lemmas.def_zh: n. 彩虹

examples.en: A brilliant rainbow appeared after the summer storm cleared.
examples.zh: 夏日暴风雨过后，天空中出现了一道绚丽的彩虹。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见搭配 chase rainbows（追求不切实际的幻想）；可作修饰语，如 rainbow nation/coalition。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词 rain（雨）+ bow（弓），指雨后天空出现的弓形彩色光弧。

lemmas.def_en: an auxiliary activity
lemmas.def_zh: n. 业余爱好，嗜好

examples.en: Gardening has become her favorite weekend hobby.
examples.zh: 园艺已成为她周末最喜欢的业余爱好。

lemmas.usage_note: 指业余爱好，动词常搭 pursue/take up a hobby；注意中式英语中勿将 work/study 误归为 hobby。

lemmas.def_en: a person who pursues an activity in their spare time for pleasure
lemmas.def_zh: 有业余癖好者

examples.en: As an amateur hobbyist, he spends weekends building intricate wooden ship models.
examples.zh: 作为业余爱好者，他周末都在制作精细的木制帆船模型。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自指称矮种马的代词，引申为木马玩具，最终演变为占据闲暇时间的业余爱好。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To send someone or something quickly to a particular destination for a specific purpose. 2. [T] (formal) To deal with a task promptly; to kill a person or animal.
lemmas.def_zh: 派遣，调遣；发出（信件等）；迅速处理；杀死

examples.en: The headquarters decided to dispatch emergency medical supplies to the affected area immediately.
examples.zh: 总部决定立即向受灾地区调遣紧急医疗物资。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，表示迅速派遣人或发送货物，常与 to 或 towards 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: an official report (usually sent in haste)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 急件；快信；官方报告

examples.en: The war correspondent sent an urgent dispatch describing the frontline situation.
examples.zh: 那位战地记者发回了一份描述前线局势的紧急快信。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指正式公文、战地急件，或指行事的“迅速”，常用于 with dispatch 这一固定书面短语中。

lemmas.def_en: the official who signals the beginning of a race or competition
lemmas.def_zh: 发送者, 配车员, 调度员

examples.en: The emergency dispatcher calmly sent the nearest ambulance to the accident site.
examples.zh: 紧急调度员镇定地派遣距离事故现场最近的救护车前往救援。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（离开）+ 词根指脚镣（释放使行），核心指迅速派遣或处置。

lemmas.def_en: a band that fits around the neck and is usually folded over
lemmas.def_zh: n. 衣领；颈圈

examples.en: He attached the engraved identification tag securely to the dog's leather collar.
examples.zh: 他把刻有名字的身份牌牢牢系在狗的皮质颈圈上。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指衣领或动物项圈，常用于 blue-collar 或 white-collar 等复合搭配中。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To catch and arrest a suspect or criminal. 2. [T] (informal) To stop someone and make them listen or talk to you.
lemmas.def_zh: 逮捕，捉拿；拦截（某人与之说话）

examples.en: Undercover detectives managed to collar the suspected shoplifter outside the department store.
examples.zh: 便衣刑警成功在百货商店外抓获了那名涉嫌行窃的人。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式及物动词，常指警方逮捕抓获罪犯，或抓抓某人迫使其与自己谈话。

lemmas.def_en: without a collar
lemmas.def_zh: 无领的, 无轭/颈圈的

examples.en: He wore a stylish collarless linen shirt to the relaxed beach wedding.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件时髦的无领亚麻衬衫去参加轻松的海滩婚礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 collum（脖子），指套在颈部的物品或动作（如揪住领口逮捕）。

lemmas.def_en: able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 相容的；兼容的；合得来的

examples.en: This new software update is not fully compatible with older operating systems.
examples.zh: 这个新的软件更新并不完全兼容较旧的操作系统。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 with 搭配，形容设备、软件相互兼容，或指人际关系合得来、理念相容。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of sympathetic understanding
lemmas.def_zh: n. 兼容性；适应性；相容

examples.en: The engineers conducted extensive tests to ensure the compatibility of the two devices.
examples.zh: 工程师们进行了广泛测试，以确保这两台设备之间的兼容性。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指技术设备的互换性与兼容度，也可指性格匹配，常与 between 或 with 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（共同）+ pati（承受），指两者能够共同相处、共存而不冲突。

lemmas.def_en: the act of receiving
lemmas.def_zh: n. 收据，发票；收到

examples.en: Please keep the printed sales receipt if you wish to exchange the item later.
examples.zh: 如果您以后想要更换商品，请保留好打印的销售收据。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示购物小票或发票时可数；表示“收到”抽象概念时不可数，常用于 on/upon receipt of 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To mark a bill or invoice as paid, or to write or issue an official receipt acknowledging payment or receipt of goods.
lemmas.def_zh: 开具收据，在（账单等上）注明已收到或已付讫；确认收到

examples.en: The accounts department properly receipted the invoice after payment was confirmed.
examples.zh: 在确认收到付款后，财务部门在发票上盖章并出具了收条。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式商业及物动词，主要指在账单或发票上签名盖章以证明款项已清，常以被动形式出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 recipere（收到），核心指收到物品的行为或书面凭据。

lemmas.def_en: (mathematics) a rectangular array of quantities or expressions set out by rows and columns; treated as a single element and manipulated according to rules
lemmas.def_zh: 矩阵

examples.en: She learned how to multiply two matrices in linear algebra.
examples.zh: 她在线性代数课上学习了两个矩阵相乘。

lemmas.usage_note: 矩阵

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 mater（母亲），指孕育、包容或发展事物的母体、模型或二维网格。

lemmas.def_en: understanding of the nature or meaning or quality or magnitude of something
lemmas.def_zh: n. 欣赏；感激；升值

examples.en: I would like to express my deep appreciation for your continuous support.
examples.zh: 我想对你一贯的支持表达深深的感激。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“感激”时常与 for 连用，如 express appreciation for；亦可表示艺术鉴赏或资产升值（appreciation of currency）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ pretium（价值），指对某事物价值的理解、感激或价值增长。

lemmas.def_en: a small nail
lemmas.def_zh: n. 细平头钉，小钉

examples.en: He secured the picture frame with several small brads.
examples.zh: 他用几枚细平头钉固定住了画框。

lemmas.usage_note: 专门的技术或木工用语，指“小无头钉/平头细钉”，常与 brad nailer（打钉枪）搭配使用，日常口语中极少出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古斯堪的纳维亚语，特指细长且扁头的小钉子。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than ten
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 十一的

examples.en: The store closes at eleven o'clock every evening.
examples.zh: 这家店每天晚上十一点关门。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰可数名词复数，后接名词时注意“at the eleventh hour”为极高频习语，意为“在最后关头”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语，核心逻辑为“十之后剩下一个”（one left over）。

lemmas.def_en: being one more than ten
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 罗马数字十一的（常作XI）；希腊字母第14个的

examples.en: Chapter XI provides a detailed analysis of the experiment results.
examples.zh: 第十一章对实验结果进行了详细分析。

lemmas.usage_note: 指希腊字母表的第14个字母（Ξ/ξ），作定语时多见于数学、物理、化学等专业公式或科学命名中，日常极罕用。

family_guide.root_logic: 直接借自希腊字母表的第14个字母 Ξ / ξ，用于符号或计数表示“十一”。

lemmas.def_en: a three-dimensional work of plastic art
lemmas.def_zh: n. 雕塑；雕刻品

examples.en: The museum acquired a massive bronze sculpture created by a local modern artist.
examples.zh: 该博物馆收藏了一座由当地现代艺术家创作的巨大青铜雕塑。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词指具体的雕刻作品，作不可数名词指雕塑这门艺术形式或技艺。

lemmas.def_en: an artist who creates sculptures
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻家

examples.en: The talented sculptor spent several months carving the statue from white marble.
examples.zh: 这位天才雕刻家花了数月时间用汉白玉雕刻这尊雕像。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To carve, cast, or shape a material into a three-dimensional work of art.
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻，雕塑

examples.en: The craftsman used a chisel to sculpture a graceful human figure out of solid marble.
examples.zh: 手艺人用凿子从整块大理石中雕刻出一个优雅的人物形象。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 from 或 out of 搭配，指用木石等雕塑成形，亦可用于被动语态形容地貌塑造。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to create a three-dimensional figure or object by carving or shaping material. 2. [T] to shape or form something carefully to give it a particular contour
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻，塑造；使具有特定外形

examples.en: The artist spent three months sculpting a bust out of marble.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家花了三个月时间用大理石雕刻了一座半身像。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or consisting of sculpture
lemmas.def_zh: 雕刻的, 雕刻般的

examples.en: The modern building features sculptural curves that catch the sunlight at sunset.
examples.zh: 这座现代建筑具有雕塑般的优美曲线，在日落时分能折射阳光。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sculpere（雕刻），指通过削减、塑形创造立体造型艺术。

lemmas.def_en: impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 看不见的，无形的

examples.en: Microorganisms in the water sample are invisible without the aid of a microscope.
examples.zh: 水样中的微生物如果不用显微镜是肉眼看不见的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作表语或定语，常与 to 搭配（如 invisible to the naked eye），指视觉看不见的或隐形的。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of not being perceivable by the eye
lemmas.def_zh: 看不见, 难觉察的, 看不见的东西

examples.en: Scientists are developing metamaterials that might one day provide true optical invisibility.
examples.zh: 科学家正在研发超材料，有朝一日或许能实现真正的光学隐形。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（无/不）+ visible（看得见的），核心指超出视觉感知范围的。

lemmas.def_en: the bill in a restaurant
lemmas.def_zh: n. 标签，小凸出物；（浏览器）标签页；账单

examples.en: Keep a running tab of your business expenses during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行期间请随时记录你的商务开支账单。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中极常用于 keep tabs on（密切监视/关注）和 pick up the tab（买单）；在电脑界面中则指“标签页”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自小布条或标签，引申为凸出小片、标签页及账单。

lemmas.def_en: clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing
lemmas.def_zh: n. 配件，附件；从犯

examples.en: A silk scarf is the perfect accessory to complete an outfit.
examples.zh: 丝巾是完善整套穿搭的完美配饰。

lemmas.usage_note: 时尚语境中常作复数 accessories 指配饰；法律正式语境中指从犯，常与介词 to 搭配（accessory to murder）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语accedere（靠近、附随），指附属于主要事物的次要物件或从犯。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To shake continuously with very small, rapid movements, or to cause something to do so.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）振动，（使）颤动

examples.en: The heavy trucks rumbled down the highway, causing the floorboards to vibrate violently.
examples.zh: 重型卡车呼啸着驶过公路，震得地板剧烈晃动。

lemmas.usage_note: 兼作及物和不及物动词，描述机械物理振动、声音共鸣或手机静音震动等动作状态。

lemmas.def_en: the act of vibrating
lemmas.def_zh: n. 振动，颤动；心灵感应，氛围

examples.en: The sensitive detector registered a slight mechanical vibration inside the engine compartment.
examples.zh: 灵敏的探测器记录到了发动机舱内发生的轻微机械振动。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理层面多指振动和摆动；复数形式 vibrations（口语常作 vibes）可指周围氛围或感应。

lemmas.def_en: a mechanical device that vibrates
lemmas.def_zh: 振动装置, 振动器, 振动按摩器

examples.en: Construction workers use a concrete vibrator to remove trapped air from the mixture.
examples.zh: 建筑工人使用混凝土振动器来排出混合物中的滞留空气。

lemmas.def_en: having the character of a loud deep sound; the quality of being resonant
lemmas.def_zh: 振动, 振响, 活力

examples.en: The market is known for its cultural vibrancy and wide variety of street foods.
examples.zh: 该集市以其文化活力和种类繁多的街头小吃而闻名。

lemmas.def_zh: 振动的, 战栗的, 响亮的, 活跃的
lemmas.def_en: vigorous and animated

examples.en: The downtown area has developed into a vibrant cultural hub filled with galleries and cafes.
examples.zh: 市中心已发展成为一个画廊和咖啡馆林立、充满活力的文化中心。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于褒义修饰语，形容颜色鲜艳明亮、声音洪亮或城市、社群充满活力生机。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characterized by vibration
lemmas.def_zh: 振动的

examples.en: Engineers measured the vibrational impact of passing trains on the bridge's foundation.
examples.zh: 工程师们测量了过往列车对桥梁地基造成的振动影响。

lemmas.def_zh: 振动的, 振动性的
lemmas.def_en: moving very rapidly to and fro or up and down

examples.en: The workers used heavy vibratory equipment to compact the loose soil quickly.
examples.zh: 工人们使用重型振动设备迅速压实了松散的土壤。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语vibrare（摇摆、颤动），核心表物理上的快速往复移动。
family_guide.core_distinction: vibrate为动词振动；vibration为名词振动状态或感应。

lemmas.def_en: a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
lemmas.def_zh: 自行车

examples.en: She parked her road bicycle outside the library and locked it securely to the metal rack.
examples.zh: 她把公路自行车停在图书馆外，并把它牢牢锁在金属车架上。

lemmas.usage_note: 普通可数名词，指两轮自行车，常与 ride, mount 或 dismount 等动词搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a person who rides a bicycle
lemmas.def_zh: 骑自行车者, 骑脚踏车者

examples.en: The alert bicyclist wore a reflective vest while riding through the city traffic.
examples.zh: 机警的骑车人穿上反光背心在城市的车流中穿行。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to ride a bicycle.
lemmas.def_zh: 骑自行车出行

examples.en: They decided to bicycle through the scenic mountain trails during the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 他们决定在暑假期间骑自行车穿行于风景如画的山间小路上。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作不及物动词表示骑自行车出行，后面常接方向或目的地介词短语（如 along, to）。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀bi-（双、两）+ cycle（轮、圆），指由两个轮子驱动的自行车。
family_guide.core_distinction: bicycle作名词指自行车，作动词指骑自行车这一动作。

lemmas.def_en: a tract of land used for burials
lemmas.def_zh: n. 墓地，公墓

examples.en: Fresh flowers were laid gently on the tombstone in the cemetery.
examples.zh: 墓地里的墓碑上轻轻摆放着鲜花。

lemmas.usage_note: 指远离教堂的大型公共墓地；常与 lie in 或 bury in 连用，注意与专指教堂附属墓地的 graveyard 区分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语koimeterion（睡觉的地方），委婉引申为逝者安息的公墓。

lemmas.def_en: equipment designed to serve a specific function
lemmas.def_zh: n. 设置，配置；体制；圈套，陷阱

examples.en: The new studio setup allows for high-quality audio recording.
examples.zh: 新录音室的配置能够实现高品质的音频录制。

lemmas.usage_note: 指系统结构、配置或“圈套”；常作 a perfect setup 搭配，注意名词连写，动词短语则须分写为 set up。

family_guide.root_logic: 由短语动词set up（竖立、布置）复合而成的名词，指结构、配置或圈套。

lemmas.def_en: a general summary of a subject
lemmas.def_zh: n. 概况，概述，总览

examples.en: The introductory chapter provides a broad overview of modern genetics.
examples.zh: 导言章节对现代遗传学进行了宏观概述。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，常用搭配 provide/give an overview of sth.，指对事物作宏观概括，介词固定用 of。

family_guide.root_logic: over（从上方）+ view（看），意为从高处纵览，即概观、总览。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous small and pulpy edible fruits; used as desserts or in making jams and jellies and preserves
lemmas.def_zh: 浆果

examples.en: The children spent the warm afternoon collecting every ripe berry they could find in the woods.
examples.zh: 孩子们在温暖的下午采摘了他们在树林里能找到的所有成熟浆果。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，多指草莓、蓝莓等浆果，常作复数使用，高频搭配 pick berries（摘浆果）。

lemmas.def_zh: 【植物学】；聚合果，浆果(如木莓、草莓和黑莓等)

examples.en: A lush berrier such as the wild raspberry produces clusters of juicy drupelets.
examples.zh: 像野生覆盆子这样繁茂的聚合果植物，能结出一串串多汁的小核果。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To gather or look for wild berries. 2. [I] (botany) To produce or yield berries.
lemmas.def_zh: 采摘浆果；（植物）结浆果

examples.en: Every autumn, local villagers would berry in the nearby hills to prepare homemade jam.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，当地村民都会去附近的山丘上采浆果，用来制作自制果酱。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，指去野外采摘浆果的活动，常用于 go berrying 短语或作进行时态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，原指小粒浆果，引申出采集浆果之意。
family_guide.core_distinction: berry作名词指浆果；作动词指采集浆果。

lemmas.def_en: tall woody perennial grasses with hollow slender stems especially of the genera Arundo and Phragmites
lemmas.def_zh: n. 芦苇；（乐器的）簧片

examples.en: The sound of the wind rustling through the tall reeds by the lake was calming.
examples.zh: 风吹过湖边高高芦苇的沙沙声让人平静。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指水边丛生的“芦苇”，亦指管乐器的“簧片”，多用于自然描写或音乐语境中。

lemmas.def_en: having a tone of a reed instrument
lemmas.def_zh: 芦苇丛生的, 芦苇做的, 芦苇状的

examples.en: A flock of wild ducks settled quietly in the reedy shallows of the river.
examples.zh: 一群野鸭在河中芦苇丛生的浅滩处静静栖息。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自原始日耳曼语，指生长在水边的芦苇植物，引申为乐器的簧片。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. (internet) To post deliberately offensive or provocative messages online to upset people and cause arguments. 2. To fish by trailing a baited line behind a boat
lemmas.def_zh: （在网上）发挑衅言论，故意引战；拖钓

examples.en: Some anonymous users joined the forum solely to troll the regular members.
examples.zh: 一些匿名用户加入论坛纯粹是为了恶意挑衅常驻成员。

lemmas.usage_note: 互联网语境常用动词，指故意发表煽动或挑衅性言论以激怒他人，常后接宾语或用作不及物动词。

lemmas.def_en: a fisherman who uses a hook and line
lemmas.def_zh: 轮唱者, 小钓船

examples.en: The wooden troller set out before dawn to catch fresh salmon near the coast.
examples.zh: 那艘木制小钓船在黎明前出发，去近海捕捞新鲜三文鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语神话怪物，现代互联网中引申为故意挑衅、钓鱼引发争吵的行为。

lemmas.def_en: the environment as it relates to living organisms
lemmas.def_zh: n. 生态学；生态，生态系统

examples.en: Pollution from local factories poses a serious threat to the coastal ecology.
examples.zh: 当地工厂造成的污染对沿海生态构成了严重威胁。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“生态学”或某一区域的“生态环境”，常与 marine、forest 等词搭配用于学术或环保语境。

lemmas.def_en: a biologist who studies the relation between organisms and their environment
lemmas.def_zh: 生态学者

examples.en: The ecologist spent five years observing the seasonal migration patterns of local birds.
examples.zh: 这位生态学者花了五年时间观察当地鸟类的季节性迁徙规律。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by the interdependence of living organisms in an environment
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 生态的，生态学的

examples.en: Deforestation in this region has caused severe ecological damage over the past decade.
examples.zh: 该地区的森林滥伐在过去十年中造成了严重的生态破坏。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语修饰名词，常见搭配包括 ecological balance（生态平衡）、disaster（灾难）等。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by the interdependence of living organisms in an environment
lemmas.def_zh: 生态的, 生态学的

examples.en: Excessive deforestation has disturbed the delicate ecologic balance of the entire tropical basin.
examples.zh: 过度砍伐森林扰乱了整个热带盆地脆弱的生态平衡。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to ecology
lemmas.def_zh: 从生态学的观点看

examples.en: The new resort was designed to operate ecologically without harming the surrounding wetlands.
examples.zh: 新度假村的设计旨在以环保的生态方式运营，且不破坏周边湿地。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根eco-（家园、住所）+ -logy（学科），原指对生物“家园”的研究，即生态学。
family_guide.core_distinction: ecology为生态学名词；ecological为其派生形容词。

lemmas.def_en: closely and firmly united or packed together
lemmas.def_zh: 紧凑的, 紧密的, 简洁的

examples.en: The apartment is small but has a remarkably compact and efficient design.
examples.zh: 这套公寓虽然不大，但设计非常紧凑实用。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容物体体积小而紧凑、空间利用率高，或文字结构简练，常修饰 car、camera、design 等。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To press something firmly together so that it becomes dense, solid, and tightly packed.
lemmas.def_zh: 压实，夯实，压缩

examples.en: Heavy rollers were used to compact the gravel before laying down the asphalt.
examples.zh: 在铺设沥青之前，重型压路机被用来压实碎石。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词指“压实、压缩”土壤、废弃物等，不及物动词表示物体自身变紧实，常用于工艺或工程语境。

lemmas.def_en: an increase in the density of something
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 压缩, 浓缩, 精简, 简缩

examples.en: Excessive soil compaction from farm machinery prevents crop roots from absorbing rainwater effectively.
examples.zh: 农用机械造成的过度土壤压实阻碍了农作物根系有效吸收雨水。

lemmas.def_en: the spatial property of being crowded together
lemmas.def_zh: 紧密, 紧密度, 简洁, 坚实

examples.en: I love the compactness of this laptop, which easily fits into my small backpack.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这款笔记本电脑的小巧紧凑，可以轻松放进我的小背包里。

lemmas.def_en: in a compact manner or state
lemmas.def_zh: 紧密地, 简洁地

examples.en: She packed her clothes so compactly that everything fit into a single small suitcase.
examples.zh: 她把衣服收拾得非常紧凑，所有东西都装进了一个小手提箱里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 compact 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ice crystals forming a white deposit (especially on objects outside)
lemmas.def_zh: 霜, 冰冻, 冷漠

examples.en: A thick layer of white frost covered the lawn on that freezing morning.
examples.zh: 在那个冰冷的早晨，一层厚厚的白霜覆盖了草坪。

lemmas.usage_note: 可表示自然现象“霜”或“严寒天气”，常见搭配如 severe frost（严霜）、sharp frost。

lemmas.def_en: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain
lemmas.def_zh: 霜冻的, 严寒的, 冷淡的

examples.en: He blew into his cold hands to warm them up on that frosty winter morning.
examples.zh: 在那个严寒的冬日早晨，他对着冰冷的手哈气取暖。

lemmas.def_en: (of glass) lacking a frosted coating
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 糖霜

examples.en: She prefers to bake unfrosted carrot cakes because they contain much less sugar.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢烤不裹糖霜的胡萝卜蛋糕，因为含糖量要少得多。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. to become covered with frost, or cover something with ice crystals. 2. [T] to cover a cake or baked goods with icing.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）结霜，（使）覆上霜；（在糕点上）涂糖霜

examples.en: The car windows began to frost over as the temperature dropped rapidly.
examples.zh: 随着气温骤降，汽车车窗开始结起了一层霜。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于气象或日常语境，指表面“结霜”；在烘焙中也可指“给蛋糕涂糖霜”，多与 over 或 up 连用。

lemmas.def_en: without warmth or enthusiasm
lemmas.def_zh: 寒冷地, 冷漠地; 冷峻地

examples.en: The store manager stared frostily at the unruly customers without uttering a single word.
examples.zh: 店经理冷冷地盯着不讲理的顾客，一句话也没说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a positive feeling of liking
lemmas.def_zh: 喜爱，钟爱，关爱

examples.en: She felt a deep affection for the small town where she had grown up.
examples.zh: 她对自己长大的那座小镇怀有深厚的感情。

lemmas.usage_note: 表温柔的喜爱或爱慕，常与介词 for 或 towards 搭配，也常用于 have/feel affection for 短语。

lemmas.def_en: having or displaying warmth or affection
lemmas.def_zh: 表示关爱的，深情的

examples.en: She gave her granddaughter an affectionate hug before leaving.
examples.zh: 临走前，她深情地拥抱了孙女。

lemmas.def_en: lacking affection or warm feeling
lemmas.def_zh: 缺乏爱的, 没有感情的

examples.en: His quiet and unaffectionate demeanor often made people think he was aloof and distant.
examples.zh: 他沉默且缺乏热情的举止常让人觉得他冷漠疏远。

lemmas.def_en: with affection
lemmas.def_zh: 充满深情地，亲切地

examples.en: He was affectionately known by his colleagues as 'the Professor'.
examples.zh: 同事们亲切地称他为“教授”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 affectio（心灵受影响、倾向），引申为由内心自然生出的温和持久的喜爱与关怀。
family_guide.core_distinction: 注意区分 affection（喜爱、钟爱）与 affectation（做作、矫揉造作），二者词源相关但语义迥异。

lemmas.def_en: art highly prized for its beauty or perfection
lemmas.def_zh: n. 宝石；宝物，精品，受人喜爱的人

examples.en: The small local museum is an absolute gem, hidden away in the old quarter.
examples.zh: 这家位于老城区隐蔽角落的本地小博物馆绝对是一块瑰宝。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为宝石，比喻义极常用，搭配 a hidden gem 指“鲜为人知的宝藏地或佳作”，多用于旅游与文艺评价。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 gemma（宝石、嫩芽），核心语义指珍贵的宝石，引申指极好的人或物。

lemmas.def_en: a portable gun
lemmas.def_zh: 枪支；火器

examples.en: Strict background checks are required before anyone can purchase a firearm.
examples.zh: 任何人在购买枪支前都必须接受严格的背景审查。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律与官方语体中常作复数 firearms，指便携式枪支，常见搭配如 discharge a firearm 或 illegal firearms。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 fire（开火/火药）+ arm（武器）组成的复合词，指利用火药爆炸力发射弹丸的轻武器。

lemmas.def_en: a special loved one
lemmas.def_zh: 心爱的人，亲爱的；宠儿

examples.en: She has always been the darling of the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 她一直以来都是时尚界的宠儿。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语中用作爱称（亲爱的），或指广受欢迎的人或物，常用于 media darling、the darling of the stock market 等搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 deorling，由 dear（亲爱的）加上表示小称或属性的后缀 -ling 构成，核心意义是“挚爱的人或物”。

lemmas.def_en: either of two soft fleshy milk-secreting glandular organs on the chest of a woman
lemmas.def_zh: 山雀, 打击, 轻佻女人, 奶头, 按钮

examples.en: A small blue tit perched on the feeder and quickly snatched a sunflower seed.
examples.zh: 一只小蓝山雀落在喂鸟器上，迅速叼走了一粒葵花籽。

lemmas.usage_note: 鸟类学中指山雀；口语习语 tit for tat（以牙还牙）极高频；亦为极其粗俗的俚语，指乳房或蠢人，正式场合须严避。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tit 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the pure mathematics of points and lines and curves and surfaces
lemmas.def_zh: n. 几何学；几何结构，几何形状

examples.en: The architect incorporated the complex geometry of Islamic patterns into the building.
examples.zh: 建筑师将伊斯兰图案中复杂的几何形状融入了该建筑。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，既指数学学科“几何学”，也可指物体表面的“几何形态或布局”，学术与设计领域常用。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by simple geometric forms in design and decoration
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 几何（学）的；几何图案的

examples.en: The modern rug features bold geometric patterns that catch everyone's eye.
examples.zh: 这条现代地毯有着醒目的几何图案，吸引了所有人的目光。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 patterns、shapes、design 等名词，表示“几何图形的”或按几何规则排列的特征。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or determined by geometry
lemmas.def_zh: 几何学的, 几何的

examples.en: The modern art museum features striking geometrical patterns painted across its wide ceilings.
examples.zh: 这座现代艺术博物馆的宽阔天花板上绘有引人注目的几何图案。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to geometry
lemmas.def_zh: 用几何学, 几何学上

examples.en: The company's digital user base began to grow geometrically after the new app release.
examples.zh: 新应用发布后，该公司的数字用户群开始呈几何级数增长。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 geo-（土地）+ -metry（测量），本义为测地术，后引申为研究空间、形状和大小的数学分支几何学。

lemmas.def_en: (physics and chemistry) the simplest structural unit of an element or compound
lemmas.def_zh: n. 分子；微粒，微量

examples.en: A single molecule of water consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。

lemmas.usage_note: 科学术语，指物理或化学意义上的“分子”，常与 water、protein、DNA 等词连用构成复合名词。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or produced by or consisting of molecules
lemmas.def_zh: 分子的, 由分子组成的

examples.en: Scientists study the disease at the molecular level to develop targeted therapies.
examples.zh: 科学家在分子层面上研究这种疾病，以开发靶向疗法。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业学术形容词，常修饰 biology（生物学）、structure（结构）、level（层面）等名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 molecula（小团、微块），由 moles（大块、质量）加指小词缀 -cula 构成，字面即“极微小的块”，后作为科学术语指“分子”。

lemmas.def_en: someone who holds shares of stock in a corporation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 股东，股票持有人

examples.en: The board of directors approved the dividend payout at the annual shareholders' meeting.
examples.zh: 董事会在年度股东大会上批准了股息分红方案。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业正式用语，指股东，常与 value 搭配构成 shareholder value（股东价值），动词常配 bring return to shareholders。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 share（股份、份额）与 holder（持有者）组成的复合词，字面即指“持有公司股份的人”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To force people or animals to leave their home or usual environment. 2. [T] To take the place or position of someone or something; to move something from its usual place.
lemmas.def_zh: 迫使离开原位（或家园）；取代，替代；排开（水）

examples.en: The violent civil conflict has displaced thousands of innocent families from their homes.
examples.zh: 这场暴力的国内冲突已迫使成千上万个无辜家庭背井离乡。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于政经、军事或物理语境，多以被动语态表示“迫使（人）离开家园”或“取代某位置”。

lemmas.def_en: act of taking the place of another especially using underhanded tactics
lemmas.def_zh: n. 移位；迫使离开家园；替代；（物理）位移，排水量

examples.en: The construction of the mega-dam led to the permanent displacement of nearby villagers.
examples.zh: 大型水坝的建设导致附近村民永久背井离乡。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指人口被逐出家园的“流离失所”，也可用于物理学指“位移”或船只的“排水量”，属于较正式书面语。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（去除、离开）+ place（放置），核心逻辑为“使离开原来的位置”，引申出迫使离开家园、取代位置及物理上的排水等。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To transport people, vehicles, or goods regularly by boat or other vehicle, especially across a short distance.
lemmas.def_zh: （乘船或机动车）运送，摆渡；往返运送

examples.en: Small wooden boats ferry daily commuters across the wide river every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 小型木船每十分钟运送一次日常通勤人员穿过这条大河。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指乘渡船或载具摆渡运送人或货物，高频介词搭配为 ferry sb/sth across/between/from... to...。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (rare) To shoe a horse (as a farrier); or to transport by ferry.
lemmas.def_zh: 为（马）钉蹄铁；用渡船运送

examples.en: The experienced ferrier safely transported passengers and their livestock through the turbulent river.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的摆渡人安全地将乘客和他们的牲畜运过了湍急的河流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ferry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person's partner in marriage
lemmas.def_zh: n. 配偶（指夫或妻）

examples.en: Employees may extend their comprehensive health insurance benefits to cover a spouse.
examples.zh: 雇员可以将其全面的健康保险福利扩展到配偶身上。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式且中性的法律与公文用语，指“配偶（丈夫或妻子）”，常用于填表、官方文件或法律条款中。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a wedding
lemmas.def_zh: 结婚的

examples.en: After their messy divorce, the court ordered him to pay substantial spousal support.
examples.zh: 在他们闹得不可开交的离婚案之后，法院责令他支付大笔配偶赡养费。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sponsus（指许下婚约的人），核心指具有法律或正式关系的婚姻伴侣。

lemmas.def_en: a material effigy that is worshipped
lemmas.def_zh: 偶像，崇拜的对象；神像

examples.en: The young singer quickly became a teen idol after her debut album was released.
examples.zh: 首张专辑发行后，这位年轻歌手迅速成为了青少年偶像。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常指受人崇拜的名人或神像，常见搭配如 matinee idol、pop idol 及 make an idol of。

lemmas.def_en: the act of admiring strongly
lemmas.def_zh: 偶像化, 盲目崇拜

examples.en: His unhealthy idolization of pop stars blinded him to their obvious human flaws.
examples.zh: 他对流行歌星盲目的偶像崇拜让他忽视了他们明显的缺点。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To admire, revere, or love someone or something to an excessive degree.
lemmas.def_zh: 把……当作偶像崇拜，极度崇拜

examples.en: Many young athletes idolize the veteran striker and try to copy his style.
examples.zh: 许多年轻运动员把这位老牌前锋当偶像崇拜，并努力模仿他的风格。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 eidolon（形象、幻象），核心语义指被当作神灵顶礼膜拜的“塑像”，后引申为受狂热崇拜的“偶像”。

lemmas.def_en: a score in American football; being in possession of the ball across the opponents' goal line
lemmas.def_zh: （美式橄榄球）达阵

examples.en: The running back broke through the defensive line to score a spectacular touchdown.
examples.zh: 跑卫突破防守线，完成了一记精彩的达阵得分。

lemmas.usage_note: （美式橄榄球）达阵

family_guide.root_logic: 由动词短语 touch down（接触地面）演变为复合名词，核心指“落向地面/触地”，引申为航天器的着陆以及美式橄榄球中的“达阵得分”。

lemmas.def_en: carbon fuel produced by distillation of coal
lemmas.def_zh: 可口可乐, 焦炭

examples.en: Blast furnaces consume large amounts of coke during the iron-smelting process.
examples.zh: 高炉在炼铁过程中会消耗大量的焦炭。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可口可乐简称时首字母常大写；作工业原料焦炭时为不可数名词，冶金工业中极为常用。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to convert coal into coke by heating it in the absence of air, or to undergo this process.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）焦化，（使）成焦炭

examples.en: The residual oil begins to coke rapidly if the furnace temperature exceeds the safe limit.
examples.zh: 如果炉温超过安全极限，渣油就会迅速焦化。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业技术词汇，指煤等原料经高温干馏转化成焦炭，多见于化工、冶金等工业语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自煤炭干馏后的焦炭，现代英语中亦口语化指代可口可乐或可卡因。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the teeth
lemmas.def_zh: 牙齿的

examples.en: Good dental hygiene is essential to prevent cavities and maintain your overall health.
examples.zh: 良好的牙齿卫生对预防蛀牙和保持整体健康至关重要。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于医疗保健搭配，如 dental hygiene（口腔卫生）、dental clinic；注意修饰词性，不可与 tooth 混淆作名词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dens（牙齿），指与牙齿或牙科相关的。

lemmas.def_en: in these times; - Nancy Mitford
lemmas.def_zh: 时下, 现今

examples.en: Nowadays, most people rely on their smartphones for both navigation and daily banking.
examples.zh: 如今，大多数人都依赖智能手机来进行导航和日常银行业务。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作时间状语表现今对比，多放句首或句尾；注意拼写末尾有 s，且只作副词，不能作名词受介词修饰（误用 in nowadays）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 now + a + days 演变而来的复合副词，意为“在现今这些日子里”。

lemmas.def_en: the middle of the day
lemmas.def_zh: 正午, 中午, 全盛期

examples.en: The committee agreed to meet promptly at noon to discuss the project budget.
examples.zh: 委员会同意在正午准时开会，讨论项目预算。

lemmas.usage_note: 固定搭配为 at noon（正午），前面不加冠词 the；较 midday 更口语化，与 at midnight 相对。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nona（第九小时，原指罗马计时的下午三点），后语义前移固定为正午十二点。

lemmas.def_en: a felt hat that is round and hard with a narrow brim
lemmas.def_zh: 德比(英国中部都市), 德比赛马, 大赛马

examples.en: Thousands of excited fans gathered to watch the local football derby this weekend.
examples.zh: 成千上万兴奋的球迷本周末聚在一起观看当地的足球同城德比。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指同城德比赛事（local derby）或德比马赛；英音发音为 /ˈdɑːbi/，美音为 /ˈdɜːrbi/，注意语境差异。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自英国德比伯爵（Earl of Derby）创立的著名赛马会，后引申为同城德比或各类竞技比赛。

lemmas.def_en: an elongated leather strip (or a strip of similar material) for binding things together or holding something in position
lemmas.def_zh: 带, 皮带

examples.en: She adjusted the leather strap of her heavy backpack to relieve the pressure on her shoulder.
examples.zh: 她调整了沉重背包上的皮带，以减轻肩部的压力。

lemmas.usage_note: 指用于固定、捆扎或悬挂的带子，常与 shoulder、watch、safety 等词组合使用。

lemmas.def_en: a woman's garment that exposes the shoulders and has no shoulder straps

examples.en: She chose an elegant silk strapless for the annual charity banquet this evening.
examples.zh: 她为今晚的年度慈善晚宴挑选了一件优雅的丝绸无肩带礼服。

examples.en: The pilot noticed that an unstrapped was shifting dangerously inside the open cargo hold.
examples.zh: 飞行员注意到未系带的物件在敞开的货舱内危险地晃动。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ to/down/into) To fasten, secure, or bind someone or something in place with a strap or belt.
lemmas.def_zh: 用带子捆扎，束牢；用绷带包扎

examples.en: Please make sure your child is properly strapped into the car safety seat before driving.
examples.zh: 开车前请确保您的孩子已被安全带妥善固定在车载安全座椅内。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 to、into 或 down 连用，表示用带子系紧或捆扎，亦常用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unstrap a bag, seatbelt, or helmet means to unfasten the strap holding it.
lemmas.def_zh: 解开...带子

examples.en: You can safely unstrap your seatbelt once the aircraft comes to a complete halt.
examples.zh: 飞机完全停稳后，你就可以安全地解开安全带了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自方言形式，本义为皮带或绑带，后派生为用带子捆扎或固定。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ up) To add coal, wood, or other fuel to a fire or furnace and stir it so it burns brightly. 2. [T] To encourage or stir up strong emotions or ideas.
lemmas.def_zh: 给（炉火等）添加燃料；激起，煽动

examples.en: The politician's provocative remarks only served to stoke racial tensions within the city.
examples.zh: 这位政客煽动性的言论只会加剧城市内部的种族紧张局势。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为给炉火添煤，常引申为激起、煽动情绪或加剧危机，常接 fire、fears、anger 等宾语。

lemmas.def_en: Irish writer of the horror novel about Dracula (1847-1912)
lemmas.def_zh: 司炉, 加煤机, 自动添煤装置

examples.en: The exhausted stoker shoveled endless piles of coal directly into the blazing furnace.
examples.zh: 筋疲力尽的司炉工将无休止的煤堆直接铲入熊熊燃烧的炉膛。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 stoken（添柴烧火），引申为煽动情绪或激化矛盾。

lemmas.def_en: money returned to a payer
lemmas.def_zh: 退款，返还款

examples.en: Customers who are unsatisfied with the product are entitled to a full refund within thirty days.
examples.zh: 对产品不满意的顾客有权在三十天内获得全额退款。

lemmas.usage_note: 退款，返还款

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To give someone their money back, especially because they have returned goods or are dissatisfied with a service.
lemmas.def_zh: 退还（款项），退款给；退款

examples.en: The airline promised to refund the full cost of the tickets after the flight was canceled.
examples.zh: 航班取消后，航空公司承诺退还机票的全额费用。

lemmas.usage_note: 重音在后，表示退还款项，可接双宾语（refund sb money）或搭配 refund money to sb。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（回）+ fund（资金），核心逻辑是“将资金退回”。

lemmas.def_en: a support placed beneath or against something to keep it from shaking or falling
lemmas.def_zh: 支柱, 支持者, 倚靠人, 道具, 螺旋桨

examples.en: The backstage crew carefully arranged every prop before the opening scene began.
examples.zh: 后台工作人员在开幕场景开始前仔细摆放了每一件道具。

lemmas.usage_note: 作可数名词，指物理支撑物、精神支柱，或戏剧电影中的道具，复数 props 尤指舞台道具。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ against/up) To lean an object against something or support it from underneath so it does not fall.
lemmas.def_zh: 支撑，撑住；靠在

examples.en: He had to prop the leaning wooden fence up with several heavy stones.
examples.zh: 他不得不搬来几块沉重的石头把倾斜的木栅栏支撑起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与副词 up 连用（prop up），表示支撑重物，引申为从财政或政治上支持脆弱体制。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为支撑物，引申为戏剧舞台上支撑剧情表演的“道具”，动词意为支撑。

lemmas.def_en: a high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 声望, 威望, 威信

examples.en: Winning the Nobel Prize brought immense academic prestige to the young scientist.
examples.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖为这位年轻科学家带来了巨大的学术声望。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指因成就或地位而享有的极高声望，常与 enjoy、gain、lose、international 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: having an illustrious reputation; respected
lemmas.def_zh: 享有声望的

examples.en: She received an offer from one of the most prestigious law firms in the country.
examples.zh: 她收到了全国最负盛名的律师事务所之一的录用通知。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰具有高声誉、极具影响力的机构、奖项或职位，如 prestigious university/award。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 praestigium（幻术、戏法），后引申为令人敬畏产生的光环、威望。
family_guide.core_distinction: prestige 为名词（威望），prestigious 为其派生形容词（有威望的、声名显赫的）。

lemmas.def_en: kitchen appliance used for baking or roasting
lemmas.def_zh: 烤箱, 灶, 子宫

examples.en: Preheat the oven thoroughly before sliding the cake pan onto the center rack.
examples.zh: 在将蛋糕烤盘滑入中间层烤架之前，请先将烤箱充分预热。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指烤箱，固定搭配 preheat the oven（预热烤箱）、in the oven；注意与 microwave（微波炉）区分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ofen，专指用于烘焙或加热的封闭式烤箱、炉灶。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To become smaller in size or amount, or make something smaller. 2. [I] (+ away/from) To move back or recoil from fear or disgust.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）收缩，（使）缩小；退缩，畏缩

examples.en: Hot water will shrink this wool sweater if you wash it by machine.
examples.zh: 如果用机洗，热水会使这件羊毛衫缩水。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指尺寸或规模的物理收缩，也指畏缩退避（常接 from），过去式常作 shrank，过去分词 shrunk。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] Past tense and past participle of shrink: to become or make smaller; to move back from fear.
lemmas.def_zh: （shrink的过去式及过去分词）变小，缩小；退缩

examples.en: The company's market share has shrunk significantly due to aggressive competition.
examples.zh: 由于激烈的竞争，该公司的市场份额已经大幅缩水。

lemmas.usage_note: shrink 的过去分词（或过去式），多构成完成时态或被动语态，表示尺寸或体量已经缩小。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] Past tense of shrink; became smaller or pulled back.
lemmas.def_zh: 收缩，缩小（shrink 的过去式）

examples.en: The shy boy shrank back into the corner when the stranger entered the room.
examples.zh: 当陌生人走进房间时，那个害羞的男孩退缩到了角落里。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (archaic) Past participle of shrink; having become smaller or shriveled.
lemmas.def_zh: 收缩，缩小（shrink 的过去分词）

examples.en: The old man sat quietly in the armchair, looking frail and shrunken with age.
examples.zh: 老人静静地坐在扶手椅上，因年迈而显得虚弱消瘦。

lemmas.def_en: process or result of becoming less or smaller
lemmas.def_zh: 收缩, 收缩量, 减低

examples.en: The garment company made design adjustments to account for fabric shrinkage after washing.
examples.zh: 服装公司调整了设计，以考虑洗涤后的面料缩水率。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族词根，本义为由于脱水、受冷等原因导致的体积收缩或退缩。

lemmas.def_en: the light horny waterproof structure forming the external covering of birds
lemmas.def_zh: 羽毛

examples.en: The peacock displayed its vibrant feathers to attract a mate in the garden.
examples.zh: 孔雀在花园里展示其色彩鲜艳的羽毛以吸引配偶。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指鸟类的羽毛；常用成语 a feather in one's cap（值得自豪的成就）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to cover, line, or decorate something with feathers. 2. [I, T] to turn an oar blade or propeller edgewise to reduce air or water resistance.
lemmas.def_zh: 用羽毛装饰；长羽毛；（划船等中）转桨（以减少阻力）

examples.en: The corrupt official used his public position to feather his own nest for decades.
examples.zh: 这名贪官几十年来一直利用公职中饱私囊。

lemmas.usage_note: 常见习语 feather one's nest（中饱私囊），亦可指用羽毛装饰或赛艇中转桨叶减少阻力。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or suggesting a feather or feathers
lemmas.def_zh: 生有羽毛的, 柔软如羽毛的

examples.en: The mountain peaks were completely covered by light, feathery snow during the night.
examples.zh: 夜间，山峰完全被轻柔如羽毛般的白雪覆盖了。

lemmas.def_en: having no feathers
lemmas.def_zh: 无羽毛的

examples.en: The mother bird carefully kept her tiny, featherless chicks warm in the nest.
examples.zh: 鸟妈妈在巢中细心守护着幼小无毛的雏鸟，为它们保暖。

lemmas.def_en: having no feathers
lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 零度桨；度桨

examples.en: The pilot quickly adjusted the unfeathered propeller to reduce aerodynamic drag during flight.
examples.zh: 飞行员迅速调整了未顺桨的螺旋桨，以减少飞行中的空气阻力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 feðer（羽毛），动词常用于习语 feather one's nest（中饱私囊）或指用羽毛装饰。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] 1. [I] (+ on) To have an unpleasant, annoying, or harsh effect on someone's nerves, feelings, or senses. 2. [I, T] To shake or jolt forcefully.
lemmas.def_zh: 刺激，使烦躁不适；震撼，颠簸；发出刺耳声

examples.en: The harsh metallic sound of the broken alarm clock jarred on my nerves all morning.
examples.zh: 坏掉的闹钟发出的刺耳金属声让我整个上午都神经紧绷。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 on 搭配，表示发出刺耳的声音让人难受；或指观点、风格等格格不入产生冲突。

lemmas.def_en: a vessel (usually cylindrical) with a wide mouth and without handles
lemmas.def_zh: 广口瓶, 震动, 刺耳声

examples.en: She took a glass jar of homemade strawberry jam out of the cupboard.
examples.zh: 她从橱柜里拿出了一个装有自制草莓酱的玻璃广口瓶。

lemmas.usage_note: 指圆柱形的广口玻璃或陶瓷瓶，亦可引申为剧烈震动、猛撞或刺耳的噪音。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner that jars and irritates
lemmas.def_zh: jar（刺耳的）的变形

examples.en: The modern glass building looked jarringly out of place among the historic houses.
examples.zh: 在这群历史悠久的房屋中，这座现代玻璃建筑显得格格不入。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 刺耳的；不和谐的；令人不悦的
lemmas.def_en: making a harsh, discordant, or irritating sound; having an unpleasant, disturbing effect
lemmas.usage_note: 既可指物理听觉上的刺耳尖锐（如 a jarring noise），也可引申指视觉、风格或氛围上的突兀违和（如 jarring colors）。

examples.en: The bright neon sign was a jarring contrast to the quiet historic street.
examples.zh: 那块明亮的霓虹招牌与古色古香的宁静街道形成了刺眼的对比。

family_guide.root_logic: 本族词源自两个同音不同源的词：一指产生震动与刺耳摩擦声（拟声词源），二指广口容器（源自阿拉伯语）。

lemmas.def_en: a hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers
lemmas.def_zh: 旅馆, 客栈

examples.en: We stayed at a charming old inn located near the quiet village square.
examples.zh: 我们住在安静的乡村广场附近一家迷人的老客栈里。

lemmas.usage_note: 指乡村或路边的小客栈、酒馆，常用于文学语境或特定连锁品牌名，搭配如 stay at an inn。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语固有词，原指“住所、家”，后专指供旅人食宿的“客栈、小旅馆”。

lemmas.def_en: something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted
lemmas.def_zh: 障碍, 妨害物, 阻碍

examples.en: Lack of funding was the biggest obstacle to completing the ambitious community project.
examples.zh: 缺乏资金是完成这个雄心勃勃的社区项目的最大障碍。

lemmas.usage_note: 后常接介词 to 表示“……的障碍”，常见搭配 an obstacle to progress 或 overcome/face obstacles。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ob-（在对面，阻碍）+ 词根 sta-（站立），字面为“立在前面的东西”，引申为障碍。

lemmas.def_en: a person who keeps and updates a blog
lemmas.def_zh: 写博客的人；博客使用者

examples.en: The travel blogger shares honest reviews and beautiful photography of destinations worldwide.
examples.zh: 这位旅游博主分享世界各地景点的真实评测和精美摄影作品。

lemmas.usage_note: 现代网络用语，指博主，常与 travel/food/fashion blogger 复合搭配，强调内容创作者身份。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 weblog（网络日志/博客）缩短为 blog，再加表示人的后缀 -er 构成。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who engages in sexual intercourse for money
lemmas.def_zh: 妓女, 男娼

examples.en: The social worker dedicated her life to helping former prostitutes rebuild their careers.
examples.zh: 这位社工毕生致力于帮助过去的性工作者重塑职业生涯。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指性工作者，正式法律语境多用 sex worker 代替；搭配有 male/female prostitute。

lemmas.def_en: offering sexual intercourse for pay
lemmas.def_zh: 卖淫, 糟蹋, 滥用

examples.en: He considered taking the commercial deal an act of intellectual prostitution.
examples.zh: 他认为接下那笔商业交易是在出卖自己的知识良知。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，除指卖淫外，常引申指“滥用才能、出卖原则”；常与 forced, child 连用。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] ('prostitute oneself') to engage in sexual activity for payment 2. [T] to misuse or debase one's talents, skills, or principles for low motives or financial gain
lemmas.def_zh: 卖淫；出卖（原则、才能等）以牟利

examples.en: She refused to prostitute her artistic integrity just to make a quick profit.
examples.zh: 她拒绝为了牟取暴利而出卖自己的艺术诚信。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于反身 prostitute oneself 或引申为“为了利益糟蹋/出卖（才能、信仰）”。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 pro-（在前面，公开）+ 词根 stitute（站立，设立），原指“公开摆出待售”，引申为卖淫或出卖原则。

lemmas.def_en: (sports) a division during which one team is on the offensive
lemmas.def_zh: 一回, 回合, 较量

examples.en: She was forced to miss work after suffering a severe bout of flu.
examples.zh: 在遭遇了一场严重的流感后，她不得不请假缺勤。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指拳击等“比赛”或疾病、情绪的“一阵发作”，常见搭配 a bout of flu/depression。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语或日耳曼语，原指“弯曲、转向”，引申为“轮到的一次行动”，常指回合或发作。

lemmas.def_en: an unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument
lemmas.def_zh: 论题, 论文

examples.en: He spent several months doing field research before writing his master's thesis.
examples.zh: 在撰写硕士学位论文之前，他花了好几个月进行实地调研。

lemmas.usage_note: 指学术论文（尤指硕博）或核心论点，常搭配 write/defend a thesis 或 thesis statement。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 thesis（放置，命题），引申为建立的论点以及论证该论点的学位论文。

lemmas.def_en: a line made of twisted fibers or threads
lemmas.def_zh: 绳索, 束缚

examples.en: Please plug the power cord firmly into the wall socket before switching on the device.
examples.zh: 打开设备电源前，请将电源线牢固地插入墙上插座。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指粗线、电线或解剖学中的索状组织；常见搭配 power cord（电源线）、spinal cord（脊髓）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To tie or fasten something securely with a cord; to stack cut firewood in measured cords.
lemmas.def_zh: 用绳索捆扎；将（木柴）堆扎成考得

examples.en: The workers corded the freshly cut firewood neatly in the backyard.
examples.zh: 工人们把刚砍好的柴火整齐地捆扎堆放在后院。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指用绳索捆扎或（木材等）按考得堆积，医学中亦可指形成索状；多用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: not having a cord
lemmas.def_zh: 无绳索的, 交直流两用的

examples.en: He bought a lightweight cordless vacuum cleaner to clean the stairs easily.
examples.zh: 他买了一台轻便的无线吸尘器，以便轻松清理楼梯。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 chorde（肠线、琴弦），引申为细绳、电线或绳状解剖结构。

lemmas.def_en: incapable of being avoided or prevented
lemmas.def_zh: 不可避免的, 必然的

examples.en: Given the rapid rise in costs, a price increase seemed virtually inevitable.
examples.zh: 鉴于成本的急剧上升，涨价似乎几乎是不可避免的。

lemmas.usage_note: 指不可避免的客观规律或结果，常修饰 outcome, consequence, delay；the inevitable 作名词指必然之事。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unavoidable
lemmas.def_zh: 无法逃避之事, 不可逃避, 必然性

examples.en: She accepted the inevitability of change and focused on finding new opportunities.
examples.zh: 她接受了变革的必然性，并专注于寻找新的机遇。

family_guide.root_logic: in-（不）+ e-（出）+ vit-（避免）+ -able（可…的），即“无法避开的”。

lemmas.def_en: the form of a literary work submitted for publication
lemmas.def_zh: 手稿, 原稿, 底稿

examples.en: The author spent several months revising the original manuscript before submitting it.
examples.zh: 作者在提交之前花了几个月时间修改原始手稿。

lemmas.usage_note: 指作家或学者未出版的手稿、原稿，正式搭配如 submit a manuscript to a publisher。

family_guide.root_logic: manu-（手）+ script（写），字面为“手写物”，特指手稿、原稿。

lemmas.def_en: sexually attracted to members of your own sex
lemmas.def_zh: 同性恋的

examples.en: The court ruling protected the civil rights of partners in a homosexual relationship.
examples.zh: 该法院判决保护了同性伴侣关系中双方的公民权利。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式或医学/法律用语，日常中常被 gay 取代；常搭配 homosexual relationship, orientation。

lemmas.def_en: someone who practices homosexuality; having a sexual attraction to persons of the same sex
lemmas.def_zh: 同性恋者

examples.en: Historical records indicate that homosexuals faced severe persecution during that dark era.
examples.zh: 历史记录表明，同性恋者在那个黑暗时代遭受了残酷的迫害。

lemmas.usage_note: 指同性恋者，在现当代英语中被部分群体认为偏临床冷淡，建议在专业语境中使用。

lemmas.def_en: a sexual attraction to (or sexual relations with) persons of the same sex
lemmas.def_zh: 同性恋

examples.en: Public attitudes toward homosexuality have become significantly more open in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来，公众对同性恋的态度已变得显著包容。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，表示同性恋性取向或状态；常与 decriminalize, accept 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: homo-（同等的，同类的）+ sexual（性的），指性取向同性别。

lemmas.def_en: a pattern forming a unity within a larger structural whole
lemmas.def_zh: (绳索的)股, 绳, 串, 海滨, 河岸

examples.en: The detective carefully examined a single strand of hair left at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 侦探仔细检查了留在犯罪现场的一根发丝。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指一缕头发、单股绳线，或抽象指思路、要素（strand of thought/DNA）；书面语亦可指海滨。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To leave someone, a boat, or a vehicle stuck in a place with no way of leaving.
lemmas.def_zh: 使搁浅；使陷于困境，使滞留

examples.en: A sudden blizzard stranded hundreds of travelers at the remote mountain airport.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雪使数百名旅客滞留在这个偏远的山区机场。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be stranded，指船只搁浅，或人“陷于困境、滞留（在某地）”。

family_guide.root_logic: 核心包含两个词源体系：一指“岸、海滩”（引申为搁浅）；二指“线绳的一股、串”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To make something clearer or easier to understand by explaining it in more detail. 2. [I, T] To make a liquid pure or clear by removing impurities.
lemmas.def_zh: 阐明，使清楚明了；使（液体等）澄清

examples.en: The minister held a press briefing to clarify his remarks regarding the tax reform.
examples.zh: 部长举行新闻简报会，以阐明他关于税制改革的言论。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指澄清事实、阐明立场或滤清液体；宾语常接 position, issue, statement。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [N] A substance, tank, or device used to remove impurities and make a liquid clear.
lemmas.def_zh: [化] 澄清器; 沉降器; 澄清剂

examples.en: The wastewater treatment plant installed a secondary clarifier to remove suspended solids.
examples.zh: 污水处理厂安装了二次澄清器以去除悬浮固体。

lemmas.def_zh: 澄清, 净化
lemmas.def_en: an interpretation that removes obstacles to understanding

examples.en: We wrote an official email to the board seeking clarification on the new policy.
examples.zh: 我们给董事会发了一封正式邮件，寻求对新政策的进一步阐明。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常用于 seek clarification（寻求澄清）、provide clarification（给出说明）；可数或不可数。

family_guide.root_logic: clar-（清晰）+ -ify（使变为），核心逻辑是“使混乱或浑浊的事物变得清晰透明”。

lemmas.def_en: one of the inherent cognitive or perceptual powers of the mind
lemmas.def_zh: 组件, 模数

examples.en: Students must complete the core module before enrolling in advanced elective courses.
examples.zh: 学生必须在修完核心模块后，方可注册高阶选修课程。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指课程单元、软件模块、航天舱组件等；常与 training, software, lunar 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 模数的, 有标准组件的
lemmas.def_en: constructed with standardized units or dimensions allowing flexibility and variety in use

examples.en: The company adopted a modular architecture to make the application easier to update.
examples.zh: 该公司采用模块化架构，以便让应用程序更易于维护和更新。

lemmas.usage_note: 修饰由标准组件构成的系统或设计；常见搭配 modular design（模块化设计）、modular furniture。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 modulus（小度量单位），引申为独立、可组装的标准单元、组件或课程模块。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (often passive, 'be racked with/by') To cause someone extreme physical pain or mental anguish. 2. [T] ('rack one's brains') To think very hard to find an answer or remember something. 3. [T] (historical) To torture someone on a rack.
lemmas.def_zh: 折磨，使痛苦；施刑，拷问；绞尽（脑汁）

examples.en: The suspect racked his brain trying to remember where he had been that night.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人绞尽脑汁，试图回忆起自己那天晚上究竟身在何处。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于 rack one's brain（绞尽脑汁）或被动语态 be racked with/by（备受折磨）。

lemmas.def_en: framework for holding objects
lemmas.def_zh: 架, 行李架, 饲草架, 搁物架, 痛苦, 折磨, 齿条, 行云团

examples.en: He placed his heavy suitcase onto the overhead luggage rack above his seat.
examples.zh: 他把沉重的行李箱放到了座位上方的头顶行李架上。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指陈列架、行李架、齿条或古代拉肢刑具；常见搭配 coat/luggage rack。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古荷兰语，核心指“框架/支架”，由此引申出古代将人绑在刑架上拉伸的“酷刑、折磨”及由此带来的“极度痛苦/竭力思考”。

lemmas.def_en: a wicked or evil person; someone who does evil deliberately
lemmas.def_zh: 坏人, 恶棍

examples.en: In the latest blockbuster, the villain's motives were surprisingly complex and sympathetic.
examples.zh: 在这部最新大片中，反派的动机出人意料地复杂且令人同情。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指文学作品中的反派角色，亦可指祸首或恶棍；常见搭配 play the villain。

lemmas.def_en: extremely wicked
lemmas.def_zh: 坏人似的, 恶棍的, 罪恶的, 极坏的

examples.en: The detective uncovered a villainous plot to steal valuable historic art treasures.
examples.zh: 侦探揭露了一起企图盗窃珍贵历史艺术珍宝的险恶阴谋。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指封建领地上的“农夫、平民”，随历史演变，贵族阶层将其贬低为“粗鄙不义之人”，最终定型为现代的“反派角色、恶棍”。

lemmas.def_en: a component of a mixture that has been separated by a fractional process
lemmas.def_zh: 小部分, 破片, 分数

examples.en: The new engine consumes only a small fraction of the fuel used by older models.
examples.zh: 这款新发动机消耗的燃油仅为老旧型号的一小部分。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指数学中的分数，或引申为极小的一部分；常见结构 a fraction of...

lemmas.def_en: a process that uses heat to separate a substance into its components
lemmas.def_zh: 分别, 分馏法

examples.en: Plasma fractionation is an essential industrial process used to produce medical therapies.
examples.zh: 血浆分馏是用于生产医疗制剂的重要工业过程。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic) To break or split into fragments. 2. [T] (chemistry) To separate a mixture into different components or fractions, especially by distillation.
lemmas.def_zh: 打碎，破碎；（化）把……分馏，分成各个组分

examples.en: The researchers fractioned the blood plasma into several distinct protein components.
examples.zh: 研究人员将血浆分馏分离成若干种不同的蛋白质组分。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，化学或医学专业语境，指将混合物“分馏、分步分离成各组分”；亦作 fractionate。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chemistry) To separate a mixture into distinct fractions using distillation or crystallization.
lemmas.def_zh: 分别, 使分馏

examples.en: Chemical engineers fractionate crude oil into various useful components like gasoline and diesel.
examples.zh: 化学工程师将原油分馏成汽油和柴油等各种有用成分。

lemmas.def_en: constituting or comprising a part or fraction of a possible whole or entirety
lemmas.def_zh: 部分的, 碎片的, 微少的, 断片的, 分数的, 分馏的

examples.en: The automated trading algorithm can execute orders in a tiny fractional second.
examples.zh: 自动交易算法可以在零点几秒的极短时间内执行订单。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 frangere（破碎、折断），核心指被折断或分割后的“碎片、部分”，数学上引申为“分数”，日常引申为“极小的一部分”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (+ with) To cross or cut across each other at a point or line.
lemmas.def_zh: 相交，交叉；横穿

examples.en: The two highways intersect just south of the city center.
examples.zh: 这两条公路在市中心南面相交。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作及物或不及物动词，常与介词 with 搭配，指线条、道路或领域发生交叉、重合。

lemmas.def_en: a point where lines intersect
lemmas.def_zh: 交集, 十字路口, 交叉点

examples.en: Be careful when making a left turn at this busy intersection.
examples.zh: 在这个繁忙的十字路口左转时一定要小心。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指“十字路口”时常与介词 at 连用；在数学中作不可数或可数名词，表示“交集”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 inter-（在……之间）+ secare（切割），字面即“在中间相互切割”，引申为几何线面或道路的“相交、交叉”。
family_guide.core_distinction: intersect 为动词‘相交’，intersection 为名词‘十字路口/交集’。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To rub, press, and knead muscles or body parts to relieve tension or pain. 2. [T] (informal) To manipulate or alter facts, figures, or data to make them more acceptable.
lemmas.def_zh: 按摩，揉捏；篡改，美化（数据等）

examples.en: She gently massaged her stiff neck to relieve the tension.
examples.zh: 她轻轻按摩着僵硬的脖子以缓解紧张。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，后接身体部位表示“按摩、揉”，引申义可表示“篡改数据”或“推敲措辞”。

lemmas.def_en: someone who rubs or kneads parts of the body to stimulate circulation and promote relaxation
lemmas.def_zh: 按摩师

examples.en: The professional massager used gentle pressure to relieve the tight knots in my shoulder.
examples.zh: 专业的按摩师用温和的手法缓解了我肩部的肌肉僵硬。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自法语，可能最终源自阿拉伯语 mass（抚摸、轻捏），核心动作为用手推拿揉捏以舒缓肌肉。

lemmas.def_en: a joint between the distal end of the radius and the proximal row of carpal bones
lemmas.def_zh: 手腕, 腕关节

examples.en: She wore a delicate silver bracelet loosely wrapped around her slender left wrist.
examples.zh: 她纤细的左手腕上松松地戴着一只精致的银手镯。

lemmas.usage_note: 身体部位手腕；习语 a slap on the wrist 意为“轻微的惩罚/象征性警告”，常用于批判惩罚过轻。
