family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，与 writhe（扭曲）同源，核心指能够“扭动、旋转”的关节，特指连接手和手臂的手腕。

lemmas.def_en: encouraging or approving or pleasing
lemmas.def_zh: 有利的, 赞许的, 良好的

examples.en: The new policy received a favorable response from most local small business owners.
examples.zh: 这项新政策得到了当地大多数小企业主的积极好评。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 favorable response/view/conditions，接介词 to 表示“对…有利”，英式拼写常作 favourable。

lemmas.def_en: not encouraging or approving or pleasing; ; ; ,
lemmas.def_zh: 不宜的, 不顺利的, 反对的

examples.en: Due to unfavorable weather conditions, the outdoor concert was postponed until next weekend.
examples.zh: 由于恶劣的天气条件，户外音乐会被推迟到下周末举行。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 favor（恩惠、偏爱），后缀 -able 表示“值得……的”，核心指“带来好处、获得赞同或创造良好条件的”。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is dazzlingly skilled in any field
lemmas.def_zh: 男巫, 术士, 奇才

examples.en: Our new software engineer is a financial wizard who solved the budget glitch in minutes.
examples.zh: 我们新来的软件工程师是个理财奇才，几分钟就解决了预算故障。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指奇幻语境下的“男巫”，或比喻在某领域技艺超群的“奇才、行家”。

lemmas.def_en: possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers; ; ; ; - Shakespeare
lemmas.def_zh: 神汉的,男巫的,神奇的

examples.en: The old scientist analyzed the mysterious data with wizardly precision and profound insight.
examples.zh: 这位老科学家以神乎其神的精确度和深刻洞察力分析了神秘数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 wys（智慧，即 wise）+ 具有特定身份的后缀 -ard，字面意为“有智慧的人”，后引申为“精通法术的巫师”或“技艺精湛的高手”。

lemmas.def_en: a regular customer
lemmas.def_zh: 赞助人, 顾客, 保护人

examples.en: The museum relies heavily on wealthy patrons to expand its private collection.
examples.zh: 该博物馆严重依赖富有的赞助人来扩充其私人藏品。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常与 of 搭配指艺术或慈善事业的“资助人”，亦用于正式语体中指餐厅或商店的“顾客”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (disapproving) To speak or behave toward someone in a way that suggests you think you are more intelligent or important than them. 2. [T] (formal) To be a regular customer of a business, shop, or restaurant. 3. [T] To act as a patron toward; support or sponsor.
lemmas.def_zh: 居高临下地对待，自显优越；光顾，惠顾；资助，赞助

examples.en: Local residents prefer to patronize small family-owned grocery stores instead of large supermarkets.
examples.zh: 当地居民更愿意光顾小型家族杂货店，而不是大型超市。

lemmas.def_en: with condescension; in a patronizing manner
lemmas.def_zh: 自以为高人一等地

examples.en: The arrogant manager spoke patronizingly to the new interns during the orientation meeting.
examples.zh: 那位傲慢的经理在迎新会上自以为高人一等地对新实习生说话。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pater（父亲），古罗马时期 patronus 指庇护附庸平民的保护人，引申为艺术或机构的“赞助人”，以及商业上的“老主顾”。

lemmas.def_en: sensational in appearance or thrilling in effect
lemmas.def_zh: 公开展示的, 惊人的, 壮观的

examples.en: The mountaintop offers a spectacular view of the entire valley below.
examples.zh: 山顶上可以俯瞰整个山谷的壮丽景色。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语或表语，修饰景色、成就或表演，常与 view, success, display 等词搭配，语气强烈。

lemmas.def_en: not spectacular
lemmas.def_zh: 不引人注意的

examples.en: Despite its unspectacular opening weekend, the indie movie steadily gained a loyal following.
examples.zh: 尽管首映周末表现平平，这部独立电影还是逐渐赢得了忠实观众。

lemmas.def_en: in a spectacular manner
lemmas.def_zh: 引人注目地；壮观地

examples.en: The ambitious new tech startup failed spectacularly after exhausting all its initial investment.
examples.zh: 这家雄心勃勃的科技初创公司在耗尽所有初始投资后惨烈地失败了。

lemmas.def_en: something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight)
lemmas.def_zh: 奇观，场面；眼镜（复数形式）

examples.en: The grand opening ceremony was an unforgettable visual spectacle.
examples.zh: 盛大的开幕式是一场令人难忘的视觉盛宴。

lemmas.usage_note: 单数常指引人注目的“奇观、壮观场面”；复数 spectacles 可专指“眼镜”，多用于正式语体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 spectaculum（壮丽场面），词根 spec-（看），核心强调“极其吸引眼球、令人叹为观止的视觉盛宴”。

lemmas.def_en: a vehicle that takes people to and from hospitals
lemmas.def_zh: 救护车

examples.en: The ambulance rushed through the heavy evening traffic with its loud sirens blaring.
examples.zh: 救护车鸣着刺耳的警笛，在傍晚拥挤的车流中疾驰而过。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 call/summon an ambulance 搭配；表示“被救护车送医”用 be rushed to hospital by ambulance。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ambulare（行走、移动），最初指军队中随军移动的野战流动医院（hopital ambulant），后转指运送伤病员的专用车辆。

lemmas.def_en: two items of the same kind
lemmas.def_zh: 二重唱

examples.en: The dynamic piano and violin duo delivered a breathtaking musical performance tonight.
examples.zh: 这对充满活力的钢琴与小提琴二重奏组合今晚带来了扣人心弦的演出。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指二人表演组或搭档，如 dynamic duo（黄金搭档）；用于非正式语境，泛指合作默契的两个人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 duo（二），原用于音乐领域指两件乐器或两名歌唱家的二重奏，现泛指由两人组成的组合或搭档。

lemmas.def_en: something with a round shape resembling a flat circular plate
lemmas.def_zh: 圆盘, 磁盘

examples.en: The system warned that there was insufficient disk space to install the software.
examples.zh: 系统警告磁盘空间不足，无法安装该软件。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指扁平圆盘物、解剖学上的椎间盘或计算机中的硬盘、软盘等存储设备。

lemmas.def_zh: 磁盘
lemmas.def_en: a small plastic magnetic disk enclosed in a stiff envelope with a radial slit; used to store data or programs for a microcomputer

examples.en: She found an old floppy diskette containing text files from her high school days.
examples.zh: 她找到了一张装有高中时期文本文件的旧软盘。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (agriculture) to break up and cultivate soil using a disc harrow
lemmas.def_zh: 用圆盘耙耕耙（农田）

examples.en: The farmer decided to disk the field before planting the winter wheat.
examples.zh: 农夫决定在播种冬小麦之前用圆盘耙整地。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，农业上指用圆盘耙耕地，计算机语境中偶尔用于指把数据写入磁盘。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 diskos（掷铁饼之圆盘），核心形态为“薄而扁平的圆形物体”，计算机时代引申为存储磁盘。

lemmas.def_en: a plant lacking a permanent woody stem; many are flowering garden plants or potherbs; some having medicinal properties; some are pests
lemmas.def_zh: 草本植物；药草，香草

examples.en: Fresh herbs can transform a simple dish into something extraordinary.
examples.zh: 新鲜香草能让一道普通的菜肴变得非同寻常。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 fresh/dried herbs、medicinal herbs；美音中字母 h 通常不发音（读作 /ɜːrb/），英音则发音。

lemmas.def_en: tea-like drink made of leaves of various herbs
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 本草书

examples.en: The village doctor consulted a medieval herbal to find a remedy for the fever.
examples.zh: 这位乡村医生查阅了一本中世纪本草书以寻找退烧的疗方。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 herba（青草、草本植物），指药用、食用或有香味的草本植物。

lemmas.def_en: a variable quantity that can be resolved into components
lemmas.def_zh: 矢量，向量；（疾病的）传病媒介

examples.en: Mosquitoes act as the primary vector for the transmission of malaria.
examples.zh: 蚊子是疟疾传播的主要媒介。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技语体，常指数学物理中的“向量”，或生物学中传播疾病的“媒介”，如 vector of transmission。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vehere（运载、携带），引申为引导方向并带有大小的量，或疾病的携带媒介。

lemmas.def_en: a solid bounded by a cylindrical surface and two parallel planes (the bases)
lemmas.def_zh: 圆柱体；圆筒，汽缸

examples.en: The mechanic discovered that one of the engine cylinders had misfired.
examples.zh: 机械师发现发动机的一个气缸出现了缺火故障。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指几何学中的“圆柱体”，或机械工程中的发动机“气缸”、储气用的“钢瓶”。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆柱体的, 圆筒形的
lemmas.def_en: having the form of a cylinder

examples.en: The ancient temple featured massive cylindric pillars that supported the stone roof.
examples.zh: 这座古老的庙宇拥有巨大的圆柱形立柱，支撑着石制屋顶。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kulindein（滚动），指可滚动的圆柱状物体，后延伸为几何圆柱体及机械汽缸。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To judge, estimate, or assess a situation, feeling, or measurement. 2. [T] To measure the exact size, capacity, or amount of something.
lemmas.def_zh: 判定，评估，判断；精确测量

examples.en: It is difficult to gauge the full impact of the new policy so early on.
examples.zh: 在这么早的阶段很难评估这项新政策的全面影响。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“评估/判断”态度或情绪，常接 reaction/mood；注意拼写中 a 在 u 前，易误拼为 guage。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指量器或规格，引申为测定、估计的动作。

lemmas.def_en: the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
lemmas.def_zh: （动植物的）生活环境，栖息地

examples.en: Deforestation threatens the natural habitat of countless endangered species.
examples.zh: 滥砍乱伐正威胁着无数濒危物种的自然栖息地。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指动植物的“自然栖息地”，搭配 natural habitat、habitat destruction；勿与人类的 home 混用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 habitare（居住），特指动植物自然生长繁衍的生态环境。

lemmas.def_en: someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
lemmas.def_zh: 祖先，先祖；原型

examples.en: His ancestors originally emigrated from Scotland in the early nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 他的祖先于19世纪初由苏格兰移民至此。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常指血统上的“祖先”，也可引申指某类现代机械、生物或事物的“原型、雏形”。

lemmas.def_zh: 祖先的, 祖传的
lemmas.def_en: inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent

examples.en: The family returned to their ancestral village to celebrate the traditional festival.
examples.zh: 这一家人回到祖籍村落庆祝传统节日。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语，修饰 home, land, rights 等名词，表示“祖先传下的”或“世代居住的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ante-（前）+ cedere（走），字面意为“走在前面的人”，即祖先。

lemmas.def_en: the length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference
lemmas.def_zh: 直径

examples.en: The trunk of the ancient redwood tree measures nearly four meters in diameter.
examples.zh: 这棵古老红杉树的树干直径将近四米。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 in 连用表示“直径为……”，或与 of 搭配指具体圆形物体的直径尺寸。

lemmas.def_zh: 直径的, 正好相反的
lemmas.def_en: related to or along a diameter

examples.en: The two rival politicians held diametric opinions on how to handle the economic crisis.
examples.zh: 这两位政敌在如何处理经济危机的问题上持截然相反的观点。

lemmas.def_zh: 直径的, 正好相反的
lemmas.def_en: related to or along a diameter

examples.en: Their views on economic reform are in diametrical opposition to each other.
examples.zh: 他们对经济改革的看法截然相反。

lemmas.def_zh: 完全地, 直径方面, 正好相反地, 截然地
lemmas.def_en: as from opposite ends of a diameter

examples.en: when two honest witnesses give accounts of the same event that differ diametrically, how can anyone prove that the evidence you gave was deliberately false?
three of these brushes were approximately 120 feet apart and the fourth diametrically opposite to one of the three

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 dia-（穿过）+ metron（测量），指穿过圆心测量两端的距离。

lemmas.def_en: a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide
lemmas.def_zh: 锡, 马口铁, 罐头

examples.en: She opened a tin of tuna and mixed it into the fresh salad.
examples.zh: 她打开一罐金枪鱼，把它拌入了新鲜沙拉中。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指金属“锡”；在英式英语中作可数名词常指“马口铁罐头”或烘焙烤模。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To coat a metal surface with a thin layer of tin. 2. [T] (chiefly British) To preserve food by putting it into a tin or can.
lemmas.def_zh: 镀锡于；（尤指英）将（食品）装罐保存

examples.en: You should always tin the tip of the soldering iron before starting the repair.
examples.zh: 在开始焊接维修之前，你应该先给烙铁头镀上一层锡。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，主要用于工业或焊接工艺，指“在……表面镀锡”，后接金属或工具等宾语。

lemmas.def_en: of or containing tin
lemmas.def_zh: 锡的, 含锡的, 像锡的

examples.en: The cheap smartphone speaker produced an irritating, tinny sound during the phone call.
examples.zh: 在通话过程中，廉价的智能手机扬声器发出了刺耳的金属杂音。

family_guide.root_logic: 日耳曼语源，原指金属锡，后借指马口铁制成的罐头容器及镀锡动作。

lemmas.def_en: motion of hands or body to emphasize or help to express a thought or feeling
lemmas.def_zh: 手势, 姿态

examples.en: Offering to pay for dinner was a polite gesture, though she insisted on splitting the bill.
examples.zh: 主动提出请客是一种礼貌的姿态，尽管她坚持要AA制。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指表达特定意图的肢体动作或象征性举动，高频搭配如 a friendly gesture、make a gesture。

lemmas.def_zh: 姿势, 手势, 用姿势表达
lemmas.def_en: a deliberate and vigorous gesture or motion
1. [I, T] (+ to/toward/at) To move your hands, arms, or head to express an idea, instruction, or feeling.
lemmas.def_zh: 做手势，打手势；用动作示意

examples.en: He gestured toward the empty chair, inviting his guest to sit down.
examples.zh: 他朝那把空椅子做了个手势，示意客人坐下。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用作不及物动词，表示用手势示意，常后接介词 toward、to 或 at，口语和书面语中均常见。

lemmas.def_zh: 用手势谈话, 用姿势表达
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To gesticulate means to make lively or dramatic movements with your hands and arms while speaking.

examples.en: Unable to speak the local language, he began to gesticulate wildly to ask for help.
examples.zh: 由于不会说当地语言，他开始拼命打手势以寻求帮助。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 gerere（表现、举止），指通过肢体或象征性行为传达意思。

lemmas.def_en: a farm where dairy products are produced
lemmas.def_zh: 乳制品

examples.en: Doctors advised him to cut down on dairy to improve his digestion.
examples.zh: 医生建议他减少乳制品的摄入以改善消化。

lemmas.usage_note: 乳制品

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 deye（女挤奶工），指与牛奶加工、产出或乳制品相关的场所或物品。

lemmas.def_en: articles of commerce
lemmas.def_zh: 商品，大宗货物；有用之物

examples.en: In times of crisis, reliable information becomes a precious commodity.
examples.zh: 在危机时刻，可靠的信息成了珍贵的商品。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指大宗商品，常与 market 搭配；引申指“有价值之物”，如 time is a precious commodity。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 commodus（便利、合适），后转义为可在市场上流通交易的便利物品或商品。

lemmas.def_en: a deep awareness of and sympathy for another's suffering
lemmas.def_zh: 同情, 怜悯

examples.en: The nurse treated every patient with immense kindness and compassion.
examples.zh: 护士怀着极大的善意和同情心对待每一位病人。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，强调对遭遇不幸者的深切同情与关怀，常用搭配 have/feel compassion for 或 show compassion。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (formal or archaic) To feel deep pity or compassion for someone suffering misfortune.
lemmas.def_zh: 怜悯，同情

examples.en: We can only compassionate those who have lost their homes in the disaster.
examples.zh: 我们只能对那些在灾难中失去家园的人深表怜悯。

lemmas.usage_note: 极度罕见且文学化或古旧的及物动词，直接接宾语，表示怜悯或同情某人，现代多用其形容词形式。

lemmas.def_en: in a compassionate manner
lemmas.def_zh: 表示怜悯地, 有同情心地

examples.en: The dedicated nurse listened compassionately to the elderly patient's many concerns.
examples.zh: 这位敬业的护士富有同情心地倾听那位老年患者的种种担忧。

lemmas.def_en: lacking compassion or feeling for others; - Shakespeare
lemmas.def_zh: 无同情心的,冷酷无情的

examples.en: Her uncompassionate response to his tragic loss shocked all her friends.
examples.zh: 她对他的悲惨遭遇所表现出的冷酷无情震惊了所有朋友。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 com-（共同）+ pati（受苦），字面为“同受苦难”，即同情和怜悯之心。

lemmas.def_en: a nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas; constitutes 21 percent of the atmosphere by volume; the most abundant element in the earth's crust
lemmas.def_zh: 零

examples.en: The telephone operator asked him to press o for further assistance.
examples.zh: 接线员请他按零以获取进一步的协助。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示字母“O”或数字“0”（口语读作/oʊ/）；亦可作语气词，但在现代英语中较少独立作普通名词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 借自拉丁语词根 os，指解剖学中的骨骼（复数 ossa）或孔口（复数 ora）。

lemmas.def_en: the sound of laughing
lemmas.def_zh: 笑，笑声

examples.en: The room erupted into burst of laughter after his witty remark.
examples.zh: 在他说了那句风趣的话后，房间里爆发出阵阵笑声。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，常与 roar with/burst into laughter 搭配；切忌误加复数形式或与可数名词 laugh 混淆。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 hleahtor，来自拟声词根，表由快乐或滑稽引起的笑声。

lemmas.def_en: the compass point midway between south and west; at 225 degrees
lemmas.def_zh: 西南，西南部

examples.en: The birds migrate to the southwest for the winter.
examples.zh: 鸟类迁往西南方向过冬。

lemmas.usage_note: 表方位时常与 in/to the southwest of 连用；首字母大写 the Southwest 特指特定西南地区。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 south（南）和 west（西）组合而成，指两者的中间方位。

lemmas.def_en: someone injured or killed or captured or missing in a military engagement
lemmas.def_zh: 伤亡人员；受害者；急诊室

examples.en: The heavy fighting caused civilian casualties on both sides.
examples.zh: 激烈的交火导致双方均有平民伤亡。

lemmas.usage_note: 指伤亡人员时常用复数 casualties；在英式英语中单数常指医院的“急诊室”（A&E）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 casus（发生的事、偶然事故、死亡），引申为因突发灾难或战争造成的伤亡人员或损失。

lemmas.def_en: a small house with a single story
lemmas.def_zh: 村舍，乡村小屋

examples.en: They spent their summer vacation in a cozy cottage by the lake.
examples.zh: 他们在湖畔一处舒适的小屋里度过了暑假。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常指乡间村舍或度假小屋；固定经济学术语 cottage industry 指“家庭作坊式手工业”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 cot（简陋小屋），后加指小后缀 -age，指乡村小别墅或农舍。

lemmas.def_en: drug or medicine that is prepared or dispensed in pharmacies and used in medical treatment
lemmas.def_zh: 药品, 成药, 药剂

examples.en: The government strictly regulates the export and import of all pharmaceuticals.
examples.zh: 政府对所有药品的进出口实施严格监管。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以复数形式 pharmaceuticals 出现，正式语体中指工业化生产的药品或制剂，尤见于商业与科技报告。

lemmas.def_en: the art and science of preparing and dispensing drugs and medicines,
lemmas.def_zh: 药房，药店；药剂学

examples.en: I need to stop by the local pharmacy to pick up my prescription.
examples.zh: 我得去一趟当地的药店取我的处方药。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指实体药房、配药室，也指药剂学学科；作地点时常搭配 at/in the pharmacy，属日常高频词。

lemmas.def_en: a health professional trained in the art of preparing and dispensing drugs
lemmas.def_zh: 药师, 药品商, 药商, 药剂师

examples.en: The experienced pharmacist double-checked the prescription before handing over the medicine.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的药剂师在交付药品前仔细核对了处方。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to pharmacy or pharmacists
lemmas.def_zh: 药学的, 制药的, 药用的, 药物的, 药剂师的, 药师的

examples.en: She works as a senior research scientist for a major pharmaceutical company.
examples.zh: 她在一家大型制药公司担任高级研究员。

lemmas.usage_note: 作前置定语，表示与药品生产、研制或流通相关的，常搭配 industry、company 或 product。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 pharmakon（药物、毒药、咒语），经古法语进入英语，现专指药房或配药学。

lemmas.def_en: (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence
lemmas.def_zh: （法律文件等的）条款；（语法中的）从句

examples.en: Make sure you read the confidentiality clause carefully before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 在签署合同之前，务必仔细阅读保密条款。

lemmas.usage_note: 法律中指合同或协议的特定条款（如 penalty clause）；语言学中指从句或分句（如 relative clause）。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or functioning as a clause
lemmas.def_zh: 条款的, 子句的

examples.en: Linguists often analyze clausal structure to understand complex grammatical relationships in text.
examples.zh: 语言学家常常通过分析子句结构来理解文本中复杂的语法关系。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 claudere（关闭），原指文章或乐曲中相对完整的段落，引申为从句或合同条款。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances the body can use 2. [T] to fully understand and absorb new information
lemmas.def_zh: 消化（食物）；理解，领悟

examples.en: It took him several days to digest the shocking news about the merger.
examples.zh: 他花了好几天时间才消化吸收了关于合并的震惊消息。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指生理上的消化食物，也可引申为充分理解、吸收复杂信息，常搭配 digest information/news。

lemmas.def_en: any substance that promotes digestion
lemmas.def_zh: 助消化药

examples.en: Grandmother always took a herbal digestive after having a heavy dinner.
examples.zh: 祖母在吃完丰盛的晚餐后总是服用一种草药助消化药。

lemmas.def_en: the process of decomposing organic matter (as in sewage) by bacteria or by chemical action or heat
lemmas.def_zh: 消化力, 领悟

examples.en: Going for a brisk walk can greatly assist your body's digestion.
examples.zh: 散步有助于极大地促进你身体的消化力。

lemmas.def_en: autoclave consisting of a vessel in which plant or animal materials are digested
lemmas.def_zh: 做摘要者, 蒸煮锅, 蒸煮器

examples.en: Organic farm waste was converted into clean biogas using a sealed digester.
examples.zh: 农场的有机废弃物在一个密封的蒸煮器中转化为清洁的沼气。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being easy to digest
lemmas.def_zh: 消化率, 可消化性

examples.en: Cooking grains thoroughly can significantly improve their digestibility for young children.
examples.zh: 将谷物彻底煮熟能显著提高其对幼儿的可消化性。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being converted into assimilable condition in the alimentary canal
lemmas.def_zh: 可消化的, 易消化的, 可摘要的

examples.en: Steamed white rice is usually very digestible for patients recovering from illness.
examples.zh: 对于康复中的患者而言，蒸熟的白米饭通常非常容易消化。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（分开）+ gest（携带，拉），本义为把事物分类理顺，引申为肠胃消化食物或大脑消化理解信息。

lemmas.def_en: a place where work is done
lemmas.def_zh: 工作场所，工作环境

examples.en: Safety standards must be strictly enforced in the workplace.
examples.zh: 工作场所必须严格执行安全标准。

lemmas.usage_note: 泛指工作场所，常用 in the workplace 搭配，多出现于关于职业安全、歧视等正式职场语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 work（工作）和 place（地点）构成，字面即工作的地方。

lemmas.def_en: a familiar name for a person (often a shortened version of a person's given name)
lemmas.def_zh: 绰号，昵称

examples.en: His incredible speed on the court earned him the nickname 'The Flash'.
examples.zh: 他在球场上惊人的速度为他赢得了“闪电侠”的绰号。

lemmas.usage_note: 指基于名字、特征或经历而取的绰号或别称，常用搭配 earn a nickname 或 give someone a nickname。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To give an informal, humorous, or descriptive name to someone or something.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……起绰号，把……叫做

examples.en: His colleagues nicknamed him the Professor because of his vast knowledge.
examples.zh: 因为他博学多才，同事们给他起绰号叫“教授”。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态或接双宾语（nickname sb. sth.），表示“给……起绰号为”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中古英语 an eke name（一个额外的名字），因误读吞音演变为 a nickname。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (+ to) to keep someone or something restricted within a certain place, limit, or subject; to keep someone in an enclosed space
lemmas.def_zh: 限制，使局限于；监禁，关押

examples.en: Please confine your remarks to the main topics on today's agenda.
examples.zh: 请将您的发言限制在今天议程的主要议题内。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多搭配 to，表示限制活动范围、言论主题（confine oneself to），或因病闭门不出（be confined to bed）。

lemmas.def_en: concluding state of pregnancy; from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child
lemmas.def_zh: 限制, 被禁闭, 分娩

examples.en: The political prisoner was held in solitary confinement for over three months.
examples.zh: 那名政治犯被单独禁闭了三个多月。

lemmas.def_en: not confined
lemmas.def_zh: 自由的, 无限制的, 无拘束的, (头发)松散的, 未束的

examples.en: Her unconfined imagination allowed her to write brilliant and original fantasy stories.
examples.zh: 她那不受拘束的想象力使她能够写出精彩独创的奇幻故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（完全）+ fine（界限），本义为用界限框住，引申为限制、监禁或卧床。

lemmas.def_en: not correct; not in conformity with fact or truth
lemmas.def_zh: 不正确的，错误的；不恰当的

examples.en: The report was based on incorrect assumptions and led to wrong conclusions.
examples.zh: 该报告基于不正确的假设，并导致了错误的结论。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，指与事实不符（错误的）或不合礼仪（不恰当的），常搭配 incorrect information、prove incorrect。

lemmas.def_en: in an incorrect manner
lemmas.def_zh: 错误地，不正确地

examples.en: The machine malfunctioned because several cables were installed incorrectly.
examples.zh: 机器发生故障是因为有几根电缆安装错误。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，修饰动词或过去分词，表示方式上不正确地、错误地，常搭配 be incorrectly labeled/installed。

lemmas.def_en: lack of conformity to social expectations
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不正确性

examples.en: The auditor quickly spotted the obvious incorrectness of the submitted financial figures.
examples.zh: 审计员迅速发现了提交的财务数据中明显的不正确性。

family_guide.root_logic: 否定前缀 in-（非）+ correct（正确的），表示不正确或不合规矩的。

lemmas.def_en: a legal document signed and sealed and delivered to effect a transfer of property and to show the legal right to possess it
lemmas.def_zh: 行为，事迹；房契，契约

examples.en: A good deed never goes entirely unrewarded.
examples.zh: 善行终有善报。

lemmas.usage_note: 指具体行为时偏书面（如 good deed）；法律上特指房契或契约，常用于 title deed。

lemmas.def_en: improper or wicked or immoral behavior
lemmas.def_zh: 罪行, 犯罪

examples.en: He felt deep remorse for his childhood misdeed and tried to atone.
examples.zh: 他对自己童年时的罪过深感懊悔，并试图弥补。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 dǣd，与 do（做）同源，本义为所做的事，后引申为法律上的契约证书。

lemmas.def_en: a cherished desire
lemmas.def_zh: 抱负，雄心，野心

examples.en: Her lifelong ambition was to become a world-renowned pediatric surgeon.
examples.zh: 她毕生的抱负是成为一名世界知名的小儿外科医生。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指对成功或权力的强烈渴望（不可数），也可指具体抱负（可数），常搭配 achieve/fulfill one's ambition。

lemmas.def_en: a strong drive for success
lemmas.def_zh: 不凡的抱负

examples.en: Her ambitiousness drove her to work long hours and secure rapid promotions.
examples.zh: 她的雄心抱负促使她长时间工作并迅速获得晋升。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (rare) To desire eagerly or seek ambitiously.
lemmas.def_zh: 热切追求，有雄心获得

examples.en: He openly ambitioned the directorship of the new research facility.
examples.zh: 他公开觊觎着那个新研究中心主任的职位。

lemmas.usage_note: 罕见或口语方言中作及物动词，表示极力追求、觊觎某职位或目标，一般更推荐使用 aspire 或 strive。

lemmas.def_en: having a strong desire for success or achievement
lemmas.def_zh: 有雄心的，有野心的；宏大的，艰巨的

examples.en: The city announced an ambitious plan to achieve carbon neutrality by 2035.
examples.zh: 该市公布了一项雄心勃勃的计划，拟在2035年前实现碳中和。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容人时指有雄心的、上进的；形容计划或工程时指宏大的、艰巨的，常修饰 project 或 plan。

lemmas.def_en: having little desire for success or achievement
lemmas.def_zh: 无名利心的, 无野心的, 谦虚的

examples.en: He lived a quiet and unambitious life in a small coastal village.
examples.zh: 他在一个沿海小村庄里过着安静且无甚野心的生活。

lemmas.def_en: with ambition; in an ambitious and energetic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 雄心勃勃地；劲头十足地；热切地

examples.en: The young startup aims ambitiously to disrupt the global delivery market this year.
examples.zh: 这家年轻的初创公司雄心勃勃，意在今年颠覆全球快递市场。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 ambire（走动，巡回），原指古罗马政客为拉选票而四处巡游，引申为对权力或成功的强烈渴望。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (usually passive) To make someone or something certain to fail, suffer, or die.
lemmas.def_zh: 注定（失败、受苦、灭亡等）；判定，判决

examples.en: Without sufficient funding, the entire project is doomed to fail.
examples.zh: 如果缺乏充足的资金，整个项目注定要失败。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常用于被动语态 be doomed to (failure/death)，表示不可避免地注定走向悲惨结局。

lemmas.def_en: an unpleasant or disastrous destiny
lemmas.def_zh: 注定（失败、受苦等）

examples.en: Dark storm clouds gathered, giving the sailors an ominous sense of doom.
examples.zh: 乌云密布，给水手们带来一种不祥的厄运感。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，文学色彩浓厚，指毁灭、灭亡或厄运，高频搭配如 impending doom 或 meeting one's doom。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 注定失败的；注定灭亡的；劫数难逃的
lemmas.def_en: certain to fail, die, or be destroyed
lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 be doomed to failure / extinction 等搭配，修饰计划、命运或群体，带有强烈的不可避免的悲剧色彩。

examples.en: Without immediate financial support, the rescue project is doomed to fail.
examples.zh: 如果没有及时的资金支持，该救援项目注定要失败。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 dōm（审判、法令），后语义特化为对灾难、死亡或不可逆悲剧的裁定。

lemmas.def_en: social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers
lemmas.def_zh: n. 蚂蚁

examples.en: A lone ant crawled across the kitchen counter in search of food.
examples.zh: 一只落单的蚂蚁爬过厨房台面寻找食物。

lemmas.usage_note: 普通名词，习语 have ants in one's pants 表“坐立不安”，注意与 aunt（姑母）发音区分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 æmette，字面意为“咬噬者”，后演化为指代蚂蚁。

lemmas.def_en: a gliding joint between the distal ends of the tibia and fibula and the proximal end of the talus
lemmas.def_zh: n. 踝，脚踝

examples.en: She slipped on the ice and twisted her ankle badly.
examples.zh: 她在冰上滑倒，严重扭伤了脚踝。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 twist/sprain 连用表示“扭伤脚踝”；注意不要将脚踝 ankle 与手腕 wrist 混淆。

lemmas.def_zh: 短袜, 脚镯, 脚镣
lemmas.def_en: a shoe for a child or woman that has a strap around the ankle

examples.en: She wore a delicate silver anklet adorned with small shells during her beach vacation.
examples.zh: 她在海滩度假时戴着一条装饰着小贝壳的精致银脚镯。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语族词根，表示弯曲、角或关节处，指小腿与脚相连的部位。

lemmas.def_en: steps consisting of two parallel members connected by rungs; for climbing up or down
lemmas.def_zh: n. 梯子；阶梯，途径；（丝袜的）抽丝破洞

examples.en: She worked long hours to climb the corporate ladder quickly.
examples.zh: 她长时间努力工作，以便在公司里迅速获得晋升。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指具象的梯子，也用于比喻晋升途径，高频搭配climb the corporate ladder。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (chiefly British) to develop a vertical line of unraveled stitches in tights or stockings, or cause this to happen.
lemmas.def_zh: （使丝袜、针织品等）抽丝，脱线

examples.en: She accidentally laddered her brand-new tights on the rough edge of the desk.
examples.zh: 她不小心在桌子粗糙的边缘上把新连裤袜勾抽丝了。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中多指长筒丝袜等抽丝起抽，可作及物或不及物动词使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语词根，本义为“倾斜（靠着）”，引申指登高的梯子及类似阶梯状升迁或抽丝破洞。

lemmas.def_en: liquid excretory product
lemmas.def_zh: n. 尿；撒尿（儿语或口语）

examples.en: Excuse me for a moment, I really need to have a pee.
examples.zh: 不好意思失陪一下，我真得去撒个尿了。

lemmas.usage_note: 口语或儿语用法，常用于have a pee或take a pee短语中表示小便。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (informal) To discharge urine from the body.
lemmas.def_zh: 撒尿，小便

examples.en: The puppy peed on the carpet before we could take him outside.
examples.zh: 我们还没来得及把小狗带到外面，它就尿在地毯上了。

lemmas.usage_note: 非正式口语词，表示排尿，常用于pee in/on等短语中，语体较随便。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词或字母“P”（代表 piss）的委婉发音拼写，指排尿。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To state clearly and firmly that something is true or valid.
lemmas.def_zh: 断言，坚定声明；证实，确认

examples.en: The court affirmed the decision made by the lower tribunal.
examples.zh: 法院维持了下级法庭作出的判决。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，常接that从句或名词短语，表示坚决断言或法律上证实。

lemmas.def_en: a reply of affirmation
lemmas.def_zh: n. 肯定词，赞成态度；赞成方

examples.en: When asked if she would accept the offer, she answered in the affirmative.
examples.zh: 当被问及是否接受这份提议时，她给出了肯定的回答。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词in连用（in the affirmative），表示肯定答复或辩论中的赞成方。

lemmas.def_en: a statement asserting the existence or the truth of something
lemmas.def_zh: 肯定, 断言, 证实

examples.en: Constant verbal affirmation from parents helps build a child's inner self-confidence.
examples.zh: 来自父母持续的口头肯定有助于建立孩子的内心自信。

lemmas.def_en: in an affirmative manner
lemmas.def_zh: 肯定地；断然地

examples.en: When asked if he accepted the job offer, he answered affirmatively.
examples.zh: 当被问及是否接受这份工作时，他做出了肯定的回答。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 ad-（加强）+ firm（坚固，稳固），核心含义是“使之稳固、证实或断言”。
family_guide.core_distinction: affirm 强调断言或证实某事的真实性；affirmative 作名词指肯定词或赞成的一方。

lemmas.def_en: dry outer covering of a fruit or seed or nut
lemmas.def_zh: n. 船体，船身；（果实或种子等的）外壳

examples.en: Inspectors found several hairline cracks beneath the steel hull of the vessel.
examples.zh: 检查人员在船只的钢制船体下方发现了几处细微裂纹。

lemmas.usage_note: 航海中专指船身外壳，农学中指谷物果实的皮壳，为标准书面名词。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To remove the outer covering, shell, or stem from seeds, nuts, or fruit.
lemmas.def_zh: 去壳，去皮，去蒂（草莓等）

examples.en: Wash and hull the fresh strawberries before adding them to the batter.
examples.zh: 在将新鲜草莓加入面糊之前，先清洗并去掉果蒂。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给草莓等果实去蒂去壳，或在军事上指击穿舰船的船体。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自日耳曼语词根，本义为“覆盖、外壳”，后引申为谷物豆类的外皮以及船体的外壳。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To feel that you do not like someone or something.
lemmas.def_zh: 不喜欢，讨厌，反感

examples.en: I strongly dislike working in environments with constant loud noise.
examples.zh: 我非常讨厌在持续喧闹的环境中工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 后接名词、代词或动名词（doing），语气比hate温和，表示反感。

lemmas.def_en: an inclination to withhold approval from some person or group
lemmas.def_zh: n. 不喜爱；厌恶

examples.en: He developed a deep dislike of spicy food after his trip abroad.
examples.zh: 那次出国旅行之后，他对手辣味食物产生了深深的反感。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，常与for/of搭配，常见固定组合likes and dislikes。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（否定，相反）+ like（喜欢），核心含义为“不喜爱、讨厌”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To give an unofficial name, nickname, or title to someone or something. 2. [T] To confer knighthood on someone. 3. [T] To replace the original spoken dialogue in a film or broadcast with another recording or language.
lemmas.def_zh: 把……称为，给……起绰号；授予称号（如封爵）；（为电影等）配音

examples.en: The local press dubbed him the city's unsung hero.
examples.zh: 当地媒体称他为这座城市的无名英雄。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“戏称/授予称号”常用于 be dubbed as 或双宾结构；表示影视“配音”常搭配 dub sth into (a language)。

family_guide.root_logic: 本义为“以剑拍肩授予骑士称号”，后引申指赋予称号、起绰号，以及给影视作品“配音”。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of sympathy and sorrow for the misfortunes of others
lemmas.def_zh: n. 同情，怜悯；可惜的事，遗憾

examples.en: It is a pity that you could not attend the award ceremony yesterday.
examples.zh: 你昨天没能出席颁奖典礼，真是太可惜了。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示同情时常与take/feel/have搭配；作可惜讲时常用it is a pity that。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To feel sorrow, sympathy, or compassion for someone in an unfortunate or suffering condition.
lemmas.def_zh: 同情，怜悯

examples.en: Do not pity him, because he brought all these troubles upon himself.
examples.zh: 别同情他，因为这些麻烦全是他自找的。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，直接接人或群体作宾语，表示怜悯，有时带有居高临下的意味。

lemmas.def_en: inspiring mixed contempt and pity
lemmas.def_zh: 慈悲的, 可怜的, 令人同情的, 可鄙的

examples.en: The abandoned puppy looked utterly pitiful shivering outside in the pouring rain.
examples.zh: 那只被遗弃的小狗在大雨中瑟瑟发抖，显得极其可怜。

lemmas.def_en: without mercy or pity
lemmas.def_zh: 无情的, 冷酷的, 无怜悯心的

examples.en: The hikers faced pitiless desert winds that swept across the barren dunes.
examples.zh: 徒步者们面临着席卷荒凉沙丘的无情狂风。

lemmas.def_en: deserving or inciting pity; ; ; - Galsworthy
lemmas.def_zh: 哀怨的, 可怜的, 慈悲的

examples.en: The trapped kitten let out a piteous cry from the drainage pipe.
examples.zh: 被困的小猫在排水管里发出一声哀怨可怜的啼叫。

lemmas.def_en: to a pitiful degree
lemmas.def_zh: 可怜地, 令人怜悯地；可恨地

examples.en: The tiny monthly pension was pitifully inadequate to cover her living expenses.
examples.zh: 那笔微薄的月养老金少得可怜，根本不足以支付她的生活开销。

lemmas.def_en: in a piteous manner
lemmas.def_zh: 可怜地, 凄惨地; 慈悲地

examples.en: The lost child wept piteously until a helpful police officer found him.
examples.zh: 走失的孩子凄惨地哭泣着，直到一位热心的警官找到了他。

lemmas.def_en: without pity; in a merciless manner
lemmas.def_zh: 无情地, 冷酷地

examples.en: Winter storms battered the remote coastal village pitilessly throughout late December.
examples.zh: 在十二月下旬，冬季风暴无情地肆虐着那个偏远的海滨村庄。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pietas（虔诚、孝顺、慈悲），与 piety 同源，后聚焦于“同情、怜悯或令人遗憾的事”。

lemmas.def_en: a small lake
lemmas.def_zh: n. 池塘

examples.en: Ducks were gliding peacefully across the surface of the pond.
examples.zh: 鸭子们在池塘的水面上悠然滑行。

lemmas.usage_note: 指天然或人工小水塘，如 fish pond；跨大西洋口语戏称英美间的大洋为 across the pond（大洋彼岸）。

family_guide.root_logic: 变体自 pound（围场，蓄圈），原指“围圈蓄水的水池”，现泛指池塘。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To take a firm hold of someone or something with your hand. 2. To completely understand a fact or an idea.
lemmas.def_zh: 抓紧，抓牢；理解，领会

examples.en: She immediately grasped the main point of the complex argument.
examples.zh: 她立刻领会了这个复杂论点的要旨。

lemmas.usage_note: 物理上指紧握，抽象上指透彻理解（grasp the concept）；搭配 grasp an opportunity 表示牢牢抓住机会。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语或日耳曼拟意词，核心动作是“用手紧紧抓握”，引申为智力上的“完全理解领会”。

lemmas.def_en: a belief (or system of beliefs) accepted as authoritative by some group or school
lemmas.def_zh: n. 教义，教条；主义，学说

examples.en: The government adopted a new military doctrine focused on cyber defense.
examples.zh: 政府采纳了聚焦于网络防御的新军事学说。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式书面语，指宗教教义、政党政治信条或军事学说，常与military/legal连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 教导, 教化
lemmas.def_en: teaching someone to accept doctrines uncritically
relating to or involving or preoccupied with doctrine
lemmas.def_zh: 教义的, 教诲的, 学说的

examples.en: The two religious groups parted ways because of serious doctrinal differences.
examples.zh: 这两个宗教团体由于严重的教义分歧而分道扬镳。

lemmas.def_en: as a matter of doctrine
lemmas.def_zh: 教条地

examples.en: The proposal was considered sound politically, but doctrinally unacceptable to the church council.
examples.zh: 该提案在政治上可行，但教会委员会认为其在教义上不可接受。

lemmas.def_zh: 灌输，强行灌输（思想或信仰）；教导
lemmas.def_en: [T] To teach someone to accept a set of beliefs uncritically and without questioning.

examples.en: The regime used state media to indoctrinate citizens with extreme political beliefs from youth.
examples.zh: 该政权利用官方媒体向公民灌输极端的政治信仰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 docere（讲授，教导），指被系统教授并被集体信奉的“教义、学说、信条”。

lemmas.def_en: young sheep
lemmas.def_zh: 小羊, 羔羊

examples.en: We ordered roasted lamb served with seasonal vegetables for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们晚餐点了配时令蔬菜的烤羊肉。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词指活羔羊，不可数名词指羔羊肉，烹饪及农牧业高频词。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (of a female sheep) To give birth to lambs.
lemmas.def_zh: 产羊羔，下羊羔

examples.en: The farmers stayed awake all night as the ewes began to lamb.
examples.zh: 随着母羊开始产羔，农夫们整夜都没有合眼。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，专门用于畜牧业语境，指母羊产羔或接生羔羊。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 lamb，核心指代“羊羔”及“母羊产羔”的动作。

lemmas.def_en: difficult to detect or grasp by the mind or analyze
lemmas.def_zh: 敏锐的, 精细的, 狡猾的, 稀薄的, 灵巧的, 微妙的

examples.en: She noticed a subtle change in his tone when the topic came up.
examples.zh: 当提起这个话题时，她注意到他的语气发生了微妙的变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 字母b不发音；常修饰 difference/hint/change，表示微妙、难以察觉的差异，褒义时亦指心思巧妙敏锐。

lemmas.def_en: lacking subtlety; obvious
lemmas.def_zh: 不细致的, 不敏锐的, 不灵巧的

examples.en: His unsubtle attempts to flatter the boss annoyed everyone in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 他不加掩饰地拍老板马屁的举动惹恼了会议室里的所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 subtilis（细致编织的），引申出“微妙”、“隐约”或“敏锐”之意。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To break, crack, or split, especially of a bone, rock, or hard object. 2. [I, T] (of a group, organization, or relationship) To split or break apart.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）破裂，（使）断裂，（使）骨折；（使关系等）分裂

examples.en: The intense cold caused the thick ice layer on the lake to fracture loudly.
examples.zh: 刺骨的严寒导致湖面上厚厚的冰层咔嚓一声破裂了。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学上指骨折（及物或不及物）；社会学或政治语境常指组织、关系的破裂瓦解，比 break 更正式。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 frangere（打破），指骨骼、物体或关系的破裂、断裂。

lemmas.def_en: a manservant (usually the head servant of a household) who has charge of wines and the table
lemmas.def_zh: 男管家, 司膳总管

examples.en: The wealthy family relied on their loyal butler to manage the entire estate smoothly.
examples.zh: 这个富裕家庭依靠忠诚的男管家来顺畅管理整个庄园。

lemmas.usage_note: 专指大宅或豪门中的男管家总管；现代酒店服务中常用于 butler service（专属贴身管家服务）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 bouteillier（掌管酒瓶的人），引申为管家、家仆之长。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make something as good, effective, or efficient as possible.
lemmas.def_zh: 优化，使达到最佳状态；充分利用

examples.en: Engineers are working tirelessly to optimize the app's performance.
examples.zh: 工程师们正不知疲倦地工作，以优化该应用程序的性能。

lemmas.usage_note: 科技与工程高频词，及物动词，指改善系统或算法以达到最佳效果。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (British English) To make something as good, efficient, or effective as possible.
lemmas.def_zh: 使最优化，使尽可能有效（optimize的英式拼写）

examples.en: We need to organise our schedule carefully to optimise the limited time available.
examples.zh: 我们需要仔细安排日程，以尽可能充分利用有限的时间。

lemmas.def_en: the act of rendering optimal
lemmas.def_zh: 最佳化, 最优化

examples.en: Continuous optimization of the supply chain reduced operational expenses.
examples.zh: 对供应链的持续优化降低了运营开支。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，常见搭配包括system optimization或cost optimization。

lemmas.def_en: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied
lemmas.def_zh: 最佳的, 最理想的

examples.en: The greenhouse creates optimal conditions for tropical plant growth.
examples.zh: 温室为热带植物的生长创造了最佳条件。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词作定语，修饰conditions、solution等，表示客观上的最优状态。

lemmas.def_zh: 最优的, 最适宜的
lemmas.def_en: most desirable possible under a restriction expressed or implied

examples.en: Keep the refrigerator at the optimum temperature to preserve food safely.
examples.zh: 将冰箱保持在最适宜的温度以安全保存食物。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词时只用于名词前作定语，常修饰level、temperature等量化指标。

lemmas.def_en: in an optimal and most desirable way
lemmas.def_zh: 最佳

examples.en: The heating system must be maintained regularly to ensure that it functions optimally.
examples.zh: 供暖系统必须定期维护，以确保其处于最佳运行状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 optimus（最好），加后缀 -ize 表示“使达到最佳状态”。
family_guide.core_distinction: optimize 为动词操作；optimization 为优化的过程或状态名词。

lemmas.def_en: street names for marijuana
lemmas.def_zh: 吸毒者, 笨蛋, 麻醉药物, 粘稠物

examples.en: The reporter managed to get the inside dope on the political scandal.
examples.zh: 记者设法获取了那起政治丑闻的内部内幕。

lemmas.usage_note: 俚语中指毒品大麻或笨蛋，非正式用法中也指内部消息（the inside dope）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To give medicine, a sedative, or performance-enhancing drugs to a person or animal. 2. [I] (informal) To take illegal recreational drugs or doping substances.
lemmas.def_zh: 给……下药（或服用兴奋剂、镇静剂）；服用兴奋剂；吸毒

examples.en: The athlete was banned for life after attempting to dope before the finals.
examples.zh: 该运动员因在决赛前企图使用兴奋剂而被终身禁赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指给赛马、运动员等服用违禁药物，或下麻醉药迷倒某人。

lemmas.def_en: having or revealing stupidity
lemmas.def_zh: 被麻醉的, 呆笨的, 迟钝的

examples.en: He felt quite dopey for hours after waking up from the general anesthesia.
examples.zh: 从全身麻醉中醒来后，他昏昏沉沉了好几个小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 doop（蘸酱、粘稠液体），后引申为麻醉剂、兴奋剂及相关动作。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To repair, renovate, or restore a building, environment, or system to good condition. 2. [T] To help someone return to a healthy, normal life after illness, addiction, or imprisonment.
lemmas.def_zh: 修复，改造（建筑等使其恢复良好状态）；使康复，使恢复正常生活；恢复（名誉、地位）

examples.en: The physical therapy program helped rehabilitate the injured athlete after surgery.
examples.zh: 理疗项目帮助这位受伤的运动员在术后恢复了健康。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指通过治疗或培训使人恢复健康或正常生活，亦可指修复名誉或老旧建筑，常接介词 into。

lemmas.def_en: the restoration of someone to a useful place in society
lemmas.def_zh: 复原

examples.en: She spent three months in rehabilitation learning to walk again.
examples.zh: 她在康复中心度过了三个月，重新学习走路。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于医疗、司法与建筑领域，常见搭配有 undergo rehabilitation 与 stroke rehabilitation。

lemmas.def_en: designed to accomplish rehabilitation; - J.B.Costello
lemmas.def_zh: 使复原的, 复职的

examples.en: The clinic offers specialized rehabilitative therapy to help stroke patients recover their speech.
examples.zh: 该诊所提供专门的康复治疗，帮助中风患者恢复语言功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 re-（重新）+ habilitate（使有能力），核心语义为“使恢复正常状态或能力”。
family_guide.core_distinction: rehabilitate 为动词动作；rehabilitation 为康复、恢复名誉的名词形式。

lemmas.def_en: someone who performs rap music
lemmas.def_zh: 敲门人, (美)(非正式)控告人, 证人, 检举人

examples.en: The old wooden door had a heavy brass rapper shaped like a lion head.
examples.zh: 那扇老木门上有一个狮头形状的沉重黄铜门环。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于音乐语境，指说唱歌手；常见搭配有 aspiring rapper（有抱负的说唱歌手）或 hip-hop rapper。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词 rap（说唱）加表示人的后缀 -er，特指说唱歌手。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
lemmas.def_zh: 克, 绿豆, 鹰嘴豆

examples.en: The baker added just one extra gram of salt to balance the sweet dough.
examples.zh: 面包师只多加了一克盐来中和甜面团的味道。

lemmas.usage_note: 重量单位克，常与数词连用；搭配 per gram（每克）或 be measured in grams，英式常拼作 gramme。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 gramma（小重量单位），为公制重量单位“克”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ about/over) To pause before doing or saying something because of uncertainty, doubt, or nervousness.
lemmas.def_zh: 犹豫，踌躇，迟疑

examples.en: Please do not hesitate to contact our customer support if you have questions.
examples.zh: 如果您有任何疑问，请随时联系我们的客户支持。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示由于疑虑或担忧而停顿，常用于 don't hesitate to do sth（尽管做某事）或 hesitate about。

lemmas.def_en: indecision in speech or action
lemmas.def_zh: 犹豫, 踌躇, 含糊, 口吃, 暂停

examples.en: He accepted the challenging job offer without a moment's hesitation.
examples.zh: 他毫不犹豫地接受了这份极具挑战性的工作邀请。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，常与介词 without 连用表示“毫不犹豫”，也常与 have no hesitation in doing 搭配。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of diffidence and indecision about doing something
lemmas.def_zh: 踌躇, 犹豫

examples.en: His noticeable hesitancy during the interview raised concerns about his confidence level.
examples.zh: 他在面试中明显的犹豫不决引起了人们对其自信程度的担忧。

lemmas.def_zh: 踌躇, 犹豫
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of diffidence and indecision about doing something

examples.en: His momentary hesitance before answering made the interviewers quite suspicious.
examples.zh: 他回答前片刻的犹豫引起了面试官的怀疑。

lemmas.def_zh: 迟疑地；踌躇地
lemmas.def_en: with hesitation; in a hesitant manner

examples.en: he finally accepted hesitantly

lemmas.def_en: without hesitation
lemmas.def_zh: 不踌躇地, 坚定地, 迅速地; 爽爽快快

examples.en: The brave lifeguard jumped unhesitatingly into the rough water to save the child.
examples.zh: 勇敢的救生员毫不犹豫地跳入汹涌的水中去救那个孩子。

lemmas.def_en: with hesitation; in a hesitant manner
lemmas.def_zh: 踌躇地, 含糊地, 犹豫地

examples.en: The nervous witness stepped forward hesitatingly to identify the suspect in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 紧张的证人犹豫不决地走上前去，在法庭上指认嫌疑人。

lemmas.def_zh: 迟疑的, 踌躇的, 犹豫不定的
lemmas.def_en: lacking decisiveness of character; unable to act or decide quickly or firmly

examples.en: Investors remain hesitant to fund early-stage startups in this volatile market.
examples.zh: 在当前动荡的市场环境下，投资者对资助初创企业依然犹豫不决。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，形容态度犹疑不决，后常接介词 about、in 或动词不定式 to do。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by quickness and firmness
lemmas.def_zh: 不踌躇的, 不犹豫的, 迅速的

examples.en: She offered unhesitating support when her friend asked for help during the crisis.
examples.zh: 在朋友危难求助时，她毫不犹豫地施以援手。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 haesitare（卡住、结巴、停留），引申为思想动作上的迟疑。
family_guide.core_distinction: hesitate 为动词动作；hesitation 为犹豫的心理状态或名词表现。

lemmas.def_en: a prisoner who is held by one party to insure that another party will meet specified terms
lemmas.def_zh: 人质, 抵押品

examples.en: The government negotiated through diplomats to secure the safe release of the hostage.
examples.zh: 政府通过外交官进行谈判，以确保人质安全获释。

lemmas.usage_note: 核心动词搭配有 take/hold sb hostage（绑架/扣押某人为质），介词用 as a hostage；注意名词不加被动。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 hostage，指作为担保或被强行扣押的“人质”。

lemmas.def_en: denoting a quantity consisting of six items or units
lemmas.def_zh: [计] vi文本编辑器

examples.en: Experienced programmers often prefer the vi editor for quick edits on remote servers.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的程序员通常更喜欢用 vi 编辑器在远程服务器上快速修改。

lemmas.usage_note: 作罗马数字表示“六”，多用于世纪（the VI century）、章节或君主世系后，一般大写且只作定语。

family_guide.root_logic: 通常为罗马数字缩写或语法缩写；作为词典词头通常标作罗马数字六（即第六的）。

lemmas.def_en: located, suited for, or taking place within a building
lemmas.def_zh: 户内的, 室内的

examples.en: Bad weather forced the school to move the sports event to the indoor gym.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气迫使学校将体育赛事移至室内体育馆举行。

lemmas.usage_note: 仅作前置定语修饰名词，如 indoor sports/activities；切勿作表语或状语，表示“在室内”须用 indoors。

family_guide.root_logic: 合成词 in（在内）+ door（门），本义为“门内的”，引申为室内的。

lemmas.def_en: lacking physical depth; having little spatial extension downward or inward from an outer surface or backward or outward from a center
lemmas.def_zh: 浅的, 肤浅的

examples.en: Young children should only paddle in the shallow end of the pool.
examples.zh: 幼童只应在游泳池的浅水区戏水。

lemmas.usage_note: 既可指水、坑等物理深度浅，也可引申指人、见解或呼吸肤浅，常见搭配如 shallow water、shallow breathing。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To become or make less deep, intense, or profound.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）变浅，（使）变少；减弱

examples.en: The coastal waters shallow rapidly as you approach the rocky shoreline.
examples.zh: 随着靠近岩石嶙峋的海岸线，近海水位迅速变浅。

lemmas.usage_note: 较少见的及物或不及物动词，指水域变浅或使水域变浅，常与 out 连用（shallow out）。

lemmas.def_en: lack of depth of knowledge or thought or feeling
lemmas.def_zh: 浅；肤浅

examples.en: Critics quickly pointed out the extreme shallowness of the candidate's proposed tax policies.
examples.zh: 批评人士迅速指出了候选人拟议税收政策的极度肤浅。

lemmas.def_en: in a shallow manner
lemmas.def_zh: 浅浅地; 不深地; 肤浅地; 浅薄地

examples.en: Under severe stress, he began breathing shallowly and clutching at his racing chest.
examples.zh: 在极度紧张下，他开始浅浅地呼吸，并紧抓着狂跳的胸口。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语，与 shoal（浅滩）同源，核心指深度不足或见识浮浅。

lemmas.def_en: a cushion to support the head of a sleeping person
lemmas.def_zh: 枕头, 靠垫, 枕状岩

examples.en: She fluffed up her down pillow before settling into bed for the night.
examples.zh: 上床安睡前，她把羽绒枕头拍得蓬松松的。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常指睡觉时垫头的枕头，常见搭配包括 pillow fight（枕头大战）和 pillow talk（枕边悄悄话）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To rest your head or an object on something soft as if on a pillow.
lemmas.def_zh: 枕，垫；把……枕在，把……垫在

examples.en: Tired from the long journey, the child pillowed her head on her mother's lap.
examples.zh: 因长途旅行而疲惫不堪的孩子把头枕在母亲的腿上。

lemmas.usage_note: 文学或具象用法，表示“把头枕在……上”或“垫着”，常与 on 或 against 连用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 pulvinus（垫子），指起支撑和缓冲作用的软枕，引申作动词“枕着”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To refuse openly to obey a person, rule, or law. 2. [T] To be impossible to explain, describe, or believe.
lemmas.def_zh: 违抗，反抗，藐视；使无法（相信、解释等）

examples.en: The brave protesters took to the streets to defy the curfew imposed by the regime.
examples.zh: 勇敢的抗议者走上街头，公然违抗政权强加的宵禁令。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示公然违抗权威、法令，或某事超出理解范围，常搭 defy authority 或 defy description。

lemmas.def_en: intentionally contemptuous behavior or attitude
lemmas.def_zh: 蔑视, 挑战

examples.en: He folded his arms and held her gaze in clear defiance of her orders.
examples.zh: 他双臂抱胸，直视着她的目光，公然蔑视她的命令。

lemmas.def_en: boldly resisting authority or an opposing force
lemmas.def_zh: 挑衅的, 目中无人的

examples.en: The defiant child crossed his arms and flatly refused to eat his cold dinner.
examples.zh: 那个叛逆的孩子双臂交叉，断然拒绝吃冰凉的晚饭。

lemmas.def_en: in a rebellious manner
lemmas.def_zh: 对抗地；挑战地

examples.en: The brave student stood defiantly before the principal, refusing to betray his close friends.
examples.zh: 那位勇敢的学生挑衅般地站在校长面前，拒绝出卖好友。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dis-（解除）+ fidere（信任），原指“撕毁誓约、宣战”，演变为公开抗拒或藐视权威、规则。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous relatively small elongated soft-bodied animals especially of the phyla Annelida and Chaetognatha and Nematoda and Nemertea and Platyhelminthes; also many insect larvae
lemmas.def_zh: 虫, 蠕虫, 小人物, 螺纹, 蜗杆

examples.en: The robin tugged a long earthworm out of the damp soil.
examples.zh: 知更鸟从湿润的泥土中拽出了一条长长的蚯蚓。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指蠕虫或软体小虫，口语中可蔑称小人，也常用于谚语 the early bird catches the worm。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To move slowly forward by wriggling, crawling, or twisting the body. 2. [T] ('worm one's way into/out of') To insinuate or maneuver oneself subtly. 3. [T] To treat an animal to expel parasitic worms.
lemmas.def_zh: 蠕行，爬行前进；钻营（worm one's way into）；给（动物）驱虫

examples.en: He skillfully managed to worm his way into the executive committee.
examples.zh: 他手段老练，想方设法钻营进了执行委员会。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 one's way into 搭配表示“慢慢钻入/巧妙钻营”，也指给动物驱虫（worm a pet）。

lemmas.def_en: infested with or damaged (as if eaten) by worms
lemmas.def_zh: 有蛀虫的, 虫多的, 虫蛀的

examples.en: He discarded the wormy apples he found beneath the old tree in the orchard.
examples.zh: 他扔掉了在果园老树下捡到的长了虫的苹果。

family_guide.root_logic: 古日耳曼语源，原指蠕虫、蛇或爬虫，动作上引申指像虫子一样缓慢蠕动或暗中钻营。

lemmas.def_en: large slender food and game fish widely distributed in warm seas (especially around Hawaii)
lemmas.def_zh: 海豚

examples.en: A playful dolphin leaped gracefully out of the ocean alongside our small tour boat.
examples.zh: 一只顽皮的海豚在我们的小游船旁优雅地跃出海面。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，注意海豚是哺乳动物而非鱼类；群用 a pod/school of dolphins，常见搭配 dolphin pod。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 delphis（海豚），词根与子宫相关，指这一类具有胎生特性的海洋哺乳动物。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden outburst of anger
lemmas.def_zh: 脾气，情绪

examples.en: He tried hard to control his temper during the heated debate.
examples.zh: 在激烈的辩论中，他竭力克制自己的脾气。

lemmas.usage_note: 脾气，情绪

lemmas.def_en: the trait of avoiding excesses
lemmas.def_zh: 节欲, 戒酒, 禁酒, 节制

examples.en: His doctor strongly advised strict temperance in both eating habits and alcohol consumption.
examples.zh: 他的医生强烈建议他在饮食和饮酒方面都要保持严格节制。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To make something less severe or extreme, especially by moderating or softening it. 2. To harden or strengthen metal or glass by heating and cooling.
lemmas.def_zh: 缓和，调和，使温和；使回火，淬炼

examples.en: The experienced judge decided to temper justice with mercy in this rare case.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的法官决定在这个罕见的案子中恩威并施、宽大处理。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语及物动词，指“使缓和、冲淡”，常用于 temper A with B，或工业上指对金属“回火回炼”。

lemmas.def_en: not brought to a proper consistency or hardness
lemmas.def_zh: 未回火的, 没有锻炼的, 未调和好的

examples.en: His speech was fueled by raw, untempered anger that shocked everyone in the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演讲充满了原始且未经克制的愤怒，震惊了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 temperare（适度调和、调配），引申指身心情绪的配比平衡（脾气），或使金属通过回火达到最佳软硬度（锤炼）。

lemmas.def_en: a distinctive emotional aura experienced instinctively
lemmas.def_zh: 感应

examples.en: This cozy little cafe gives off a relaxed vibe with its soft acoustic music.
examples.zh: 这家舒适的小咖啡馆播放着轻柔的原声音乐，给人一种轻松的氛围。

lemmas.usage_note: 极高频口语词，常复数表示氛围或感觉，搭配如 give off good vibes、ruin the vibe，指场所或人的气场。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 vibration（震动）的截短词，现代口语中借指人或环境散发出的“气场、氛围或感觉”。

lemmas.def_en: the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well
lemmas.def_zh: 乐观主义, 乐观, 乐天

examples.en: There is growing optimism about the country's upcoming economic recovery.
examples.zh: 人们对该国即将到来的经济复苏抱有越来越大的乐观态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数抽象名词，指对未来的积极态度，常与介词 about 搭配，如 cautious optimism（谨慎乐观）。

lemmas.def_zh: 乐观者, 乐观主义者
lemmas.def_en: a person disposed to take a favorable view of things

examples.en: As an incurable optimist, she always looks for the silver lining in every crisis.
examples.zh: 作为一个无可救药的乐天派，她总能在每次危机中看到积极的一面。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指生性乐观的人，常与介词 by nature 搭配，反义词为 pessimist。

lemmas.def_en: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds
lemmas.def_zh: 乐观的, 乐观主义的, 乐天的

examples.en: The medical team is cautiously optimistic about the patient's chances of a full recovery.
examples.zh: 医疗团队对这名患者完全康复的前景持谨慎乐观态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 作表语或定语，表示乐观的，常接介词 about，搭配结构为 be optimistic that / about sth。

lemmas.def_en: with optimism; in an optimistic manner
lemmas.def_zh: 乐观地；乐天地

examples.en: She optimistically predicted that the construction project would finish ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 她乐观地预测这项建筑工程将提前完工。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 optimus（最好），哲学上指“凡事皆趋向最好的状态”，引申为乐观主义。

lemmas.def_en: worthy of notice
lemmas.def_zh: 值得注意的, 显著的

examples.en: The historic town is notable for its well-preserved medieval architecture.
examples.zh: 这座历史名镇因其保存完好的中世纪建筑而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示值得注意的或著名的，常搭配 notable example、notable achievement，后接介词 for。

lemmas.def_en: a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
lemmas.def_zh: 著名人士, 值得注意之事物

examples.en: Local notables and city officials gathered at the banquet to welcome the foreign diplomats.
examples.zh: 当地名流和市政府官员齐聚宴会，欢迎外国外交官。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，通常用复数 notables，多指社会名流、要人或重要人物，属于正式语体。

lemmas.def_en: a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
lemmas.def_zh: 显著, 著名, 著名人物

examples.en: The young pianist achieved international notability after winning the prestigious global competition.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在赢得声誉卓著的全球竞赛后闻名国际。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 note（注意）+ -able（能够……的），核心逻辑是“值得被注意、显而易见的”。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form
lemmas.def_zh: 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的

examples.en: She enrolled in an intensive language course to prepare for her overseas assignment.
examples.zh: 她报名参加了一门高强度语言集训班，以便为外派任务做准备。

lemmas.usage_note: 指短时间内高度集中的、强化的，常见搭配有 intensive care（特护）、intensive training、labor-intensive。

lemmas.def_en: in an intensive manner
lemmas.def_zh: 强烈地；集中地

examples.en: Researchers have been studying the newly discovered virus intensively for the past few months.
examples.zh: 在过去几个月里，研究人员一直在深入密集地研究这种新发现的病毒。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 intendere（拉紧、集中注意力），-ive 为形容词后缀，强调力量、时间或资源高度集中和紧绷的状态。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ for/from) To ask someone earnestly for money, help, votes, or information. 2. [I, T] (formal) To approach people to offer sexual services in exchange for money.
lemmas.def_zh: 恳求，请求，征集；招揽（生意）

examples.en: The charity went door to door to solicit donations for the flood victims.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构挨家挨户上门为洪水灾民募集捐款。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，指恳切地征求意见、请求捐赠或招揽生意，常搭配 solicit advice/funds from sb。

lemmas.def_en: a petitioner who solicits contributions or trade or votes
lemmas.def_zh: (英)律师, 初级律师, (美)法务官, (美)掮客, 游说者, (美)募捐者

examples.en: She consulted a solicitor to help draft her will and finalize the property sale.
examples.zh: 她咨询了一位事务律师，以协助起草遗嘱并完成房产出售事宜。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指事务律师（处理诉讼准备及非诉业务）；美式英语中常指法务官或募捐掮客。

lemmas.def_en: an entreaty addressed to someone of superior status
lemmas.def_zh: 恳求, 恳请, 教唆, 诱惑

examples.en: The university strictly prohibits the unauthorized solicitation of commercial business on campus.
examples.zh: 该大学严禁在校园内进行未经授权的商业揽客行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sollicitare（搅动、促动），演变为主动上前央求、请求支持或招徕生意。
family_guide.core_distinction: solicitor 在英国专指“初级事务律师/诉状律师”，在北美则指“募捐者/推销员”。

lemmas.def_en: able to be compared or worthy of comparison
lemmas.def_zh: 可比较的, 比得上的

examples.en: The quality of this domestic brand is directly comparable to imported alternatives.
examples.zh: 这一国产品牌的质量完全可以与进口替代品相提并论。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 to 或 with 连用，表示在规模、品质等方面相似或可相提并论，多用于正式论述。

lemmas.def_en: such that comparison is impossible; unsuitable for comparison or lacking features that can be compared
lemmas.def_zh: 无法比较的

examples.en: The natural beauty of the untouched alpine valley remains uncomparable to any other landscape.
examples.zh: 这片原始高山峡谷的自然美景是任何其他景观都无法比拟的。

lemmas.def_en: qualities that are comparable
lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可比较性

examples.en: Standardized metrics were implemented to ensure the comparability of experimental data across laboratories.
examples.zh: 实施标准化指标是为了确保各实验室之间实验数据的可比性。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 compare（比较）+ -able（能……的），指两者性质或体量相近，从而“可以拿来相提并论的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: comparable 强调“可比拟的、类似的”；comparative 强调“相对的、比较而言的（如 comparative study 比较研究）”。

lemmas.def_en: an assistant subject to the authority or control of another
lemmas.def_zh: 子公司, 附件, 辅助者

examples.en: The multinational technology corporation decided to establish a new subsidiary in Southeast Asia.
examples.zh: 这家跨国科技公司决定在东南亚成立一家新的子公司。

lemmas.usage_note: 商业正式用语，指子公司或附属机构，常与 a wholly-owned subsidiary（全资子公司）搭配。

lemmas.def_en: secondary importance
lemmas.def_zh: 权力自主原则, 权力下放原则（允许成员针对影响自身的问题自作主张）

examples.en: The European Union governance model relies heavily on the democratic principle of subsidiarity.
examples.zh: 欧盟的治理模式很大程度上依赖于民主的辅助性原则。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 subsidium（预备队、支援），指提供辅助支持的角色，在现代商业中特指依附于母公司的子公司。

lemmas.def_en: insulting terms of address for people who are stupid or irritating or ridiculous
lemmas.def_zh: 私生子, 劣货

examples.en: In feudal times, a bastard could not inherit his father's noble title.
examples.zh: 在封建时代，私生子无法继承其父亲的贵族爵位。

lemmas.def_en: declaring or rendering bastard
lemmas.def_zh: 认定为私生子

examples.en: Traditionalists heavily criticized the modern film remake for the blatant bastardization of classic literature.
examples.zh: 传统派强烈批评这部现代翻拍电影肆意糟蹋经典文学。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (disapproving) To bastardize a language, art form, or tradition means to corrupt or lower its quality by adding inferior elements.
lemmas.def_zh: vi. 判定/证明...为私生的, 变劣, 变为不纯, 误用语言, 乱用, 使不纯

examples.en: Critics argued that commercial adaptations tend to bastardize the rich subtleties of the original novel.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，商业改编往往会使原著小说丰富的精妙之处变质劣质化。

lemmas.def_en: born out of wedlock; - E.A.Freeman
lemmas.def_zh: 私生的, 假冒的

examples.en: Selling defective medical equipment to rural clinics was condemned as an utterly bastardly crime.
examples.zh: 向乡村诊所出售有缺陷的医疗设备被谴责为极其卑劣下流的罪行。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，原指非婚生子（私生子），后在俚语中泛化为对人粗鲁、恶劣的辱骂，或非正式地用作调侃。

lemmas.def_en: a professional performer who tells jokes and performs comical acts
lemmas.def_zh: 喜剧演员

examples.en: The talented stand-up comedian kept the entire audience laughing with his relatable everyday humor.
examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的单口喜剧演员用引起共鸣的日常幽默让全场捧腹大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 指喜剧演员，常见搭配 a stand-up comedian（脱口秀/单口喜剧演员）；口语中也可指爱开玩笑的逗比。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 comedy（喜剧）+ -ian（人），专门指以幽默风趣逗人发笑为职业的人。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to pass the tongue over the surface of something 2. [I, T] (of flames, waves, etc.) to touch or lap lightly and repeatedly 3. [T] (informal) to defeat or overcome someone easily
lemmas.def_zh: 舔，舔吃；轻拍，拂过；轻易击败

examples.en: The friendly golden retriever ran over to lick my hand as I arrived home.
examples.zh: 当我回到家时，那只友好的金毛寻回犬跑过来舔了舔我的手。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义为舔，口语习语极多，如 lick one's wounds（休养生息）、lick sb's boots（谄媚讨好）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声/印欧词源，模拟舌头触碰并滑过物体表面的动作，亦借指火苗或波浪轻轻掠过。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (informal) To get rid of or abandon someone or something you no longer want. 2. [I, T] To make an emergency landing of an aircraft on water.
lemmas.def_zh: 丢弃，抛弃，甩掉；使（飞机）水上迫降；在……开沟

examples.en: The workers were instructed to ditch along the perimeter of the field to prevent waterlogging.
examples.zh: 工人们接到指示，在田地周边开沟以防止积水成涝。

lemmas.usage_note: 本义指在土地上开沟排水；非正式口语中极高频，意为果断丢弃、摆脱或甩掉某人某物。

lemmas.def_en: a long narrow excavation in the earth
lemmas.def_zh: 沟渠

examples.en: The car veered off the icy highway and ended up in a deep roadside ditch.
examples.zh: 汽车在结冰的公路上偏离方向，最终陷进了路边深沟里。

lemmas.usage_note: 具体名词，指田间、路旁用于排水或灌溉的长沟，常与 dig、drainage 搭配使用。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语意为“挖出的水渠”，引申为倾倒废弃物之处，后作动词表“丢弃”。

lemmas.def_en: the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours
lemmas.def_zh: 刻度盘, 钟面, 转盘

examples.en: The dial on the pressure gauge indicated that the tank was almost empty.
examples.zh: 压力表上的刻度盘显示储罐几乎已经见底了。

lemmas.usage_note: 指钟表盘、仪表盘或收音机等设备的调节转盘，常见搭配有 instrument dial 和 clock dial。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To call a telephone number by pressing buttons or turning a disc; to adjust a control using a dial.
lemmas.def_zh: 拨（电话号码）；（通过转盘或旋钮）调节

examples.en: She panicked and could barely steady her fingers to dial the emergency services.
examples.zh: 她惊慌失措，手指颤抖得几乎无法拨通紧急求助电话。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，指拨打电话号码，常用于 dial a number 或 dial 911 等应急语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自中世纪拉丁语“每日的”，最初指日晷刻度盘，后泛指仪表盘及拨号盘，并转为动词“拨号”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To officially keep someone in custody or confinement, especially for questioning. 2. [T] To delay someone or keep them from proceeding.
lemmas.def_zh: 拘留，扣押；耽搁，延误

examples.en: Customs officers decided to detain the suspect for further questioning at the airport.
examples.zh: 海关人员决定在机场拘留该嫌疑人以作进一步审讯。

lemmas.usage_note: 司法语境指拘留、扣押；日常正式语境指因突发情况耽搁、延误某人，常用于被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: a state of being confined (usually for a short time)
lemmas.def_zh: 阻止, 监禁, 拘留

examples.en: The activist was held in prolonged detention without access to legal representation.
examples.zh: 该维权人士遭到长期拘留，且无法获得法律代理协助。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，指官方拘留监禁；在校园语境中专指对违纪学生的“放学后留校惩罚”。

lemmas.def_en: some held in custody
lemmas.def_zh: 被拘留者, 被扣押者

examples.en: Each detainee was granted the right to speak with a lawyer.
examples.zh: 每位被拘留者都有权与律师沟通。

lemmas.def_en: a state of being confined (usually for a short time)
lemmas.def_zh: [经] 扣留

examples.en: His unexpected detainment at the airport caused him to miss the flight.
examples.zh: 他在机场意外被扣留导致他错过了航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀de-（向下、离开）+ 词根tain（握住、保持），核心义为“强行留住阻止前行”。

lemmas.def_en: contrary to your interests or welfare
lemmas.def_zh: 不利的, 敌对的, 相反的, 逆的

examples.en: The clinical trial was suspended after patients reported serious adverse reactions to the drug.
examples.zh: 在患者报告对该药物出现严重不良反应后，临床试验被暂停。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面正式用词，形容条件或影响消极不利，高频搭配 adverse effects、adverse weather 条件。

lemmas.def_en: a state of misfortune or affliction
lemmas.def_zh: 逆境, 不幸, 灾祸, 灾难

examples.en: She showed remarkable courage and resilience in the face of great adversity.
examples.zh: 面对巨大的逆境，她表现出了非凡的勇气和韧性。

lemmas.def_en: in an adverse manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不利, 有害, 相反, 逆, 敌对, 逆向

examples.en: High inflation has adversely affected the purchasing power of average households.
examples.zh: 高通胀对普通家庭的购买力产生了不利影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀ad-（朝向）+ verse（转向），字面为“反向对着”，引申为“不利的、相反的”。

lemmas.def_en: the male organ of copulation (`member' is a euphemism)
lemmas.def_zh: 阳物, 阴茎

examples.en: The anatomical chart accurately illustrated the vascular structure of the mammalian penis.
examples.zh: 该解剖图准确展示了哺乳动物阴茎的血管结构。

lemmas.usage_note: 解剖学与医学领域的正规严肃名词，指男性或雄性动物的生殖器官，非粗俗俚语。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the penis
lemmas.def_zh: 阴茎的

examples.en: The surgeon treated the rare penial disorder with a specialized procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生通过特殊手术治疗了这种罕见的阴茎疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语penis，原义为“尾巴”，在解剖学中借指男性外生殖器。

lemmas.def_en: lacking in energy or will; - George Meredith
lemmas.def_zh: 消极的, 被动的, 冷漠的, 顺从的, 无源的

examples.en: Rather than taking initiative, he adopted a completely passive stance during the negotiations.
examples.zh: 在谈判期间，他非但没有采取主动，反而采取了彻底被动的态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容态度被动、顺从，常搭配 passive role；亦用于专业领域如 passive smoking（二手烟）或被动语态。

lemmas.def_en: in a passive manner
lemmas.def_zh: (贬)被动, 守势, 受动, (贬)消极, 不抵抗, 驯服, 钝性, 无源, 钝态, 无利息

examples.en: She refused to passively accept the unfair treatment from her manager.
examples.zh: 她拒绝被动接受经理的不公正对待。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of remaining inactive; a lack of initiative
lemmas.def_zh: 被动, 被动性, 无抵抗, 钝性, 被动结构

examples.en: His total passivity in times of crisis frustrated all his teammates.
examples.zh: 他在危机时刻的彻底被动让所有队友感到沮丧。

lemmas.def_en: submission to others or to outside influences
lemmas.def_zh: 被动, 顺从; 被动性

examples.en: The teacher noticed the boy's passiveness during group discussions in class.
examples.zh: 老师注意到了那个男孩在课堂小组讨论中的被动态度。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语passivus（承受的、经受苦难的），引申为“被动的、消极接纳的”。

lemmas.def_en: group of people related by blood or marriage
lemmas.def_zh: 氏族, 宗族, 集团

examples.en: The entire clan gathered annually to celebrate their long family heritage.
examples.zh: 整个宗族每年都会聚集在一起庆祝他们悠久的家族传统。

lemmas.usage_note: 原指有血缘关系的氏族、家族，现常引申为关系紧密的庞大群体，如 family clan、political clan。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自盖尔语clann（后裔、子女），指具有共同祖先的宗族，引申为利益集团。

lemmas.def_en: a humble request for help from someone in authority
lemmas.def_zh: 恳求, 辩解, 抗辩, 诉讼, 请愿, 托词

examples.en: The charity made an urgent plea for donations after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震发生后，该慈善机构紧急呼吁捐款。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用语，法庭上常与 enter/make a plea of guilty/not guilty 连用；生活中常作恳求 a plea for help。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，经拉丁语placitum（合意、裁决）演变而来，指法庭上的诉求，引申为“恳求、托词”。

lemmas.def_en: formed of separate units gathered into a mass or whole
lemmas.def_zh: 合计的, 聚集的

examples.en: The aggregate turnover of the group exceeded expectations despite market headwinds.
examples.zh: 尽管面临市场逆风，该集团的总营业额依然超出了预期。

lemmas.usage_note: 经济、统计与学术界专用，作定语修饰名词，表示“总计的、汇集的”，如 aggregate demand。

lemmas.def_en: formed of separate units gathered into a mass or whole
lemmas.def_zh: 集合的, 聚集的, 作为整体的

examples.en: The report used an aggregative index to evaluate national economic health.
examples.zh: 该报告使用集合指标来评估国家的经济健康状况。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To amount to a combined total, or to combine several different amounts or items into a single total.
lemmas.def_zh: 总计达；使聚集，汇总

examples.en: The software is designed to aggregate consumer feedback from multiple social media platforms.
examples.zh: 该软件旨在从多个社交媒体平台汇总消费者的反馈意见。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式用词，可作及物或不及物动词，指数据、资金或事物聚集、汇总，常与 into 连用。

lemmas.def_en: a person who collects things
lemmas.def_zh: 聚合器, 整合者; 汇集者, 聚合

examples.en: This news aggregator pulls headlines from several major media outlets daily.
examples.zh: 这个新闻聚合器每天从数家主流媒体抓取头条新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀ad-（向）+ greg-（羊群），意为“聚集成群”，引申为总体、合计。

lemmas.def_en: the power or capacity of an organism to tolerate unfavorable environmental conditions
lemmas.def_zh: 宽容，容忍；忍受力

examples.en: The community promotes mutual respect and zero tolerance for discrimination of any kind.
examples.zh: 该社区提倡相互尊重，对任何形式的歧视都采取零容忍态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 宽容，容忍；忍受力

lemmas.def_en: a disposition to tolerate or accept people or situations
lemmas.def_zh: 宽容, 默认, 信仰自由

examples.en: The government promoted religious toleration to maintain peace among different cultural communities.
examples.zh: 政府提倡宗教宽容，以维持不同文化群体间的和平。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To allow or accept behavior, beliefs, or conditions that one dislikes without protesting. 2. [T] To bear or endure pain, hardship, or an unpleasant situation. 3. [T] (biology/medicine) To be able to withstand a substance or condition without adverse effects.
lemmas.def_zh: 容忍，忍受；容许，放任；耐受（药物、恶劣环境等）

examples.en: The school administration will not tolerate bullying under any circumstances.
examples.zh: 学校管理层在任何情况下都不会容忍霸凌行为。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，后接名词或动名词形式，表示在艰难环境中勉强忍受或允许某事存在。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽容的, 容忍的, (对冷、热)能耐的
lemmas.def_en: showing respect for the rights or opinions or practices of others

examples.en: They are remarkably tolerant of differing cultural and religious practices.
examples.zh: 他们对不同的文化习俗和宗教信仰表现出了极大的包容。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配为 be tolerant of，用于修饰对异见保持包容的态度，也可指植物等耐受性强。

lemmas.def_zh: 宽容地, 容忍地
lemmas.def_en: in a tolerant manner

examples.en: he reacts rather tolerantly toward his son's juvenile behavior

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语tolerare（忍受、承受），后缀-ance表性质，指容忍力或机件公差。

lemmas.def_en: showing regard for others in manners, speech, behavior, etc.
lemmas.def_zh: 有礼貌的, 文雅的, 客气的, 有教养的

examples.en: It is always polite to send a brief thank-you note after attending an interview.
examples.zh: 参加面试后寄一封简短的感谢信始终是合乎礼貌的做法。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用搭配为 be polite to sb.，常修饰言行、微笑或社交礼仪，表达客气但有时带疏离感。

lemmas.def_en: in a polite manner
lemmas.def_zh: 有礼貌地, 文雅地, 客气地

examples.en: He politely asked the passengers to step aside for the elderly.
examples.zh: 他礼貌地请乘客们给老年人让出一条路。

lemmas.def_en: a courteous manner that respects accepted social usage
lemmas.def_zh: 有礼, 优雅

examples.en: His natural politeness made everyone feel comfortable and respected in meetings.
examples.zh: 他天生的礼貌让每个人在会议中都感到舒适和受尊重。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语politus（磨光的、打磨光滑的），引申指人“有教养的、举止得体的”。

lemmas.def_en: intense sorrow caused by loss of a loved one (especially by death)
lemmas.def_zh: 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难

examples.en: The sudden tragedy brought immense grief to the entire local community.
examples.zh: 这场突如其来的悲剧给整个当地社区带来了巨大的悲痛。

lemmas.usage_note: 指深切悲痛，常与 over/at 搭配，如 overcome with grief；口语俚语 give sb grief 意为使某人烦恼受累。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，追溯至拉丁语gravis（沉重的），指心中承受不可承受的“深切悲痛”。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To make someone feel afraid, anxious, or shocked.
lemmas.def_zh: 使惊恐，使害怕；吓跑

examples.en: The loud clap of thunder did frighten the little girl so much that she started crying.
examples.zh: 那声巨响的雷鸣着实吓坏了那个小女孩，以至于她哭了起来。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作及物动词表示惊吓某人，常见搭配为 frighten sb. into doing sth. 或 frighten sb. away。

lemmas.def_en: in an alarming manner
lemmas.def_zh: 吓人地; 令人恐惧地, 引起突然惊恐地

examples.en: The global temperature is rising at a frighteningly rapid pace each decade.
examples.zh: 全球气温正以惊人的速度逐年攀升。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 令人恐惧的；可怕的
lemmas.def_en: making you feel afraid or nervous
lemmas.usage_note: 主语通常是事物、经历或景象，表示具有威慑或惊吓性质；区别于修饰人感受的 frightened。

examples.en: It was a frightening experience that nobody in the village will ever forget.
examples.zh: 那是一次村里无人能忘却的可怕经历。

family_guide.root_logic: 名词fright（惊恐）+ 动词后缀-en（使成为），意为“使惊恐、吓唬”。

lemmas.def_en: the starting point for a new state or experience
lemmas.def_zh: 门槛, 入口, 开端, 阈

examples.en: She stood at the threshold of the house, hesitating before entering.
examples.zh: 她站在门槛前，犹豫着要不要进去。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于 on the threshold of（即将迎来/在…门槛上）或 high/low pain threshold，多用于书面语表达临界点。

family_guide.root_logic: 古英语复合词，原指进门前用于踏碎或脱去谷物杂物的门槛，引申为极限或起始点。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ in/on/for) (chiefly US) To officially register yourself or someone else as a member of a course, school, or organization.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）登记，（使）注册，（使）入学，（使）入会

examples.en: She decided to enroll in an advanced web development course this semester.
examples.zh: 她决定本学期报名参加一门高级网页开发课程。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，不及物时常接介词 in；及物时表示招收或为某人登记入籍。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ in/on/for) (British English spelling of enroll) To register formally for a course, institution, or program.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）登记，（使）注册，（使）入学，（使）入会

examples.en: You need to enrol in the online course before the end of this week.
examples.zh: 你需要在本周末之前注册这门在线课程。

lemmas.def_en: the act of enrolling
lemmas.def_zh: 登记, 注册, 入伍

examples.en: School enrollment has increased steadily over the past three academic years.
examples.zh: 在过去的三个学年里，学校的入学人数稳步增长。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指入学者人数或注册登记的程序，常见搭配有 open enrollment 或 enrollment rate。

lemmas.def_en: the act of enrolling
lemmas.def_zh: 登记, 注册, 入伍, 入学, 入会, 注册人数, 入学人数

examples.en: The university reported a significant increase in student enrolment this semester.
examples.zh: 该大学报告称，本学期的学生注册人数显著增加。

lemmas.def_en: a person who enrolls in (or is enrolled in) a class or course of study
lemmas.def_zh: 被征入伍者, 入会者, 入学者

examples.en: Each new enrollee must complete a brief orientation session before classes begin.
examples.zh: 每位新入学者在开学前都必须参加一次简短的培训。

family_guide.root_logic: en-（进入）+ roll（名册），本义为“记入名册”，引申为登记、入学。

lemmas.def_en: a republic in southern South America on the western slopes of the Andes on the south Pacific coast
lemmas.def_zh: 辣椒，辣椒酱

examples.en: Add a pinch of dried chile to give the sauce a spicy kick.
examples.zh: 加一小撮干辣椒碎，让酱汁带点辛辣的风味。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语常用于指辣椒或辣椒酱（同 chili/chilli），作为不可数或可数名词使用，首字母大写时特指国家智利。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自美洲原住民语言，指辣椒或辣椒制成的调味品（亦作 chili/chilli）。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to bite and grind food repeatedly with the teeth. 2. [I] to think carefully about something (often with 'on' or 'over').
lemmas.def_zh: 咀嚼，嚼碎；深思，细想

examples.en: Take time to chew your food thoroughly before swallowing it.
examples.zh: 吞咽之前要花时间把食物彻底嚼碎。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指生理上的咀嚼（搭配 over 或 on），也可在短语 chew over 中比喻仔细考虑、推敲问题。

lemmas.def_en: requiring much chewing
lemmas.def_zh: 需要多嚼的, 难嚼的

examples.en: I prefer fresh homemade cookies that are soft and chewy in the center.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢中间松软且有嚼劲的新鲜自制曲奇。

lemmas.def_en: someone who chews (especially someone who chews tobacco)
lemmas.def_zh: 反刍动物；咀嚼口香糖的人

examples.en: As an avid gum chewer, he always keeps a fresh pack nearby.
examples.zh: 作为一个口香糖爱好者，他身边总备着一包新的。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 ceowan，模拟上下颌咬碎食物的动作，引申指深思、咀嚼。

lemmas.def_en: the time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon
lemmas.def_zh: 日落，傍晚；晚年

examples.en: They watched the spectacular sunset over the calm sea.
examples.zh: 他们注视着平静海面上那壮丽的日落景象。

lemmas.usage_note: 常作 at sunset（在日落时）；在法律和商业中常作定语，如 sunset clause/provision 指失效/日落条款。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 sun（太阳）+ set（下落）构成的复合词，指日落时分。

lemmas.def_en: bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer
lemmas.def_zh: 阳光充足的；开朗的

examples.en: Her sunny disposition always brings cheer to the office.
examples.zh: 她开朗的性格总能给办公室带来欢乐。

lemmas.usage_note: 除形容天气晴朗外，常修饰人或性格，如 a sunny disposition/smile（开朗的性格/灿烂的微笑）。

lemmas.def_zh: (sunny 的复数) a. 阳光充足的, 乐观的, 快乐的, 像太阳的

examples.en: Don't forget to grab your sunnies before heading out to the beach.
examples.zh: 去海滩前，别忘了拿上你的太阳镜。

family_guide.root_logic: sun（太阳）+ -y（多……的形容词后缀），指阳光明媚的或性格开朗的。

lemmas.def_en: a rude or vulgar fool
lemmas.def_zh: n. 小丑，丑角；v. 扮小丑，耍闹

examples.en: The circus clown made all the children burst into laughter with his funny antics.
examples.zh: 马戏团的小丑用滑稽的动作逗得所有孩子们哈哈大笑。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指马戏团等表演中的小丑，也用于比喻举止荒唐可笑或引人发笑的人。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (+ around/about) To behave in a silly, funny, or playful way to make people laugh.
lemmas.def_zh: 扮小丑，耍活宝，滑稽逗乐

examples.en: Stop clowning around and focus on finishing your assignment properly.
examples.zh: 别胡闹了，专心把你的作业好好完成。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，极常以短语 clown around 出现，口语中指胡闹、打闹或插科打诨。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源可能与粗笨的原木或农夫有关，后定型为剧场或马戏团中滑稽扮相的丑角。

lemmas.def_en: conformable to or allowed by law
lemmas.def_zh: 合法的，正当的

examples.en: He had a lawful excuse for his absence from the court hearing.
examples.zh: 他缺席法庭听证会有正当且合法的理由。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于法律公文与正式文体，修饰权利、行为或权威，常与 lawful authority 等搭配。

lemmas.def_en: not conforming to legality, moral law, or social convention
lemmas.def_zh: 非法的，违法的

examples.en: The security guards detained the intruder for unlawful entry into the building.
examples.zh: 保安人员因该入侵者非法进入大楼而将其拘留。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式法律术语，严格指违反法律或未经法律许可的，常搭配 unlawful entry 或 unlawful act。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner acceptable to common custom
lemmas.def_zh: 守法地；合法地

examples.en: All citizens must act lawfully and respect the regulations set by the council.
examples.zh: 所有公民都必须依法行事，并遵守委员会制定的规章。

lemmas.def_en: not conforming to the law
lemmas.def_zh: 不正当地；不合法地

examples.en: The suspect was accused of unlawfully entering the private property late at night.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人被指控在深夜非法闯入私人领地。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of conforming to law
lemmas.def_zh: 法制, 合法

examples.en: The judge questioned the lawfulness of the evidence obtained without a valid warrant.
examples.zh: 法官对没有合法搜查令而获得的证据的合法性提出了质疑。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of failing to conform to law
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 不合法, 非法, 违反道德准则

examples.en: The company faced severe penalties due to the clear unlawfulness of their financial actions.
examples.zh: 由于其财务行为明显违法，该公司面临严厉的处罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 law（法律）+ -ful（具……特性的），核心义为符合法律规定的。
family_guide.core_distinction: lawful 强调受法律认可或允许；unlawful 则明确指违反法律规定的行为。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To tend to think or behave in a certain way, or to influence someone toward an opinion. 2. [I, T] To slope, lean, or bend forward or downward.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）倾向于，（使）有意于；（使）倾斜，低头

examples.en: The recent evidence inclines me to believe that their proposal is feasible.
examples.zh: 最近的证据使我倾向于相信他们的提议是可行的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以被动形式 be inclined to do 表示倾向于；作及物动词时可表示低头或倾斜身体。

lemmas.def_en: an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
lemmas.def_zh: 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头

examples.en: She showed an early inclination toward music and began playing the piano gracefully.
examples.zh: 她很早就表现出对音乐的偏好，并弹得一手好钢琴。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 倾向于……的；倾斜的；有天赋的
lemmas.def_en: wanting to do something or having a natural tendency or preference; leaning or sloping
lemmas.usage_note: 常见结构为 be inclined to do sth（倾向于做某事），亦可用在复合词中如 mathematically inclined（有数学天赋的）。

examples.en: I am inclined to agree with your analysis of the market.
examples.zh: 我倾向于赞同你对市场的分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 in-（向……）+ cline（倾斜），引申为倾向于某种想法或行动。

lemmas.def_en: (astrology) one of 12 equal areas into which the zodiac is divided
lemmas.def_zh: 大厦，豪宅

examples.en: The billionaire bought a historic mansion on the coast.
examples.zh: 那位亿万富翁在海边买下了一栋历史悠久的豪宅。

lemmas.usage_note: 指极其宽敞豪华的独立大宅邸，英式英语复数 a block of mansions 可指高档豪华公寓楼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 manere（停留、居住），原指停留之所，后特指规模宏大的豪华宅邸。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy, closely woven fabric (used for clothing or chairs or sails or tents)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 帆布，画布；v. 游说，详细检查

examples.en: The artist applied thick layers of vibrant oil paint to the canvas.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家在画布上涂抹了厚厚的一层鲜艳油彩。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词指帆布材质，作可数名词常指油画布或油画作品本身，文体中立。

lemmas.def_en: a petitioner who solicits contributions or trade or votes
lemmas.def_zh: 游说者, 检票员, 兜揽生意的人

examples.en: A political canvasser knocked on our front door to discuss the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 一位政治拉票员敲响了我家前门，想讨论即将举行的选举。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To cover, line, or equip something with canvas.
lemmas.def_zh: 用帆布覆盖；用帆布装备

examples.en: Volunteers will canvas the entire neighborhood to collect public opinions tomorrow.
examples.zh: 志愿者们明天将走访整个街区以收集公众意见。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词时意同 canvass，指在某地区游说拉票、走访调查民意或彻底排查讨论。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To try to obtain political support, votes, or opinions from people by visiting them or asking detailed questions.
lemmas.def_zh: 游说，拉票；打探民意，进行调查

examples.en: Volunteers plan to canvass the neighborhood to raise support for the new library.
examples.zh: 志愿者们计划在社区挨家挨户游说，以争取对新图书馆的支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kannabis（大麻），由大麻纤维织成的粗布，引申为画布，作动词时衍生出彻底检查、拉选票之意（源于用粗布筛查）。

lemmas.def_en: a profession of belief
lemmas.def_zh: 证据，证明；遗嘱

examples.en: The company's sustained profitability is a testament to its innovative strategy.
examples.zh: 该公司持续的盈利能力是其创新战略的有力证明。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常构成搭配 a testament to sth.，指某事物的明证；在法律语境中指最后的遗嘱。

lemmas.def_zh: 遗嘱的, 据遗嘱的, 遗嘱中有的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a will or testament or bequeathed by a will or testament

examples.en: The lawyer meticulously reviewed every testamentary disposition mentioned in the elderly billionaire's final will.
examples.zh: 律师仔细审查了那位年迈亿万富翁最终遗嘱中提到的每一项遗嘱处分。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 testis（证人），指证实意愿的文件，引申为遗嘱或坚定的证明。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To become less strong, powerful, or determined, or to make someone or something less strong.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）变弱，（使）减弱，削弱

examples.en: High inflation has weakened consumer spending power.
examples.zh: 高通胀削弱了消费者的消费能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 可用作及物或不及物动词，常与 resolve、economy 或 immune system 搭配，表示削弱力量、决心或体质。

family_guide.root_logic: weak（虚弱的）+ -en（使动后缀），字面即“使变弱”。

lemmas.def_en: a military campaign designed to achieve a specific objective in a foreign country
lemmas.def_zh: 远征，探险队，考察

examples.en: The research team mounted a scientific expedition to Antarctica to study ice sheet dynamics.
examples.zh: 研究小组组织了一次前往南极洲的科学考察，以研究冰盖的动态变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指有组织、有明确科学或探险目的的长途考察，常见搭配为 embark on / mount an expedition。

lemmas.def_zh: 远征的, 考察的, 探险的
lemmas.def_en: (used of military forces) designed for military operations abroad

examples.en: The general organized an expeditionary force to secure the remote mountain border.
examples.zh: 将军组建了一支远征军以保卫偏远的山区边界。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速的, 敏捷的
lemmas.def_en: marked by speed and efficiency

examples.en: The company promised an expeditious review of all pending customer service complaints.
examples.zh: 公司承诺对所有待处理的客户投诉进行迅速审查。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅速(完成), 高效, 效率高, 敏捷, 急速(进行)
lemmas.def_en: with efficiency; in an efficient manner

examples.en: he functions efficiently

family_guide.root_logic: ex-（出）+ ped（脚）+ -ition（名词后缀），原指整装出发，后指有特定目的的远征或探险。

lemmas.def_en: a son of your brother or sister
lemmas.def_zh: 侄子，外甥

examples.en: She took her young nephew to the natural history museum.
examples.zh: 她带着小侄子去了自然历史博物馆。

lemmas.usage_note: 指兄弟姐妹的儿子（侄子或外甥），注意与 niece（侄女/外甥女）区分，属日常亲属称谓词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 nepos（孙子、侄子），现专指兄弟姐妹的儿子。

lemmas.def_en: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
lemmas.def_zh: 小贩，摊贩；销售商

examples.en: The company decided to negotiate contract renewal terms with its primary cloud software vendor.
examples.zh: 公司决定与其主要的云软件供应商协商合同续约条款。

lemmas.usage_note: 指沿街叫卖的小贩或商业活动中的卖方，常与 street vendor、software vendor 连用，多见于商务与日常语境。

lemmas.def_zh: 小贩, 卖主, 自动售货机
lemmas.def_en: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money

lemmas.def_zh: 兜售，贩卖，出售
lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (formal) To sell small items, food, or goods, especially from a street stall, cart, or machine.

examples.en: Several local merchants vend fresh fruits along the busy sidewalk daily.
