examples.zh: 几位本地商贩每天都在繁忙的人行道旁售卖新鲜水果。

family_guide.root_logic: vend（出售，源自拉丁语 vendere）+ -or（人/物），特指卖主或自动售货机等供应主体。

lemmas.def_en: a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations
lemmas.def_zh: n. 前景；人生观，观点

examples.en: Despite the current crisis, the economic outlook remains positive.
examples.zh: 尽管面临当前的危机，经济前景依然乐观。

lemmas.usage_note: 指人生观时常搭配 outlook on life；指前景时接 for（如 economic outlook for next year）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 out（向外）+ look（看）构成，核心意象为“向外看”，引申为前景或世界观。

lemmas.def_en: inferior in rank or status
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 琐碎的；小气的，心胸狭窄的

examples.en: We should not waste valuable office hours on petty squabbles over desk assignments.
examples.zh: 我们不应把宝贵的工作时间浪费在争夺办公桌分配这种琐碎的争执上。

lemmas.usage_note: 含贬义，修饰琐碎微不足道的事物或小气狭隘的性格，常见搭配有 petty squabble、petty crime。

lemmas.def_en: narrowness of mind or ideas or views
lemmas.def_zh: 琐碎, 微小, 小气, 委琐, 偏狭, 卑鄙, 心胸狭窄的举动

examples.en: Try to ignore office pettiness and focus on your long-term career goals.
examples.zh: 尽量忽略办公室里的琐碎琐事，专注于你的长期职业目标。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 petit（小的），指细微、无关紧要的，常带贬义。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To cause someone or something continual distress, trouble, or suffering over a long period. 2. [T] To annoy or bother someone persistently.
lemmas.def_zh: 折磨，使苦恼；纠缠，打扰

examples.en: Financial difficulties continued to plague the company for months.
examples.zh: 财务困难持续困扰了这家公司数月。

lemmas.usage_note: 作动词多用于被动语态 be plagued by/with，表示长期饱受疾病、贫困或问题的折磨与困扰。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 plaga（打击、灾祸），名词指瘟疫，动词引申为像瘟疫一样长期困扰。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] to annoy someone or make them impatient. 2. [T] to make a part of the body sore, red, or inflamed.
lemmas.def_zh: 使烦躁，激怒；刺激（身体部位，引起疼痛或发炎）

examples.en: The harsh chemicals in the detergent began to irritate her sensitive skin after prolonged exposure.
examples.zh: 长时间接触后，洗涤剂中的刺激性化学物质开始刺激她敏感的皮肤。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，既可表示使人心烦恼怒，也可表示生理上刺激皮肤或黏膜，多与 be irritated by 连用。

lemmas.def_en: the psychological state of being irritated or annoyed
lemmas.def_zh: 刺激, 烦恼, 刺激物

examples.en: He tried to hide his irritation when the train was delayed again.
examples.zh: 当火车再次晚点时，他努力掩饰自己的烦躁。

lemmas.def_zh: 刺激物, 刺激剂
lemmas.def_en: something that causes irritation and annoyance

examples.en: Chemical fumes in the factory acted as a severe respiratory irritant.
examples.zh: 工厂里的化学烟雾是对呼吸道的严重刺激物。

lemmas.def_en: in an irritating manner
lemmas.def_zh: 刺激地, 使愤怒地

examples.en: The computer screen kept flickering irritatingly while I was trying to work.
examples.zh: 当我试图工作时，电脑屏幕恼人地闪烁个不停。

lemmas.def_en: (used of physical stimuli) serving to stimulate or excite
lemmas.def_zh: 刺激性的, 刺激的

examples.en: Inhaling the chemical fumes caused an immediate irritative cough among the factory workers.
examples.zh: 吸入化学烟雾导致工厂工人们立刻引发了刺激性咳嗽。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 irritare（激怒、刺激），指使情绪烦躁或使身体器官产生不适反应。

lemmas.def_en: the act of orienting
lemmas.def_zh: n. 方向；取向；（新员工或新生的）迎新培训

examples.en: All new employees must attend a mandatory orientation next Monday.
examples.zh: 所有新员工都必须参加下周一的必修迎新培训。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指新生或新员工的“迎新/岗前培训”（orientation week），也表示方向定位或性取向。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 orient（朝向东方，定位），引申为方向、目标取向以及适应新环境的培训。

lemmas.def_en: (psychiatry) an abnormal absorption with the self; marked by communication disorders and short attention span and inability to treat others as people
lemmas.def_zh: n. 自闭症，孤独症

examples.en: Early intervention can significantly improve language and social outcomes for children diagnosed with autism.
examples.zh: 早期干预可以显著改善被确诊患有自闭症的儿童的语言和社交能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 医学与心理学专有名词，指自闭症谱系障碍，常与 diagnosed with、autism spectrum 连用，为正式客观用语。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or affected with autism
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 孤独的, 自我中心的

examples.en: The specialized school offers tailored support programs for autistic children and their families.
examples.zh: 这所专科学校为自闭症儿童及其家庭提供定制的支持项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 由词根 aut-（自己）+ -ism（病态/状态）构成，字面意为“沉浸在自我中”，即孤独症。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden violent spontaneous occurrence (usually of some undesirable condition)
lemmas.def_zh: n. （暴力、疾病等的）爆发，突然发生

examples.en: Health officials are working to contain the outbreak of the virus.
examples.zh: 卫生官员正努力控制该病毒的爆发。

lemmas.usage_note: 指疾病、战争或暴力冲突的突然爆发，常用搭配为 an outbreak of flu/violence/war。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 out（向外）+ break（爆发），指疾病、战争或暴力等突发性爆发。

lemmas.def_en: a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
lemmas.def_zh: n. 词典，字典

examples.en: If you come across an unfamiliar word, look it up in the dictionary.
examples.zh: 如果你遇到不认识的词，就查词典吧。

lemmas.usage_note: “查字典”地道表达为 look up a word in the dictionary 或 consult a dictionary，避免直译 check。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dictionarium，词根 dict（说，词）+ -ary（集合场所），即词汇的汇编工具书。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To become steady, stable, or unchanging, or to make something do this.
lemmas.def_zh: （使）稳定，（使）稳固

examples.en: Emergency measures were promptly introduced by the central bank to stabilize the volatile financial market.
examples.zh: 央行迅速采取了紧急措施，以稳定动荡的金融市场。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，用于经济、病情或局势等恢复平稳，常见搭配为 stabilize the market/economy。

lemmas.def_en: the act of stabilizing something or making it more stable
lemmas.def_zh: 安定, 稳定, 平抑, 安定化, 稳定化

examples.en: Doctors worked overnight to achieve the stabilization of the injured patient's vital signs.
examples.zh: 医生们彻夜工作以维持受伤患者生命体征的稳定。

lemmas.def_en: a chemical that is added to a solution or mixture or suspension to maintain it in a stable or unchanging state
lemmas.def_zh: 有安定作用之物, 安定装置, 水平安定面

examples.en: The heavy camera needs an external stabilizer to capture smooth video footage.
examples.zh: 这部沉重的摄像机需要一个外接稳定器来拍摄平稳的视频素材。

lemmas.def_en: a device for making something stable
lemmas.def_zh: 稳定器, 安定器, 安定剂

examples.en: This dairy product contains a natural stabiliser to improve its overall texture.
examples.zh: 该乳制品含有一种天然稳定剂，以改善其整体质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 stable（稳定的）+ -ize（使动后缀），核心意为“使……稳固”。

lemmas.def_en: extremely small in scale or scope or capability
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 极小的，微观的；微型的

examples.en: The company specializes in micro electronic components for smartphones.
examples.zh: 该公司专营用于智能手机的微型电子元件。

lemmas.usage_note: 指极微小或微观层面的，常与 macro 相对，修饰 micro scale/level 等抽象分析语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 mikros（微小），表示微观层面的或极小规模的。

lemmas.def_en: a person with fair skin and hair
lemmas.def_zh: n. 金发女性

examples.en: The tall blonde sitting in the corner is our new marketing manager.
examples.zh: 坐在角落里的那位高个子金发女郎是我们的新营销经理。

lemmas.usage_note: 指金发女性（男性通常写作 blond）；在当代英语中使用名词指代人需注意避免刻板印象。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语，特指浅黄色、金黄色的头发，作名词常指金发女性。

lemmas.def_en: a grand and imposing entrance (often extended metaphorically)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 大门，入口；门户网站

examples.en: Students can check their exam results through the school portal.
examples.zh: 学生可以通过学校的门户网站查询考试成绩。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指宏伟的拱门大门，现多用于互联网领域表示“门户网站/入口”（如 web/client portal）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 porta（大门），引申为宏伟的入口，现代常引申为网络入口或门户网站。

lemmas.def_en: on the lower or downward side; on the underside of
lemmas.def_zh: prep. 在……下面，在……底下

examples.en: I found the missing keys underneath the sofa cushion.
examples.zh: 我在沙发垫子底下找到了丢失的钥匙。

lemmas.usage_note: 强调处于正下方且多被覆盖或隐藏，比 under 更具画面感，常接名词作宾语表位置或内心情感。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 under（在……下）+ neath（下方）强化构成，强调正下方或表面被遮盖的位置。

lemmas.def_en: an act of traveling by water
lemmas.def_zh: 航行, 航海, 航程, 旅行, 航空

examples.en: The luxury ocean liner completed its historic maiden voyage across the Atlantic without incident.
examples.zh: 这艘豪华远洋邮轮平安完成了横跨大西洋的历史性处女航。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指漫长而遥远的水上或太空航程，具文学色彩，高频搭配为 maiden voyage（首航）或 set out on a voyage。

lemmas.def_en: a traveler to a distant land (especially one who travels by sea)
lemmas.def_zh: 航行者, 航海者

examples.en: The lone voyager documented every milestone of his journey across the frozen desert.
examples.zh: 这位孤独的旅行者记录了他穿越冰冻荒漠旅程中的每一个里程碑。

lemmas.def_en: [I] To make a long journey, especially by sea or in space.
lemmas.def_zh: 远航，远行，作长途旅行

examples.en: Centuries ago, courageous explorers voyaged across uncharted waters in search of new trading routes.
examples.zh: 几个世纪前，勇敢的探险家们漂洋过海穿越未知的海域，以寻找新的贸易路线。

lemmas.usage_note: 正式或文学书面语动词，意为长途航行或穿越，后常接介词 across, through 或 into。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 viaticum（旅费、行装），核心语义为‘长途旅行’，尤指航海或航天。

lemmas.def_en: feeling shame or guilt or embarrassment or remorse
lemmas.def_zh: 惭愧的, 羞耻的

examples.en: He felt deeply ashamed of his rude behavior toward the guest during yesterday's formal dinner.
examples.zh: 在昨天正式的晚宴上，他对客人的无礼行为深感惭愧。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作表语，表达道德或良心上的惭愧与羞耻，固定搭配有 be ashamed of 或 feel ashamed to do sth.。

lemmas.def_en: used of persons or their behavior; feeling no shame
lemmas.def_zh: 无羞耻心的, 不知耻的, 厚脸无耻的, 问心无愧的

examples.en: She was completely unashamed of her humble background and shared it proudly.
examples.zh: 她对自己的卑微出身毫无愧色，并且自豪地分享出来。

lemmas.def_en: without shame
lemmas.def_zh: 厚颜无耻

examples.en: He wept unashamedly in front of the entire audience during the final speech.
examples.zh: 在最后的演讲中，他在全体观众面前毫无顾忌地哭了起来。

lemmas.def_en: with a feeling of shame
lemmas.def_zh: 不好意思地

examples.en: The boy looked down ashamedly after admitting that he had lied to his parents.
examples.zh: 承认对父母撒谎后，男孩不好意思地低下了头。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 a-（表状态）+ shame（羞耻），表示‘处于羞耻、惭愧的状态’。

lemmas.def_en: showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth
lemmas.def_zh: 极深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 渊博的

examples.en: The advent of artificial intelligence has exerted a profound influence on modern higher education.
examples.zh: 人工智能的出现对现代高等教育产生了深远的影响。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式书面语，形容影响深远、见解渊博或情感极其强烈，高频搭配为 profound impact / profound change。

lemmas.def_en: to a great depth psychologically
lemmas.def_zh: 深深地, 深切地

examples.en: The tragic news profoundly affected the entire community and prompted widespread reflection.
examples.zh: 这一悲惨的消息深深地触动了整个社区，并引发了广泛的反思。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词修饰动词或形容词，意为极度、深刻地，常见搭配如 profoundly affected、profoundly grateful。

lemmas.def_zh: 深度, 深奥, 深刻, 深厚
lemmas.def_en: wisdom that is recondite and abstruse and profound

examples.en: The professor spoke with great profundity on the philosophical nature of time.
examples.zh: 教授极为深刻地探讨了时间的哲学本质。

lemmas.def_en: extremeness of degree
lemmas.def_zh: 深刻；深奥

examples.en: The sheer profoundness of her philosophical insights impressed every scholar in the room.
examples.zh: 她哲学见解的深奥让房间里的每位学者都赞叹不已。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 profundus（pro- 向前/向下 + fundus 底部），字面指‘深至底部’，引申为深度、深奥、深远。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To shout 'boo' at a performer, speaker, or team to show disapproval or contempt.
lemmas.def_zh: 向……喝倒彩，发嘘声；发出嘘声

examples.en: The angry crowd began to loudly boo the referee after the terrible call.
examples.zh: 在糟糕的判罚之后，愤怒的人群开始大声向裁判喝倒彩。

lemmas.usage_note: 指向表演者或选手发出嘘声喝倒彩，常见搭配 boo sb off the stage（嘘下台）。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模仿发出低沉的嘘声以表达不满或喝倒彩。

lemmas.def_en: an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)
lemmas.def_zh: 地铁, 地道

examples.en: She prefers taking the crowded subway to avoid the terrible morning traffic jams.
examples.zh: 她宁愿乘坐拥挤的地铁，以避开早晨可怕的交通拥堵。

lemmas.usage_note: 美语中指地下铁（take the subway）；在英式英语中多指地下人行通道，英式地铁多用 underground。

family_guide.root_logic: sub-（在……下面）+ way（道路），字面指‘地下的通道’，现多指地下铁道。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to demography
lemmas.def_zh: 人口统计的

examples.en: Rapid urban expansion is driving a significant demographic shift across the southern provinces.
examples.zh: 城市的快速扩张正在推动南部各省出现显著的人口结构转变。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词修饰与人口统计或结构相关的特征，多用于学术及商业报告，常见搭配为 demographic shift / demographic trends。

lemmas.def_en: a statistic characterizing human populations (or segments of human populations broken down by age or sex or income etc.)
lemmas.def_zh: [法] 人口统计的, 人口学的

examples.en: The streaming platform designed its new content strategy specifically to attract the younger demographic.
examples.zh: 该流媒体平台专门设计了其新的内容策略，以吸引更年轻的受众群体。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，指特定的人口群体或目标受众，常用于市场营销，搭配如 target demographic、the 18-to-35 demographic。

family_guide.root_logic: demo-（人民、人口）+ -graph（写、记录）+ -ic（形容词/名词后缀），指对人群统计特征的描述。

lemmas.def_en: a fractional monetary unit of Japan and Indonesia and Cambodia; equal to one hundredth of a yen or rupiah or riel
lemmas.def_zh: 传感器（传感元件, 探测设备）

examples.en: The optical sen detected the minor change in ambient light instantly.
examples.zh: 光学传感器瞬间检测到了环境光的微小变化。

lemmas.usage_note: 专有名词性货币单位，指日本等国的“钱”（日元百分之一），单复数同形，属于专业金融历史词汇。

family_guide.root_logic: 借词，源自日语（銭）及其他亚洲货币单位，指‘钱/仙’等辅币单位。

lemmas.def_en: a discrete amount of something that is analogous to the quantities in quantum theory
lemmas.def_zh: 量, 量子

examples.en: The discovery represents a quantum leap in our understanding of molecular biology.
examples.zh: 这一发现代表了我们在分子生物学理解上的巨大飞跃。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于物理学与科技领域，构成固定搭配如 quantum leap（飞跃）或 quantum computing（量子计算）。

lemmas.def_zh: （实验中）仅有两种可能的； 量子的, 量子论的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a quantum or capable of existing in only one of two states

examples.en: The experiment produced a quantal response, with cells either surviving or dying completely.
examples.zh: 实验产生了全或无的反应，细胞要么存活，要么完全死亡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 quantus（多少），物理学借用指‘不可分割的基本微小能量单位’，引申指质的飞跃。

lemmas.def_en: artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
lemmas.def_zh: 布料, 织品, 布

examples.en: She carefully cleaned the dusty wooden table with a soft, damp cloth.
examples.zh: 她用一块柔软的湿布仔细擦拭落满灰尘的木桌。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“布料”时不可数（a piece of cloth）；指“抹布”时可数；注意与衣服 clothes（复数）区分拼写及用法。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 clāth，最初指‘编织好的物料或布匹’，后专指特定用途的织物或抹布。

lemmas.def_en: an advertisement consisting of short scenes from a motion picture that will appear in the near future
lemmas.def_zh: 事先查看, 预览

examples.en: The gallery invited several art critics to a private preview of the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 画廊邀请了几位艺术评论家参加新展览的内部预展。

lemmas.usage_note: 指电影、展览等的预映、预展或技术预览，常与介词 of 或 give a preview 搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To inspect, view, or exhibit something before it is officially released or shown to the public.
lemmas.def_zh: 预览，预先审查；试映，预演

examples.en: The tech company will preview its upcoming operating system at the conference tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这家科技公司将在明天的发布会上预先展示其即将推出的操作系统。

lemmas.usage_note: 作及物动词，表示提前观看、预先展示或概述某事物，宾语常接电影、功能或计划。

family_guide.root_logic: pre-（提前）+ view（看），核心语义为‘提前观看、预先审视’。

lemmas.def_en: feeling a need to see others suffer
lemmas.def_zh: 恶意, 怨恨, 使人烦恼的事物

examples.en: He refused to invite his cousin to the dinner purely out of spite.
examples.zh: 他不肯邀请表弟参加晚宴纯粹是出于恶意报复。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于书面及口语，表示出于恶意的动机，高频短语包括 in spite of（尽管）及 out of spite（出于怨恨）。

lemmas.def_en: feeling a need to see others suffer
lemmas.def_zh: 怀恨在心；充满恶意

examples.en: Her spitefulness alienated all the colleagues who had previously tried to help her.
examples.zh: 她的刻薄怀恨疏远了所有以前试图帮助她的同事。

lemmas.def_en: showing malicious ill will and a desire to hurt; motivated by spite
lemmas.def_zh: 怀恨的, 怀有恶意的, 恶意的

examples.en: She regretted sending that spiteful message to her friend in the heat of anger.
examples.zh: 她后悔在盛怒之下给朋友发了那条充满恶意的短信。

lemmas.def_en: in a maliciously spiteful manner
lemmas.def_zh: 怀恨地, 怀有恶意地

examples.en: He spitefully ruined her garden project after they had a bitter argument last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚发生激烈争吵后，他恶意破坏了她的花园项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 despit（看不起、蔑视），与 despise 同源，现多指因怀恨而故意为难的情绪。

lemmas.def_en: a quick reply to a question or remark (especially a witty or critical one)
lemmas.def_zh: 复原, 复辟, 复位, 尖刻的对答, 抱怨的原因

examples.en: The veteran tennis player made a remarkable comeback after two years of injuries.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的网球老将因伤缺阵两年后上演了精彩的回归。

lemmas.usage_note: 多指“东山再起”，固定搭配 make/stage a comeback；非正式语境中也可指机智反驳（a quick comeback）。

family_guide.root_logic: 动词短语 come back（归来、反驳）的名词化，指重返巅峰或机智的反驳。

lemmas.def_en: a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart
lemmas.def_zh: 血管, 静脉, 纹理, 气质, 情绪

examples.en: The novel continues in a similar humorous vein throughout the subsequent chapters.
examples.zh: 这部小说在随后的章节中继续保持着类似的幽默基调。

lemmas.usage_note: 可指生理上的静脉血管、矿脉纹理，亦可引申指风格、基调，常搭配 in a ... vein（以……基调）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (usually passive) To cover, streak, or mark a surface with lines or veins like those in marble, wood, or leaves.
lemmas.def_zh: 使布满脉纹（或叶脉状条纹）

examples.en: Cracks of glowing magma veined the dark volcanic rock after the eruption.
examples.zh: 喷发之后，炽热的岩浆裂纹如脉络般密布在黑色的火山岩上。

lemmas.usage_note: 多以过去分词 veined 形式作被动态或伴随状语，表示“使布满脉纹、使呈大理石纹状”。

lemmas.def_zh: 静脉的, 在静脉中的, 有脉的
lemmas.def_en: of or contained in or performing the function of the veins

examples.en: The nurse quickly located a suitable venous site to draw the required blood sample.
examples.zh: 护士迅速找到合适的静脉位置来采集所需的血样。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 vena（血管、矿脉、纹理），引申指像血管一样纵横分布的纹理或特定的风格心境。

lemmas.def_en: a clique (often secret) that seeks power usually through intrigue
lemmas.def_zh: 小派系, 内讧

examples.en: A radical faction within the party is threatening to block the proposed tax reform.
examples.zh: 党内的一个激进派系正威胁要阻挠拟议中的税制改革。

lemmas.usage_note: 指政党、组织内部因利益分歧而形成的派系或派别斗争，多含贬义，常与 rival 连用。

lemmas.def_zh: 好搞派系的, 好结党营私的
lemmas.def_en: dissenting (especially dissenting with the majority opinion)

examples.en: The committee's work was constantly delayed by bitter disputes among factious members.
examples.zh: 委员会的工作因好搞派系的成员之间激烈的争执而屡屡延误。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 facere（做、行动），引申为因共同政治行动而形成的分裂‘小集团’。

lemmas.def_en: someone who has won first place in a competition
lemmas.def_zh: 格格地嚼, 咀嚼声

examples.en: The quiet stable was filled with the rhythmic champ of the horses eating their oats.
examples.zh: 安静的马厩里充斥着马匹吃燕麦时有节奏的咀嚼声。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为动词的名词化使用，指大声咀嚼的动作或咬嚼声，日常交流中较为少见且具描述性。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] to chew or bite noisily, vigorously, or impatiently
lemmas.def_zh: 格格地咬，大声咀嚼；（马）咬嚼（嚼子）

examples.en: The young athletes were champing at the bit to get onto the field and play.
examples.zh: 这些年轻运动员急不可耐地想要上场打比赛。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示急躁、格格地咀嚼或咬，极其高频的固定搭配为 champ at the bit（跃跃欲试、急不可耐）。

family_guide.root_logic: 作名词时为champion的口语缩写；作动词时源于拟声词，指大声咀嚼或因急躁而咬嚼。
family_guide.core_distinction: champ (n.) 为 champion 口语缩略，意为“冠军”；champ (v.) 意为“大声咀嚼/急躁地咬”，两者词源不同但形态重合。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
lemmas.def_zh: 能养活的, 能生长发育的

examples.en: Solar energy has become an economically viable alternative to fossil fuels in many regions.
examples.zh: 在许多地区，太阳能已成为化石燃料在经济上切实可行的替代方案。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容方案、技术等“切实可行的”，或生物学中“能存活的”，常搭配 viable alternative 或 financially viable。

lemmas.def_en: not capable of living or developing successfully
lemmas.def_zh: 无法生活的

examples.en: The biologist confirmed that the damaged seeds were completely nonviable.
examples.zh: 生物学家证实这些受损的种子完全无法存活。

lemmas.def_en: (of living things) capable of normal growth and development
lemmas.def_zh: 生存能力, 发育能力

examples.en: Rising operational costs have threatened the long-term viability of the clinic.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的运营成本威胁到了该诊所的长期生存能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自法语 vie（生命），核心逻辑为“具备存活或成功推行能力的”。

lemmas.def_en: (baseball) a list of batters in the order in which they will bat
lemmas.def_zh: 阵容, 阵形, 布阵, 一组人

examples.en: The festival announced an impressive lineup of international jazz musicians today.
examples.zh: 该节日今天公布了令人印象深刻的国际爵士音乐家阵容。

lemmas.usage_note: 指“阵容”或警方的“指认队列”，常见搭配 an impressive lineup of artists 或 a starting lineup（首发阵容）。

family_guide.root_logic: 由短语 line up（排队、列队）复合派生而来的名词，指按次序排列好的人或事物名单。

lemmas.def_en: hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window)
lemmas.def_zh: 窗帘，帘子

examples.en: She drew the heavy velvet curtains to block out the harsh morning sunlight.
examples.zh: 她拉上厚厚的天鹅绒窗帘，以挡住清晨刺眼的阳光。

lemmas.usage_note: 窗帘，帘子

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ off) To cover a window or divide an area using a curtain or hanging cloth.
lemmas.def_zh: 用帘子遮蔽，给……装帘子（常与off连用隔开）

examples.en: The nurse curtained off the bed to give the patient some privacy during the examination.
examples.zh: 护士用帘子将病床隔开，以便在检查期间保护病人的隐私。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“装上帘子”或“用帘子隔开”，极高频搭配为短语动词 curtain off（用帘子隔开）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cortina（帷幔），核心意象为遮挡、隔断或作为舞台的幕布。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make a proposal or bill into a law. 2. [T] To perform a story, play, or role.
lemmas.def_zh: 颁布，制定（法律）；扮演，演出；发生，实行

examples.en: Congress voted overwhelmingly to enact new legislation protecting consumer data privacy.
examples.zh: 国会以压倒性多数投票通过了保护消费者数据隐私的新法规。

lemmas.usage_note: 多用于正式法律语境，表示“通过并颁布法律”，也可用于戏剧或比喻语境表示“扮演、上演”。

lemmas.def_en: the passing of a law by a legislative body
lemmas.def_zh: 制定, 条例, 法规, 法令, 颁布, 规定

examples.en: The enactment of the new policy caused immediate debate among local business owners.
examples.zh: 新政策的颁布立即引发了当地企业主之间的争论。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 en-（使成为）+ act（法令、行动），核心逻辑是“使法规产生效力”或“付诸表演”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ in) To put something into liquid until it is completely wet, or to become thoroughly wet. 2. [T] ('soak up') To absorb liquid completely.
lemmas.def_zh: 浸泡，使湿透；吸收（soak up）

examples.en: Heavy rain quickly soaked through his thin jacket, leaving him shivering in the cold.
examples.zh: 大雨很快湿透了他的薄夹克，让他在寒冷中瑟瑟发抖。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示浸湿、浸泡或吸收，常与介词 in, through 或副词 up 搭配，构成 soak up（吸收、领略）。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy rain
lemmas.def_zh: 浸洗人, 酒量大的人, 倾盆大雨

examples.en: We got caught in a sudden summer soaker on our way home.
examples.zh: 在回家路上，我们遭遇了一场突如其来的倾盆大雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 socian，核心逻辑是液体充分渗透或浸泡物体。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To treat or process used materials such as paper, glass, or plastic so that they can be used again. 2. [T] To use something again in a different form or context.
lemmas.def_zh: 回收利用，再循环；重新使用（旧概念、材料等）

examples.en: Our city encourages every household to recycle plastic bottles and paper waste.
examples.zh: 我们市鼓励每个家庭回收塑料瓶和废纸。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 waste/materials 搭配；引申为“沿用旧思路”，注意与简单复用（reuse）区分。

family_guide.root_logic: re-（重新）+ cycle（循环），指让物品或材料重新进入使用周期的过程。

lemmas.def_en: marked by simplicity; having a humble opinion of yourself
lemmas.def_zh: 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的

examples.en: Despite his remarkable success in business, he remained modest about his achievements.
examples.zh: 尽管在商业上取得了非凡的成功，他对自己的成就依然保持谦逊。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰成就、收入或外貌，表达谦逊或适度规模；与about搭配表示对某事谦虚。

lemmas.def_en: with modesty; in a modest manner
lemmas.def_zh: 适当地；谨慎地

examples.en: She smiled modestly as the audience applauded her outstanding piano performance.
examples.zh: 当观众为她出色的钢琴演奏鼓掌时，她谦虚地微笑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 modestus（有节制的），核心是不过分、不张扬的处事或规模状态。

lemmas.def_en: a quantity of no importance
lemmas.def_zh: 尖啸声, 拉链, 活力

examples.en: The dress has a hidden zip running down the back for a sleek look.
examples.zh: 这件连衣裙背部有一条隐形拉链，显得线条流畅。

lemmas.usage_note: 英式英语中指拉链，亦可引申为精力或活力；常搭配fasten/undo the zip。

lemmas.def_en: a fastener for locking together two toothed edges by means of a sliding tab
lemmas.def_zh: 拉链

examples.en: The metal zipper on his old leather backpack suddenly broke this morning.
examples.zh: 他旧皮包上的金属拉链今天早上突然坏掉了。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (+ up) To fasten a garment or bag with a zipper. 2. [I] (informal) To move very quickly or briskly.
lemmas.def_zh: 拉上拉链，用拉链扣紧；飞速移动，疾驰

examples.en: She zipped through the morning traffic and arrived at the office early.
examples.zh: 她飞速穿过早高峰的车流，早早到达了办公室。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指拉拉链（常接up/down），也可作不及物动词指快速疾驰或高效穿梭移动。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] (chiefly North American) To fasten or close something with a zipper.
lemmas.def_zh: 拉上拉链；装上拉链

examples.en: The metal zipper on his old leather backpack suddenly broke this morning.
examples.zh: 他旧皮包上的金属拉链今天早上突然坏掉了。

lemmas.def_en: quick and energetic
lemmas.def_zh: 元气旺盛的, 敏捷的, 活泼的

examples.en: The compact electric car offers a surprisingly zippy ride through heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 这款紧凑型电动车在拥堵的交通中穿行格外轻快敏捷。

family_guide.root_logic: 拟声词，模拟拉链滑动的嘶嘶声或物体疾速飞过的声音。

lemmas.def_en: army unit smaller than a division
lemmas.def_zh: （军队）团, 大量（人或物）

examples.en: He served with distinction in an infantry regiment during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，他在一个步兵团服役，表现优异。

lemmas.usage_note: 军事上指陆军编制中的团，亦可用于泛指大群或大批人（常与of连用）。

lemmas.def_en: the imposition of order or discipline
lemmas.def_zh: 团的编制, 系统化, 严格控制

examples.en: Many creative students felt stifled by the strict regimentation of the military academy.
examples.zh: 许多有创造力的学生感到被军校的严格管制所压抑。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To organize and control people, their work, or their lives strictly and rigidly; to form people or troops into military regiments.
lemmas.def_zh: 严密编组，严格管制；把……编成团

examples.en: The daily routine at the boarding school was strictly regimented.
examples.zh: 这所寄宿学校的日常生活被严格死板地管理着。

lemmas.usage_note: 多以被动形式出现，常含批评意味，指对某人的生活、工作等进行极其严格死板的管制。

lemmas.def_en: belonging to or concerning a regiment
lemmas.def_zh: 团的, 附属于团的

examples.en: The soldiers gathered in the courtyard for their daily regimental parade.
examples.zh: 士兵们在院子里集合，进行每日的团列队检阅。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 regere（统治、引导），核心为严格规约和体系化编排的组织体系。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To grow vigorously, stay healthy, and flourish or become very successful.
lemmas.def_zh: 繁荣，茁壮生长，蓬勃发展

examples.en: These delicate native plants thrive best in moist and shady environments.
examples.zh: 这些娇嫩的本土植物在湿润阴凉的环境中生长得最好。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词，常接介词 on（如 thrive on stress），表示“在……中茁壮成长”或“因……而活跃”。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 繁荣的；蒸蒸日上的；蓬勃发展的
lemmas.def_en: growing, developing, or being successful; prosperous and flourishing
lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰经济、商业、社区、生态或动植物生长，如 a thriving business / ecosystem。

examples.en: The coastal town has developed a thriving tourist industry over the last decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年间，这座沿海小镇发展起了繁荣的旅游业。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古诺斯语 thrífa（抓住、繁盛），核心语义为生命或事业蓬勃向上发展。

lemmas.def_en: an impelling force or strength
lemmas.def_zh: 动量

examples.en: In physics, momentum is equal to the mass of an object multiplied by its velocity.
examples.zh: 在物理学中，动量等于物体的质量乘以速度。

lemmas.usage_note: 动量

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 movere（移动），物理学中指动量，引申为事物发展前进的势头或冲力。

lemmas.def_en: a sodium salt of carbonic acid; used in making soap powders and glass and paper
lemmas.def_zh: 苏打, 碳酸水

examples.en: He ordered a large burger and a cold glass of soda.
examples.zh: 他点了一个大汉堡和一杯冰苏打水。

lemmas.usage_note: 在美式英语中指“碳酸甜饮料”，也可指纯“苏打水”；表示不同杯数或罐数时可数（a soda）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自阿拉伯语 suwwad（一种含碱植物），后演化指苏打盐，现代口语特指含二氧化碳的碳酸饮料。

lemmas.def_en: a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood
lemmas.def_zh: 铅笔, 色笔, 眉笔, 画笔, 光线束

examples.en: Please complete the preliminary sketch in pencil before applying color.
examples.zh: 在涂色之前，请先用铅笔完成初步草图。

lemmas.usage_note: 指书写或绘画的铅笔工具，常用介词in搭配（如write in pencil）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To write, draw, or mark something with a pencil. 2. (pencil in) To arrange or schedule something tentatively.
lemmas.def_zh: 用铅笔写（或画）；暂定，初步安排（通常与in连用）

examples.en: I will pencil you in for a brief meeting next Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我先暂定下周二下午和你开个简会。

lemmas.usage_note: 最常构成固定短语pencil in，表示暂定、初步安排某人或某日程于某日。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 penicillus（小尾巴、画笔），后演变为用木质包裹铅芯的硬质书写工具，引申出“用笔描摹/记录”之意。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages
lemmas.def_zh: 中世纪的；老式的

examples.en: The city is famous for its well-preserved medieval architecture.
examples.zh: 这座城市以其保存完好的中世纪建筑而闻名。

lemmas.usage_note: 指欧洲“中世纪的”；在日常语境中常用作贬义修饰语，比喻制度、观念“极其老旧落后的”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 medius（中间）+ aevum（时代），字面即“中世纪的”。

lemmas.def_en: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine
lemmas.def_zh: 汽车

examples.en: The company has become a global leader in manufacturing electric automobiles.
examples.zh: 该公司已成为全球电动汽车制造领域的领头羊。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式正式用语，指四轮机动车；多出现于工业、统计或行业报告等正式语境。

lemmas.def_en: [I] (dated) to travel or ride in an automobile.
lemmas.def_zh: 乘汽车旅行，驾车出行

examples.en: During their summer holiday, the wealthy family automobiled along the coast.
examples.zh: 暑假期间，这户富裕人家驾车沿着海岸线旅行。

lemmas.usage_note: 极度罕见且过时的古旧用法，指驾驶或乘坐汽车出行，现通常由drive替代。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 auto-（自己）与 mobile（移动的）构成，指自行移动的机动车辆。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being foretold
lemmas.def_zh: 可预测的；墨守成规的

examples.en: The movie was technically impressive, but its plot was entirely predictable.
examples.zh: 这部电影在技术上令人印象深刻，但其情节完全在意料之中。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰结果、剧情或人的行为，有时含贬义指毫无新意、容易料到或墨守成规。

lemmas.def_en: not capable of being foretold
lemmas.def_zh: 不可预测的；反复无常的

examples.en: Mountain weather is notoriously unpredictable, so prepare appropriate gear.
examples.zh: 山区的气候以变化莫测著称，因此要准备好相应的装备。

lemmas.usage_note: 多修饰天气、市场、情绪或局势，强调由于变数过多而难以准确揣测预估。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being predictable
lemmas.def_zh: 可预言

examples.en: Investors appreciate the predictability of long-term government bonds in volatile markets.
examples.zh: 在动荡的市场中，投资者看重长期政府债券的可预测性。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being guided by sudden unpredictable impulses
lemmas.def_zh: 不可预测性, 不可预知性

examples.en: The sheer unpredictability of mountain weather makes outdoor hiking somewhat risky.
examples.zh: 山区天气的完全不可预测性使户外徒步旅行带有一定危险。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 predict（预言，pre- 前 + dict 说），后缀 -able 表“可……的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: predictable 强调事物有规律、可预料；反义词 unpredictable 强调变幻莫测。

lemmas.def_en: United States singer (1918-1990)
lemmas.def_zh: （城堡的）外塔，城圈，外庭

examples.en: The soldiers gathered in the castle's outer bailey.
examples.zh: 士兵们聚集在城堡的外庭院中。

lemmas.usage_note: 历史建筑专有名词，指中世纪城堡的内庭或外院；大写的 Old Bailey 特指英国中央刑事法院。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 bail（围栏），特指城堡外围的城拱或庭院。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] to intervene between people or parties in a dispute to help them reach an agreement 2. [T] to bring about an agreement or settlement through mediation
lemmas.def_zh: 调解，斡旋；促成（协议、和平等）

examples.en: A professional negotiator was brought in to mediate between the two parties.
examples.zh: 一位专业谈判专家被请来为双方进行调解。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物或不及物动词，常与between搭配，指作为中立第三方调解纠纷、促成和解。

lemmas.def_en: a negotiation to resolve differences that is conducted by some impartial party
lemmas.def_zh: 调解，仲裁

examples.en: The dispute was finally settled through diplomatic mediation without going to court.
examples.zh: 该纠纷最终通过外交调解得以解决，并未对簿公堂。

lemmas.usage_note: 指作为第三方的调解、斡旋行为；常与go to/enter into/seek等动词搭配使用。

lemmas.def_en: a negotiator who acts as a link between parties
lemmas.def_zh: 调停者, 传递者, 基督

examples.en: A neutral mediator was appointed to help resolve the tense labor dispute.
examples.zh: 一位中立的调停者被任命来协助解决紧张的劳资纠纷。

lemmas.def_en: having no intervening persons, agents, conditions
lemmas.def_zh: 无中介的,未经调停的

examples.en: Babies explore the world through direct, unmediated sensory experiences every day.
examples.zh: 婴儿每天都通过直接、无中介的感官体验来探索世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 medius（中间），意为居于两者之间进行调停或连接。
family_guide.core_distinction: mediate 为动词调停；mediation 为名词调停行为或过程。

lemmas.def_en: an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others
lemmas.def_zh: 自我；自尊心；自负

examples.en: He has a fragile ego that cannot handle criticism.
examples.zh: 他自尊心脆弱，经不起任何批评。

lemmas.usage_note: 日常中常指自尊心或自我意识，常用搭配有 boost/bruise one's ego、a fragile/huge ego。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语单数第一人称代词 ego（我），在心理学中指自我，引申为自尊或自负。

lemmas.def_en: one who loves and defends his or her country
lemmas.def_zh: 民族主义者；国家主义者

examples.en: The prominent nationalist urged citizens to support domestic industries.
examples.zh: 这位著名的民族主义者呼吁民众支持本国工业。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指民族主义者或国家主义者；在政治语境中常指倡导民族自决或优先维护国家主权的人。

lemmas.def_en: love of country and willingness to sacrifice for it
lemmas.def_zh: 民族主义；国家主义

examples.en: Economic hardship often fuels the rise of populist nationalism across the region.
examples.zh: 经济困境往往会在整个地区助长民粹民族主义的抬头。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指民族主义思想或运动；常与rise of搭配表示民族主义思潮的抬头。

lemmas.def_en: fanatically patriotic
lemmas.def_zh: 国家主义的

examples.en: The politician gained massive public support by delivering an intense and emotional nationalistic speech.
examples.zh: 这位政治家通过发表极具煽动性且带有民族主义色彩的演讲获得了大量公众支持。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自 nation（国家，民族），后缀 -ist 表“……主义者”。

lemmas.def_en: a range of mountains (usually with jagged peaks and irregular outline)
lemmas.def_zh: （尤指西班牙和美洲的）齿状山脊，连绵山脉

examples.en: Snow covered the highest peaks of the sierra.
examples.zh: 白雪覆盖了这处连绵山脉的最高峰。

lemmas.usage_note: 地理学及专有名词，源于西班牙语，指齿状连绵山脉；常作大写专名如 the Sierra Nevada。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自西班牙语，本义为“锯子”，借指锯齿般连绵起伏的山脉。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To sing or recite a religious prayer or liturgical text on a monotone or simple melody. 2. [I, T] To repeat a word, phrase, or slogan rhythmically together with a crowd.
lemmas.def_zh: 吟诵，念唱（经文等）；反复呼喊，齐声喊唱

examples.en: Thousands of excited fans chanted the team's name throughout the final.
examples.zh: 成千上万兴奋的球迷在整场决赛中齐声高喊着球队的名字。

lemmas.usage_note: 既指抗议或比赛中众人反复呼喊口号，也指按单调节奏吟诵经文或唱赞美诗。

lemmas.def_en: reed pipe with finger holes on which the melody is played
lemmas.def_zh: 吟唱者, 调旋律管, 唱诗班成员

examples.en: He practiced the bagpipe melody repeatedly on his wooden practice chanter.
examples.zh: 他用木制练习用旋律管反复练习风笛旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cantare（唱），指有节奏地重复哼唱或喊叫。

lemmas.def_en: a short mixed drink
lemmas.def_zh: 鸡尾酒；混合物

examples.en: He ordered a dry martini cocktail at the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯干马天尼鸡尾酒。

lemmas.usage_note: 除了指鸡尾酒外，常用于比喻多种事物危险或复杂的混合，常见搭配 a cocktail of drugs/chemicals。

family_guide.root_logic: 原指鸡尾状杂毛马，引申指混合调配的酒，再泛化为混合物。

lemmas.def_en: using language effectively to please or persuade
lemmas.def_zh: 修辞技巧；花言巧语，虚夸言辞

examples.en: Voters are growing tired of empty political rhetoric that never translates into action.
examples.zh: 选民们越来越厌倦那些从未转化为实际行动的空洞政治说辞。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，可指高超的修辞演说技巧，但现代政论文中常贬指虚妄华丽但空洞的说辞。

lemmas.def_en: a person who delivers a speech or oration
lemmas.def_zh: 修辞学者, 雄辩家

examples.en: The ancient rhetorician taught students how to craft persuasive public speeches.
examples.zh: 这位古代修辞学者教授学生如何构思有说服力的公开演讲。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to rhetoric; - W.A.White; - Lewis Mumford
lemmas.def_zh: 修辞学的, 符合修辞学的, 修辞的

examples.en: She asked a rhetorical question that required no immediate answer from anyone.
examples.zh: 她提出了一个修辞性反问，并不需要任何人的即刻回答。

lemmas.def_en: in a rhetorical manner
lemmas.def_zh: 在修辞学上, 讲究修辞地

examples.en: He smiled and paused rhetorically before delivering the final punchline.
examples.zh: 在说出最后的妙语之前，他微笑着讲究修辞地停顿了一下。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 rhetor（演说家），原指演说修辞艺术，常引申指华而不实的言辞。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or associated with heat
lemmas.def_zh: 热的, 热量的, 温泉的

examples.en: You should wear thermal underwear to protect against the bitter winter cold.
examples.zh: 你应该穿上保暖内衣，以抵御严冬的寒冷。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 energy, insulation, spring 等，指与热量、保暖或温泉相关的物理属性。

lemmas.def_en: not involving heat
lemmas.def_zh: 非热能的

examples.en: This new preservation method relies entirely on nonthermal food processing technologies.
examples.zh: 这种新的保鲜方法完全依赖非热能的食品加工技术。

lemmas.def_en: by means of heat or with respect to thermal properties
lemmas.def_zh: 热地

examples.en: The modern house is thermally insulated to reduce heating costs during winter.
examples.zh: 这栋现代化房屋做了热绝缘处理，以降低冬季的取暖费用。

lemmas.def_en: rising current of warm air
lemmas.def_zh: 上升温暖气流

examples.en: The eagle circled gracefully, catching a thermal to gain altitude without flapping its wings.
examples.zh: 老鹰优雅地盘旋着，借助一股上升热气流无需扇动翅膀便升到了高处。

lemmas.usage_note: 航空及气象领域专业名词，指上升的热气流，常与 catch, ride 等动词搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 therme（热），核心含义与“热量、温度”直接相关。

lemmas.def_en: an erroneous mental representation
lemmas.def_zh: 错觉；幻想；假象

examples.en: Mirrors can create the optical illusion of a much larger room.
examples.zh: 镜子可以制造出房间宽敞许多的视错觉。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与 under the illusion that 或 shatter/dispel the illusion 连用，指错误的观念或视错觉。

lemmas.def_en: a person with unusual powers of foresight
lemmas.def_zh: 幻想家, 魔术师

examples.en: The clever illusionist amazed the theater audience with his vanishing card tricks.
examples.zh: 这位聪明的魔术师用他消失的纸牌戏法惊艳了剧场观众。

lemmas.def_zh: 产生幻觉的, 幻影的, 错觉的
lemmas.def_en: based on or having the nature of an illusion

examples.en: The calm weather proved illusory as a fierce storm hit shortly after.
examples.zh: 平静的天气被证明只是假象，不久后暴风雨便猛烈来袭。

lemmas.def_zh: (=illusional)错觉的, 幻影的
lemmas.def_en: marked by or producing illusion

examples.en: The artist created an illusionary sense of depth that transformed the flat, dull wall.
examples.zh: 艺术家营造出一种虚幻的纵深感，彻底改变了平淡无奇的墙面。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 illudere（嘲弄、戏弄），前缀 in- + ludere（玩耍），指感官受到戏弄而产生假象。

lemmas.def_en: the compass point midway between north and east; at 45 degrees
lemmas.def_zh: 东北

examples.en: A heavy blizzard swept across the Northeast overnight, disrupting transport.
examples.zh: 一场强暴风雪一夜之间席卷了东北部地区，导致交通瘫痪。

lemmas.usage_note: 指方位或地区，常与定冠词 the 连用，多作介词宾语，首字母在特指区域时大写。

lemmas.def_en: situated in or oriented toward the northeast
lemmas.def_zh: 东北的, 向东北的, 来自东北的

examples.en: We sailed slowly along the rugged northeast coast of the island.
examples.zh: 我们沿着该岛崎岖不平的东北海岸缓慢航行。

lemmas.usage_note: 作定语修饰名词，表示“东北方向的”或“来自东北的”，常修饰 coast, corner, wind 等。

lemmas.def_en: coming from the northeast
lemmas.def_zh: 向东北的

examples.en: The ship sailed safely under a gentle northeasterly breeze toward the port.
examples.zh: 船只在温和的向东北方向微风吹拂下，安全驶向港口。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合词，由 north（北）+ east（东）构成，指介于北与东之间的方位。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] to look quickly and briefly at someone or something. 2. [I] to bounce off a surface at an angle.
lemmas.def_zh: 匆匆一瞥，扫视；掠过，擦过

examples.en: He glanced nervously at his watch while waiting for the interview to begin.
examples.zh: 在等待面试开始时，他紧张地看了一眼手表。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 at, down, over 搭配，表示迅速看一眼；及物用法较罕见。

lemmas.def_en: a quick look
lemmas.def_zh: 一瞥, 闪光, 掠过, 辉矿类

examples.en: With a quick glance over her shoulder, she made sure no one was following her.
examples.zh: 她飞快地回头瞥了一眼，以确保没有人跟着她。

lemmas.usage_note: 高频搭配为 at a glance（一眼就…）或 cast/take a glance at，指短暂的一瞥。

family_guide.root_logic: 词源或与闪烁、快速移动有关，引申为目光或光线迅速而短暂地一瞥或掠过。

lemmas.def_en: one of two divisions of an academic year
lemmas.def_zh: n. 学期（尤指半学年制）

examples.en: She plans to study abroad during the fall semester.
examples.zh: 她计划在秋季学期出国留学。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词in/during搭配，如during the spring semester；美式英语指一学年两学期制，三学期制常用term。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 semestris（六个月的），由 sex（六）和 mensis（月）结合而成，现指一学年分为两期的“学期”。

lemmas.def_en: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
lemmas.def_zh: adv. 完全地；总共；总而言之

examples.en: The train service was canceled altogether due to the storm.
examples.zh: 由于暴风雨，火车班次被彻底取消了。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示“完全”时常修饰形容词，如altogether different；注意与短语all together（大家一起）区分拼写与含义。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合副词，由 all（全部）+ together（一起）构成，意为“全然”、“总共”。

lemmas.def_en: coming next after the eighth and just before the tenth in position
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 第九的；九分之一的

examples.en: He celebrated his son's ninth birthday yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天庆祝了儿子的九岁生日。

lemmas.usage_note: 作为序数词前常加the，如the ninth edition；注意拼写去掉了nine中的e，极易误拼为nineth。

family_guide.root_logic: 基数词 nine（九）加序数词后缀 -th 演变而来（注意省略字母 e）。

lemmas.def_en: occurring or extending throughout a country or nation
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 全国性的，遍及全国的

examples.en: The police launched a nationwide hunt for the missing child.
examples.zh: 警方展开了全国范围的搜寻，以寻找那名失踪儿童。

lemmas.usage_note: 常置于名词前作定语，如a nationwide search/survey；兼作副词使用，表示“在全国范围内”，无需介词。

family_guide.root_logic: 复合形容词，由 nation（国家）+ -wide（遍及……的）构成，指全国范围的。

lemmas.def_en: very unhappy; full of misery
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 痛苦的，悲惨的；令人难受的

examples.en: The cold, rainy weather made everyone feel miserable.
examples.zh: 阴冷多雨的天气让每个人都感到极不好受。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于make somebody miserable或feel miserable；既可形容人的痛苦绝望，也可形容天气阴冷令人难受。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 miser（可怜的、悲惨的），后缀 -able 表示具有……特性的。

lemmas.def_en: any of various small flat sweet cakes (`biscuit' is the British term)
lemmas.def_zh: n. 曲奇饼，小甜饼；（计算机）Cookie

examples.en: She baked a fresh batch of chocolate chip cookies.
examples.zh: 她烤了一批新鲜的巧克力曲奇饼。

lemmas.usage_note: 美式英语指饼干（英式常用biscuit）；口语搭配that's the way the cookie crumbles意为“这就是现实”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自荷兰语 koekje（小蛋糕），传入美式英语后泛指饼干类点心。

lemmas.def_en: a brittle silver-white metalloid element that is related to selenium and sulfur; it is used in alloys and as a semiconductor; occurs mainly as tellurides in ores of copper and nickel and silver and gold
lemmas.def_zh: n. 唱名中的第七音（同 ti）

examples.en: In sol-fa notation, te is followed by the octave doh.
examples.zh: 在唱名体系中，te 之后紧接着是高八度的 doh。

lemmas.usage_note: 音乐术语，指唱名法中的第七音（常用ti替代）；亦可作为化学元素碲（Tellurium）的符号缩写。

family_guide.root_logic: 简短外来借词，常用作“ti”的变体，指唱名中的第七音（xi/ti）。

lemmas.def_en: inconsistent with reason or logic or common sense; - Walter Lippman
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 荒谬的，荒唐的；可笑的

examples.en: It is completely absurd to spend all that money on something you will never use.
examples.zh: 把你所有的钱花在一件你永远用不上的东西上，简直荒谬透顶。

lemmas.usage_note: 常形容想法、提议或情况极其不合理，修饰 idea, proposal 或在 It is absurd that... 中作表语。

lemmas.def_en: a message whose content is at variance with reason
lemmas.def_zh: 荒谬, 悖理, 荒谬的言行

examples.en: She laughed at the utter absurdity of paying ten dollars for plain water.
examples.zh: 她对一杯白开水竟要卖十美元这种极其荒谬的事付之一笑。

lemmas.def_en: in an absurd manner or to an absurd degree
lemmas.def_zh: 荒谬地, 荒唐地, 愚蠢地

examples.en: The tiny studio apartment in the city center was priced absurdly high.
examples.zh: 市中心那间微型单身公寓的价格高得荒谬。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 absurdus（不合调的、愚蠢的），由 ab-（偏离）+ surdus（聋的、听不见的）组成，引申为荒谬。

lemmas.def_en: lying between two extremes in time or space or state
lemmas.def_zh: 中间的, 中级的

examples.en: This textbook is designed specifically for students at an intermediate level of English.
examples.zh: 本教材专为中级英语水平的学生设计。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 level, stage, course 等，表示水平介于初级与高级之间，或阶段居中。

lemmas.def_en: a substance formed during a chemical process before the desired product is obtained
lemmas.def_zh: 中间物, 调停者, 中级

examples.en: The ski slope is suitable for intermediates who want to refine their technique.
examples.zh: 该滑雪道适合想要磨炼技术的中级滑雪者。

lemmas.usage_note: 指中级水平者、居间者或化学反应中的中间体，可数名词，学术或分级场景常用。

lemmas.def_en: the act of intervening for the purpose of bringing about a settlement
lemmas.def_zh: 调解, 调停, 仲裁

examples.en: The dispute was finally settled through the skilled intermediation of a neutral diplomat.
examples.zh: 这场争端最终通过一位中立外交官巧妙的调解得以解决。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to act as an intermediary or mediator between opposing parties to resolve a conflict
lemmas.def_zh: 居中调解，斡旋；起媒介作用

examples.en: A neutral committee was appointed to intermediate between the striking workers and management.
examples.zh: 一个中立委员会被任命在罢工工人与管理层之间进行调停。

lemmas.usage_note: 较正式的书面语，多作不及物动词，常与 between 搭配，表示居中调停或起媒介作用。

lemmas.def_en: to an intermediate degree
lemmas.def_zh: 在中间

examples.en: The raw material is stored intermediately in large bins before final processing.
examples.zh: 原材料在最终加工之前被暂时存放在大仓中。

family_guide.root_logic: 由 inter-（在……之间）+ medi-（中间）构成，指处于中间阶段、状态或调解。

lemmas.def_en: garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering
lemmas.def_zh: n. 待洗（或已洗）衣物；洗衣店

examples.en: I need to do the laundry tonight because I have run out of clean shirts.
examples.zh: 我今晚得洗衣服了，因为我的干净衬衫都穿完了。

lemmas.usage_note: 指待洗或刚洗好的衣物（不可数），常用 do the laundry；亦可指洗衣店（可数）。

lemmas.def_zh: 洗涤，洗烫（衣物）；洗钱（洗黑钱）
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To wash and iron clothes, sheets, or linen. 2. [T] To move illegal money through legitimate businesses so that its criminal origins are hidden.

examples.en: Criminals used fake businesses to launder millions of dollars in stolen cash.
examples.zh: 罪犯利用空壳公司清洗数百万美元的赃款。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 lavanderie，词根来自拉丁语 lavare（洗涤），现指待洗衣物或洗衣房。

lemmas.def_en: the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
lemmas.def_zh: n. 木材，木料；林木

examples.en: The house was built with a traditional timber frame.
examples.zh: 这座房子是用传统的木质框架建造的。

lemmas.usage_note: 多作不可数名词指木材、建筑用料，如a timber industry；伐木工人砍倒树木时会喊“Timber!”提醒避让。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 timber（建筑材料、木料），强调作为建材的木材或树木。

lemmas.def_en: concrete pavement is sometimes referred to as cement
lemmas.def_zh: 水泥, 胶结剂

examples.en: The workers mixed sand and cement thoroughly to prepare the mortar for the wall.
examples.zh: 工人们将沙子和水泥充分混合，以调制砌墙用的灰浆。

lemmas.usage_note: 建筑材料指水泥（不可数），亦可引申指粘合剂或维系关系的纽带，常作主语或介词宾语。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To strengthen a relationship, agreement, or position so it lasts. 2. [T] To join bricks, stones, or surfaces together with cement.
lemmas.def_zh: 巩固，加深（关系等）；用水泥粘结

examples.en: The successful merger helped to cement the company's position as a market leader.
examples.zh: 成功的合并有助于巩固该公司作为市场领导者的地位。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作及物动词，比喻义“巩固、加强（友谊、合作、地位等）”极高频，书面语常用。

lemmas.def_zh: 似水泥的, 有黏性的
lemmas.def_en: like or relevant to or having the properties of cement

examples.en: Workers applied a strong cementitious coating to waterproof the cracked concrete foundation.
examples.zh: 工人们涂抹了一层坚固的水泥基涂料，为开裂的混凝土基础防水。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 caementum（碎石屑、用于砌墙的石灰混合料），后引申为加固、粘合。

lemmas.def_en: marked by extreme and violent energy
lemmas.def_zh: adj. 凶猛的；激烈的；狂暴的

examples.en: The two smartphone manufacturers are engaged in fierce competition for market share.
examples.zh: 这两家智能手机制造商正在为争夺市场份额而展开激烈的竞争。

lemmas.usage_note: 常修饰 competition, debate, wind, battle 等，强调激烈、凶猛或狂暴的程度。

lemmas.def_en: in a physically fierce manner
lemmas.def_zh: 猛烈地, 厉害地

examples.en: The mother bear fiercely protected her young cubs from the approaching predator.
examples.zh: 母熊凶猛地保护着幼崽，抵御逼近的捕食者。

lemmas.def_en: the property of being wild or turbulent
lemmas.def_zh: 凶猛, 猛烈

examples.en: The unexpected fierceness of the storm caused severe damage to the coastal village.
examples.zh: 风暴出人意料的凶猛势头给沿海村庄造成了严重破坏。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自拉丁语 ferus（凶猛的、野性的），引申为狂暴的、激烈的。

lemmas.def_en: a preparation (usually made of sweetened chicle) for chewing
lemmas.def_zh: 牙龈，齿龈

examples.en: Brushing your teeth too hard can damage your gums and cause them to bleed.
examples.zh: 刷牙太用力会损伤牙龈并导致出血。

lemmas.usage_note: 牙龈，齿龈

lemmas.def_zh: (gummy 的复数) a. 树胶的, 粘的

examples.en: The children eagerly reached for a handful of sweet, fruit-flavored gummies.
examples.zh: 孩子们争相伸手抓了一把香甜的水果味软糖。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To stick or seal something together using gum or glue. 2. [T] (gum up) To clog or make something sticky so that it cannot work properly.
lemmas.def_zh: 用胶水粘合，涂胶于；使黏结，堵塞（与 up 连用）

examples.en: She carefully gummed the label onto the package before mailing it.
examples.zh: 她在邮寄包裹前，小心翼翼地把标签用胶水贴在上面。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，表示用胶水粘贴，常与 on/together 连用；gum up 则常指“用粘物堵塞”。

lemmas.def_en: having the sticky properties of an adhesive
lemmas.def_zh: 树胶的, 粘的

examples.en: Spilled orange juice left a gummy, sticky film across the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 洒出的橙汁在厨房台面上留下一层发黏的胶状薄膜。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 kommi（树胶）或古英语 goma（牙龈），现兼具“植物胶/口香糖”与“牙龈”之意。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (law) To officially declare that a contract, document, or election is invalid and has no legal force. 2. [T] (formal/medicine) To discharge or empty urine or feces from the body.
lemmas.def_zh: 宣布……无效，作废，废止；排泄，排出（大小便等）

examples.en: The sensor failed to scan properly because the system voided the uninked margins of the document.
examples.zh: 由于系统使文档未着墨的边缘脱墨留白，传感器未能成功进行扫描。

lemmas.usage_note: 技术及法律语境中作及物动词，常指使合同无效或在印刷/光学识别中留出空白点或脱墨。

lemmas.def_en: capable of being rescinded or voided
lemmas.def_zh: 可使无效的, 可以撤销的

examples.en: A contract signed under extreme duress is legally voidable by the victim.
examples.zh: 在极端胁迫下签署的合同依法可由受害者撤销。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 void 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions
lemmas.def_zh: 良心，良知；内心的道德感

examples.en: He could not in good conscience accept the prize knowing someone else had done the work.
examples.zh: 明知那是别人做的工作，他良心上无法坦然接受这个奖项。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，常与 have, clear, guilty 连用，多见于道德与伦理反思语境。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being in accord with the dictates of conscience
lemmas.def_zh: 责任心

examples.en: Her natural conscientiousness made her the most reliable project manager on the team.
examples.zh: 她天生的责任心使她成为团队中最可靠的项目经理。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by extreme care and great effort
lemmas.def_zh: 有责任心的, 负责的, 本着良心的

examples.en: He is a conscientious student who always double-checks his homework before submission.
examples.zh: 他是个认真的学生，总是在交作业前仔细检查两遍。

lemmas.def_en: lacking a conscience
lemmas.def_zh: 没良心的, 不知廉耻的

examples.en: The conscienceless scammer stole the life savings of dozens of elderly residents.
examples.zh: 那个丧尽天良的骗子骗光了数十位老年居民的毕生积蓄。

lemmas.def_en: with extreme conscientiousness
lemmas.def_zh: 认真, 凭良心做, 尽心尽责, 谨慎, 诚心诚意

examples.en: She worked conscientiously on the complex report until every single error was corrected.
examples.zh: 她尽职尽责地修改那份复杂的报告，直到每个错误都被纠正。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 conscientia（共同知晓、内省认知），由 con-（共同，表强调）与 scire（知道）结合而成，引申为内心明辨是非的道德知觉。

lemmas.def_en: the killing of animals (as for food)
lemmas.def_zh: 残杀, 屠杀, 杀戮

examples.en: The international community condemned the senseless slaughter of innocent civilians during the war.
examples.zh: 国际社会谴责了战争期间对无辜平民毫无意义的屠杀。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常作不可数名词，常与 mass, brutal 搭配，多用于军事战争或牲畜宰杀语境。

lemmas.def_en: a person who slaughters or dresses meat for market
lemmas.def_zh: 屠夫, 屠杀者, 刽子手

examples.en: The experienced slaughterer prepared the cattle for processing according to strict humane standards.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的屠宰师傅按照严格的人道标准准备处理牲畜。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To kill a large number of people cruelly and violently; massacre. 2. [T] To kill animals for meat. 3. [T] (informal) To defeat an opponent overwhelmingly.
lemmas.def_zh: 屠杀，残杀；屠宰（牲畜）；彻底打败

examples.en: Thousands of cattle were slaughtered to prevent the spread of the contagious disease.
examples.zh: 为防止传染病蔓延，数千头牲畜被宰杀。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常与 cattle, victims 连用，也口语化用于比喻在体育赛事中大胜对手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slaughter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of being cautious; being attentive to possible danger
lemmas.def_zh: 小心, 慎重, 警示

examples.en: The financial advisor urged his clients to exercise extreme caution before investing in the market.
examples.zh: 财务顾问敦促客户在进入该市场投资前务必保持极度谨慎。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词表慎重，与 exercise, utmost 搭配；作可数名词时指警示或告诫，多见于正式文体。

lemmas.def_en: the trait of being cautious; being attentive to possible danger
lemmas.def_zh: 谨慎；小心

examples.en: His natural cautiousness prevented the company from making a risky and costly investment.
examples.zh: 他天生谨慎的性格使公司避免了一笔高风险且代价高昂的投资。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to warn or advise someone carefully about a danger, risk, or mistake
lemmas.def_zh: 告诫，提醒，警告

examples.en: The doctor cautioned him against returning to work before his knee had fully healed.
examples.zh: 医生警告他在膝盖完全康复前切勿重返工作岗位。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接 sb. against (doing) sth. 或接 that 从句，用于正式警示潜在危险。

lemmas.def_en: showing careful forethought
lemmas.def_zh: 谨慎的, 小心的

examples.en: Investors remain cautious about the economic recovery despite recent market gains.
examples.zh: 尽管近期股市上涨，投资者对经济复苏依然持谨慎态度。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常与 about, of 搭配或修饰 approach, optimism，表达行事警惕、不冒险的态度。

lemmas.def_zh: 警告的
lemmas.def_en: warding off; - Victor Schultze

examples.en: The documentary serves as a cautionary tale about corporate greed.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片是对企业贪婪行径的一则警世故事。

lemmas.def_en: as if with kid gloves; with caution or prudence or tact
lemmas.def_zh: 慎重地

examples.en: She cautiously opened the old wooden door, worried it might make a noise.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地推开那扇旧木门，担心它会发出声响。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 cavere（当心、警惕），核心语义为对潜在危险或风险保持注意与防范。

lemmas.def_en: that part of the earnings of a corporation that is distributed to its shareholders; usually paid quarterly
lemmas.def_zh: n. 股息，红利；回报，效益；[数]被除数

examples.en: Investing in employee training often pays substantial long-term dividends.
examples.zh: 对员工培训进行投资往往会带来丰厚的长期回报。

lemmas.usage_note: 商界指“股息/红利”，常搭配 pay a dividend；比喻用法 pay dividends 极为常用，表示“带来丰厚回报”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 dividere（分割、分配），字面义为“应被分配的事物”，引申为红利、股息或带来的额外回报。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To move your head down and up, especially to show agreement, greeting, or acknowledgement. 2. [I] To let your head fall forward when sleepy; to fall asleep briefly.
lemmas.def_zh: 点头示意，点头答应；打盹，打瞌睡

examples.en: She nodded in agreement when I suggested stopping for a short break.
examples.zh: 当建议停下来稍作休息时，她点头表示同意。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 nod in agreement/approval（点头同意）；短语 nod off 为口语，意为“打瞌睡/打盹”。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 点头（表示赞同、招呼或许可）
lemmas.def_en: a downward and upward movement of the head, typically signifying agreement or greeting
lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，常用搭配 a nod of approval/agreement（赞同的点点头），give a nod（点头示意）。

examples.en: She gave a slight nod of acknowledgment as he entered the room.
examples.zh: 他进屋时，她微微点头致意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: German engineer (born in France) who invented the diesel engine (1858-1913)
lemmas.def_zh: 柴油；柴油机；柴油车

examples.en: Rising fuel taxes have made diesel significantly more expensive than unleaded petrol.
examples.zh: 燃油税的上涨使得柴油比无铅汽油贵得多。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常不可数，指柴油或柴油机；常作定语修饰 diesel engine, diesel fuel, diesel car 等交通术语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自德国发明家鲁道夫·狄塞尔（Rudolf Diesel）的姓氏，指其发明的内燃机及相关燃油或车辆。

lemmas.def_en: a negotiable certificate that can be detached and redeemed as needed
lemmas.def_zh: 优惠券；折价券；息票

examples.en: Don't forget to use this coupon at the checkout to get a 20% discount.
examples.zh: 结账时别忘了使用这张优惠券，可以享受八折优惠。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，高频动词搭配有 clip a coupon（剪优惠券）和 redeem a coupon（兑换/使用优惠券）。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 couper（剪、切），原指从票据或广告上剪下的一小联，现指用于兑换、打折的优惠券或利息票。

lemmas.def_en: something that follows something else
lemmas.def_zh: n. （书、电影等的）续集，续篇；随之而来的事情，结果

examples.en: The original movie was such a massive hit that the studio immediately greenlit a sequel.
examples.zh: 那部原版电影票房大卖，制片厂随即批准开拍续集。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 to 搭配，作 a sequel to sth，既可指文艺作品的“续集”，也可在书面语中指事情的“后果/余波”。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 sequi（跟随），核心指“紧随其后的事物”，引申为续作或结果。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by grandeur
lemmas.def_zh: 宏伟的；壮丽的；极好的

examples.en: The hotel balcony offered a magnificent view of the snow-capped mountain range.
examples.zh: 从酒店阳台望去，白雪皑皑的群山呈现出一幅壮丽的景象。

lemmas.usage_note: 褒义形容词，常修饰 view, performance, building，用于文学或描述性语境中表达宏伟壮丽。

lemmas.def_en: extremely well
lemmas.def_zh: 壮丽地; 宏伟地; 极好地; 出色地

examples.en: The ancient castle sat magnificently atop the hill overlooking the wide river.
examples.zh: 古老的城堡雄伟地坐落在俯瞰宽阔河流的山顶上。

lemmas.def_zh: 富丽堂皇, 华丽, 宏大
lemmas.def_en: splendid or imposing in size or appearance

examples.en: Tourists were left in awe by the sheer magnificence of the ancient palace.
examples.zh: 游客们被这座古老宫殿的富丽堂皇深深震撼。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 magnus（大）和 facere（做/制造），引申为宏伟壮丽的、卓越的。

lemmas.def_en: properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient
lemmas.def_zh: 有能力的，称职的；胜任的

examples.en: She proved to be a highly competent manager capable of handling complex projects.
examples.zh: 事实证明她是一位非常有能力的管理者，能够胜任复杂的项目。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常与 in, to do 连用或修饰 professional, authority，用于职场评价与法律公文。

lemmas.def_zh: 胜任, 职称, 能力
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually

examples.en: The job applicant demonstrated a high level of technical competence during the interview.
examples.zh: 该求职者在面试中展现了高水平的技术胜任能力。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，常与 demonstrate, core 搭配，用于专业技能评估及权限说明的正式语境。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
lemmas.def_zh: 足以使人过舒适生活的富裕收入, 充裕的生活条件

examples.en: His substantial competency allowed him to retire early and pursue his artistic hobbies.
examples.zh: 他丰厚的资产使他得以早早退休并追求艺术爱好。

lemmas.def_en: with competence; in a competent capable manner
lemmas.def_zh: 胜任地；适合地

examples.en: She competently managed the entire department while the director was away on leave.
examples.zh: 在主管休假期间，她胜任地管理着整个部门。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 competere（相称、适合），核心义为“有能力满足需求、合格胜任的”。

lemmas.def_en: [I, T] To make a serious, solemn promise or commitment to do something or that something is true.
lemmas.def_zh: 起誓，发誓；郑重宣布

examples.en: The young soldiers vowed to defend their homeland until the very last breath.
examples.zh: 年轻的士兵们发誓要保卫祖国直到最后一刻。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面语色彩浓厚，常接不定式 vow to do sth 或 that 从句，表示庄严发誓或下定极大决心，不可用于轻率口头承诺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vow 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To officially force a foreign national to leave a country. 2. [T] (formal, 'deport oneself') To behave or conduct oneself in a particular manner.
lemmas.def_zh: 驱逐出境，遣返；表现，举止

examples.en: The government decided to deport the illegal immigrants after reviewing their cases.
examples.zh: 政府在审查案件后，决定将这些非法移民驱逐出境。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接 sb. from/to 或以反身代词配合表现行为，多用于法律移民及书面语境。

lemmas.def_en: the act of expelling a person from their native land
lemmas.def_zh: n. 驱逐出境，放逐

examples.en: He hired an experienced lawyer when he found himself facing imminent deportation.
examples.zh: 在发现自己面临即刻被驱逐出境的境况时，他聘请了一位资深律师。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数或可数名词，常与 face, order 搭配，多用于法律公文、政务报道等正式文体。

lemmas.def_en: (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people
lemmas.def_zh: 行为, 举止

examples.en: Her strict parents always emphasized the importance of proper deportment at public events.
examples.zh: 她严厉的父母总是强调在公共场合举止得体的重要性。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is expelled from home or country by authority
lemmas.def_zh: 被驱逐者

examples.en: The deportee was placed on a flight back to his native country yesterday.
examples.zh: 这名被驱逐者昨天被送上了返回原籍国的航班。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 deportare（运走、流放），由 de-（离开）和 portare（携带）构成，现代主要引申为依法将某人驱逐出境，或书面语中指（以某种方式）举止表现。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ through/into/across) To walk with effort through water, mud, or deep snow. 2. [I] ('wade through') To read or work slowly through something tedious.
lemmas.def_zh: 蹚（水、泥等），跋涉；艰难费力地处理（wade through）

examples.en: We had to wade across the shallow stream to reach the hiking path on the other side.
examples.zh: 我们不得不趟过那条浅溪，才能走到对岸的远足小道上。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物或及物动词，常与 through, across 搭配，亦可引申为费力处理（文件等繁重任务）。

lemmas.def_en: [T] To roll, compress, or fold paper, cloth, or soft material into a tight ball or pad; to pad or stuff with soft material.
lemmas.def_zh: 揉成一团，揉拢；用软物填塞

examples.en: He angrily wadded the draft into a tight ball and threw it away.
examples.zh: 他愤怒地把草稿揉成一个紧实的纸团扔掉了。

lemmas.def_en: any of many long-legged birds that wade in water in search of food
lemmas.def_zh: 涉水者, 涉禽, 高统防水长靴

examples.en: He pulled on his waterproof waders before stepping into the fast-flowing river.
examples.zh: 在走进湍急的河流之前，他穿上了防水高统长靴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: plant fiber used e.g. for making baskets and hats or as fodder
lemmas.def_zh: 稻草, 麦管, 吸管, 一文不值的东西, 草帽

examples.en: The roof of the traditional cottage was built from thick layers of dried straw.
examples.zh: 这座传统农舍的屋顶是用厚厚的干稻草铺成的。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数或不可数名词，表稻草（材料）或吸管，常用于 the last straw 等固定成语中。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (dated) To scatter or cover a floor or ground with straw or similar material.

examples.en: The stable hands strawed the horse stalls each evening to keep the animals warm.
examples.zh: 马厩工人每天傍晚都会在马厩里铺上稻草，以便为牲口保暖。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，意为“用稻草覆盖”或“散落铺垫”，多见于农业养殖或古旧文献语境。
lemmas.def_zh: （用稻草等）铺撒，散布

family_guide.root_logic: 以 straw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] To travel regularly between one's home and place of work or study. 2. [T] (law) To change a severe judicial punishment to a less severe one.
lemmas.def_zh: 通勤，上下班往返；减刑；替代

examples.en: Many people choose to commute by train to avoid heavy city traffic every morning.
examples.zh: 许多人选择每天早晨乘火车通勤，以避开拥堵的城市交通。

lemmas.usage_note: 不及物动词指往返通勤（+from/to）；及物动词指减刑（commute a sentence to），正式严谨。

lemmas.def_en: a passenger train that is ridden primarily by passengers who travel regularly from one place to another
lemmas.def_zh: 乘公共车辆上下班者, 月季票乘客

examples.en: Thousands of commuters crowd the subway platform every morning during rush hour.
examples.zh: 每天早高峰时段，数以千计的通勤者挤满了地铁站台。

lemmas.def_en: the travel of a commuter
lemmas.def_zh: 交换, 变换, 代替

examples.en: The prisoner applied for a commutation of his life sentence to twenty years.
examples.zh: 该囚犯申请将他的无期徒刑减刑为二十年。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 commutare（交换、改变），引申指用季票代替单程票的往返乘车行为，后专指通勤。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of having an inferior or less favorable position
lemmas.def_zh: 缺点, 不利, 坏处

examples.en: Her lack of formal experience placed her at a distinct disadvantage during the interview.
examples.zh: 她缺乏正式的工作经验，这使得她在面试中处于明显的劣势。

lemmas.usage_note: 常与介词 at 连用表示处于劣势，或构成 have/suffer a disadvantage，指客观劣势或缺陷。

lemmas.def_en: [T] (often passive) To put someone in an unfavorable position that reduces their chances of success.
lemmas.def_zh: 使处于不利地位，妨碍，损害

examples.en: The new zoning regulations severely disadvantaged small local businesses.
examples.zh: 新的分区规划法规严重损害了当地小企业的利益，使其处于不利地位。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，多用于被动语态或正式公文中，表示使处于不利地位或剥夺某些平等机会。

lemmas.def_en: constituting a disadvantage
lemmas.def_zh: 不利的, 蔑视的, 贬抑的

examples.en: Signing the contract under these strict terms would be extremely disadvantageous for us.
examples.zh: 在这些苛刻的条款下签订合同对我们将极其不利。

lemmas.def_en: in a disadvantageous way; to someone's disadvantage
lemmas.def_zh: 不利地

examples.en: The small retail store was disadvantageously located far away from the city center.
examples.zh: 这家小零售店位置不利，远离市中心。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（不，相反）+ advantage（优势），核心指处于不利或劣势的状态。

lemmas.def_en: to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
lemmas.def_zh: (adv.) 合理地；相当地，适度地

examples.en: The hotel was reasonably priced and very clean.
examples.zh: 这家酒店价格合理，而且非常干净。

lemmas.usage_note: 一指“合理地”（如 behave reasonably）；二指“相当程度地、尚可”（如 reasonably priced/good），起弱化修饰作用。

lemmas.def_en: not in a reasonable or intelligent manner
lemmas.def_zh: 不合理地

examples.en: The landlord was unreasonably demanding and refused to fix the broken heating system.
examples.zh: 房东无理苛求，且拒绝修理坏掉的供暖系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 reasonable（合理的）+ -ly（副词后缀），表示符合情理或程度适中。

lemmas.def_en: the feel of a surface or a fabric
lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 质地，手感；纹理；结构

examples.en: The moisturizing cream has a smooth, non-greasy texture.
examples.zh: 这款保湿霜质地细腻且不油腻。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用于描述食物口感（smooth/creamy texture）或物体质地；引申指文章、音乐等丰富的层次感与细节特质。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 texere（编织），原指织物的编织质感，引申为任何物体表面的触感或质地。

lemmas.def_en: (of persons) befitting a warrior
lemmas.def_zh: (adj.) 军事的，战争的；尚武的

examples.en: The government declared martial law after violent protests erupted across the capital.
examples.zh: 首都爆发暴力抗议后，政府宣布实施戒严令。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，常修饰 law、arts 或 music，指与战争、军队或武力有关的事物，语体较为正式。

lemmas.def_en: in a martial manner
lemmas.def_zh: 勇敢地；好战地

examples.en: The soldiers were martially equipped and ready to march onto the battlefield.
examples.zh: 士兵们全副武装，英勇善战，随时准备开赴战场。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自罗马战神 Mars（玛尔斯），指与战争、军事或搏击相关的。

lemmas.def_en: inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli
lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 本能，直觉，天性

examples.en: Her first instinct was to run, but she stood her ground.
examples.zh: 她的第一本能是逃跑，但她还是坚守在原地。

lemmas.usage_note: 常搭配 by instinct（凭本能）或 have an instinct for sth；注意“直觉做某事”是 an instinct to do，而非 of doing。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 instinguere（驱使、激励），指未经思考即可自发作出的本能反应。

lemmas.def_en: unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope; ; ; ; ; ; ; ; ; - W.R.Inge
lemmas.def_zh: (adj.) 巨大的，无限的

examples.en: The medical team is working under immense pressure during the ongoing health crisis.
examples.zh: 在持续的公共卫生危机中，医疗团队正承受着巨大的压力开展工作。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，常修饰 pressure、value、potential 等抽象名词，表示程度或规模极其庞大。

lemmas.def_en: to an exceedingly great extent or degree
lemmas.def_zh: (adv.) 极其，非常，极大地

examples.en: We enjoyed the classical concert immensely and look forward to the next performance.
examples.zh: 我们非常享受这场古典音乐会，并期待着下一场演出。

lemmas.usage_note: 副词，常修饰 popular、helpful、enjoy 等，在书面语与口语中均可表示极其或非常。

lemmas.def_en: unusual largeness in size or extent or number
lemmas.def_zh: 广大, 无边, 巨物

examples.en: Standing on the cliff, she was overwhelmed by the sheer immensity of the ocean.
examples.zh: 站在悬崖边，她被大海的浩瀚无边深深震撼了。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 in-（无）+ metiri（测量），字面意为“无法测量的”，引申为巨大的。

lemmas.def_en: a bachelor's degree in arts and sciences
lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 腹肌（常作abs）

examples.en: He spends hours at the gym trying to get six-pack abs.
examples.zh: 他泡在健身房数小时，试图练出六块腹肌。

lemmas.usage_note: 常以复数 abs 出现，为口语中腹肌（abdominal muscles）的简称；常与 tone/work on 搭配。

family_guide.root_logic: abdominal（腹部的）的口语缩写，常以复数 abs 形式指代腹肌。

lemmas.def_en: by reasonable assumption
lemmas.def_zh: (adv.) 据推测，大概，可能

examples.en: Presumably, bad weather caused the flight to be canceled.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气大概是导致航班取消的原因。

lemmas.usage_note: 书面与口语均常用，表示基于合逻辑的推测“想必/大概”，常置于句首修饰全句或位于系动词后。

family_guide.root_logic: 来自 presume（推测）+ -ably（副词后缀），指基于现有线索合理推断出“很可能”。

lemmas.def_en: equally distant from the extremes
lemmas.def_zh: (adj.) 中途的，半途的；不彻底的

examples.en: We have reached the halfway point of the project.
examples.zh: 我们已经到达了项目的半程节点。

lemmas.usage_note: 常用作定语或表语，固定搭配 a halfway house（折中方案/中途宿舍），常修饰 mark 或 point 表示中途。

family_guide.root_logic: half（一半）+ way（路途），表示空间、时间或进度上走了一半。

lemmas.def_en: a colorless and odorless inert gas; one of the six inert gases; comprises approximately 1% of the earth's atmosphere
lemmas.def_zh: (n.) 增强现实（Augmented Reality 的缩写）

examples.en: The mobile game uses AR to bring digital creatures into the real world.
examples.zh: 这款手机游戏利用增强现实技术将数字生物引入现实世界。

lemmas.usage_note: 多为特定领域缩写，科技语境下多指 Augmented Reality（增强现实），书面中常作大写 AR 使用。

family_guide.root_logic: Augmented Reality 的首字母缩写，指在真实场景中叠加虚拟信息的技术。

lemmas.def_en: a thick flat pad used as a floor covering
lemmas.def_zh: 垫, 丛, 衬边

examples.en: Please wipe your dirty shoes thoroughly on the door mat before entering the house.
examples.zh: 进屋前请先在门垫上把脏鞋彻底擦干净。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词，指放置在地面的垫子或纠结成团的物体，常见搭配有 bath mat、yoga mat。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To tangle or twist together into a thick, messy, and compact mass.
lemmas.def_zh: 缠结成团；铺垫子

examples.en: The stray dog's thick fur had matted badly after weeks of rain.
examples.zh: 几周阴雨过后，这只流浪狗浓密的毛发已经严重打结缠绕。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，常用于被动语态，描述头发、毛发等纠结杂乱成块的状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 mætte（草席、垫子），引申出使物体表面缠结、失去光泽的动词义。

lemmas.def_en: not in physical motion
lemmas.def_zh: 静态的, 静止的, 固有的, 静电的

examples.en: Oil prices remained virtually static throughout the last quarter.
examples.zh: 在上一个季度中，石油价格几乎保持静止不变。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词，描述缺乏变化、没有发展的静态局面，或指静电学上的静止电荷。

lemmas.def_en: a crackling or hissing noise caused by electrical interference
lemmas.def_zh: 静电, 静电干扰

examples.en: There was too much static on the radio to clearly hear the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 收音机里的静电杂音太大，根本听不清天气预报。

lemmas.usage_note: 作不可数名词，多指无线电设备收到的杂音、天电干扰，或指物体摩擦产生的静电。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 statikos（引起静止的），指处于静止、不变状态，或指静电及电波杂音。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the science of acoustics
lemmas.def_zh: 听觉的, 声学的, 音响的

examples.en: The singer gave a moving performance accompanied only by an acoustic guitar.
examples.zh: 这位歌手仅凭一把原声吉他伴奏，带来了一场动人的表演。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容词，指与声音传播、听觉相关的性质，或特指不用电放大的原声乐器（如 guitar）。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the science of acoustics
lemmas.def_zh: 听觉的, 声学的

examples.en: Engineers installed acoustical panels on the walls to reduce echo in the studio.
examples.zh: 工程师在墙上安装了吸音板，以减少录音室内的回声。

lemmas.def_en: a remedy for hearing loss or deafness
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 听的; 声学的

examples.en: The musician preferred playing an acoustic over an electric model during recording sessions.
examples.zh: 录音期间，这位音乐家更倾向于演奏原声乐器而非电声款。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词时复数形式 acoustics 更为普遍，单数形式多见于专业术语或用作乐器统称。

lemmas.def_en: a physicist who specializes in acoustics
lemmas.def_zh: 声学家

examples.en: The architect hired an experienced acoustician to optimize sound quality in the hall.
examples.zh: 建筑师聘请了一位经验丰富的声学家来优化大厅的音质。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to acoustics
lemmas.def_zh: 听觉上；声学上

examples.en: This concert hall is acoustically designed to deliver balanced sound to every seat.
examples.zh: 这座音乐厅经过声学设计，能为每个座位传递均衡的声音。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自希腊语 akouein（听），与声音的传导、听觉或未经电声放大的原声相关。

lemmas.def_en: any of various tailless stout-bodied amphibians with long hind limbs for leaping; semiaquatic and terrestrial species
lemmas.def_zh: 青蛙

examples.en: A tiny green frog leapt across the narrow garden path into the pond.
examples.zh: 一只绿色的小青蛙跳过狭窄的花园小径，钻进了池塘里。

lemmas.usage_note: 可数名词，指两栖动物青蛙；口语习语 a frog in one's throat 表示嗓子干哑。

lemmas.def_en: [I] to hunt or catch frogs.
lemmas.def_zh: 捕蛙，猎蛙

examples.en: The knitters had to frog three full rows of the sweater after noticing a dropped stitch.
examples.zh: 编织工在发现漏针后，不得不把毛衣整整拆掉了三行。

lemmas.usage_note: 专业及特殊动词用法，常指（在手工或解剖中）捕蛙或用青蛙做试验，也可指织物拆线。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 frogga，拟声模仿青蛙叫声或跳跃形态。

lemmas.def_en: a landowner who leases to others
lemmas.def_zh: 房东, 地主

examples.en: The landlord promised to repair the leaking kitchen sink by tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 房东承诺在明天下午之前修好漏水的厨房水槽。

lemmas.usage_note: 指房东或酒吧老板（英式）；易错点是女性房东可统称 landlord 或用 landlady，注意不要误用为 owner。

family_guide.root_logic: land（土地）+ lord（主人），字面指“土地拥有者”。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To make a substance or place impure, dirty, or dangerous by adding a harmful or toxic agent.
lemmas.def_zh: 污染，毒害；玷污

examples.en: Industrial waste leaked from the factory and contaminated the local groundwater.
examples.zh: 工厂泄漏的工业废料污染了当地的地下水。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，常接 water、soil 或 air 作宾语，搭配 contaminate with 表示被某种毒物污染。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being contaminated
lemmas.def_zh: 污染, 污物

examples.en: Routine tests revealed high levels of bacterial contamination in the municipal reservoir.
examples.zh: 常规检测显示市政水库中存在严重的细菌污染。

lemmas.usage_note: 不可数名词，指污染状态或污染物，常见于 environmental/bacterial contamination 搭配中。

lemmas.def_zh: 污染物, 沾染物
lemmas.def_en: a substance that contaminates

examples.en: Filters were installed to remove every dangerous chemical contaminant from drinking water.
examples.zh: 安装了过滤器，以清除饮用水中所有危险的化学污染物。

lemmas.def_en: not corrupted by contact or association
lemmas.def_zh: 没有被污染的, 未沾染的

examples.en: The villagers rely on an uncontaminated mountain spring for their daily drinking water.
examples.zh: 村民们依靠未受污染的山泉水作为日常饮用水。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 con-（共同）+ tamin-（接触，源自 tangere“触碰”），核心为“因触碰杂质而弄脏”。
family_guide.core_distinction: contaminate 侧重外来杂质使变质；pollution 侧重环境层面的广泛污染。

lemmas.def_en: (law) the findings of a jury on issues of fact submitted to it for decision; can be used in formulating a judgment
lemmas.def_zh: 裁决, 判决, 判断性意见, 定论, 结论

examples.en: The jury deliberated for three days before reaching a unanimous guilty verdict.
examples.zh: 陪审团审议了三天，最终达成了一致的有罪裁决。

lemmas.usage_note: 法庭中指陪审团裁决，引申为公众结论；高频动词搭配 reach/deliver/return a verdict (of)。

family_guide.root_logic: 词根 ver-（真实）+ dict-（说），字面即“说真话”，引申为裁判裁断。

lemmas.def_en: [T] 1. To pull or twist something out of its natural, normal, or original shape. 2. To report or represent information in an untrue or misleading way.
lemmas.def_zh: 扭曲，使变形；歪曲，曲解

examples.en: The tabloid was accused of intentionally distorting the politician's statements.
examples.zh: 该小报被指责蓄意曲解那位政客的公开发言。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，宾语可为物理形态（如 face）或抽象事实（如 truth、facts、reality）。

lemmas.def_en: a change for the worse
lemmas.def_zh: 扭曲, 变形, 曲解

examples.en: His account of the incident was a complete distortion of what actually happened.
examples.zh: 他对该事件的陈述完全是对事实真相的扭曲。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词，可指物理上的形变失真，或抽象层面的曲解歪曲，常与 of 连用。

lemmas.def_en: without alteration or misrepresentation
lemmas.def_zh: 未失真的, 不偏激的

examples.en: These premium headphones deliver completely undistorted sound even at peak volumes.
examples.zh: 这款高端耳机即使在最高音量下也能提供完全不失真的声音。

family_guide.root_logic: 前缀 dis-（偏离）+ tort-（扭曲），本义为扭离原本的形状或真相。
family_guide.core_distinction: distort 强调外力扭曲变形或歪曲事实；deform 侧重物理形态永久损毁。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (formal or literary) to wake up from sleep, or to make someone wake up 2. [I, T] to stir up or arouse an emotion, interest, or memory
lemmas.def_zh: （使）醒来，唤醒；唤起（记忆、情感等）；觉察，意识到

examples.en: The dramatic documentary awakened public awareness about global plastic pollution.
examples.zh: 这部戏剧性的纪录片唤醒了公众对全球塑料污染问题的意识。

lemmas.usage_note: 可作及物或不及物动词，较 wake 更加典雅正式，常引申为唤起情绪或使意识到问题。

lemmas.def_en: the act of waking
lemmas.def_zh: 唤醒, 觉醒, 被唤起

examples.en: The crisis marked a painful awakening for the company's careless management team.
examples.zh: 这场危机标志着该企业疏忽大意的管理团队一次痛苦的觉醒。

lemmas.usage_note: 名词，常指意识、认识或情感的觉醒与苏醒，常见搭配有 spiritual/political awakening。

lemmas.def_en: not aroused or activated
lemmas.def_zh: 未醒的, 潜伏的

examples.en: She believes every child possesses great, unawakened potential waiting to be discovered.
examples.zh: 她相信每个孩子都拥有巨大的、未被唤醒的潜能等待发掘。

family_guide.root_logic: a-（表状态/强调）+ wake（醒来）+ -en（使动后缀），意为“使醒来”或“苏醒”。
family_guide.core_distinction: awaken 多用于文学书面语或比喻义（唤醒意识）；wake 则是日常口语基础词。

lemmas.def_en: a notable achievement
lemmas.def_zh: 壮举, 功绩, 技艺表演

examples.en: Climbing the steep mountain without oxygen was an incredible feat of endurance.
examples.zh: 不带氧气攀登这座陡峭的高山是一项惊人的耐力壮举。

lemmas.usage_note: 指需要勇气、技巧或力量的壮举，常搭配 no mean feat（了不起的成就）或 a feat of engineering/endurance。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 factum（已做之事），经古法语演变为指卓越功绩或技艺。

lemmas.def_en: a place of worship that has its own altar
lemmas.def_zh: 小教堂, 礼拜式

examples.en: The couple exchanged their wedding vows inside a charming stone chapel yesterday.
examples.zh: 这对新人昨天在一座迷人的石砌小教堂里交换了结婚誓言。

lemmas.usage_note: 指附属于大建筑或独立的小礼拜堂，常见于 wedding chapel；去礼拜常用 go to chapel，前面通常不加冠词。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 capella（斗篷），因最初供奉圣马丁的半件斗篷（cappa）之所而得名。
family_guide.core_distinction: chapel 通常指小教堂、附属于大机构的礼拜堂；church 多指独立的普通教堂实体。

lemmas.def_en: an alloy of copper and zinc
lemmas.def_zh: 黄铜, 黄铜制品

examples.en: The antique door handle was crafted from solid polished brass.
examples.zh: 这个复古门把手是由坚固的抛光黄铜制成的。

lemmas.usage_note: 常指黄铜金属或管乐器，也可口语指厚脸皮，常搭配 brass instrument、top brass。

lemmas.def_en: resembling the sound of a brass instrument
lemmas.def_zh: 似黄铜的, 厚脸皮的

examples.en: Her brassy laughter echoed loudly through the quiet, dimly lit library.
examples.zh: 她刺耳放肆的笑声在安静昏暗的图书馆里大声回荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古英语 bræs，指黄铜合金，引申出铜管乐器及俚语“厚颜无耻/高级军官”。

lemmas.def_en: having or experiencing a rapid onset and short but severe course
lemmas.def_zh: 尖锐的, 敏锐的, 激烈的, 严重的, 急性的

examples.en: The hospital is facing an acute shortage of experienced intensive care nurses.
examples.zh: 这家医院正面临着经验丰富的重症监护护士极度匮乏的困境。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容问题严峻、感官敏锐或疾病急性发作，常见搭配 acute pain、acute shortage。

lemmas.def_en: in an acute manner
lemmas.def_zh: 尖锐地, 剧烈地

examples.en: He was acutely aware of the risks involved in this delicate operation.
examples.zh: 他敏锐地意识到了这项精密手术所涉及的风险。

lemmas.def_en: a sensitivity that is keen and highly developed
lemmas.def_zh: 锐利, 敏锐, 剧烈

examples.en: The acuteness of her analytical mind impressed every member of the board.
examples.zh: 她敏锐的分析能力给董事会的每位成员留下了深刻印象。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 acus（针），引申为“像针一样尖锐、敏锐或剧烈的”。
family_guide.core_distinction: acute 指敏锐的、病症急性的；chronic 指疾病慢性的、长期的。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of morphology that deals with the structure of animals
lemmas.def_zh: 剖析, 解剖学, 骨骼, 结构

examples.en: Medical students are required to master human anatomy during their first year.
examples.zh: 医学生在第一年必须掌握人体解剖学。

lemmas.usage_note: 指解剖学、人体结构或对事物的深入剖析，常用于学术或比喻语境，如 the anatomy of failure。

lemmas.def_en: an expression that relates to anatomy
lemmas.def_zh: [医] 解剖学的

examples.en: The museum features detailed anatomical models displaying various internal organs of animals.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出展示各种动物内脏的精细解剖模型。

lemmas.def_en: an expert in anatomy
lemmas.def_zh: 解剖学家

examples.en: The experienced anatomist carefully examined the rare skeletal structure under bright light.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的解剖学家在强光下仔细检查了罕见的骨骼结构。

lemmas.def_en: with respect to anatomy
lemmas.def_zh: 解剖, 结构上, 解剖学上

examples.en: Modern humans and Neanderthals were anatomically quite similar in many structural aspects.
examples.zh: 现代人与尼安德特人在许多解剖结构方面都非常相似。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the structure of the body
lemmas.def_zh: 解剖的, 结构上的, 解剖学上的

examples.en: The surgeon thoroughly explained the anatomic features of the patient's damaged shoulder.
examples.zh: 外科医生向患者详细解释了其受损肩膀的解剖特征。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To dissect an animal or plant to study its structure, or to analyze a subject in thorough detail.
lemmas.def_zh: 解剖, 仔细分析

examples.en: The essay skillfully anatomizes the root causes of modern economic inequality worldwide.
examples.zh: 这篇文章巧妙地剖析了全球现代经济不平等的深层根源。

family_guide.root_logic: ana-（向上，彻底）+ tom-（切），字面指“彻底切开剖析”，引申为解剖学。

lemmas.def_en: the thick white fluid containing spermatozoa that is ejaculated by the male genital tract

examples.en: The lab technician analyzed the sample of cum under a high-powered microscope.
examples.zh: 实验技术人员在高倍显微镜下分析了精液样本。

lemmas.usage_note: 源自拉丁语，常作连字符用以连接具有双重身份的词（如 bedroom-cum-study 兼作书房的卧室）；粗俗俚语中指精液。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语介词 cum（和，连同），英文中常以短横线构成连字符复合词，亦可作生理粗俗俚语。

lemmas.def_en: the rate at which energy is drawn from a source that produces a flow of electricity in a circuit; expressed in volts
lemmas.def_zh: 电压, 伏特数

examples.en: You need a special transformer because the voltage here is quite high.
examples.zh: 你需要一个专门的变压器，因为这里的电压相当高。

lemmas.usage_note: 指电压，高频搭配为 high/low voltage 或 mains voltage（市电电压），描述带电时常写作 high-voltage。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自物理学家伏特（Volta）之名 + -age（度量后缀），表示电势差。

lemmas.def_en: joyful religious song celebrating the birth of Christ
lemmas.def_zh: 颂歌, 欢乐的歌

examples.en: Children gathered on the snowy street corner to sing a joyful Christmas carol.
examples.zh: 孩子们聚在积雪的街角，唱起欢快的圣诞颂歌。

lemmas.usage_note: 通常特指宗教或圣诞赞美诗歌，常见搭配有 Christmas carol、sing carols。

lemmas.def_en: a singer of carols
lemmas.def_zh: 欢唱（颂歌）的人

examples.en: A cheerful caroler knocked on our door to spread holiday joy tonight.
examples.zh: 一位快乐的颂歌演唱者今晚敲响了我们的门，传递节日喜悦。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To sing cheerful Christmas carols or songs of joy, especially in groups outdoors.
lemmas.def_zh: 唱圣诞颂歌；欢唱，歌咏

examples.en: Groups of neighbors caroled from door to door throughout the holiday evening.
examples.zh: 邻里成群结队，在整个节日夜晚挨家挨户欢唱颂歌。

lemmas.usage_note: 表示欢快地歌唱或挨家挨户唱颂歌，多带文学色彩，常作不及物动词或接宾语。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自古法语 carole（伴有歌唱的圆圈舞），后演变为专门歌颂圣诞等节日的喜庆歌曲。

lemmas.def_en: a female deity
lemmas.def_zh: 女神, 美女, 受崇拜的女性

examples.en: Ancient Greeks built a magnificent temple dedicated to Athena, the goddess of wisdom.
examples.zh: 古希腊人建造了一座宏伟的神庙，献给智慧女神雅典娜。

lemmas.usage_note: 指女神（如 Goddess of Liberty），常与 of 连用；现代口语常用于修饰受极高崇拜或外貌出众的女性（a screen goddess）。

family_guide.root_logic: god（神）+ -ess（阴性后缀），指女性神祇。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or constituting the middle value of an ordered set of values (or the average of the middle two in a set with an even number of values)
lemmas.def_zh: 中央的, 中间的, 正中的

examples.en: The report indicates that the median household income has risen steadily this year.
examples.zh: 该报告指出，今年家庭收入中位数呈现稳定增长。

lemmas.usage_note: 作形容词表示统计学上的中位值的，或解剖/几何中的正中的，如 median income。

lemmas.def_en: the value below which 50% of the cases fall
lemmas.def_zh: 正中动脉, 中位数, 中线

examples.en: When extreme values skew the average, the median offers a much more accurate picture.
examples.zh: 当极端值使平均数失真时，中位数能提供更准确的概貌。

lemmas.usage_note: 作名词指统计学的中位数或道路中央分隔带（美式），常搭配 calculate the median。

family_guide.root_logic: 源自拉丁语 medius（中间的），核心意为处于正中间位置的数值或物体。

lemmas.def_en: not clearly understood or expressed; ; -Anatole Broyard; - P.A.Sorokin; - John Locke
lemmas.def_zh: 模糊的, 昏暗的, 难解的, 晦涩的, 偏僻的, 微贱的, 无名的

examples.en: The researcher found an obscure reference to the treaty in an eighteenth-century journal.
examples.zh: 研究人员在一本18世纪的期刊中发现了一处关于该条约的冷僻记载。

lemmas.usage_note: 形容含义晦涩难懂或人、事物默默无闻，常修饰 passage、reason、author。

lemmas.def_en: [T] to cover something or block it from view; to make something difficult to see, hear, or understand
lemmas.def_zh: 遮掩，遮蔽；使模糊，使费解

examples.en: Thick clouds moved in rapidly to obscure the morning sun.
examples.zh: 浓云迅速聚拢，遮挡了清晨的太阳。

lemmas.usage_note: 及物动词，指遮挡视线、掩盖真相或使理解困难，常接 view、truth、meaning 作宾语。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being unclear or abstruse and hard to understand
lemmas.def_zh: 阴暗, 朦胧, 晦涩, 费解, 身份低微

examples.en: The indie band rose from total obscurity to international fame almost overnight.
